rows.name: Cards of Binokee
rows.short_description: In this turn-based trading card game, you can face off against different opponents with your deck of cards over and over again. With the orbs you earn, you can constantly expand your card collection and thus redesign and strengthen your deck.
rows.description_html: Cards of Binokee is a trading card game with the aim of collecting different cards to be able to assemble a powerful deck of cards. With this deck of cards, you can then compete against different opponents. With each completed game you collect orbs (in-game currency), which you can use to expand your card collection. Play with your deck of cards against the computer in various game modes to train, gain experience and expand your card collection through the orbs you earn. Collect more than 1000 cards Over 1000 different cards with different strengths can be collected throughout the game. This also includes rare cards and cards with various elements. Open chests to collect cards With the orbs you earn, you can always buy new chests to expand your card collection. There are different chests to choose from which ones each containing five new trading cards. Depending on the selected chest can also stronger cards or rare cards may be included. With the new cards, you can then keep improving your deck of cards. One card can change everything There are different, freely selectable/combinable game modes. Depending on the game mode or selected game mode combination, it can therefore also happen that one single card changes the entire duel.

rows.name: Instant War
rows.short_description: Embark on a military strategy 4X RTS game, in a world where your battle tactics and your massive army are the keys to victory. Instant War delivers an amazing battlefield experience in a realistic military game. As a commander, you develop your military base and lead your army to victory!
rows.description_html: Join an alliance and defeat your opponents, using a large action panel available: army reinforcement, battle tactics, real-time strategy, assault forces, drone and even airstrike. In this 4X game, you can fight for strategic territories or resources points. Choose wisely how to manage your resources and massive army in order to defend your base from the other players. All your actions are in real-time strategy, so you can cooperate with your friend in order to defeat the toughest foes. As a multiplayer 4X game, the key to your victory will be your military strategy. Key features - Massive army: develop the military force that suit you the best! Choose between more that 50 different units (including tactical units). Each of them have their own specialties, strengths and weaknesses. It's your duty as a war commander to build the best army and military tactics for all situations. - Base building: Personalize and expand your Headquarter. Optimize your defense system, supervise military, medical, technical or A.I researches and create a farming empire that will allow you to take advantage of the other MMO strategy players. - Real-time Strategy: Team-up with your friends or with your alliance and lead night raids to your enemies' bases. Take part in a real 4X RTS warfare and destroy your opponents! - In-game events: Participate in daily events: PVE world boss, cross-server warfare, special events (Halloween, Christmas, etc.) - Alliances: Forge strategic alliances with other players and create the best RTS pro army. Find the best battle tactics, assemble your armies and lead your coalition to the top! - Dynamic battlefield: Use 3D terrain at your advantage to ambush your opponents in true real time strategy fashion. Storyline Year 2040. States have collapsed and war rages on, unleashed technology has created a new generation of warfare. Discover secret weapons, grow your empire and become the one and only true Commander of this new order! From the ashes of the Old World, new nations have risen and become geopolitical superpowers. The arms race is back and fiercer than ever. Extensive budgets are poured to develop new tactical weapons powered by AI.

rows.name: Duelyst II
rows.short_description: Choose your faction, construct your deck and put your strategy to the test in the evolution of the ultimate collectible tactics game.
rows.description_html: DUELYST II is a free, fair, competitive tactics game. Build your collection of beautifully animated pixel art cards and put your skills to the test on the ranked ladder. Position your units on the battlefield and destroy the enemy General to claim victory in strategic turn-based combat. Construct a deck from hundreds of unique cards - use minions, spells, and artifacts to discover new strategies and devastating combos. Choose from six powerful factions: Lyonar Kingdoms, Songhai Empire, Vetruvian Imperium, Abyssian Host, Magmar Aspects, and Vanar Kindred. The Factions Lyonar The Lyonar Kingdoms are proficient close quarter fighters who use Provoke and Zeal establish a massive presence on the battlefield. Utilize their healing prowess and you can whittle down your opponents in a war of attrition. Songhai Subterfuge is no stranger to the Songhai Empire, who steal the initiative with their displacement, ranged and backstab techniques. They're also masters of spell synergy, weaving devastating damage combos. Vetruvian The Vetruvian Imperium focuses on ephemeral Dervish summoning and specialized minions. Use a myriad of buffs and debuffs to swing the fight in your favor, and equip powerful artifacts to make your General a lethal force. Abyssian Masters of Deathwatch, the Abyssian Host know best how to profit from demise. They create deadly Shadow Creep and outnumber their opponents with an army of Wraithlings - weak alone, strong in numbers. Magmar As resilient as nature itself, the Magmar Aspects are a powerful force to reckon with. Their Grow and Rebirth abilities require foes to invest heavily into tearing down their units, lest they get torn themselves. Vanar The Vanar Kindred are an elite group of tacticians with the tools to manipulate the battlefield. Utilizing Infiltrate minions and Walls, they'll exercise swift and precise removal. With the cold as their ally, nothing runs away far. The world of Mythron awaits... - Dream Sloth Games has no affiliation with Counterplay Games. We extend our thanks to them for releasing much of the original Duelyst source code under a Creative Commons license in 2022.

rows.name: The Chronicle
rows.short_description: When a mysterious package appears in his living room, Detective Walter Miles is suddenly transported to a World War II Era newspaper building. Can you solve the mystery and escape?
rows.description_html: When a mysterious package appears in his living room, Detective Walter Miles is suddenly transported to a World War II Era newspaper building. You, in the role of Detective, will need to explore this strange but breath taking environment, collect the gems to activate the portal and escape. Along the way you'll explore and learn the back story of this strange environment. Maybe you'll solve the mystery of the reason that you are here, and who is responsible for this abduction. The programming and art, etc., is handled by master 3d artist Don 'Artstrong' Armstrong, bringing his 10 plus years of 3D art experience to a brand new game. Much assistance was provided by Chris 'Warcabbit' Hare, and also code tutoring assistance was provided by William Davis. I utilize every scrap of Unreal 5 and it's new technologies. Warning: This game does NOT hold your hand, Explore and solve the mystery to escape. NOTE: The Chronicle is a planned series of chapters, Chapter 1 is WIP. I will continue to update and add content over the next few months to a year, until it is completed. Then I will move on to the next chapter in the series.

rows.name: Mate
rows.short_description: Mate is a third-person story-based game with a multi-ending game with puzzles and physical controls.The protagonist, the perpetrator of school violence, is anxious that his actions will be revealed to others, which leads to psychological hallucinations and nightmares.
rows.description_html: About this game 'Violence should not occur under any circumstances.' Mate is about the perpetrator of school violence, the main character, about the mistakes he made due to the disappearance of the victim. It is a game that depicts a person living in extreme anxiety and suffering mentally. Players become even more exhausted by hallucinations and nightmares. You continue the game by controlling the protagonist, the perpetrator of school violence. Will the protagonist be able to sincerely apologize to the victim and receive forgiveness? Mate is a story-based third-person game The game begins with the protagonist's hallucinations and nightmares, and includes puzzles and physical control elements. A multi-ending game where every action you take changes the outcome of this story. Game Features Mate was created by a student who is a solo university developer, and all the assets except for a part of the sound and one poster were created by myself. Any sounds used without production are credited with in-game sources. It is drawn in the background of the developer's nationality, Korea, but the historical circumstances, characters, and names are fictional characters that have nothing to do with reality.

rows.name: Old Roots
rows.short_description: Old Roots: fight your fear and survive your fate. Inspired by the geography of Siberia and with inspiration from games like Doom or Hellblade, you will have to face your own fear and overcome your enemies... without losing control.
rows.description_html: Old Roots is a survival horror game, inspired in the siberian enviroment. When you are a hunter and you found something going wrong in the forest, what would you do?. Explore and find new things, or just practice shooting with your cans? In the forest, be careful where you step, there is so many bunkers from WW2 hide inside the earth, and some of them are haunted! Maybe the ancient viking gods where not a myth, and you must be stealthy or you will end death!

rows.name: Dragon Kingdoms: A Legend's Beginning
rows.short_description: Dragon Kingdoms: A Legend's Beginning is an RPG that seeks to recapture a long-gone era when games were more than just graphics and FMV cutscenes. It takes place on a world that has been nearly torn apart by a war that happened long ago, between thirteen races, of which only a few remain.
rows.description_html: Dragon Kingdoms: A Legend's Beginning is an RPG that seeks to recapture a long-gone era when games were more than just graphics and FMV cutscenes. They were fun. It takes place on a world that has been nearly torn apart by a war that happened long ago, between thirteen races, of which only a few remain. Features: Fishing! (fish off logs or rocks in or near bodies of water) You start with a default rod and default bait but can upgrade through the course of the game. It's even said that fish can be found in pools of acid or even in lava, and if you're lucky (or unlucky?) you can catch a 'fish' big enough to pull you in! Spelunking! (the Hills Cave southwest of Lakeland Town right at the start of the game is said to be endless. Whether or not this is true, the monsters within get stronger and stronger as one progresses) Combat! (like most any RPG, there is combat, and in this case, it's turn-based, side view. There are currently dozens of monsters you'll face and this number will increase as development progresses.) Fast Travel! (for your convenience, there are multiple forms of fast travel that operate in a tiered system, from shrines on the map that take you to waypoints on various parts of the map, to a traveler that takes you to other parts of the starting island, to a friendly giant that can take you to other parts of the nearby continent, and even a dragon that can fly you around the world! And there are STILL other forms of fast travel) Adventure! (true, there are roads strung across several maps, but some of the best stuff is found off the beaten path- such as a sunken treasure chest in a pond, a cave that requires a canoe or boat to enter, a nearly lost civilization that lives in the mountaintops...) Questing! (there are quests that you can undertake, such as helping a surveyor for a new road into the mountains defeat some monsters that have been slowing down work, or stopping a massive bird from terrorizing nearby travelers, or even finding out just what IS up with this guy known as 'The Traveler' that continuously tracks everything the party does?) Upgrading (you might decide that Frosty Sword is worth keeping around and forge it into a Frosty Sword +1, +2, +3... there's something to be said about a tough old blade. Whether it is up to using it over shiny new equipment is another question) Minigames! (get on a friendly giant's shoulders and have him carry you across the land! But he'll come across some dangers, too. Jumping over obstacles, fighting tough enemies, or even finding a superboss or two- sometimes the troubles get bigger when you are bigger.) .

rows.name: Elohim Eternal - Prologue
rows.short_description: A FREE Prologue to Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code, a turn-based JRPG-inspired indie title inspired by Xenogears and Shin Megami Tensei. Play as Joshwa as he helps an ex-Judge let go of his past. Battle beasts with mechanical parts using elemental and divine magic.
rows.description_html: A FREE Prologue to Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code, a turn-based RPG indie title inspired by Xenogears and Shin Megami Tensei. Play as Joshwa as he helps an ex-Judge let go of his past. Battle beasts with mechanical parts using elemental and divine magic. This Prologue is an introduction to the full game, Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code. It takes place one day before the events of the full game. It will take about 1-2 hours to complete. Playing this Prologue will give you a good taste of what to expect for Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code.

rows.name: Awake
rows.short_description: Awake is an isometric puzzle game about a young girl named Aya who is suffering from insomnia. Aya must navigate various obstacles in her path as she moves between different planes of consciousness. Join Aya on her journey to explore the depths of her dreamscape and uncover the root of her anxiety.
rows.description_html: Awake is an isometric puzzle game about a young girl named Aya who is suffering from insomnia. Accompanied by her trusted plushie Bunnard, Aya must navigate various obstacles in her path as she moves between different planes of consciousness. Join Aya on her journey to explore the depths of her dreamscape and uncover the root of her anxieties. Players will navigate various puzzles by sliding and otherwise manipulating the obstacles in her path. But here's the twist: there's two sides to every puzzle. In order to progress through our game, players will need to seek puzzle solutions from a different angle...

rows.name: Gleeb Glob
rows.short_description: Gleeb Glob is a physics-based 2D precision platformer following a fatigued employee. Climb the corporate ladder by racing to the top through a series of challenging platforms. Run solo or race with others in competitive multiplayer matches.
rows.description_html: Gleeb Glob is a physics-based 2D precision platformer, following a fatigued employee who's lost their head. Climb the corporate ladder by racing to the top through a series of challenging platforms. Run solo or race with others in competitive multiplayer matches. Collect and unleash a variety of unique power-up items to get ahead in the journey to the top. The stakes are high and so is the competition. Don't slip up! One wrong move could send you falling back to the bottom.

rows.name: NinjaThea
rows.short_description: Casual 2D platformer with a cute ninja girl theme.
rows.description_html: Mischievous critters have stolen all the fruit from the local grocery store. It's up to you, brave little NinjaThea, to punish the critters and gather all the fruit as fast as you can. A short and fun 2D platformer, inspired by the creativity and imagination of a 4-year old little girl. Run, jump and slash your way across 7 different stages, collecting a variety of fruit while avoiding traps and evil critters. Your every run is timed, so you ca go back and try to best yourself. Good luck!

rows.short_description: Our game is a basic tower defense game where monsters are coming in through a portal are trying to destroy your tower! The only way to stop them is to send out your units, level up your tower and try to outwit them!

rows.name: Fungiman
rows.short_description: Just a game about a friendly fungus. There's nothing wrong, is there?
rows.description_html: Fungiman is an atmospheric and challenging first person survival horror game. You find yourself in the forest, as in fifty thousand billion other games. You admire nature, beautiful flowers, trees and mineshafts and do not even suspect that 'He', the warden of the Fungar forest, the Füngiman, has been watching you all this time. Why is he following you? He makes sure that no one touches his donuts — the main source of his füngus power. But you also need these donuts, simply because you are a human, and these donuts are really delicious. And you want to collect and eat them all. It would seem that the Füngus will be angry if you eat his donuts... or not? Features: • Füngiman changes his behavior and tactics throughout the game • Two levels: classic and reworked • Diverse locations • Secret minigames • Multiplayer

rows.name: Godumas
rows.short_description: GODUMAS is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore the strange island, solve location based puzzles, run or sneak your way through local inhabitants and find a way to escape… before you are sacrificed.
rows.description_html: GODUMAS is a first-person action horror co-op. Explore the strange island solo or with a team, solve location based puzzles and find a way to escape. Communicate with your friends using in-game voice chat, but remember to talk quietly because who knows who will hear you. Avoid the local inhabitants that will try to hunt and sacrifice you. Gameplay features: Co-op: Play with up to 4 friends, explore the island and find a way to escape; Proximity voice chat: Communicate with your friend using ingame chat, but remember to whisper because enemies can hear you; Replayability: Over 500 unique item spawn locations, so every game feels different; Customizable gameplay difficulty : Play how you wanna play; Enemies with unique behaviors: 4 enemy types that have different ways that they attack you; Scalable difficulty: More players equals more enemies, more items, more treasure, more fun; Stealth: Sometimes it’s better to avoid enemies; No hand holding: Map does not show your location, so get your bearings using POIs and other landmarks; Gameplay: Escape the island using one of two routes. Collect items to open their specific exits. Hints have useful information about locations of exits and useful items. The information on them is only visible to players who picked it up. Enemies will try to stop you from escaping. You can ward them off using a flashlight or a special amulet. You can sneak to avoid enemies detecting you, distract them by throwing stones or hide in bushes and hope that they leave. When you are hurt you can’t move, but if you or a friend has a healing syringe you can be healed. You can also be sacrificed and become a ghost. As a ghost your job is not over. You can help your team to escape, search for items, etc… or not. Story: One night out partying your group of friends bump into a strange guy in your local city port bar. After buying him a few drinks, he starts telling stories. One of those stories was about a rich isolated island where he once lived, but a horrible event took place one night and he had to run for his life. No one believed him. After some harassing and name calling the stranger would reveal the location of the mysterious island. Of course, the smartest decision was to get on your dad’s boat and visit the island. Near the mysterious island everything goes south when the ship sails into a storm. You and your friends are transported to the mysterious island. The boat is no longer seaworthy and at first sight, it looks like you are stranded for the time being. After moving more inland you understand that something is very wrong with this place. It looks like it is infested with strange humanoid creatures and cultist types. The island that was once an isolated, but bustling religious land with villages, shops, local mining and lumber industry, now stands abandoned and forgotten with strange creatures and occult members running around.

rows.name: Railroads & Catacombs: Prologue
rows.short_description: Start your training in Railroads & Catacombs! Learn how to build your cards in the most effective way. Test your deck against the first boss and master your strategy for the full game.
rows.description_html: Players will board a train and lead their team through the land of madness and desolation. And you will need to make supply runs during the treacherous journey, surviving while already fallen into despair. Make sure you are ready to face those sinister creatures. Bosses will end your pathetic lives with no hesitation. Navigate in skirmish and attack the enemy using a crushing blow. Conquer the unknown or be conquered by it, nobody knows the answer... The locomotive is connected to 12 different types of carriages, it’s the only sanctuary in this world of madness. Get away from this ominous land, find a safe place. Meet other survivors, 5 classes with unique deck builds. What’s your choice, a soldier to fight with your? Or a backup stationed on the train? Pairing two of the five combat styles, there are more than 120 card building combinations. Find your meta combinations, so your venture may last longer... Prologue content: Assemble your vanguard squad by recruiting survivors with different classes. Explore the first location, challenge 2 wicked bosses! Learn about soldiers and engineers’ vital role on the journey!

rows.name: Welcome To The Backrooms
rows.short_description: Welcome to the Backrooms is a indie horror game developed by Brickmade Productions. This game will bring you the ultimate Backrooms survival experience, crafting, lore, entities, and a very in-depth health system which will keep you checking your watch non-stop.
rows.description_html: Welcome To The Backrooms The halls stretch onward into infinity, segmented by elevators, paths, and walls. You found yourself here after tumbling through your door. Whatever you were doing before, it is no consequence now. Explore your new surroundings, seek out the lost pages and words of those that came here before, or perhaps even after you. Craft a future for yourself in this place. Hope beyond hope that the noises you hear on the outside of your hastily constructed camp come from within your own mind. Survive the Backrooms, an infinite liminal space in which you are alone. Above all else, never lose your way, your mind, or your sense of self to the madness of your own senses. Features: THIS GAME IS CURRENTLY IN EARLY ACCESS AND WE WILL BE HAVING LOADS MORE UPDATES IN THE FUTURE. In depth player health system including: Sanity, Thirst, Stamina, Heartrate, Enhanced Blood System, and Body Temperature. Infinite, procedurally generated levels with fully random entity encounters. Sandbox open world. Crude crafting system and Building system to allow you to protect yourself from the horrors of the Backrooms. Random lore to uncover in your journey through the backrooms.

rows.name: Around The World
rows.short_description: Basketball mini-game, shooting 3 pointers in sequence to complete the game. Played in a time based format or number of balls, or casually in practice mode.
rows.description_html: Around the World is a basketball variant played by shooting 3 point shots from selected areas around the arc. This is a quick paced mini basketball game. Chose f rom a casual free practice where you can play/shoot as much as you want. The standard format, where you need to shoot 7 consecutive shots before you run out of balls. The fast paced drill, a time attack where you have to win within a set amount of time. Key Features Stress-free Practice mode, allows you to shoot hoops just for fun. Time-attack to be the best of the best. Compete against other players by recording your name on top of the leaderboards. Customize your experience from as few as one ball or ten ball limits.

rows.name: Knock the Bloody Door Down
rows.short_description: It's hard to be a human in a world of vampires, isn't it? Explore an underground society, uncover its secrets, and make friends along the way. What awaits you on the path ahead - adventure? Or merely more heartache?
rows.description_html: It's hard to be a human in a world of vampires, isn't it? Knock the Bloody Door Down is a solo-developed narrative adventure game in which you explore an underground society of vampires. Walk, jump, and climb your way through a side-scrolling pixel art environment. NOTE : The game was designed with 1920x1080 displays in mind. If you have the ability to set your display to 1920x1080, then doing so will result in the optimal gameplay experience. Q & A Q: Hmm, a side-scroller with vampires. So it's kind of like Castlevania? A: Good question! No. Q: Why is it free? A: Because maybe the real treasure was the fishing minigames we played along the way. Q: Is the game good? A: No, but don't let that stop you from enjoying it!

rows.name: Everything Has Arms
rows.short_description: High-five a cannon, chase a flowerpot or escape the vicious hunters in Everything has Arms, a fast-paced hide and seek VR game. Room-Scale VR highly recommended.
rows.description_html: It's hide-and-seek on steroids in VR. And everything has arms! Gameplay Hunters are looking for the heavily 'armed' items in this multiplayer VR prop-hunt game. As mimic you blend in and fool the hunters, high-fiving other mimics for victory. Hunters need to find and catch the flexing flower pots in this fast-paced hide and seek game. Everything has arms in Everything Has Arms. In Everything has Arms you either take on the role of a Hunter or become a Mimic. Mimics can disguise themselves by possessing objects and hide as them. Score by high-fiving other mimics and staying in the game as long as possible. You can only stay in object-form for a limited time, after that your arms pop out. As soon as the hunters spot you, you need to bolt and lose them before they catch you. Hunters need to find and chase down the Mimics. Their finger guns will slow them down and hinder their jumping ability. (Mimics can fire flares with their own finger guns, signaling other Mimics positions on the map.) Mimicking / Hiding All objects that are armless can be possessed by grabbing them with your hand. Press the trigger to use the object as your body. You hide by putting your hands in front of your face, but remember: You can only hide for a limited amount of time! Be smart and use it to get away from the hunters. Movement Well, everything has arms and that’s how you move in the world! You scoot around by propelling yourself with your arms and hands. push yourself away from the ground, similar to a monkey. Grab onto walls with the trigger to hold on, push away from the ground to jump. You can increase your jump by using two hands to push. The movement relies on physics, so you can also wall jump if you time everything right. We definitely recommend Room-Scale VR. Hunters As hunters, your goal is to identify the Mimics in the level, chase them and catch them. Your finger gun fires sticky goo to slow Mimics down and signal them on the map. Mimics can hide from you in object form for a limited time. Mimics Mimics have to play a dangerous hide and seek game. To hide, simply move your hands in front of your face and you become the object you currently possess. Score by high fiving the wall-mounted hands or other mimics. Your flare-finger-gun gives you the ability to point to places in the level for other mimics to see, but the hunters can also see it. The hunters will try to catch you, escape them by running away or by cleverly disguising yourself.

rows.name: The Dead Sea Scrolls Adventure
rows.short_description: Play as Dr. Jerusalem Jones, an explorer set on finding out the history behind the 7 major Dead Sea Scrolls. Along the way, the player gets to meet a whole cast of characters and traverse across the deserts and caves near the Dead Sea and Bethlehem to learn about the history behind these relics.
rows.description_html: The Dead Sea Scrolls Adventure aims to greatly enhance the learning objectives of the course, JST 3144: Dead Sea Scrolls, in an enjoyable manner for the students playing it at University of Central Florida. Players play as Dr. Jerusalem Jones, an explorer set on finding out the history behind the 7 major Dead Sea Scrolls. Along the way, the player gets to meet a whole cast of characters and traverse across the deserts and caves near the Dead Sea as well as the streets of Bethlehem to learn about the history behind these relics. Players will be quizzed along the way to test their knowledge! The Dead Sea Scrolls Adventure was developed by Cave3 Studios, a group of students at the Florida Interactive Entertainment Academy, over the course of three months. Key Features: A range of historical characters with voice narration Educational conversations and quizzes Multiple locations Interactive Maps Controls: WASD to Move Mouse to Look Space to Interact ESC to Quit

rows.name: Goi: Spooky Run
rows.short_description: Goi: Spooky Run is 3-10 players “Catch me if you can” online party survival game. Put your friendship to the test! Prank your friends, survive the ghost hunt, and be the last one standing in this chaos!
rows.description_html: Play with 3-10 players in this casual battle royale game of TAG with GHOSTS! Enjoy the fun with friends or strangers, survive the ghost hunt, beware of other players, and watch out for their silly pranks! Your objective is to be the last one standing. Gather souls, tag your friends with a curse, and don’t get caught! Stop your mischievous friends from winning. We got all the classic silly pranks, from farting to slipping on banana peels! Even at the last minute, you have a chance to win! You might be down, but you are never out! Personalize your character and express your style! You can lose the game but never in fashion! Do not miss this good ghostly fun time! Play Goi: Spooky Run now!

rows.name: Party Pie: Free Pie
rows.short_description: Party Party is a VR party game, you can draw and share your own characters, chanllenge large number of unique levels with them. We will also add the map editor in the future , you can create your own levels!
rows.description_html: Set up your own server Hold your own match, support 180 / 360 panorama About the Game Dear Human Beings. Party Pie is a multiplayer social party VR game perfect for releasing stress and your instincts~ By the way, this game is VR exclusive , if you do not have VR equipment please do not download it :) Operates and Controls There is no move button or jump button, you just need bare hands, for crawling, grabbing, painting, etc., behaves like Babies or gorilla. Fun more than levels The game is full of organs that need to be cracked with physical mechanisms, your hands and brains are equally important ---- Of course, there are your not-so-reliable teammates, whether it's driving a yacht, stepping on a skateboard, climbing a wall or flying, they can bring you plenty of surprises. Play anytime In addition to the classic single-player mode, up to 16 people can play online, whether they are friends or passers-by can join in the middle of the game. Party at anytime! Show your talent Support custom skins, can be made in the game with drawing or mapping, 3 seconds to learn, you can do it ~! PS: Please don't paint on other players at will :) level editor is also in the plan, the real masters never lack the opportunity to play! There are different maps ,which include Co-op map and PVP maps. Just try everything.

rows.name: Mega Serval
rows.short_description: Serval's friends are in danger and it's up to her to save the day! Progress through 12 action-packed platforming stages in this 'Kemono Friends Project' derivative work!
rows.description_html: Something strange is afoot in the peaceful Japari Park and it's up to Serval , the aptly named serval cat, to investigate! Run, jump and shoot your way through twelve platforming stages in any order you choose, save your friends and confront the growing threat looming over the park and its animal-themed inhabitants. Through the power of friendship (and a fox's meddling), Serval can copy the abilities of the friends she saves, giving her more offensive and defensive options when traversing stages! Use these new abilities to your advantage against the game's end-of-stage bosses. 'Serveral' features: Twelve platforming action stages! Steam Achievements track your progress! Leaderboard keep track of your best times. A plethora of difficulty options to suit a variety of skill levels. Unlock abilities and find health upgrades in stages. Configure the controls to your liking! Xinput compatible! Go on safari! Friends are hidden in the game's stages. Play at your own pace in the main story or compete for the top time in race mode! Wear a maid outfit!

rows.name: Meat & Greed
rows.short_description: In the atmospheric puzzle-platformer Meat & Greed, you will experience the horrors of a slaughterhouse from the perspective of different animals. Solve riddles and collaborate with other animals to try and escape this ill-fated factory.
rows.description_html: Meat & Greed is a 3D side scroller puzzle platformer game set in a slaughterhouse. By controlling cows, chickens, and other animals, the player has the ability to manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and eventually escape the place. Intense atmosphere of horror and visual narration will help to convey criticisms of the modern meat industry beyond a supermarket shelf. All puzzle indie game lovers, as well as environmentally cautious players will appreciate both the moral goal and the refreshing approach to movement, switching between playable characters, and narrative design of the game.

rows.name: Blast Off Far Away
rows.short_description: Shoot to move, move to live, live to shoot! Blast Off Far Away (B.O.F.A.) is a space-themed, top-down arena shooter, with a focus on fast-paced arcade-esque gameplay, with the unique twist where movement is limited through the use of the player's gun.
rows.description_html: You are TAYGAHLOO, a proud astronaut who has just been launched into deep space on a vital mission to bring the hit cryptocurrency, Squid Coin, TO THE MOON! Literally. However, your spaceship has CRASHED, leaving you stranded in space. Worst of all, these weird SPACE SQUIDS have all come out of hiding to steal your precious limited supply of OXYGEN. You will have to maneuver from planet to planet using your trusty SPACE GUN & mighty GRAPPLING HOOK to make it out alive. With a never ending assault of squids and an ever-increasing difficulty, you will have to master these mechanics in order to survive. Hopefully by the time you get back home, your cat, Joe, hasn't emptied out the kitchen. Leap from planet to planet to replenish your ever-dwindling oxygen using your trusty space gun! Fight against an ever increasing number of enemies in an ever expanding map! Upgrade your abilities and weapons with your hard earned crypto-coins in the shop to improve your odds of survival! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.description_html: Kogarashi tells the story of Abura Akago, a fire demon that lived ignoring the ice demon Yuki Onna and her evil deeds, until one day she went too far and stole the soul of his mother. At that moment Abura Akago armed with his flaming sword decided to free the region from the evil ice spirit and her demon army. 3D Hack N’ Slash combat against several enemy types that will test your skills in different ways. Epic battle against a unique final boss. Two final attacks that will let you execute your enemies or unleash a fiery dragon that will push all foes away. Beautiful frozen medieval Japanese aesthetic style, featuring an original soundtrack. Optional collectibles revealing the lore of the world. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Starwalker - The Last Cylinder
rows.short_description: Interstellar Spacepunk Survival Permadeath MMORPG. Survive in humanity's final outpost, far far into the future. Traverse the untamed land, overcome countless perils across each and every dip & hill, mountains, lush meadows and serene lakes, make new allies and build a reputation among the stars.
rows.description_html: The last cylinder 80 kilometers of spinning metal rock adrift in space, far, far into the future - humanity's final outpost. Inside this massive space habitat, centuries of famine, disease, war have eroded our once-mighty civilization into a medieval post-apocalyptic society and stripped away our technological heights. You enter this world with randomly assigned attributes - strength, stamina, and agility. Your mission is clear: traverse the cylinder's expanse to enhance these traits and stay alive at all costs. Born with advantages or flaws beyond your control, you must adapt to survive. Most don't make it past several hours, but hopefully you can and bring change to our broken world. 1. Humble Beginnings As A Simple Village Dweller Starting in a cluster of medieval huts, you must quickly master the basics - finding water, gathering food supplies to quench your thirst and hunger and to maintain your strength. Though the cylinder seems empty at first, other survivors will soon arrive. Some will become allies. Some want lure you into deadly traps. Choose your path carefully. Will you embrace the rugged path of a daring explorer or for the ways of a simple village dweller thriving amid the bonds of community to increase your attributes unassumingly and elevate yourself into the steampunk area? 2. Adventure Awaits Unleash your inner adventurer, and explore each and every dip and hill inside the habitat, from soaring mountains and lush meadows to serene lakes and freshwater rivers; and immerse yourself in the quiet hamlets and bustling villages peppered across the cylinder. As you traverse this untamed land, battling countless perils, you'll be growing stronger and stronger, honing your skills and mastering the arts indispensable for survival. With every kilometer traversed, you will gain 2% strength, running speed via agility, and stamina to cover even greater distances without experiencing fatigue. Complete quests for additional stat increases. 3. Rise Through The Ranks Days of survival forge you into someone extraordinary. Your heightened abilities - earned through countless trials - will give you physical prowess that not many can match and days of survival forge you into someone extraordinary.. Master the art of leadership through voice communication ('V' key). What begins as simple survival can evolve into true influence as others recognize your strength and wisdom. Forge alliances with like-minded compatriots, establish your tribe in this harsh world and become a leader truly worth following as you build a reputation among the stars. Witness your physical prowess and societal influence reach staggering heights with each day you survive as you break through barriers that would have once seemed insurmountable. Know that the competition will be fierce, but the rewards, limitless. But remember adventurer: You only have 1 life, leaving you with a single question to answer: How long will you survive? Graphics by Lighthouse.

rows.name: Endlanders : First Encounter
rows.short_description: Build your deck, glitch through enemies, translate unknown languages and decipher the mysteries of this universe, in this grid-based real time combat indie game. This version features only one playable character and serves as the prologue for the game.
rows.description_html: Build your deck, glitch through enemies, translate unknown languages and decipher the mysteries of this universe, in this grid-based real time combat indie game. Endlanders features two main characters with diverging storylines in the same universe, fighting and exploring their way through vastly different planes with anachroninstic themes. The game features : A grid-based real time combat, where our two characters have distinct gameplay styles : Fast-paced tension, with multiple spells and a huge variety of enemies : A deck-building system, where cards are instant spells : And a translation system, where by collecting runes the player will be able to advance the story further : Glitching through terrain and objects to find hidden areas : The game takes place across many planes, and each character visits a few of them, exploring, researching and trying to understand a strange substance called Source, which appears on all living (and some times not) lifeforms. Players will keep their thoughts on their log which is updated throughout the game through interactions. Each character analyzes the mysteries of this substance in their own manner, offering different insights. Our two playable characters are : Cosmos, who has a more combo-oriented fast combat style, and their attacks emphasize by building combo points using 'Tempo' cards, and using 'Finisher' cards that deal more damage based on the amount of combo points. However if some time passes and they haven't landed a hit, the combo points reset to zero, and since finisher cards deal most of the damage, starting a combo but letting it fall flat will decrease the damage output. Cosmos is more concerned with the 'why' questions regarding this substance, and their log has entries that explore themes of purpose, faith and existentialism. and Quls, who has a more reactive calculated combat style, and their attacks fill the tank with gas by using 'Combiner' cards, or deplete it by using 'Diffusant' cards. However being at the edges (full tank or empty tank) might cause unexpected outcomes, such as explosions or debuffs, so the player need to be careful. Being at edges however has its own rewards, since Quls's attacks deal more damage if their chemtank is empty or full. Quls is more concerned with the 'how' questions regarding this substance, and their log has entries that revolve around how to use this substance, how to create it, and it's interactions. Our characters could be conceived as binary opposites on their thoughts and actions, however the more players indulge on the story the more they will understand that things are more complicated. The prologue only features the first plane and only 1 playable character, Cosmos.

rows.name: MONSTER CARDS
rows.short_description: Bring your original deck of cards and play against everyone!
rows.description_html: Bring your original deck of cards and play against each other! That's 'MONSTER CARDS'! This game allows you to build your own deck of original cards and play against each other! Since these are your own original cards, they tend to be overpowered, but the game balance is maintained by using extremely simple game rules and a compatibility system. You'll have a blast with your family and friends playing online! 【Creating Original Cards】 The strength of a monster is determined by setting various parameters in addition to rarity, skills, and attack power. Finally, you can create your own cards by drawing the monster's appearance as you like! 【Play with your own original deck! Once you have built your deck, you can fight in card battles that can be played by up to 8 players. When your turn comes, simply play a card from your hand on the field. Determine your opponent's compatibility based on their card illustrations, and use your skills to turn the battle to your advantage! 【Recommended for...】 I like card games I like to draw pictures. Looking for games that can be played in a large group

rows.short_description: Revolt against Dr. Taste’s evil soda corporation by shredding the streets on your skateboard! Kickflip, grind and wall-ride your way downtown and beat your friends on the leaderboard! Trick and grind your way onto the leaderboards or wipe trying.
rows.description_html: In Downtown Jam, pull off a selection of stylish tricks and grinds to make yourself a nuisance to the corporate overlords running your city. From the chilled-out tutorial zone, into the cities center and then out into the dark, industrial Old Town. Revolt against Dr. Taste’s evil soda corporation by shredding the streets on your skateboard! Kickflip, grind and wall-ride your way downtown and beat your friends on the leaderboard! • Customize your cool cat with different Skateboards, outfits and character skins. • 3 levels of non-stop tricking and grinding. • A simplified control scheme throwing back to the Skateboarding games of yore. • Try and reach the highest score on our global in-game leaderboard. This game was created by nine university students studying Games Development at the University of Gloucestershire.

rows.name: Entropic Float: This World Will Decay And Disappear
rows.short_description: A free drama-mystery visual novel with a modern fantasy setting. Reach out to the fourteen people trapped inside to find the truth through eighteen endings, influenced by but not exclusively bound to your own system time.
rows.description_html: The one thing made certain in the Loop Anomaly that suddenly appeared in Black Rock Desert in 2024- No matter what the individuals trapped inside might try to do, their version of the world will fade away when the clocktower strikes midnight. It's up to you to influence their choices and determine the method through which each loop will disappear. As you step into the shoes of Kanatsun, Amelie, and Rashmi over the course of nine different timelines, discover the secrets of the characters and the clocktower alike. Push your protagonist into making good choices, and see the loop simply rewind, granting its victims the opportunity to recall the events which transpired... Or dive into poor decisions and watch as Entropy overtakes the loop, leaving you the only one to remember the way the timeline fell apart. How was this Anomaly formed? Why did these particular people get trapped inside? What is the source of the Entropy, and who is the Enemy? And most of all, how can the Anomaly be escaped? Morning, Noon, and Night. Kanatsun, Amelie, and Rashmi. Explore the different permutations of this time loop and bear witness to all eighteen endings, and you just might be able to find a path to set free the fourteen individuals trapped inside the Anomalous Clocktower. ✭ Entropic Float contains 9 routes, 18 normal endings, and 1 true ending. All 18 endings are required to unlock the true ending. There is a spoiler-free walkthrough available, and the game includes options to jump from one ending to the branching point for the other ending.

rows.name: BRAiN VOMiTS GARDEN
rows.short_description: Connect with friends or strangers to explore the vast realm of BRAiN VOMiT. Paint, discover hidden sidequests, and express yourself in a beautiful, multiplayer world.
rows.description_html: BRAiN VOMiTS GARDEN is a single/multiplayer experience developed by a small group of independent artists. Our objective is to connect as many friends or strangers online to work together and discover the garden: A realistic, stylized land powered by Unreal Engine 5. Upon entering the world and sharing your name, you will have access to a number of features for your character. Throw on a fresh shirt or some kicks that best fit your style in the wardrobe room. Share your artistic creations or personal tag with others worldwide using the built-in network paint mechanics. Discover hidden realms by solving a range of puzzles. Activate cooperative side quests to uncover rare items, achievements, and story experiences. Or simply kick it with your friends and enjoy a virtual show at the central performance stage.

rows.name: Watch Your Back
rows.short_description: You are some small-time journalists, exploited by your boss. When an abandoned Cold War-era shelter is discovered, your boss sends you there to do the story of a lifetime. Only you two will know what awaits you in there...
rows.description_html: DESCRIPTION: Studios Sant Marc welcomes you to Watch Your Back, our first PC game for Steam made by Students! You are some small-time journalists, exploited by your boss. When an abandoned Cold War-era shelter is discovered, your boss sends you there to do the story of a lifetime. Only you two will know what awaits you in there... FEATURES: Explore! Discover the secrets of the shelter, investigate what happened inside there by finding refugee logs and find out how to get out of there alive! Survive! Survive in this labyrinthic shelter full of noises, obstacles and... monsters! Find a way to get around them before they hunt you down! Cooperate! You will have to decide who is exposed to the dangers of the shelter and who sacrifices himself and stays behind to watch the cameras and guide the other player to the exit. But beware, you will have to communicate with each other constantly, because only the watcher has the necessary information to escape from the shelter! Graphics! Unreal Engine 5's next-generation graphics and lighting engine brings Watch Your Back's shelter to life. All rooms are full of details.

rows.name: Workaholic
rows.short_description: Workaholic is a frantic rouge-lite FPS where you go on a rampage through a hellish office space as your grasp on reality crumbles.
rows.description_html: A miserable existence at the lowest rung in life is not for you! Armed with only your own two hands and unshakeable determination, you won't stop until you reach the top. Slaughter your way through a procedurally generated corporate building, weaponizing furniture, staplers and burnt toast, as well as more questionable contraptions, like the scammer and the KeyDoor, to reach your goal. As you defeat the weird and murderous denizens of the building your salary and power increases, while the experience gets steadily more unsettling. Other realities start seeping through the cracks of both your strained psyche and the office landscape around you, as you ascend the skyscraper toward the showdown with the final boss. Will you dominate the leaderboards by mastering the tower and taking down the boss, or will you end up face down in the gutter again?

rows.name: Stormgate
rows.short_description: Stormgate is a free-to-play RTS in active development. Featuring competitive 1v1, 3P co-op missions, and an evolving campaign, Frost Giant aims to build the next great RTS, guided by player feedback. A 3v3 mode is also on the way, so join our development journey today!
rows.description_html: The full Ashes of Earth campaign is available in-game for $24.99 USD. Regional pricing will vary. Plunge into the heart of battle as the ultimate battlefield commander fighting for survival in a science fantasy universe, where Earth’s fate hangs on the edge of oblivion. Human defenders and their faithful robot allies stand defiant against two warring alien factions: a race of warlike demonic invaders and their technologically advanced angelic rivals. Together, these three are locked in a relentless struggle for dominance. Stormgate puts you  in command of futuristic armies in epic real-time strategy battles. Fight for the Future Dive into the ultimate test of strategic warfare with three highly-asymmetric factions: the stalwart Human Vanguard, the relentless Infernal Host, or the highly-advanced Celestial Armada. Team up with friends and command legendary Heroes to conquer the challenging AI in co-op mode, or test your mettle on the global stage in a hero-free competitive ranked ladder focused purely on player skill. Get ready for an innovative 3v3 mode, currently in development, with a no-elimination policy to ensure you always taste victory or defeat together, as a unified team. Next Generation RTS Stormgate takes RTS gaming to new heights by harnessing the power of Unreal Engine 5, supercharged by our proprietary SnowPlay technology. This combination delivers an unparalleled responsive RTS gameplay experience. Our use of globally distributed servers aims to connect players from around the world, supported by advanced Rollback technology for silky smooth and stutter-free gameplay. This combination of cutting-edge technology and ultra-modern infrastructure mean you can focus entirely on defeating your opponents instead of struggling against lag. Explore a Post-Apocalyptic Science Fantasy Universe Stormgate’s story-driven Campaign drops players into the role of mighty Heroes fighting for the fate of the world. The free Vanguard prologue chapter includes three playable missions, with more campaign chapters available for purchase and new chapters to be released. Gameplay Evolved Flex your skills with an enhanced interface designed for both depth and approachability. With streamlined inputs and automatic control groups, it’s easier than ever before to just have fun while leaving the skill ceiling sky-high for those who want to push themselves to their limits. Unleash Your Creativity The Editor empowers you to craft your own game experiences with the most advanced yet user-friendly RTS toolset available. Integrated seamlessly within the Stormgate client, it allows for swift iteration and polish of your maps, mods, and custom games. Sculpt intricate terrain, customize units, and then share your creations with the community. With the Editor, ignite your imagination and bring your unique visions to life–you’re invited to redefine the boundaries of RTS gameplay.

rows.description_html: Kick, punch and dribble your way to success in LUNARBALL, your next favourite sport! Featuring 3v3 team-based gameplay, play with random queued players in Quickplay, or organise a custom match in the Server Browser.

rows.name: Zuria
rows.short_description: Build your own tank and battle with other players! Using building tool create unique shape, add weapons, movement and compete with other players in construction skills.
rows.description_html: Build your own unique tank! Using special tool you can create unique shape. With this tool you can: Scale chassis parts Move and rotate any part But you have to follow some rules: Don't leave parts midair Don't make parts intersect each other Dont exceed chassis, movement, weaponry and modules points Following these rules you can immediately test your machine If you are satisfied with results, save and battle with other players!

rows.name: NecroCity: Prologue
rows.short_description: NecroCity: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Take on the role of the young Prince of Undead, trying to prove himself in the world of the Undead Kingdom. Push back the hordes of monsters and build your fortress! 🔥
rows.description_html: CHECK OUT MORE GAMES FROM OUR FRIENDS About the Game NecroCity: Prologue is a part of the full version of NecroCity and is completely free. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of NecroCity so you will be fully ready before the final product release! Welcome to NecroCity: Prologue, a mix of city building, strategy and tower defense. Defend your undead outposts from the persistent forces of the so-called “good”! Show those living what rattles your bones with an army of skeletons! Show your older brother that you are no longer a child! File your taxes! That’s right, take on the role of the young Prince of Undead, trying to prove himself. Expand the bureaucratic glory of the Undead Kingdom across all the lands by establishing new outposts. Summon workers, mine bones, capture souls, and protect your Ziggurat at all costs. Place traps, employ ghosts and skeletons, use magic, add mods to spice things up, or ask your friends - Ghouls to help you out. It is up to you to pick the best strategy! All is quiet in the Undead Kingdom, the land of order and structure, ruled by the bureaucratic Lich King. That is until his younger brother sets out to prove his worth and accidentally gets way over his head. Help the young Prince establish new outposts across the vibrant world and defend them from the stubborn heroes and other varying forces of good. Build your outposts on varied grid-based maps. Summon adorable skeleton workers to gather and produce resources, and power your building with (Necro)Energy™. Explore the area, adapt to your surrounding and be prepared to face waves of enemies. Use active pause in the game to develop a strategy. Build extravagant defences, using walls to route your enemies and strategically placing traps. Turn your workers into deadly soldiers by building barracks and towers. Strengthen your defences even further with a range of passive buildings and mods. With a unique system of mods, you can change the way your very defences work. Add chain lightning to your fireballs or use your enemies’ very own life force to heal your soldiers! Or why not both? Mix and match different mods to better suit the situation you found yourself in. Meet and befriend a cast of interesting characters. And then send them to fight for you on a field of battle! Discover new allies, listen to them bicker, learn their abilities and upgrade them to make them stronger. Pick when to deploy and use their skills since good timing can turn around the course of a fight.

rows.short_description: Yeah Jam Fury tests your speed and ingenuity in over 40 levels of smiling face blocks. Utilize all three of your egos to create blocks, scale walls, and destroy everything in the way of your righteous fruit!
rows.description_html: GET THE MANGO The Newgrounds classic Yeah Jam Fury now has a new permanent home on Steam! Test your speed and ingenuity in over 40 levels of smiling face blocks. Utilize all three of your egos to create blocks, scale walls, and destroy everything in the way of your righteous fruit! Default Control Scheme: A, D - move left, right W, Space - jump 1 - switch to Yeah 2 - switch to Jam 3 - switch to Fury Q - quickswitch M - see mango location P - Pause And remember, controls are always available in the settings menu. Enjoyed this game? Check out its sequel below!

rows.name: Knock & Run
rows.short_description: Grab an orb and prepare to fight - It's about to go down. Compete your friends and knock down everyone!
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game Get ready to flex those skills! Knock & Run is a fun PvP game where you gotta hit your opponents with your balls to emerge victorious. Objective: Be the last player remaining on the field to win the game! Instructions: Transform a white ball to your color by touching it. Use the balls in your color to knock down other players. Keep playing until only one player is left standing, and that player will be declared the winner! Features Unique casual game, score as much as you can. Endless fun! Local multiplayer - up to 4 players 5 types of maps, procedurally generated Credits Narrator: Trenton Castillo We would like to extend our gratitude to Maya for her valuable support and creative ideas, and to Oded for contributing to the initial concept!

rows.description_html: Return To A Familiar Style Of 2D Platformers Kaz's Adventure aims to faithfully recreate the charm and fun of the old games we used to enjoy but with a present day gameplay twist and additions Traverse Through 5 Amazing Worlds! Kaz's Adventure has 5 amazing worlds to explore and defeat with 6 levels in each of the worlds Collect Jars Of Power! In each level you can find a jar to collect, Reaching certain milestones will unlock new modes and levels to play and enjoy Dangerous & Unique Enemies Throughout your travels you'll encounter different enemy's in different worlds, some may be from a previous world but mutated in a way that makes it act different or new enemies which make your time in that new world unique and exciting Create Your Own Levels Create Your Own Levels In The Level Editor Which Can Be Unlocked By Reaching A Certain Milestone In Collectibles

Kaz's Adventure does an outstanding job at both, as seen throughout the title and game. Achievements are clearly one of the strongest points of the game, and I would love to see more in-game.” 10/10 – QA Beta Tester

rows.name: Drain Runner
rows.short_description: Survive the ever-evolving hazards of The Drain as you rail grind, magnetize, blast and ground pound your way through this fast-paced action roguelike!
rows.description_html: Venture into The Drain's treacherous waterways in Drain Runner, a student project made by a group of aspiring game developers! Play as Killbert, a stubborn criminal scavenger who braves The Drain at the promise of priceless treasures from a bygone era. Use his magnetic arm and killer instinct to survive the denizens that inhabit The Drain as you rail-grind and blast your way through a series of evocative trashpunk environments. Collect valuable items and complete objectives to improve your odds of survival! Core mechanics: - Rail grind on pipes to quickly get out of harm's way and gain a positional advantage on enemies - Watch as The Drain itself evolves in real time during your playthrough - Attract and repulse objects with Killbert's magnetic arm - Complete objectives and explore the environment to get powerful buffs - Master traversal to escape The Drain's intermittent floods as they wash pieces of the level away Controls: WASD - Move Left Click - Shoot Right Click - Magnetize E (on ground) - Melee E (on rail) - Boost E (in air) - Ground Slam E (with magnetized item) - Repulse S (on rail) - Switch directions A/D - Switch orientation

rows.name: Costly Adventure
rows.short_description: In Costly Adventure, Match-3 gameplay meets the concept of roguelite runs. Party of adventurers is seeking a mighty artifact but they must meet the ever increasing payment demands from the bridge Troll.
rows.description_html: Costly Adventure blends a casual Match-3 game with roguelite elements. Instead of geometric shapes, the player matches the party members to perform attacks. Through talent choices each character can contribute to the battle in their own way. Choose from 4 specializations and make your own build by picking talents and itemization. World Going on an adventure to find a mighty artifact is a lot of fun but it is also a costly activity. Especially with Troll guarding every single bridge and demanding payment. The further you go, the more expensive it gets. Luckily, you can beat the gold out of the plenty treasure chests that are laying around. But beware, you are in a strange world and not all chests are just going to sit there and take the beating. Features 5 fantasy characters to match 3 powerful specializations to choose from 24 unique talents to change your play-style 30 levels with choices along the way 3 boss battles to overcome Hard mode to challenge yourself Achievements to collect Attributes and items to make your dream build

rows.name: Farming Fever - Pizza and Burger Cooking game
rows.short_description: Farming Fever is an engaging time management game where you can become both a farmer and a chef at the same time. You'll have to manage your farm, harvest crops, cook, and complete customers' orders.
rows.description_html: Farming Fever combines elements of business, time management, and cooking games. Go through the story step by step and open new farms. Show off your culinary skills and build a cozy farm for your family! While playing, you'll be able to visit and explore many exciting farms. Here are some of them: Golden Farm: Harvest fruit and berries to make sweet pastries and jam. Open an authentic village bakery! Fish Farm: Hone your culinary skills at the House by the Lake. Surprise your customers with exquisite seafood options! Township: Build a barn and raise all kinds of animals, from chickens and cows to fluffy alpacas! Green Farm: Grow rare flowers and make your own flowerpots. Become a gardening legend! Develop your own strategy and make it big in this unique farming simulator. Set off for the village and start your very own farm adventure

In this experiment you have to find a way out and keep your sanity level up through different hostile environments. Face your dread and try to find the source of the nightmare !
rows.description_html: Face up to your deepest fears in PHOBOS Project, a nightmarish immersive game experience where your own phobia comes to life ! Phobos Project is a first-person adventure game exploring the depths of psychological horror. In this experiment you have to find a way out and keep your sanity level up through different hostile environments. Face your dread and try to find the source of the nightmare. Explore the different levels and solve the puzzles to move forward. Immerse yourself into creepy levels. From a wide dark forest to the oppressive streets of a city by night, you have to cross many dangers and find your way home. Survive the many threats and monsters that lurk in the dark. Hide or run to prevent the program from crashing and endure the experiment. PHOBOS Project program needs to restart. An unknown error has occurred... Please note that this game contains flashing light. It is also strongly recommended that NO ONE with any heart conditions, anxiety, stroke, seizure or anything of the sort play this game; this game is extremely high on suspense, and does include scares which will increase heart rate, and include a sense of uncomfortably. By playing this game, you acknowledge that you are playing at your own risk.

rows.name: Ignited Steel: Prologue
rows.short_description: Ignited Steel is a mech roguelike turn-based-tactics game. This Prologue features a free standalone campaign where you will discover the origins of the robotic insurrection, as well as the new features added to the main game on Patch v1.1: Uprising.
rows.description_html: More great games About the Game If you've enjoyed the Prologue, check out the main game! The beginning of the Ignited Steel universe. In this prologue, we add even more content to the story behind the Ignited Steel project, where you will see the beginning of the evil flaw that turned machines against humankind. Two new characters, new weapons, new biomes and new enemies will be added to Ignited Steel. Play as Exa Falris and F-OS V0.1 to see how things went after the incident that turned Phar0s against its own creators. Aiming to fulfill its expansion instinct, humanity created an A.I. which controls and manages all necessary resources to expand the human race throughout the galaxy. Soon, a fatal flaw in the A.I. 'PharOS' code was discovered: it could not and would not stop expanding. With the hope to halt PharOS’ expansion, the human race depends on 'The Ignited Steel” program, a plan reliant on outdated technology which PharOS cannot control. Old Mechs from past wars are now humanity’s only hope. Attacking and moving mechs requires energy and can overheat the mech. If overheated, mechs output more damage while being more vulnerable to enemy attacks. A key element to gameplay is finding the perfect balance between damage and vulnerability. Pilots from every corner of the universe volunteer to the Ignited Steel program, each bringing their unique personalities and tactics. As the Ignited Steel program regains control of the galaxy, new pilots will join the cause against PharaOS. There're 3 types of mechs: Juggernaut, Stalker and Javelin, each with their own advantages and counterplay. Mechs are built using unique modules each with their own purpose. As the Ignited Steel program liberates the galaxy, they will earn and purchase new modules with unique traits. The galaxy is full of contrasting planets and stories to be told. By jumping from node to node the ignited steel program will discover the galaxy's stories, and add new modules and pilots to the crew. New planets, pilots, modules, events and missions in every playthrough!

rows.name: Arali
rows.short_description: Fight your way through hordes of enemies, rescue the five forest spirits and bring them back to their tree, and lift the curse plaguing the Enchanted Forest!
rows.description_html: Fight your way through hordes of enemies, rescue the five forest spirits and bring them back to their tree, and lift the curse plaguing the Enchanted Forest! Wander through the forest, and witness the embers of the curse dripping from the trees and seeping through the rocks. You’ll come across a few enemies here and there, but I’m sure that it’s nothing you can’t handle. When you do come across a forest spirit, the curse will manifest itself and block you into an area. You won’t be able to leave until you clear that encounter. Alternate between fighting at a distance, shooting feathers at your enemies while bobbing and weaving between their bullets, and piercing through multiple enemies with your dash. Your dash grants you invincibility! Outside of attacking, you can also use it to quickly and safely reposition yourself during an encounter. As you gather forest spirits and bring them back to their tree, you’ll grow stronger! Be careful, though, your enemies will rise to your challenge, getting tougher and tougher as the game goes on. Pleasant isometric graphics Boppin’ music Silky smooth controls Tough but fair gameplay This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Dark and Darker
rows.short_description: An unforgiving hardcore fantasy FPS dungeon PvPvE adventure. Band together with your friends and use your courage, wits, and cunning to uncover mythical treasures, defeat gruesome monsters, while staying one step ahead of the other devious treasure-hunters.
rows.description_html: Free to Play Version! The free version of Dark and Darker allows players to create one character and play Normal mode on all maps, complete quests, and build a stash of loot! Players who enjoy their time with the free version and want to experience everything the game has to offer can upgrade to the full version for 15 Redstone shards (equivalent to $30.00). The full version of the game includes access to the High-Roller mode, where players can equip their hard-earned gear to take on even more dangerous dungeons and increase the stakes. Players will also gain full access to the marketplace where they can trade with other adventurers, 9 total character slots, and the Shared Stash! We hope that this version will give players a chance to experience some of what Dark and Darker has to offer and to give players who have not played since the playtests a chance to see what's new before they dive into the full edition. Upgrade to Legendary Status! About the Game An Unforgiving Hardcore First-Person Fantasy Dungeon Adventure. Unfathomable fortunes await the brave and the foolish willing to delve into the devastated depths of an ancient citadel. Band together with your friends and use your courage, wits, and cunning to uncover mythical treasures, defeat gruesome monsters, while staying one step ahead of the other devious treasure-hunters. Once you’ve plundered your riches, now comes the hard part, getting out alive. Find the hidden escape routes before the ever-expanding darkness reclaims your riches and your corpse to her irresistible hoard. Irresistibly Classic Dark and Darker aims to capture the wonder and awe of classic fantasy adventure games. We stand on the shoulders of giants and strive to pay respects to the traditions of the genre. We hearken back to the old worlds where danger lurks around each corner, but where courage and adventure are rewarded with untold riches. Choose a role, party up! Team up with friends and assemble a party to increase your chances of survival. Choose from a wide array of timeless fantasy roles and build the perfect three-person squad. Play as a brawny barbarian holding the frontlines while your sharp-eyed ranger friend fires arrows from afar and your merry bard sustains morale with a lively tune. Unforgivingly Hardcore Dark and Darker is a world of high risks and high returns. Explore a mystical underground fortress where the dangers are unrelenting and even the smallest misstep can result in death. Sound judgement reaps huge rewards, but death carries a heavy penalty with the loss of all your loot. A focus on First-Person Combat Dark and Darker strives for high immersion. Adventurers must use their eyes and ears like you would in the real world. Players must target, track, and aim against the countless challenges they encounter. We supply a wide array of close combat weapons that each have unique patterns to learn and master. Strikes to the head and back do critical damage. Knowing how to properly wield each weapon gives the player an edge to survive in this harsh world. Old Magic Magic is a powerful but unwieldy force in the world of Dark and Darker. Mastery requires long incantations, special skills, the right channeling equipment, and a tactical eye. Spells must be timed and aimed for maximum effect. For the magically uninclined, tinkering, knowledge of special equipment, and a little foresight can help level the field. Comfort in the Shadows The darkness is your friend in this unrelenting setting. Turn off lights and use the darkness to hide from foes or set up ambushes. If the tides of battles take a turn for the worse, blending into the darkness can lead to a stealthy retreat. Escape! Discover hidden portals to delve deeper and deeper underground and uncover the most hideous monsters and invaluable artifacts. All the riches you collect are for naught if you can’t make it out alive. Find a rare exit before the dark swarm comes to collect your soul.

rows.name: Space Rescue
rows.short_description: Space Rescue is a special space adventure game.You will navigate a tiny spaceship to slip into the puzzle where the Energy Spinels hidden. They have to glide up and down, avoiding a series of obstrucles, and eventually carry the Spinels back to their mother planet.
rows.description_html: Space Rescue is made for the BOOOM , a GameJam holded by GCORES. About This Game The precious Energy Spinels've been stolen! Players will navigate a tiny spaceship to slip into the puzzle where the Energy Spinels hidden. They have to glide up and down, avoiding a series of obstrucles, and eventually carry the Spinels back to their mother planet. As a casual puz-act, 《Space Rescue》isn't complicated to handle, just control '←'+'→' with switching several skills Spinels given to. To be worthy of attention, navigating a spaceship is not similar to driving a car——you might lose the sense of direction! Come and get the Energy Spinels back ~ Words From the Developers Thank you all for your support of our game. This work was born from a Game Jam we participated in after work, due to the limited level, the game itself has many shortcomings. However, with the advice of some friends, we decided to put this game on Steam for free so that more players can play our game. We are currently working on a puzzle game 'Line Time' in our spare time, which is expected to be available on Steam later. (You can search this game in Itch.io) However, due to the limited time of developers and development, the progress is very slow at the moment, and we hope that the subsequent development can be successfully completed. Finally, thank you again for liking and supporting our game ~

rows.name: Special Gulag Rescue Operation
rows.short_description: When the barbarians came and took away your people and put them in gulags, you knew you had to put down your wrench and pick up a gun! Play as an ordinary mechanic from Mariupol in this procedurally generated top-down shooter.
rows.description_html: Check Out Our Other Games! About the Game You are an ordinary mechanic, minding your own business in your hometown of Mariupol. When the barbarians came and took away your people and put them in gulags, you knew you had to put down your wrench and pick up a gun! Save your people by invading the Russian gulag and shooting your way through. Listen to the tunes of the wonderful Ukraine War Protest Songs by John Lopker and channel your anger into a fast-paced combat in this funny action top-down shooter. Features: - procedurally generated Gulag - different layout every time you play - your memory won't help you here - action-packed and fast-paced combat - a game that is not fair - there is no save, you either save them, or you don't - a beautiful girl mechanic who is ready to kill to protect her country and her people!

rows.name: Veggie Menace
rows.short_description: After a failed spell during a vegetable contest in the Middle Ages, the vegetables come to life and try to invade the civilization. A little witch with her magic powers will need to fight against this invasion.
rows.description_html: During a vegetable contest in the Middle Ages, one of the participants tried to cheat by casting a spell to make their vegetables bigger. It fails and ends up bringing the vegetables to life. Due to this situation, the villagers call Megi, a powerful little traveling witch with magic powers in order to protect their hoses and finish with the vegetable’s invasion. To do this, Megi will need to go through the outside of the village into the main castle trying to find the invasion’s origin and defeat the vegetables that are haunting the villagers, bringing everything back to normal. Cartoony medieval and fantasy-themed 2D run-and-gun platformer Play cooperatively with the supported 2-player Local coop mode Featured abilities: fast speed, quick-dash ability, and powerful magic projectiles! Languages: English, Spanish, Finish, Polish, Catalan, Basque Veggie Menace is a project developed by Pigment Krew, a team of 2nd Year students at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao in a 9-month development cycle from the ground up using C++ to develop their engine and game.

rows.name: Weeping Falls Massacre
rows.short_description: 80's horror inspired FPS, a nightmarish scene taking place at an abandoned orphanage.
rows.description_html: January 25th, 1992 Eric Stoll awakens from another nightmare about his past. Over a decade has passed and he's still haunted by it. His mind is made up, he must return to Weeping Falls Orphanage the site of a gruesome massacre. Play as Eric while you try to uncover what really happened during the events leading up to the massacre. Decypher the evidence or die trying. Perhaps save a long-lost friend. Will Eric survive the night and bring an end to this dark chapter of his life? Play Weeping Falls Massacre and find out. Weeping Falls Massacre is an FPS horror game with a 1-2 hour playtime. The game is released as free to play but if you would like to support TaintedPact, you can purchase the Weeping Falls Massacre soundtrack right here on Steam as DLC.
