rows.name: Elvera
rows.short_description: Welcome into the realm of ELVERA, an Indie Third-Person PvP Action Game passionately developed by a single developer.
rows.description_html: Welcome into the realm of ELVERA, an Indie Third-Person PvP Action Game developed by a single developer. The game is completely free-to-play with no monetization, where player choice and strategy shape their experience. From the mind of one, for the community of many, ELVERA offers a rich, evolving world where two factions fight for dominance. Each match is a fresh challenge, shaped by the unique abilities of a diverse roster of heroes, several unique events that happen during rounds and your strategy choices. ELVERA stands out with its signature Twinbytes and Manifestation mechanic, inviting players to engage in a strategic dance of deception and unpredictability. Free to all, ELVERA provides a balanced battlefield where tactics, not transactions, lead to triumph. Join the Early Access on Steam, contribute to ELVERA's growth, and be part of our small, yet passionate community. Discord - Twitter - YouTube -

rows.name: Twin Cores
rows.short_description: Defend a Terraforming station against hordes of enemies in this short coop-only rail-shooter! A unique mix of nostalgic arcade elements and modern coop shooter gameplay. Triumph against your foes and compete for the top of the leaderboard!
rows.description_html: Emergency calls echo throughout the C2 Terraforming station: a strange coral anomaly has caused a bug in the system, and the machines are not following orders anymore! Play as the Twin Cores , two mighty synchro-drones , and fight to eliminate the frenzied machines! FIGHT WITH A FRIEND! Twin Cores is COOP-ONLY , so grab a friend and play together either locally or online through Steam Remote Play Together! Together, brave heaps of diverse enemies and use your synchro-abilities to face any challenge coming your way! rows.name: Sakura Gym Girls: Prologue
rows.short_description: A short and sweet prologue to a larger story. Shouhei has no particular interest in working out, but that changes when his bubbly girlfriend, Ranko, sweet-talks him into going to the local gym with her.
rows.description_html: Sakura Gym Girls: Prologue is a prequel to Sakura Gym Girls. This visual novel is about Kitagawa Shouhei, a university student, who lives in Tokyo with his girlfriend, the energetic and cheerful Sakizaki Ranko. Shouhei and Ranko are still in the early stages of their relationship, and they’re utterly in love. Everything seems to be going well between Shouhei and Ranko – until Ranko discovers, to her horror, that Shouhei’s doting ways have led her to packing on the pounds. In an attempt to keep fit, Ranko sweet-talks Shouhei into joining the local gym with her, so she can shed some of the weight she gained while eating all of Shouhei’s home-cooked meals. Join Shouhei and Ranko in this cute, light-hearted story, which serves as a prelude to a larger series, which will introduce even more cute girls for Shouhei to spend time with! Ranko is Shouhei’s girlfriend. She’s incredibly self-confident, and she was actually the one who proposed to Shouhei first. Ranko is as affectionate as a puppy, and she’s always giving Shouhei hugs and kisses, even in public, to Shouhei’s embarrassment. Having a girlfriend as devoted as Ranko is a bit of a handful, but Shouhei loves her a lot, and he’s certain they’ll always stay together. Why wouldn’t they, when they get along so well together?

rows.name: STARSHIP
rows.short_description: In the game, you have different spaceships and 13 different skills. Gain money, parts, and skill pieces in victory and create your own ship skill set. In combat, anticipate your opponent's actions, avoid his damage, allocate energy properly, deploy skills, and push him to his death step by step.
rows.description_html: [Game Features] ﹣Super high degree of freedom﹣ In the game, you can get rid of the shackles of the plane, move freely in the three-dimensional space, and cast skills in the full picture without dead ends. Give you a broad stage to give full play to your tactics. At the same time, you have three unique spaceships and thirteen different skills. Get money, parts and skill fragments in victory, create your own spaceship skill combination, and use your exclusive tactics to defeat your opponents! ﹣Strong strategic ﹣ In the game, you need to use your ingenuity, predict the opponent's actions, avoid the opponent's damage, allocate energy reasonably, and deploy skills to push the opponent into death step by step. You will love this game if you like to fight wits and brave people. With the advancement of space technology and the improvement of weapon lethality, the form of war in the distant future has undergone tremendous changes. It takes a few hours for spacecraft to cross the galaxy. The most powerful weapon can instantly destroy the planet, so the number of The advantage is weakening, and static defense becomes inefficient. How to hit the enemy and not be hit by the enemy has become the most important thing in the interstellar battlefield. This game is designed according to the concept of future space war. Hope You will like it. Welcome to the Star Warship, Commander. At present, the game has 13 skills and 3 different types of spaceships. Commanders can freely match the most powerful combination in their hearts in the base, fight with other commanders in arenas and ladders, win rich materials, and upgrade spaceships. And skills. Start your space journey.

rows.name: Solitude Underwater
rows.short_description: Solitude Underwater is a short horror adventure game. Two treasure-hunting brothers are searching for sunken riches off the coast of South Africa, only to find themselves immersed in catastrophe after one of them gets trapped in a cage, deep inside shark-infested waters.
rows.description_html: Solitude Underwater is a short horror-adventure game where you play as one of two treasure-hunting brothers who are searching for a long-lost ship filled with sunken treasure, but everything goes wrong… FEATURES Original Sound Track made by Rozmis B. Gergő In Depth Story created by Louis Badalament Voice Acting by the very talented Jake Johnston and Louis Badalament GAMEPLAY After a deceptively calm start aboard the boat with your brother, you’ll soon find yourself trapped in a shark cage at the bottom of the ocean.  A cage broken in such a way where the sharks can get in, but you can’t get out.  You will have to fend off the hungry sharks armed with nothing but the light from your phone… and did we mention its battery is almost dead?  As if that wasn’t bad enough, your oxygen tank is also broken; be very careful about when and how long you draw your next breath!  And if you somehow manage to find a way to escape the cage, other challenges still lie ahead!  Will you somehow manage to survive this deep-sea nightmare?

rows.name: The Backroom - Lost and Found
rows.short_description: The Backroom - Lost and Found is a story rich adventure game with some horror elements. Why is there an orphaned room hidden away in the depths of a strange liminal space? Is it 'the backrooms' or something else? CYOA? SCP? Weirdcore? No clipping? And what's with the cute paintings?
rows.description_html: The Backroom - Lost and Found tells the story of an orphaned room hidden away in the depths of a strange liminal space. As you embark on this adventure, you will encounter perplexing locations which defy the laws of physics, as well as meet some of the cute and horrifying inhabitants of this ... sector. Can you discover the truth, bring the lost together, and find your way out? FEATURES Coherent story divided into two available chapters. 19 different endings. Hand crafted levels and unique gameplay mechanics. Secrets, strangeness, weirdcore, and Achievements. Playtime approximately 2 hours. 'Horror-lite' - no jumpscares. Has a bit trypophobic content. No clipping.

rows.name: Wheels of Duty
rows.short_description: After a deadly virus left humanity paralyzed, survivors now battle on wheels! Customize your rig, sharpen your aim, and roll into fast-paced wheelchair warfare across multiple maps and modes. Join the fight!
rows.description_html: After a terrorist-engineered virus crippled the world, humanity adapted the only way it could — on wheels. Now, survivors roll into battle in high-powered wheelchairs, armed to the teeth and ready to reclaim what’s left. Customize your rig, perfect your aim in the gun range, and prepare for fast-paced, tactical wheelchair warfare against players and bots across diverse maps and intense game modes. Game Modes: Team Deathmatch – Roll out with your squad and dominate the opposition. Free For All – Everyone’s your enemy. Be the last one rolling. Gun Game – Earn new weapons with every kill — no breaks, no mercy. Last Man Standing – One life. One shot at glory. Last Team Standing – Team up, no respawns. Win or get wiped out. Join our community, share your feedback, and help shape the future of Wheels of Duty

rows.description_html: Welcome to the world of Charlie and Friends! Currently looking for a new caretaker for our beloved characters: Charlie the Cat, Hilda the Hyena, Sammy the Snake, and Rosy the Rabbit. Your job is to take care of our wonderful characters by feeding them, cleaning after them, fixing anything they broke, and uploading daily records of the characters. However, your job won't be that easy though since the characters like to wander around the building and they may interrupt you. Plus there seems to be something else happening in the background of the company you work for. Can you survive your work week and solve the mystery of what's happening?

Your Assistant Chat with your AI friend - Calliope, maybe there is a little surprise.

rows.name: Asteroid
rows.short_description: Asteroid is an open world action adventure RPG set in space! Explore the universe to save planets, upgrade your ship and equipment, and defeat increasingly fearsome enemies!
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER About the Game A world without limits Asteroid is an open world action adventure RPG set in space. The universe is infinite and procedurally generated. Explore every corner of the galaxy to find treasures and precious resources, but also planets and enemies never seen before! Story mode - COMING WITH THE FULL VERSION The universe has changed: someone is trying to steal a mysterious power given by the gods to help a past civilization survive. Free the planets of hostilities and find out what is happening. During your journey, you may encounter many people willing to help you out, upgrade your ship and equipment, or even pay you to do some quests. Asteroid's story mode is in constant development and each planet presents its own narrative arc . With the addition of other planets , there will also be the introduction of a new chapter of the story mode. Updates and Seasons We plan to support the game with constant updates and Seasons , with new content to play, events and customizable ships! Seasons are major updates that introduce new planets and chapters of story mode , in addition to the content mentioned above! Fight fierce bosses in Black Hole Raids! Black Hole Raids are boss fights to be done alone or with friends* which confer valuable rewards such as Flact, Lunar Dust and Aquanium Gems . During the course of your exploration, you may come across a Black Hole - enter it to access a Black Hole Raid . Black Holes differ in shape, color and size : depending on these parameters, the difficulty and rewards can vary , so always keep an eye on them! *At launch it will only be possible to play alone. We are working to make the Alestore Online Play service for Asteroid active as soon as possible, but for the moment we expect its possible release during the course of 2023. Customization Being stylish is also important in the Z9 galaxy ! The Item Shop offers a variety of spaceships to purchase* to show off your gorgeous look, and if you are not satisfied with the proposed selection, don't worry: items change every day! *To purchase the items in the Item Shop, it is necessary to have Aquanium Gems, a currency that can be obtained by playing for free or through in-app purchases with microtransactions. In-app purchases will be available with the full version of the game. Events There will be new events with rewards every month , so always keep an eye on the Steam update page for Asteroid , the official Discord server and the Events section within the game! Online multiplayer - COMING IN 2023 (AFTER THE RELEASE OF THE FULL VERSION) We intend to make Asteroid an online experience by allowing users to have fun with friends by playing in the same game world and participating in events . The Alestore Online Play service is in development for Asteroid and we can't wait to release more information, so we recommend you follow the Steam updates page for Asteroid and the official Discord server . We expect the service to launch in 2023 . ...And more! Even more surprises await you in Asteroid, play and enjoy!

rows.name: XBall
rows.short_description: A real-time tactics PvP sports game with an underground vibe. Control every player on your team in fast-paced matches that blend basketball, football, and hockey. Customize the action with adjustable time pace and team sizes.
rows.description_html: XBall is a PvP team sport game where players control the entire team at once, merging real-time tactics with a gritty, underground sports atmosphere. The game draws inspiration from basketball, football, and hockey, but it stands apart as a unique and abstract experience that defies direct comparison. XBall allows players to customize their matches by selecting different numbers of players and adjusting the game's time pace. Whether you're strategizing through slow, intricate tactics or diving into rapid, chaotic fun, XBall offers a dynamic and versatile gameplay experience that keeps each match fresh and unpredictable.

rows.name: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground
rows.short_description: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground is a playable sneak peek at the driving and demolition physics from the upcoming Demolition & Build 3. In the game, you take control of a modern excavator and drive around a small test track or demolish structures.
rows.description_html: Demolish & Build 3 will include brand new demolition and driving physics. This short tech demo allows you to try them out before the final release. rows.name: Ashen Knights: One Passage
rows.short_description: Ashen Knights: One Passage invites you to explore the beginning of Ashen Knights story. Two heroes, two different genres: souls-like & hack’n’slash. They switch places and trigger a wild emotional storm making sure you never get bored of playing.
rows.description_html: ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST Discord About the Game Ashen Knights: One Passage invites you to explore the beginning of Ashen Knights story. Two heroes, two different genres: souls-like & hack’n’slash. They switch places and trigger a wild emotional storm making sure you never get bored of playing. Two heroes, two different genres. TRY IT OUT! Ashen Knights is a unique mixture of two complementary gameplays. Tired of managing your stamina and scrupulously calculating your attacks? The game will grant you an opportunity to destroy foes in dozens with a single sweep of your weapon. Bored without a decent challenge? Try slaying an enemy ten times stronger than you are. More genres mean more emotions. FEEL THEM ALL! In Ashen Knights, the gameplay is but a way to share and express emotions. Playing as different characters, you'll feel how your battle drive gets replaced with crippling anxiety that slowly transforms into blinding rage. Every detail matters. DIVE IN! All of your emotions, every sound, every note, and every detail are a hidden message from the game world. And just as the world of Ashen Knights is a myriad of remote isles shattered by the Abyss, its narrative is a grim and mysterious puzzle made of numerous manifestations. Will you be able to piece it back together? A dark fantasy story. REVEAL IT! Every single phenomenon in the game—from the quietest of sounds to the biggest of bosses—is just a cover hiding the story of this world. So, what is the nature of the Abyss? What does it have to do with our heroes? And how does it bring them together? Every battle tells its part of the story. DEFEAT ENEMIES! The Abyss is not going to reveal its secrets for nothing. For every answer, one has to pay with numerous battles against its spawn: multiform mutants, insidious mimics, and mighty bosses. Every location is the same story told in a new way. EXPLORE THEM! The Abyss is not going to reveal all its secrets right away. On every level, it will expose itself in a new, previously unknown way. It will keep getting you back to the very beginning of the location. It will throw immortal enemies at you. It will stab you in the back with no chance to defend yourself. But no matter how dissimilar the distant corners of this world seem, they are all united by the narrative of collapse and the atmosphere of dark fantasy.

rows.name: Defenders of Asteria
rows.short_description: Asteria is under siege! Take up arms as the commander and find the perfect strategy in this hero filled tower defense game. Will you become a Defender of Asteria or fall short?
rows.description_html: Defenders of Asteria will become free to play soon DEFEND THE KINGDOM Weakened by the Asterian War the kingdom scrambles to defend its key points, and its up to you to command the army to victory! Becoming a true Defender of Asteria takes courage and wit, will you survive the onslaught or fall to the hordes of enemies knocking at your door? DIFFERENT WAYS TO PLAY Take on quickplay if you want to find the perfect strategy and earn achievements. Then if you feel like a true strategist try your hand at the constantly scaling endless mode and survive as long as you can! With different heroes and perks to use there is lots of strategies to find. TAKE ON RAIDS A true war of attrition, take on raid maps to put your skills to the test. Each raid map has a unique boss to slay and an achievement to match. You are in for the long haul with this mode. KEY FEATURES Enlist 5 different heroes to help you cull the hordes on the battlefield 14 current maps to conquer Endless mode for endless fun Raid maps with unique bosses Unlock perks through playing to enhance your strength Free content updates

rows.name: Glyph-Bound: Kotodama
rows.short_description: Track, train, and trade elemental spirits in Glyph-Bound! An indie MMORPG inspired by Pokemon Platinum, Final Fantasy Tactics, and Old School Runescape.
rows.description_html: Glyph-Bound is a monster-catching MMORPG inspired by Pokemon, Final Fantasy Tactics, and Old School Runescape . Our goal is to capture the wonder, exploration, and player choice that timeless classics are made of. TRACK, TRAIN, & TRADE elemental spirits called 'Kami'. Each Kami species has three growth stages and different aesthetic rarities ! THREE STARTING LOCATIONS from which to begin your journey and EXPLORE THE NON-LINEAR, OPEN WORLD region of the Akitsu Isles. TURN-BASED TACTICS influenced by Final Fantasy Tactics, Tactics Ogre, Into the Breach, Fire Emblem, and more! Increase your PVE REPUTATION AND PVP RANK TO UNLOCK COSMETIC OUTFITS ! Informed by Shinto religion and the concept of 'Kotodama', is a key pillar in Glyph-Bound lore . Bind Kami to elemental stones using the mystical words of power!

rows.name: FPS Chess
rows.short_description: Battle a friend in this fast paced 1v1 class-based first-person shooter. Chess takes a back-seat to FPS as you win duel after duel and capture the opponent's pieces until you've beaten their king and won the game.
rows.description_html: Play an ordinary game of chess against a friend or a stranger. However, all your intricate strategies will crumble before the enemy rook's sniper trick-shot. All your practiced openings and counters will amount to nothing before the enemy queen's randomly sprayed machine gun. You finally checkmate the king. Unfortunately, it seems you are not ready for this fight. 5 seconds in and you've been sliced in half by the king's sword. It turns out you are not playing Chess at all, but an FPS. Just make sure to practice your aim! 6 unique piece toolkits with unique weapons and abilities. Online, LAN, and local split-screen 1v1 multiplayer matches. Invite a friend or join a lobby. A fun room to explore during every duel. Custom board editor to play with your favorite pieces. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Bakso Simulator
rows.short_description: Create the most successful bakso business in this world!
rows.description_html: Bakso is an Indonesian meatball. The word bakso may refer to a single meatball or the complete dish of meatball soup. Have you ever dreamed of having your own bakso restaurant? Dream no further, because now you can do it all with Bakso Simulator ! In this world, you will own your own bakso restaurant with your old friend Help the townsfolks by doing their quests and uncover all the secrets in town! Build your business! Upgrade your business! And Protect your business! Features: - Create your own bakso restaurant - Lots of characters to interact in the city - Follow the exciting story about the city - Done working? Go back home to sleep and don't forget to design your house according to your liking - Don't forget to pay your employees - Guard your bakso from flies, thieves and ghost - Explore the city! And most importantly, collect the money and make your bakso restaurant the best in the world!

rows.name: The Riflemen
rows.short_description: Multiplayer first-person shooter with classic WW2 bolt-action rifles. Tight battles between two teams with up to 5 players in each, lots of unique arenas, game-changing weapon drops, different game modes, and lots of customization options. You'd better not miss a shot!
rows.description_html: The Riflemen is a fun, fast-paced low poly first-person shooter where matches are short and full of action! All players start with bolt-action rifles that they don’t need to reload. Players can customize their weapons and characters to get the look they want. PLAY LIKE YOU WANT The Riflemen offers a variety of game modes to suit your playstyle. Go head-to-head in a classic fight for elimination in Team Deathmatch . Work together with your squad to capture and hold objectives in Domination . Feeling resourceful? Scavenger throws you into a world with limited ammo, forcing you to adapt and utilize dropped ammunition from fallen enemies and allies to survive. For a truly tactical challenge, dive into Secure & Survive , a round-based battle where securing valuable cargo or eliminating the opposing team is your objective. You can disable the supply drops in Barebones to get only bolt-action rifle action or make it even more competitive with the Hardcore type where every hit will be an insta-kill! GUNPLAY The Riflemen is a battle of skills and a true trial of friendships. Aim, shoot, reload, and repeat — no automatic weapons, only tough-ass action. Headshots make your opponents go sleepy-time at once and supply drops might bring you a shotgun, a sniper rifle, a bazooka, frag grenades, rapid fire pistol, mines or even a gunto sword! Whew, now that's a lot of fire power! All players start with bolt-action rifles & knives Headshots kill with one shot No manual reloading is needed CUSTOMIZATION The Riflemen isn't just about raw skill – it's about expressing yourself on the battlefield. As you progress through over 100 levels, you'll unlock a variety of character and weapon skins, allowing you to create a soldier that's uniquely yours. Don't stop there! Personalize your arsenal with a variety of wood and metal finishes, crafting a weapon that reflects your playstyle. With the DLC you'll be able to unlock 3 times more cosmetics! Become a legend who walks the line between lethality and sheer style. In The Riflemen, the battlefield is your canvas, and the bolt-action rifle your brush. Every shot a stroke, every kill a masterpiece.

rows.name: Heal & Hurt
rows.short_description: Fight as an angel or a skeleton in this fast-paced free for all multiplayer arena shooter! Pay attention to gunfights as you can either heal or hurt your opponents!
rows.description_html: Heal & Hurt is a fast-paced old school arena shooter where you switch sides from angel to skeleton and vice versa every time you die! Both characters have unique abilities that you can use to outclass your opponents. You should also pay attention to damage types as you can either heal or hurt your enemies (and yourself!) There two different gamemodes to choose from.'Deathmatch' is the normal mode where you must eliminate your opponents in order to win! The other mode is called 'Hold the Crown' where you and the others will compete for the crown that will give you score. When playing as an angel, you can fly through the skies and take out your opponents from high ground! You should also notice that when diving underwater you will eventually drown if you don't remember to get some fresh air. As a skeleton you can take advantage and slide to avoid enemies firing. Skeletons are also keen in diving as they won't drown underwater, they can also pass through the bony walls found in the maps. When playing as either of the characters the visuals of the surrounding world will change. Both characters can also use teleports to get fast from location to another! Features Switch sides when you die from an angel to skeleton and vice versa Heal or hurt your enemies (and yourself!) 6 different weapons 2 gamemodes Rocket jumping Teleports Flying Sliding

rows.name: NIRAVASI
rows.short_description: Escape and explore the ruins of a once-great city, while being hunted by the machine that watches over it. Remember, there is always protection in perfection.
rows.description_html: Story In ages past, there existed a city unlike any other. From the strength and unity of humanity, Niravasi was born. But when a brutal war ravaged the world itself, Niravasi became lost to the depths of space. Some say its people remain unharmed, while others speak of dark horrors residing in its streets. In the end, these are just stories. But Niravasi is real. About NIRAVASI is a Dark Adventure game, set within the ruins of an ancient human city. You play as Mura , a feline archaeologist that finds himself trapped within the titular lost city of ruin after being split off from the rest of his team. Armed with only a flashlight, and a mysterious ally guiding him through the city with his handheld radio, Mura must now navigate the dark streets of Niravasi to find his missing team and make his way out of derelict cityscape. But Mura is not the only one living within Niravasi . Guarding it is the Artificial Ecological Overseer Network (A.E.O.N) , an artificial intelligence built to protect and perfect humanity. Together with its robotic proxies, A.E.O.N will do everything in its power to remove anyone who arrives in the city uninvited. Among these machines is a particularly devastating one known only as The Harvester , which will continually track and hunt Mura down until either the latter escapes or is killed. In order survive, you’ll need both your skills and wits to help keep Mura alive long enough to find a way to escape Niravasi . Built using the RPG Maker MV engine (and the MV3D plugin), NIRAVASI will take you through a world filled with both wonders and horrors. Whether you wish simply to leave the city or explore its most darkest secrets, the throne of humanity offers many riches to those willing to take the leap. After all, there is always protection in perfection . Explore a lost city! Niravasi may be infested by robots, but its streets are filled with many wonders to behold. From the dilapidated ruins of the ancient Stepwell of Dhara Hanirr , to the sunken streets of the Aruvi District , NIRAVASI offers players a variety of amazing levels to explore. Excavate the secrets within! While the humans that lived here are long gone, the stories they had still remain. Venture through the darkest depths of the city, and uncover the sinister secrets that shed some light on the lives of the people who lived here, as well as how the city came to fall in the first place. Evade an army of machines! In humanity's absence, A.E.O.N (the artificial intelligence that watches over the city) has filled the city with a large army of robotic proxies, which must be avoided at all costs. Use your skills and wits as an archaeologist to sneak past them and avoid detection at all cost. Escape the Harvester! If you've been detected by A.E.O.N , the Harvester will not be far behind. Hastily make your way to safety before the timer runs out, or else the Harvester will live out its namesake. Expect anything! Niravasi is an alien world to an alien cat, as well as a city that's been derelict for centuries. You'll have to open your mind to all possibilities if you want to escape the lost city unharmed. Enjoy its surreal visuals! NIRAVASI sports a very distinct art-style, blending pixel art styles with iconography found within corporate organisations, and the ancient civilisations of old. Go out there and see what you can find! Endure the truth of your heart! You get to play as a cat! What's not to love about that?!

rows.short_description: Mine Seeker is a strategic game where the player has to click tiles in order to find mines hidden under some of them. It might seem familiar to many people... If you like to play calming games with peaceful atmosphere you should give it a try!
rows.description_html: In Mine Seeker you are able to play a well known game in a new 3 dimensional way! Customize the Map size, choose between different locations to play in and set the difficulty by adjusting the amount of mines on the board. Be fast though because you have a maximum of 60 minutes to clear all tiles that aren´t mines.

rows.name: Monster Showdown: Prologue
rows.short_description: Monster Showdown: Prologue is the first 3 maps of an action packed VR shooter. Increase your chances of survival against an ever growing horde of monster by exploring your environment and strengthening yourself by picking up Perks, Ranged Weapons and Melee Weapons.
rows.description_html: Monster Showdown: Prologue includes the first 3 out of 10 maps of this action packed VR Shooter. WEAPONS: Buy your favorite weapons from a choice of over 60 from a dispenser at the wall or try your luck at the enigmatic box for a chance to get a really powerful gun. You can also attack enemies with melee weapons by swinging your VR controller. The more skillful your swings are the more damage your attacks will deal. rows.name: Hermea
rows.short_description: Hermea is an intern at Hermes' Delivery Service who transports mail by traversing perilous environments on foot and using a variety of abilities. Control Hermea to race against the clock and deliver timely as a faster time will reward a better score in this third person speedrunning platformer!
rows.description_html: Race against the clock to deliver the gods' mail on time! Hermea is a third person speedrunner where you play as Hermea, an intern at Hermes' Delivery Service, who transports mail to Greek gods by traversing perilous environments on foot and using a variety of interchangeable abilities. The gods will throw everything they can at you to try and stop you, but with some encouraging words from Hermes, you can totally take them on! Features: 6 action packed levels and 1 tutorial level 6 unlockable abilities such as Artemis' Bow Grappling Hook and Zeus' Favor Teleport 3 different environments inspired by Greek Mythology Online leaderboards Twitch integration to allow chat to vote on silly modifiers Multiple 'Curses' or difficulty modifiers for added gameplay and to test yourself A number of accessibility options so every gamer can play Controller Support

rows.name: Deck of Life: No Turns, Individual Card Permadeath
rows.short_description: A card battler where cards are your health. No turns, individual card permadeath. Construct defenses while launching projectiles to destroy your opponent's cards. Beat enemies and events to win cards from unique card pools. If all your cards on the field are destroyed, you die.
rows.description_html: Unblocked Enemy Attacks Permanently Remove Cards From Your Deck Enemy attacks destroy cards from your deck and they are not available in the next encounter. Protect your Cards while Destroying your Opponent's Hand Play cards on your side of the field to launch projectiles or construct defenses. Draw new cards from your deck automatically at an upgradable rate. Survive Each Run The cards in your hand are always physically on the field and can be attacked at any time with projectiles. You defeat the enemy if you destroy all the enemy's cards on the field. Your run ends if all your cards on the field are destroyed. Choose Cards to Reinforce your Deck's Strategy As you clear enemies and events your deck gains cards unique to the floor. Each floor has a unique pool of cards that work well together. Choose a Path to Control your Deck's Evolution Each level you have a choice of 2 floors with a unique card pool. You always have the option to continue acquiring cards of the same type or to branch off into a different random card type. As you clear levels the random floors increase in difficulty. Unlock New Starting Decks Every floor you defeat you gain a new deck that you can start a run with. This new deck has cards specific to the floor's unique cards.

rows.name: Light Maze
rows.short_description: A simple casual game where you light up floor tiles in a level in order to go to the next level.
rows.description_html: Gameplay: You will be controlling a cube around multiple levels with varying degrees of difficulty. As you navigate, the tile underneath you will light up and stay lit until you complete the level. Features: Simple controls. Move up, down, left, or right. As a tile lights up, the level gradually illuminates. 100 different levels. Varying levels of difficulty. Save system. Delete it too if you want. Controls: WASD IJKL 8456 or 8426 on the Numpad Arrow Keys This list of controls is accessible in the game. Other Keybinds: P or Escape Key to pause the game. R key to restart the level. Bugs, Issues, Feedback, Suggestions, etc: Whatever it is, please feel free go to the Community Hub Discussion section for this game and ask away.

rows.name: Barista: Take Away
rows.short_description: Drag and drop game against the clock, where you will try to make the perfect coffee for each client
rows.description_html: Test your barista skills in this game inspired by Club del Café in Pontevedra. Try to guess the type of origin coffee for each client and don't forget any ingredient! In this drag and drop game against the clock, you will experience behind the bar of the emblematic coffee of Pontevedra and you will be able to know the qualities of each of the coffees of origin that are served there, while trying to get the perfect coffee. Check the menu, select the coffee and drag the ingredients to add them to the glass and make your customer leave happy. Oh, and remember to cover it, so not a drop spills out! Nine different coffee origins, seven different ways to prepare it, a bunch of disparate customers, and a little jazz music to calm your nerves. What score will you be able to get?

rows.name: 3D Joys
rows.short_description: 3D Joys is a Memory game in VR
rows.description_html: 3D Joys is more of a utility and is short for 3D Joysticks. It's called that because it's based on Joysticks used in arcades. 3D Joys allow the player to go 6 different directions instead of 4 directions like from a regular Joystick with the help of VR controllers. The player can summon their 3d Joystick at the position of their hand by using the grip button and choosing from up, down, right, left, forward or backwards motion done with a VR controller. Testing their hand eye coordination in the process. VR Memory Cube is the first addition to 3D Joys. Test your memory and maybe possibly improve it with a color remembering game like the classic Simon game. Basically, the game is to remember a sequence of colors on a cube while each side of the cube will light up different colors that will resemble your cube which is the 3D Joystick around your hand when you summon it. Online Leaderboard has been implemented for the people that want to show off. Offline Leaderboard is also an option. Oculus Rift is the only VR headset I tested this game on. The future of 3D Joys will depend on its growth because there is only one person working on this project which is myself and I am a college dropout student with a Digital Arts Media Certificate. I started working on this project when I had my first Computer Programing class, where I learned Python and which made me pursue other programming languages like C#. Unity is the engine that I am using to make this game. I am not a professional. I try as hard as I can to bring my vision for this game into fruition and it may take longer than someone that knows what they're doing but I hope you see the potential and come along the ride that is 3D Joys. @WhoDisz

rows.name: Race Day Rampage: Streamer Edition
rows.short_description: Streamers, be the Race Director and connect with your community through real-time races you host on stream. Use pre-made tracks or build your own, invite your community and new players to join the race day chaos. Start those engines and call the action, live on stream!
rows.description_html: Welcome to season 5: Classics! Get ready for the ultimate adrenaline rush this season! This season features new roles and emotes, Hero Bot construction, new cars, and of course loads of new customization for your car and profile. Download now! About the Game Welcome to Race Day Rampage , an interactive racing game built to bring streamers and their audience together. As a streamer, this Steam version of Race Day Rampage is for you. Your audience can join races that you stream over Twitch by using our mobile app, or by typing !play in chat for quick play. Not a streamer? You can still build your own tracks and host events for friends! You will be the Race Director. Select the tracks, invite your audience, control the race, and stream the action! Cinematic camera controls let you zoom in on individual racers, or you can zoom out and watch the race from afar, all while you wreak havoc by activating traps throughout the track. Your friends or fans will be the Racers.* Invite your players to join the race via our mobile app or simply typing !play in the chat. They’ll be featured live on your stream, where you can spotlight or shoutout your favorite cars and target specific racers by activating traps as they pass. The more cars you crush, the more scrap you’ll generate, allowing you to unlock new track elements. Start the race immediately on popular tracks, or build your own! Host races using top tracks from in-game playlists, or create your own with four exciting game modes: Race Mode: The classic Race Day Rampage mode where players compete to see who can cross the finish line first! Endurance mode: How long can each car survive? It’s a battle to see who lasts the longest. Rampage Mode: Fast-paced action where maximum destruction wins the day! Sandbox Mode: Streamers and track designers can experiment with different in-game features (including boost, charge, explode, and shield) to create unique race experiences. Build custom booby-trapped race tracks to create maximum chaos. Collect scrap and unlock amazing new features. Engage with your players live on stream and grow your audience interactivity like never before. Are you ready for Race Day? If you’re looking to join a race, check out the Race Day Rampage mobile apps or type !play in chat. NOTE: Racers do not require the Steam version of Race Day Rampage to play. Community members can join a race by downloading the mobile app or typing !play in the Twitch stream chat.

rows.name: Jump The Gun
rows.short_description: Think you can make it out? Many have tried… All have failed. Traverse the unforgiving cave and do impossible jumps with your rocket launcher and shotgun.
rows.description_html: About This Game “A game I made For a certain kind of person To hurt them.” -Bennett Foddy Jump the Gun is a Foddian style, 2-D, shooting, platformer centered around a robot making its way out of an extremely difficult and unforgiving cave. The player uses multiple guns to propel themselves up at angles to perform precise double (maybe triple!) jumps. This game was made for fun by a group of friends and is meant to be an introduction to the Foddian Genre. -Use a combination of shotgun and rocket launcher shots to perform strategic jumps -Learn from your mistakes -Have guidance with that voice in your head -Learn, Fail, Repeat. Don’t just jump the gun. Be the gun.

rows.name: Soccer But Different
rows.short_description: It's Soccer except you can randomize the map, change the ball, strap ice cubes to everyone's feet- LAUNCH EVERYONE WITH ROCKETS- ADD 10 MORE BALLS- RANDOMLY TELEPORT EVERYONE- ...FINALLY SOME GOOD SPORTS!
rows.description_html: I remember watching sports as a kid and wondering if they have a meta like video games do- new features, balance changes, and maps? Imagine my heartbreak when I found out we've been playing roughly the same Soccer for like 200 years. In this game, all players are given cards while playing that they can use to change the rules of the game and change things up. 'Randomize the map, change the ball, strap ice cubes to everyone's feet- LAUNCH EVERYONE WITH ROCKETS- ADD 10 MORE BALLS- RANDOMLY TELEPORT EVERYONE- FINALLY SOME GOOD SPORTS!' I cried to my parents as I ran up to my room at the ripe age of just 10. I hugged my stuffed dinosaur. Dino understands me. He would play my game. Maybe he can be the main character. Someday. In Soccer But Different, you play in a top-down circular-shaped arena with goals on either side of the circle, one for each of the two teams. For 5 minutes, each player in the match will receive random Rule Cards which will change the game in some way for every player, the trick is when to use them properly. Some cards change how you interact with the ball, from grabbing or punching it, and other cards will strap rockets to everyone's back, boosting movement speed but lowering your control for a few seconds. Using the W, A, S, and D (or arrow keys) to move around and the Space bar (or left click) to interact with the ball, you will try to work with your team and all of the chaos around you to try and score the most goals before the time limit is up. To use Rule Cards, you can click them with your mouse (or use the 1, 2, and 3 keys). You can play Soccer But Different with up to 10 players (5 on each team) in a match by connecting to a host of a server through the lobby list- anyone can host a server.

rows.name: The Shadow Government Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Shadow Government Simulator: Prologue is just part of the amazing adventure that awaits you in the full version of the game. A turn-based strategy game where you lead a secret society towards world domination. Investigate the influential and convert them to your faction via bribery, seduction & more
rows.description_html: The Shadow Government Simulator: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. Your job in the Prologue of the game is to take a control of a shadow organization dead set on global domination via bribery, intimidation, seduction, and any means necessary. Inspired by old classics like Plague Inc. and modern gems like The Shrouded Isle, this is a challenging game where you infiltrate nations, discover their networks of power, and then reshape them to fit your agenda. The Shadow Government Simulator: Prologue is a turn-based strategy game. The Shadow Government Simulator: Prologue is a part of the full version of The Shadow Government Simulator and is completely free. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of The Shadow Government Simulator so you will be fully ready before the final product release! Turn-based strategic infiltration Every action you take matters on a global scale. When you enter a new nation, you’ll be alone with just a headquarters at your disposal and minimal information. Slowly, you will send your tendrils throughout the region uncovering who are the influential and how much power they truly wield. You'll discover their traits and personalities, earning an understanding of their weaknesses and how to best convert them to your side. Infiltrate nations around the world! More importantly, you'll discover who they are connected to, and thus person by person, you shall take over the whole elite. Having a strong interconnected network is the key to success, but the bigger you get the more visible you are and this could lead to your demise. Manage your network, cut and create connections, to ensure you act from the shadows when the time is right. Evolve your organization The world will be difficult to conquer without growth and adaptation. As you capture new units, you can change their abilities, unlocking new traits and adapting to the necessities of the shadow war. Throughout your campaign for world domination, you'll be able to build your organization with unique traits. Tailor your society and its pawns to fit your grand plan. Conquer the world and you'll be able to unlock different factions such as the Masons and the Templars, with different strengths and weaknesses! Fight for global supremacy As your organization grows and becomes more visible on the global scale the challenges you face will increase. The world’s countries will unite against you and you will face off against rival organizations. Choose wisely which region to infiltrate first, as they will provide different bonuses, but also present different challenges. Each region will offer a distinct play experience with its procedurally generated networks. As time moves forward the regions will acquire unique modifiers to increase the difficulty and diversity of the maps you play on. It might well be worth the risk, however, as nations you take over become yours to command, unlocking new powerful abilities. Be it a person or a country, they shall all become like pawns before you!

rows.name: Bionic Traveler
rows.short_description: A compilation of the collaborative efforts of the University of Pennsylvania Game Research and Development Environment's programmers, artists, writers, and sound engineers over the 2021-2022 academic year. Fight our enemies, view our art, explore our scenes, and listen to our soundtrack!
rows.description_html: Explore the wild, fantasy, and sci-fi realms of the world of Bionic Traveler! Wander in this semi-open 2D top-down world; encounter enemies, items, and NPCs in the world. Fight the enemies with your melee and ranged weapons while also getting dodging and teleporting away to manage your health. The game offers two main places for these combat encounters: 1. In the latest build the open world where you will encounter enemies out in the wild 2. The enemy arena in which you can challenge each of our enemies in a one-on-one fight Aside from combat, read the lore of this world in our story section while listening to the tunes of our soundtrack, admiring our art assets, and speaking with the NPCs of our world in our art museum section. Bionic Traveler is the 2021-2022 School Year Project of the University of Pennsylvania Game Research and Development Environment Club (UPGRADE). Under the leadership of Di Lu (SEAS '22) and Edward Zhang (SEAS + Wharton '23), UPGRADE sought to use the development of this project to teach its members the processes of game development, to serve as an outlet for creative expression, and to provide the expression of bringing a game from concept all the way to market. Thus, the contents of this game were made over the course of a singular academic year at UPenn off of weekly meetings, a few extra-meeting crunches, and a hackathon. The game was ultimately not entirely finished, but this build that is now listed on Steam serves to show off the work that the students in this club were able to accomplish on top of their rigorous course loads at UPenn. The game concept was pitched by Praneel Chakraborty (CAS + Wharton '24), and the story premise was picked by Jimmy Ciardullo (SEAS '22). Lennart Meincke (SAS '23) served as the project's lead programmer, Meggie Cheng (SEAS '22) served as the game's Art Director, Kevin Zhao (SEAS '22) served as the game's Sound Lead, and Kevin Ma (SEAS '25) and Jimmy Ciardullo (SEAS '22) served as the game's lead writers.

The enemy arena in which you can challenge each of our enemies in a one-on-one fight Aside from combat, read the lore of this world in our story section while listening to the tunes of our soundtrack, admiring our art assets, and speaking with the NPCs of our world in our art museum section. Bionic Traveler is the 2021-2022 School Year Project of the University of Pennsylvania Game Research and Development Environment Club (UPGRADE). Under the leadership of Di Lu (SEAS '22) and Edward Zhang (SEAS + Wharton '23), UPGRADE sought to use the development of this project to teach its members the processes of game development, to serve as an outlet for creative expression, and to provide the expression of bringing a game from concept all the way to market. Thus, the contents of this game were made over the course of a singular academic year at UPenn off of weekly meetings, a few extra-meeting crunches, and a hackathon. The game was ultimately not entirely finished, but this build that is now listed on Steam serves to show off the work that the students in this club were able to accomplish on top of their rigorous course loads at UPenn. The game concept was pitched by Praneel Chakraborty (CAS + Wharton '24), and the story premise was picked by Jimmy Ciardullo (SEAS '22). Lennart Meincke (SAS '23) served as the project's lead programmer, Meggie Cheng (SEAS '22) served as the game's Art Director, Kevin Zhao (SEAS '22) served as the game's Sound Lead, and Kevin Ma (SEAS '25) and Jimmy Ciardullo (SEAS '22) served as the game's lead writers.

rows.name: Cyber Blades - Demo
rows.short_description: Cyber blades is a game where you fight back by slicing the enemy projectile with a melee weapon in a synthwave setting. It provides a unique experience that allows you to face hundreds of enemy archers with melee weapons. Slash arrows more powerfully, and get a higher score by cutting in a row!
rows.description_html: Have you ever seen a scene in an action movie where a sword is used to cut bullets and strike back? Cyber Blades is an intense Workout VR game in which you become an Action Star and fight back against the enemy Projectile, In a synthwave-themed world. The game is challenging enough to burn your Cardio in a short amount of time and you have to constantly dodge obstacles and counter or defend against enemy projectiles. ABOUT GAMEPLAY IN VR: - You can try various styles of Run by holding boxing gloves, (reverse grip-able) daggers, swords, Mace, and shields in each hand. - By selecting the player's hit points, you can exercise continuously regardless of being hit, or try a perfectionist run that doesn't allow even a single hit. Also, you can adjust the intensity of the exercise by adjusting the frequency of appearance of enemies by adjusting the difficulty. - At the end of each run, the ferocious T-Rex is on the lookout for your life. Infested with fury, this beast unleashes a variety of patterns of Deadly Attacks against players.

rows.name: Tvö
rows.short_description: Tvö is an online cooperative puzzle game where two players must use their wits and communication skills to find a way into the heart of the labyrinth. This game can be played using our in-game voice chat or a third-party option.
rows.description_html: Decipher the puzzles of an ancient maze to save your soul. You and your partner awake on separate sides of a mysterious maze. Surrounded by shadows, spectral whispers, and magical orbs that help you communicate with each other, the two of you must traverse the winding corridors and find a way out. The only question that remains… will your soul be saved? Tvö is a cooperative puzzle game. Two players find themselves trapped on opposite sides of an elaborate maze. Together, they must solve puzzles hidden in its depths in order to discover a way out. Both sides of the maze have their own secrets that the players can find. Communicate Only your words and wits can save you now. Through floating orbs, the mysterious maze lets you talk to your partner on the other side. Use your communication skills to solve the puzzles you will face. Solve The way to salvation is teeming with trials. Work together with your partner to unravel the puzzles laid throughout the maze. What your partner experiences will be crucial to your success. Atmosphere You and your partner are not alone… Explore the corridors of the maze to find those that came before, and those that still remain. Immerse yourself in the dark ambience of the maze.

rows.name: Blastonier
rows.short_description: A 2D physics-based puzzle game inspired by old flash games and arcade tasking you with shooting a ball into a cube.
rows.description_html: Blastonier is a short 2D physics-based experience with minimal neon graphics where your goal is to shoot a ball through a level full of obstacles and into a green win zone to win levels and move on to the next. To do this you only need your mouse to aim your shot, left click to fire a shot in the direction of your mouse, and space bar to retrieve your shots and refill your ammo (your only allowed 2 shots at a time). There are 100 handmade levels requiring a mixture of skill, timing, and luck to win.

rows.name: non-binary
rows.short_description: 'non-binary' is a video game that mixes text choices and bullet hell to tell the story of two non-binary people's journey of self-discovery. Make your choices. Dodge words. Go through things that hurt without breaking down. If you can.
rows.description_html: 'non-binary' is a game in three acts that blends bullet hell and storytelling to bring you into the lives of two non-binary people. you will accompany Elisa or Luca from childhood to adulthood, experiencing with them frustration and joy, discovery and change. 'non-binary' features two different paths: one for a character socially defined as female and the other, male. at the beginning of the game, the character will be randomly assigned to you. at the end of the game, you will be able to retrace their story or live that of the other protagonist. we recommend that you experience both stories: by combining personal experiences and the testimonies of those who have supported us, we have created two very different paths. the lives of non-binary people are as varied and complex as those of anyone else. that's why the game doesn't aim to tell everyone's story, but only a small glimpse into a complex world. if you are a non-binary person and you are going through a bad time, remeber: you’re not alone 💛🤍💜🖤 many countries have LGBTQIA* associations that can provide support. if you’d like to share in the comments those active in your country, it will make it easier for those who may need them to find them. and if you feel the need, you can write us.

Namely: Although current version is rather funny: in general, the game is planned to be very depressing, violent, with a lot of content that many may find offensive. Keep this in mind before investing yourself in a project in any way.

rows.name: Siphonopolis
rows.short_description: Enter a surreal, rotting, underwater world. Chat with some creatures. Murder a lot more. Find the heart.
rows.description_html: Left to rot. Awake once again. Welcome back. One last task. Enter Siphonopolis. Find the heart. > What am I looking at? This game was originally made some time around 2017-18. It was hard to control and used poor 3d renders for its graphics. The plot was barely there. So it was forgotten and deleted. But it didn’t die. Recovered from beyond the grave and the recycle bin, it has been fixed up, polished and remastered with a new photo-edit artstyle using stock images, old project renders and even a few pixel art drawings. Every asset has changed, becoming more twisted and strange. The story has changed in a similar direction. > What am I supposed to do? Siphonopolis can be called a point-and-click game, but it’s a rather odd one. There are a few puzzles but they aren’t the focus. Most of your time here will be spent swimming through surreal landscapes, fighting bizarre creatures in bullet hell combat and running away from the ones you can’t shoot. > How big is this trench? The original game has 52 short levels. A few more with new mechanics have been added to this version, which now has 70 levels. It's a short trip, but it doesn't end when you find the Heart. Completing the game will unlock another salvaged bullet hell game and 3 alternate protagonists for the main game with different gimmicks each.

Mine raw materials and finance the construction of other buildings. Assemble your troops and arm them with swords, catapults, bows and arrows. Everyone's out to have the biggest castle and the largest kingdom. Transform your castle into a stronghold, unconquerable to enemy attackers. Your fortress will protect you from all and sundry. Of course they do say that 'Offense is the best defense'. Put together an army of epic proportions and conquer Damoria .

rows.description_html: PARTICIPATE IN DEVELOPMENT SUPPORT US About the Game Welcome to the Soak & Splash! Get ready to sweat, socialize, and have a blast with your friends in this unique game that combines the best of traditional sauna culture with modern party fun. First, step into the steamy sauna and feel the heat and humidity envelop your body. Once everyone is inside, it's time to start the fun. You can start by whisking each other with broom. Feeling competitive? You can also fight with other players with sauna equipment. Or you can simply relax and enjoy the company of your friends, chatting, singing, or telling jokes. Finally, when you've had enough of the sauna, you can cool off in the nearby pool or shower. Overall, this game is all about having fun, bonding with your friends, and experiencing the unique benefits of sauna culture. So why wait? Download game and get ready to sweat, laugh, and enjoy life to the fullest!

rows.name: Enlisted
rows.short_description: In Enlisted, you are not only commanding a single soldier, but an entire squad! This MMO squad based shooter recreates the key battles of the bloodiest war of the 20th century, with hundreds of soldiers, tanks and aircraft taking part in each battle.
rows.description_html: In Enlisted, you are not only commanding a single soldier, but an entire squad! This MMO squad based shooter recreates the key battles of the bloodiest war of the 20th century, with hundreds of soldiers, tanks and aircraft taking part in each battle. Lead your squads to victory! You are a squad leader Each player commands his own squad of AI-controlled soldiers in battle. If you lose a soldier, you can immediately switch to another in your squad and continue the fight. Thanks to this, battles in Enlisted feel truly massive and intense, similar to the real battlefields of the Second World War! Iconic Fronts The battles will take you to all corners of the world! Fight on several islands across the Pacific Ocean, in the villages of Normandy, on the streets of Berlin, on the snowy fields of Moscow, in the heart of Stalingrad or even in the sands of Tunisia! The game features four countries participating in the war: USA, USSR, Germany and Japan. Choose just one or all of them and build your own army to your liking from the myriad of squads with different specialties. Based on your choices, you’ll end up on different battlefields, each with its own weapons, vehicles and matching uniforms. Combined arms Not just infantry, but also 350 of the most famous and diverse military equipment is at your disposal: tanks, armored cars, motorcycles and aircraft, both fighters and bombers, are available for your army. At the same time, tankers and pilots are fully trained soldiers. Was your vehicle damaged? Leave it behind and join the fight on foot, continuing the fight as an infantry squad! Tools of war 16 different soldier classes, each with unique perks and specialized weapons, including not only classic small arms but also heavy weapons: anti-tank guns, heavy machine guns, anti-aircraft guns, rocket launchers, flamethrowers, rifle grenade launchers and many more, so you can adapt to any situation and overcome every challenge. These unique mechanics allow you to flank the enemy, drop your paratroopers behind enemy lines, build fortifications and gun emplacements, and use dozens of different tactics to push toward the mission objectives. Map and mission editor Each player has access to developer tools to create custom missions that can be launched on the public server! rows.about_html: In Enlisted, you are not only commanding a single soldier, but an entire squad! This MMO squad based shooter recreates the key battles of the bloodiest war of the 20th century, with hundreds of soldiers, tanks and aircraft taking part in each battle. Lead your squads to victory! You are a squad leader Each player commands his own squad of AI-controlled soldiers in battle. If you lose a soldier, you can immediately switch to another in your squad and continue the fight. Thanks to this, battles in Enlisted feel truly massive and intense, similar to the real battlefields of the Second World War! Iconic Fronts The battles will take you to all corners of the world! Fight on several islands across the Pacific Ocean, in the villages of Normandy, on the streets of Berlin, on the snowy fields of Moscow, in the heart of Stalingrad or even in the sands of Tunisia! The game features four countries participating in the war: USA, USSR, Germany and Japan. rows.name: Lilith
rows.short_description: Do you enjoy non-stop, high-intensity, combat while fighting hordes of enemies? Come play Lilith and find yourself engulfed in this experience!
rows.description_html: The game is based on high-impact combat. A playable character traverses land and fights a swarm of enemies. In order to move on in the game, the player needs to defeat enemies to exit and enter parts of a level. Defeating enemies gives a base score per enemy defeated. Combo attacks provide a multiplier score for the enemy defeated. Harder combos also add higher scores. Pickups in the game also add to the player score. At the end of levels, the player is given awards based on the amount scored. The game has many different special moves that can be used while fighting hordes of enemies to clear them out faster and can instantly kill enemies, it will also play a cut scene before activation or until completed.

rows.name: Play With Me
rows.short_description: Use whatever you can think of to destroy al the different objects that are keeping you away from playing with your human, but you will have to be fast because you have twenty minutes before he gets back home. Will you be able to make it?
rows.description_html: Play With Me is a charming puzzle game featuring a lovable pirate toy as the protagonist. In this indie game, you play as the pirate toy who wants nothing more than to be played with by your human owner. Unfortunately, your owner is too busy with distractions like TV, smartphones, and tablets. It's up to you to solve a series of whimsical puzzles and riddles to destroy these distractions and get your owner to play with you. With its colorful and cartoon-like graphics, Play With Me offers a playful and light-hearted atmosphere that's perfect for gamers of all ages. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter a variety of challenges that will test your problem-solving skills and creativity. From navigating through obstacle courses to manipulating objects in the environment, you'll need to think outside the box to succeed. Whether you're a fan of puzzle games, pirates, or just looking for a fun and engaging way to pass the time, Play With Me is the perfect choice. So set sail on an adventure like no other and help this pirate toy get the attention it deserves!

rows.name: Operation: Forge the Deep
rows.short_description: Solve real materials science problems, contribute to science, and survive a new ice age in a puzzle adventure that combines engineering problems with a unique puzzle that will challenge how you look at the world around you.
rows.description_html: There is real science happening here. You are helping materials scientists at Brigham Young University find out how materials work at almost atomic levels! Your contributions here matter, and are helping to publish real scientific data to the world! Follow the story as the world is struggling against a new ice age, trying to survive sub-zero temperatures while energy sources are running out. Reggie feels this personally as his family struggles to find heating for their home, in spite of creating incredible new inventions. What Reggie doesn't realize is that this invention holds the key to solving many of the problems the city is facing! Work with a team of engineers to solve the many issues facing the city, and uncover an undersea energy source that could keep everyone warm: Solve real materials science problems the team faces Learn how materials work in real life situations Dive deep into a harsh environment Face increasing challenges as weaknesses appear

rows.name: Hellway
rows.short_description: Hellway combines the advantages of retro stylistic roguelike games and is maintained in a dark-fun atmosphere. Inherits such titles as Bomberman™ (stealth elements) or Diablo™ (hack'n'slash, character development)
rows.description_html: Hellway combines the advantages of retro stylistic roguelike games. The game draws from such titles as Diablo™ and Bomberman™ but is maintained in a dark-fun atmosphere that may appeal to many gamers. Meet Zazazel, a little devil whose mission is to reach the very bottom of hell. He can do this in two ways: tear through the dungeon killing every monster he encounters, or painlessly place booby trap bombs on unsuspecting monsters (good luck!). We hope that the game will steal the hearts of those who prefer to go through the game with tactics and those who want to touch the sword of each encountered enemy. Game mechanics takes into account - 11 Acts. - A choice of 3 character classes: Pyrodancer , Banemaster , and Rockslider , each with a different skill tree. - Randomly generated game world. - Leveling up and Skill's Tree. - The need to ensure that your weapons do not blunt. - Equipment with life potions, sharpshooters or teleport to the city. - 4 statistics. Statistics Strength + Weapon's Level : affects your weapon's durability along with your minimum and maximum damage. Constitution + Armor's Level : affects your maximum health. Speed + Boots' Level : affects movement and attack speed. Luck + Amulet's Level : affects the chance for dodge, critical attack, and loot drop.

rows.name: Tempusia
rows.short_description: Based on rewinding time mechanics, Tempusia is the puzzle platformer requiring a big cold head :3
rows.description_html: Based on rewinding time mechanics, Tempusia is a puzzle platformer requiring a big cold head: 3 TIME-REWINDING MECHANICS In Tempusia, you can activate the 'rewinding effect,' and after it ends, a clone appears and copies everything the player did. To solve several puzzles, you must time the actions of the clones and the player. There is also the checkpoint mechanic, which allows you to return to some state of the game. The map is designed to have multiple ways, and there is a special button at the end of each way. After activating all the buttons, you can open the ending gate. You can also use the checkpoint to comeback after you finish one way.

rows.name: Iaijutsu
rows.short_description: In this retro action game, the player controls a mysterious ronin, navigating the rooftops and alleys of a rainy city as they are hunted by a team of elite assassins.
rows.description_html: In Samurai Bushido tradition, 'Iaijutsu' is the technique of quickly drawing your blade for lethal effect. Precision, patience and timing are key to this form. So too is it the key to besting your foes in this rooftop hopping action platformer. Play as the nameless ronin as you seek to liberate your clan from its corrupt usurpers. Your opponents will be tough and will block any careless attacks you may make, so pay close attention to their moves and choose when you draw your blade carefully. - Journey through two levels featuring a variety of beautiful pixel art environments - Encounter several combinations of enemies with varying abilities - Face off one on one against two tough bosses - Iaijutsu features an original soundtrack by samurai descendant Jeffrey Daijiro Taylor featuring two intense songs for Taiko drums. Controls : Move: A and D Strike: J Jump: Space Dash Attack: Jump + Strike, use WASD to control direction of dash

rows.name: A Game with a Kitty 1 & Darkside Adventures
rows.short_description: Foil a little nerd's world domination plans with Kittey in A Game with a Kitty 1 and help a grumpy little Archchancellor solve a mystery in Darkside Adventures! And as a bonus, the collection also features Treasure Hunter Man 1.
rows.description_html: Two very old freeware games shall live again! Play as chubby Kittey trying to foil the plan of an evil mastermind in A Game with a Kitty 1, or help the Archchancellor solve the mystery of Princess Daphodil's lost crown in Darkside Adventures. These two games are retro 2d platformers with a focus on exploration. As you play, you'll learn new moves that'll let you find new places and treasures, even in previously visited levels. Run & hat-glide with Kittey in A Game with a Kitty 1 or wall-run with the Archchancellor in Darkside Adventures. Numerous bosses are waiting to be challenged, too! What are you waiting for? Grab these moneybags and thoroughly kick some (evil) koala butt! And, hey -- as a special bonus, I've also added Treasure Hunter Man 1 to the collection. Features Retro pixel graphics at a VERY low resolution Two 2d platformers in one package Partially non-linear gameplay structure with light metroidvania touches Kinda hard (sorry) Saving & level selection maps Gain new skills as you progress through these 2 adventures Ending variations in Darkside Adventures A Game with a Kitty is relatively short (1-2 hours), but Darkside Adventures can take you much longer to complete Completely free (you can support me by buying my other games if you like) Amazing soundtrack by Sean Cameron (thank you) Controls In both games, hitting Backspace or double-clicking will activate windowed mode. Maximize the window to go back to fullscreen. --A Game with a Kitty 1-- -Arrow Keys: Moving -X or Shift: Jump -C or Control: Run (once you have it) -X or Shift in midair: Glide (once you have it) -UP & C/Control in midair: Kittey Zoom (once you have it) -LEFT or RIGHT in midair near a wall: Cling to wall (once you have it) -UP or DOWN while wall-clinging: Move (once you have it) -X or Shift while wall-clinging: Jump off (once you have it) -UP when next (not over) to a NPC: Talk --Darkside Adventures-- -Arrow Keys: Moving -X or Shift: Jump -C or Control (hold): Run (once you have it) -X or Shift in midair: Double Jump (once you have it) -C or Control (hold) and running into a wall: Wall run (once you have it) -X or Shift while wall-running: Jump off -C or Control (tap): Shoot star / pick up stuff -UP: Pick up stuff -UP when next (not over) to a NPC: Talk -TAB: Skip certain cutscenes --Treasure Hunter Man 1-- -Arrow Keys: Moving -X or Shift: Jump -C or Control (hold): Run (once you have it) -C or Control (tap): Attack with current weapon (once you have it) -Enter: Show inventory to select a usable item or use or switch weapons -Space: Switch between weapons -Jumping in midair: Double-jump (once you have it) -UP when next (not over) to a NPC: Talk There's rudimentary gamepad support. Please have the controller plugged in before starting the game. If it doesn't work, try disabling Steam Input for the game. If the controller still won't work, enable support for older programs in the Game Controller Settings (Control Panel/Win10+).

rows.name: Graveyard Girls
rows.short_description: Graveyard Girls is a halloween-themed yuri visual novel about complicated grief and overcoming hardships. Collect Elle’s “scribbles” to learn about her struggles, befriend a mysterious girl, and have a conversation about death.
rows.description_html: Graveyard Girls is a Halloween-themed visual novel about complicated grief and overcoming hardships. The game was shortlisted during the Spooktober 2021 Game Jam! Collect Elle’s “Scribbles” to learn about her struggles, befriend a mysterious girl, and have a conversation about death. 'Grief isn’t a low. It’s a terrifying high, atop a mountain I never climbed.' Visiting her father's grave on Halloween was never the plan, but inexplicably, Elle finds herself drawn to the local cemetery. Hoping to find a semblance of closure, she arrives at his graveside with a notebook clutched to her chest. Sitting against his headstone, Elle talks to her dad for the first time in years. Drowning in a downpour of memories, she closes her eyes and focuses on breathing. Daylight slips away, but before Elle can leave, a stranger approaches. When Elle and Lucia meet on Hallows Eve, two grieving worlds collide... - Collect Elle’s “Scribbles” and learn about her struggles - Halloween/Autumn Aesthetic - Conversations about grief and normalizing questions about death - Subtle romantic tones - Short and free, most players will be able to finish the game in 1 hour!

rows.name: XGamer - AI revolution
rows.short_description: 'XGAMER - AI Revolution' is a sci-fi third-person RPG game. In the main world, it is divided into 4+1 areas, the first 4 areas are: phantom, earth, void and heat. Each core has 20 programs. Find out The Key is. By getting to know The Key and finding the world code, you will know the truth.
rows.description_html: Only you can unveil the enigmatic plot concealed behind the game! Set sail on a riveting odyssey that transcends time and space in XGAMER - AI Revolution, an escapade steeped in the allure of science fiction. Together with your fellow adventurer, Tsz Ching Lee, delve into the tangled web spun by a cryptic gaming company and an enigmatic arms dealer while unraveling the closely guarded secrets of the AI Revolution phenomenon. Journey through the cosmos and encounter the mysteries of the unknown! XGAMER - AI Revolution is an extraordinary third-person RPG single-player game, unfolding across a tapestry of parallel universes teeming with wonder and enigma. Developed in Hong Kong, the game showcases traditional Chinese voice acting in the captivating tones of the Cantonese dialect. In the game, you are a traveler, visiting different worlds with the help of Xenro Device and Xenro(The AI), and everyone experiences the main world differently. Visit the fixed timeline to unlock the character's skills, improve the character's health, and get more story pieces. Let you uncover the true veil of the parallel world. 【NOTICE】 Traveler, remember one thing: you feel like you are who you are, and you feel like you are real, when in reality you are probably just an NPC in someone else's world. But there is another truth that the person who controls your NPC in another world may also be played as an NPC by people in another world... As an intrepid traveler of time and space within the game, you wield the power to traverse the boundless celestial expanse. Guided by the enigmatic Eternal Mechanism and the Xenro AI, immerse yourself in diverse prime worlds and fixed timelines. Each player's journey is unique, offering an individualized prime world experience. Unlock extraordinary character skills, enhance your vitality, gather narrative fragments, and ultimately unveil the hidden truths of parallel dimensions. Question your identity as the lines between reality and illusion blur! Heed this warning, traveler: you may be naught but an NPC in another's universe. Yet the puppet master pulling your strings could be destined to become an NPC in a different realm. As you embark on this limitless expedition, dare to challenge the fragile boundaries separating reality from illusion! Conquer light-years and push against the boundaries of survival! Embrace the innovative non-combative survival gameplay, where players can experience infinite reincarnations but must always return to the beginning. The prime world knows no bounds, its invisible walls forever elusive. Armed with the Xenro chapter selector, players can choose to replay chapters after completing them once.

rows.name: Dimwarper
rows.short_description: Dimwarper is an Icy Tower type of platformer, where You play as a mysterious character, who gained an ability to swap between two dimensions. Your task is to climb seven towers, controlled by seven wizards with different powers. This journey will require from You great focus and speed. Good luck!
rows.description_html: Climb towers with platforms, enemies and traps present in two different dimensions, between which You swap with one press of a button. Complete journey including eight different levels with increasing level of difficulty or jump into the Endless Tower mode and try scoring the highest possible score. Whatever you choose we hope You have fun! With each tower, You will face a new type of danger: - Smaller platforms - Moving platforms - Fireballs - Ice lasers - Fire and ice monsters - Changing speed of the game
