rows.name: Islet Hell
rows.short_description: Fly your plane over an archipelago of small islands and destroy all enemy planes and boats.
rows.description_html: This is a flight simulator in which you control a plane flying over a sea of small islands. The game is organized in a series of 10 levels of increasing difficulty. You have to shoot down all enemy planes and sink all enemy ships in order to win at each level. A radar at the bottom right of the screen allows you to locate all enemies as red dots with regard to your position, which is a black dot at the middle of the radar. Navigate the plane with the arrow keys in typical flight-simulator style: Left and Right for roll and Up and Down for pitch motion. Shoot with the space-bar. That is all! You have no bombs so you have to sink ships by simply shooting at them. However, they can fire missiles at you.

rows.name: Maurice: In The Predator's Nest
rows.short_description: Plunge into 'Maurice: Predator's Nest'. A survival game where you're either a cunning survivor or a fearsome predator in a dark, treacherous world. Outwit or hunt in this thrilling battle for survival.
rows.description_html: Dive into the heart-stopping world of A first-person horror survival game where the line between prey and predator blurs in the enveloping darkness. Navigate a treacherous environment, outsmart your foes, and survive the night, whether you're fighting for your life as a survivor or embracing the thrill of the hunt as a formidable predator. In the role of a survivor, you're plunged into darkness with nothing but your wits and essential survival tools. Each decision, from the paths you choose to the alliances you form, could mean the difference between life and death. Stealth, strategy, and teamwork are your best assets as you navigate through an environment where anything could be lurking in the shadows. Can you outwit the predator and lead your fellow survivors to safety? Embody the terror that stalks the night as a predator, each equipped with unique abilities that make the hunt exhilarating. Your powers allow you to track, trap, and outmaneuver your prey with chilling precision. The environment is your domain, a place where you can exploit the shadows to your advantage. Will you dominate the night and prove yourself as the ultimate predator?

rows.description_html: Try to escape Peepo Island by completing its difficult obstacle course and puzzles while an army of very cute Peepos try to push you to your doom! Peepo Island is a single player third person 3D platformer where the goal is to navigate through a very difficult obstacle course full of deadly traps that will test your reflexes and perseverance. If the traps weren't enough, you also have to worry about an army of little Peepos that are constantly chasing you and trying to push you off the edge! But don't worry, because you can fight back! The game has checkpoints that save your progress so you can return to it later! If you are a Twitch streamer, you may connect with your Twitch account and have your chat spawn their own Peepos with their own Twitch username.

rows.name: Ghosts over the Water: Changing the Tides of Japan's Future
rows.short_description: Ghosts over the Water: Changing the Tides of Japan's Future is an engaging strategy-based, multi-route historical visual novel. It is designed by a team of four undergraduate students associated with University of Texas, Austin's Japan Lab and Epoch Games Initiative.
rows.description_html: Studio Unagi's Ghosts over the Water: Changing the Tides of Japan's Future is a historical, immersive strategy game made by four undergraduate students from Yale University and University of Texas, Austin in association with UT Austin's JapanLab. Built upon a familiar and accessible visual novel framework, Ghosts over the Water takes you into a fast-paced world filled with difficult decisions. Featuring: - Three different, character-specific routes - Seven total different endings, based on choice - A rich cast of over 15 historically based characters - Engaging and expansive story with powerful dialogue (130,000 words!) - Hand-drawn art and assets - Collectible, full-screen CGs - Soundtrack of over 35 songs ~ It is the summer of 1853. Earlier in the year, the most unexpected visitors arrived on Japanese shores: Americans. A small fleet of ships commanded by Commodore Matthew C. Perry stormed into Edo Bay, engaging in no violence but causing immense panic. Over two hundred years had passed with Japanese borders closed to outsiders—and suddenly, these foreigners were at the country’s shores demanding open trade. You play as Tsumaki Naoharu: an ambitious, curious young samurai working under Abe Masahiro, the chief senior councillor of Tokugawa Japan. In his lofty position, Masahiro has the imperative duty of formally deciding how Japan will respond to this newfound threat. However, the answer to this deceptively simple question of, “How do we answer to the demands of the foreigners?” is far from clear. You will discover that the citizens are on edge, the opinions of the local lords are at odds with each other, and the current systems are at risk of being upended. But above all else, you will learn that nobody can decide whether to open up to Western trade or keep Japan closed entirely—and Masahiro is no exception. Out of desperation for information and assistance, Abe tasks Naoharu with collecting the opinions of people around Edo in order to gain insight on what to do about Japan’s future. Naoharu’s ability to talk to people and understand their opinions are key reasons as to why he has been chosen to collect this intel—and as the second son of his own family, he does not have the right to inherit the family estate. He must perform well in order to keep his job and establish productive political connections for a secure, debt-free future. There is no traditional sense of “winning” in Ghosts over the Water; the primary goal of the game is to explore and navigate the nuances of Tokugawa Japan's response to the Americans. You will discover what Japan feared, what Japan dreamed of, and what fate Japan pursued in the end. This simple task of gathering the opinions of the daimyo might open Naoharu up not just to the Western world but also to concepts and experiences he has never heard of or experienced before in his life as a samurai. He will meet several factions whose ideologies may intrigue or puzzle him... and it is up to you, the player, to decide whose beliefs hold the most weight—whose beliefs Naoharu will follow, and what end he will meet. If you so desire, you can even sit back and let Naoharu watch history play out as it was fated to. Beware, however, of the consequences. In Ghosts Over the Water, the fate of Japan lies with you.

rows.name: Escape Yourself
rows.short_description: You will take on the role of Danny Bent, a boy who wakes up in a train car. Without memories and without knowing why he is there, he soon realizes that something strange is going on. Can you solve all the puzzles? Of discovering the truth? Will you be able to escape?
rows.description_html: SYNOPSIS You will take on the role of Danny Bent , a boy who wakes up in a train car . Without memories and without knowing why he is there, he soon realizes that something strange is going on and all the passengers on the train are in great danger . You'll have to explore each wagon and find out what's going on in order to recover their memories and save your life . Can you solve all the puzzles? Of discovering the truth? Will you be able to escape ? Accept the challenge ! CHARACTERISTICS • Explore the train cars and unravel the mysteries they hide. • Story and environment engaging from beginning to end. • Large variety of main and optional puzzles . • Find hidden objects and solve the mind puzzles . • Collectibles throughout the adventure. • Genre: Graphic adventure , Escape room . • Languages: English , Spanish . • Players: 1. • Developed by one person . • Backgrounds drawn by hand .

rows.short_description: Play as a raccoon in this fun, stealth-based food retrieval game! Avoid rats and Animal Control while you collect food for your pack and explore the city of Scratchton.
rows.description_html: Your pack is getting hungry, and it's your job to get them fed! In this top-down stealth game, your goal is to collect food from trashcans without getting spotted by the evil Animal Control. Run, dodge, and do your best to avoid getting captured because the pack is relying on you! Players can expect a fast-paced journey around a city, locating trashcans and choosing food inside them. They'll explore around buildings, trees, and fountains throughout the cityscape until they fill their inventory full of tasty treats. Once their food is collected, it's a race back to the Old Raccoon and to winning the game.

rows.name: Lord Ambermaze: Prologue
rows.short_description: Lord Amber maze: Prologue is a free entry to a turn-based dungeon-crawler set in a labyrinth of frozen time. Plan each move carefully, battle quirky monsters, and solve intricate puzzles, one dungeon at a time.
rows.description_html: Test your wits and tactics in this stylish pixel-art maze where you’ll overcome predatory vegetables and stinky insects in unique turn-based challenges. Inspired by classic Zelda games, you’ll play as Zeyn, a young adventurer armed with a large sword, a bow, and bombs.    The gameplay is simple: time moves only when you move. Use this to your advantage — avoid deadly traps, lure enemies into them, plan several steps ahead, and use your modest arsenal to fend off the maze’s dangers.     Features: A unique one-off story that precedes the full game An exclusive boss not appearing in the full game Over thirty unique one-screen challenges filled with enemies, traps, and puzzles Speedrunning mode to challenge yourself and compare your results with players worldwide on the global leaderboard Wishlist the full game below!

rows.name: Keyboard Warrior
rows.short_description: Whether you are a keyboard warrior or not, you can take your keyboard here and use the keys on the keyboard as a weapon and launch letter-shaped bullets to defeat the guys who are trying to beat you
rows.description_html: Keyboard Warrior is a top-down view shooting adventure game. On your way to your destination, there are many enemies that will stop you, you can try to avoid them, or defeat them in the same way they attack, there are no bullets, instead there are letters,but they have Added the ability to deal damage as the bullets. You need to be careful to avoid these damages, then try to defeat your enemies. There are 9 levels in the game, and the total time is about 2 hours. The style of the game is bright and relaxed, the elements of violence are downplayed, and the fighting atmosphere is rather funny. The inspiration of the game comes from the ubiquitous keyboard warriors on the Internet. They will attack others with words on the Internet for no reason, just like in the game they will launch letter-shaped bullets at you for no reason to attack you, the game The characters are all sitting on chairs, just like sitting in front of a computer typing in reality world. Words can't make you bleed, but they can cause harm. The developers hope that through this game, we call on everyone not to be affected by keyboard warriors on the Internet in their daily lives. In addition, they also hope that everyone will not become that annoying keyboard warrior.

rows.name: AL QMRAH RESTAURANT - مطبخ القمرة
rows.short_description: Survive the night in AL QMRAH RESTAURANT with a 4-Player co-op survival horror set in a real-life restaurant, players take on the roles of restaurant workers completing closing tasks while facing haunted kitchen creatures and keeping the restaurant stable to find their way out.
rows.description_html: AL QMRAH RESTAURANT Get ready for a thrilling and scary adventure with *AL QMRAH Restaurant*. It all starts with a regular closing shift at a real restaurant, but things quickly take a terrifying turn. As the clock hits midnight. The restaurant's doors lock, and a otherworldly monster is after you. You'll need to face the restaurant's secrets to make it through. Game Highlights 🌙 Survive the Night 🌙 Brace yourself for a long and scary night, from midnight until 5 am. Can you handle the constant fear during these dark hours? Your goal is to make it through the night. 🚪 No Escape 🚪 You're stuck inside the restaurant with the monster. Your only option is to confront it. To survive, you'll need to uncover the restaurant's secrets and figure out how to escape. 👥 2 to 4 Player Online Coop 👥 Work with up to three other players to complete tasks, solve puzzles, and fend off the monster. Experience the terror together—while the presence of friends might give you courage, the fear is real... Can you all survive as a team, or will the monster claim its prey? 💡 Power Struggles 💡 The monster keeps messing with the restaurant's power, making things even scarier. You'll have to fix it to stay safe. Don't let the lights go Blue! 📋 Closing Tasks 📋 On top of staying alive, you have Tasks to do, like taking out the trash and cleaning up. You'll also need to organize and check the inventory. These tasks are essential to your survival. 🌑 Beware the Darkness 🌑 The shadows hide something spooky. If you stay in the dark too long, you might lose it all... Stay in the light to be safe... maybe safe... 🔪 Fight or Flight 🔪 When things get really tough, will you have the courage to stand and make your way out? Surviving might mean facing your fears... 🎖️ Multiple Endings 🎖️ Your choices decide how the story ends. Will you escape or get caught by the monster? It's up to you... Your decisions have real consequences! AL QMRAH Restaurant Isn't just a game; it's a dive into psychological fear. Your decisions shape your journey as you go through the night, get your tasks done, and discover the spooky secrets of the restaurant. Do you have what it takes to survive the night? Your adventure awaits!

rows.name: Astronite - Landing on Neplea
rows.short_description: Astronite Landing on Neplea is the prologue to this fantastic 1bit metroidvania that combines action, exploration, puzzles and platforms. Take on Astronite's first major challenge and defeat the deadly Kronch.
rows.description_html: Astronite Landing on Neplea is the prologue of this fantastic 1bit metroidvania that combines action, exploration, puzzles and platforms. Play the beginning of this fantastic space adventure. Mission 2205 is the last big chance for the ancient inhabitants of Neplea. Long ago the inhabitants of Neplea discovered that a strange Entity lived in the core of the planet. They studied it carefully but were never able to decipher the riddle. After a while, the Entity created a great army which ended up taking their home from the inhabitants of Neplea. Now it's Astronite's turn, an intrepid space adventurer who will have to do everything possible to expel the invaders from his planet once and for all. Play the beggining of the game and meet Astronite. Original soundtrack created by zeeWave Sound.

rows.name: Goblin Rules Football
rows.short_description: Goblin Rules Football (GRF) is an arcade sports game that is sort of like a dumb version of Rugby (AND NOW GOLF). You can play single player against the bots or multiplayer in either 1v1 or 3v3 matches. Power ups, punching, kicking, touching the ball on the ground, and more! That more is golf
rows.description_html: Goblin Rules Football Test your mettle on the goblin gridiron in Goblin Rules Football! Withstand the ferocious punches and blows of your opponent to actually touch the ball down to score a touchdown! Only one team can win, unless the score ends in a tie! Leave your helmet and pads at home. It's time to play the sport of a true warrior: Goblin Rules Football ! Strap yourself into the comfiest gaming chair you own and prepare yourself for the best 90's arcade style, goblin themed, rugby-like, 2D sports game developed for the PC by an amateur game developer that has been released on Steam in years! Punch opposing players to knock them out and steal the ball from them. Slide tackle to trip them and steal the ball. Pass the ball to your teammates! Run as fast as you can to score a touchdown (by actually touching the ball down!)! Kick the ball downfield to give your team space away from your own end zone! Collect and use powerful power ups! Avoid the refuse tossed onto the field by the crowd! Dodge the rowdy crowd as they streak onto the field! Always be on the lookout for the lone Goblin Cowboy on his smoke break. And introducing... Goblin Rules Golf! A BRAND NEW game mode has finally arrived! The people finally get what they've all been clamoring for, a new golf mode! Officially called Goblin Rules Golf (GLF)! Be careful out on the golf course. Strange weather is afoot, and it is affected by the statues of the Great Weather gods. Hit your ball within their circle of dominion to gain their favor. Good weather favor will grant you clear skies and easy hits. Bad weather favor will bring you nothing but rain, lightning, and a weak stroke. And if you dare to shatter the Bad Weather Statue with your mighty white ball (color can be changed in lobby), expect a ravage tornado to hunt you down! There are also power ups, spinning hoops to hit your ball through, and also green pipes that can transport you across the map. Try to have fun out there!

rows.name: Half-Earth Socialism
rows.short_description: Try your hand as a global planner of a future society. Play with a wide range of technologies and policies spanning different fields and ideologies. Will you lead the world to ecological utopia or planetary ruin?
rows.description_html: If you've enjoyed the book or the game Half-Earth Socialism, then join the HES discord server where you can chat with gamers, readers, and the authors. There you can chat about strategies for the game, organize with fellow ecosocialists, and learn more about history, theory, and utopia! To get an invitation to the channel email: half.earth.socialism@proton.me SET THE PLANETARY PLAN : Half-Earth Socialism allows anyone to try their hand as a global planner of a future society. Starting in the year 2023, you must make decisions about what projects the world will pursue--new research like alternative energy sources, or massive infrastructure projects like mass electrification or space travel, or one of over one hundred other possibilities. Decide how energy and food is produced across the world. Should we immediately halt all fossil fuel usage, or should we swap to a 'transition' fuel source first? WORK WITH PARLIAMENT : At the same time you must juggle relationships with competing political factions in global parliament and improve the quality of life for everyone on the planet. Will you be able to guide the world into a better future amidst differing interests and visions? IMPACT THE WORLD : Half-Earth Socialism features a simple model of the world: the impact of your decisions are simulated using the HECTOR climate model and a model of planetary production and demand. See how the world changes according to your actions--perhaps new culinary trends around eating invasive species, or the emergence of eco-terrorists if your plans fail to improve planetary health and human well-being. This game, based on the book Half-Earth Socialism (Drew Pendergrass and Troy Vettese, Verso 2022), is the fruit of the labour of many designers, researchers, and artists (full credits below). Francis Tseng (Jain Family Institute) is the game developer and Son La Pham (TRUST) is the designer. rows.name: Timmy Types
rows.short_description: Don't swipe - type! Improve your typing speed with this endless runner game.
rows.description_html: Don't swipe - type! Improve your typing speed with this endless runner game. In the 2010s the world went crazy for mobile endless runner games like Subway Surfers and Temple Run in which you swipe your away around obstacles and try to see how far you can make it before crashing. Timmy Types is a creative twist on the genre in that you type words to navigate your environment. The only interesting typing game I've found on Steam is Typing of The Dead: Overkill . The game is a great arcade experience that you navigate using your keyboard instead of a gun, and I really want to play other similar games. Unfortunately Typing of the Dead isn't really suitable for kids and there aren't really any other comparable games out there. And this is why Timmy Types was created. It is our first experiment in developing a fun family-friendly typing game. We appreciate your support of our game! We're working tirelessly, creating new prototypes and always thinking of ways to breathe life into the typing game genre. Hope you enjoy Timmy Types and please stay tuned because there's more to come!

rows.name: Dawn vs Dusk
rows.short_description: An over the shoulder arena battle multiplayer game. Battle as either the Dawn or Dusk teams for supremacy of the arena by holding capture points with your team mates. Last team standing at 20 minutes wins the game!
rows.description_html: 8/12/2025 There has been litany of improvements made to the game so far. In addition to setting up the private API to manage cross-play matchmaking, I have been completely rebuilding the game to incorporate many more components and streamline action using Unreal's Gameplay Ability System.  I'm hoping to do a release in the coming weeks, in Alpha. All the improvements I've incorporated are building the groundwork for swift character development when ready.  ALPHA TODOS: Finish GAS based basic attack system. Incorporate IK and advanced Animations on the Sheriff character. Rebuild the Card System using GAS. Updated map and other visuals. Build the character leveling and GAS based ability system.  BETA TODOS: Server Stress Testing. Build Character Bots for offline play. Complete Steam/Epic/PC Matchmaking on Dedicated Servers. Player accounts for game stats on official website. 6 complete characters. Deck Builder. RELEASE TODOS: 10 Complete Characters. Character customizing. Map creatures and events. Console Feasibility Study. POST-RELEASE: Single player character DLCs (story driven). More maps, More characters, More gamemodes! 5/16/25 Well its been two years without much development since I was working two jobs and have a family to look after. I was laid off a couple months ago due to the tariff war and now I'm back on the game development. The original alpha could never be competitive because it was self hosted. That was always a glaring problem. I am currently building an website and API to handle player accounts and matchmaking using dedicated servers. You can check out the 'coming soon' website at the website listed to the right in 'Visit the Website,' there you can subscribe for promotional updates.  I am a software engineer and this is the first fully featured online game I have made. I am working solo and I have zero budget. Adding characters, special abilities, a card deck maker, a character customizer, custom banners, and cross-play are all on the agenda. But I'm starting at the backend bottom and working back up to the game state where I'm building Unreal blueprints in C++ to handle the API authentication and other calls. (5/22/23 - First released version has some glaring bugs! I'm sorry but some sound effects are not being heard on all clients, and some bugs with point capture are present) Dawn vs Dusk is a 3v3, PvPvE, asymmetric, hard-point capture, styled, brawler. Featuring Unreal Engine 5 and Paragon assets, this game is a re-imagining of what that franchise could have been. There are no lanes, there are no towers to destroy; only three capture pads. When a team captures a pad they get Gold points to spend on card upgrades. Cards change the game by giving health, mana, or damage boosts. Each player receives 5 lives with no respawn timer, so play smart! Last team standing wins! As of today, May 22, 2023 the game is still a baby. Please be patient as I work solo to build and update this game. Early access, pre-alpha gameplay is not representative of the finished product, but comments and constructive criticism are welcome.

Grow your strength throughout each round, unlock game-changing attacks and abilities, and obliterate enemy players and bosses alike. ◆ Heroes With Roles Pick heroes with unique abilities and skills to fulfill strategic roles for your team: - DAMAGE: Simple but effective, super aggressive play style with a focus to take down the enemy - TANK: Persistent and hard to K.O., help your team hold the field and soak up the enemy's attacks - TECHNICAL: Versatile support, maximize your team's chances by boosting your allies and disrupting the enemy ◆ Customization Personalize your favorite heroes in your own style with character skins, entrance animations, and special finisher animations. Find an aesthetic combination that shows off your love for the characters in your own way.

rows.short_description: Dr. Pumpkin Island is shrouded in mystery and intrigue, with its inhabitants being some of the most unusual creatures you'll ever encounter. From the moment you step onto the island, you'll feel like you've entered a different world, with strange noises and peculiar sights around every corner.
rows.description_html: Dr. Pumpkin Island is shrouded in mystery and intrigue, with its inhabitants being some of the most unusual creatures you'll ever encounter. From the moment you step onto the island, you'll feel like you've entered a different world, with strange noises and peculiar sights around every corner. The island is home to a variety of puzzles, ranging from easy to mind-bending difficult. Some of the puzzles are physical, requiring you to use your strength and agility to get through, while others are more mental, requiring you to use your wits and intellect to unravel their mysteries. As you explore the island, you'll encounter a variety of strange creatures that seem to have evolved in ways that defy explanation. Some are small and nimble, darting around your feet as you walk, while others are massive and lumbering, capable of crushing you with a single swipe of their enormous claws. One of the most fascinating aspects of Dr. Pumpkin Island is its flora. The island is covered in lush, vibrant vegetation, but many of the plants seem to possess strange, otherworldly properties. Some plants glow in the dark, while others emit a strange, hypnotic scent that can put you into a trance-like state. Despite the many dangers that lurk on Dr. Pumpkin Island, there is something undeniably alluring about the place. Perhaps it's the sense of adventure that comes with exploring uncharted territory, or maybe it's the thrill of solving puzzles and unraveling mysteries. Whatever it is, one thing is for certain: those who dare to venture to this strange and mysterious island will never forget the experience. rows.name: A2C:Ayry seems to be playtesting a 2D runner shooter from Cci
rows.short_description: A 2D runner shmup(shoot-em up) where you may or may not save a nation by beating a game. Shoot and dodge bullets while you keep running and jumping! Enjoy a story where you play the game made by Cci while Ayry and Cci banter with each other(and talk about the world of Nosolute and game development)!
rows.description_html: 『Crow Highly, Towards the unattainable dream far away in the sky.』 Q:Why free? A:Reason 1:How are the children gonna afford my games if it isn't free? You see all those wonderful flash games out there? They are all [free]. So I guess I will make all my games in the future [free] too. A 2D runner shmup(shoot-em up) where you may or may not save a nation by beating a game. Shoot and dodge bullets while you keep running and jumping! Enjoy a slice of life(?) story where you play the game made by Cci while Ayry and Cci banter with each other (and talk about the world of Nosolute and game development)! In other words, it's a game about game-dev made by the in-game character in game who banters about the game with another in-game character, while you also play/experience the game the in-game character made! 玄之又玄, it's pretty meta. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Shoot Dodge Run SUPERHOT (opps wrong game) Hotel?Trivago ((Warning: Game contains flashy RGB bullets that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition.)) ((An option has been added which makes the bullets flashes slower and also removes most of the RGB from the game.)) (also someone remind me to update the steam store assets,they are outdated) Story: TL;DR The guardian of the nation has went missing again from work! And its up to Ayry to get the guardian(CcI) back to the work office by play-testing the game Cci made? Enjoy a story where you play the game made by Cci while Ayry and Cci banter with each other (and talk about the world of Nosolute(橆故原) and game development)! Features: 2D runner shmup gameplay where you jump and run and shoot and gun. Its a runner but its also a shoot-em up! You are forced to run forward but you can control how fast you want to go. A casual and chill story between 2 characters having fun at somewhere on the land of Nosolute. C00L backgrounds. Programmer art.(Yup,it is indeed somehow a feature.) RGB Bullets. A lot of RGB bullets. Different endings(probably). Bullet time mechanic to help you against the swarm of RGB bullets. Created (mostly?) by one person. Sorry, no dogs yet. Wonderful soundtrack from Rengoku Teien(煉獄庭園) and other composer. Game comes with free music ❎ Music comes with free game ✅ A kill counter for score chasers!(with numbers that will go up pretty fast) A timer for speed runners!(despite going fast at the game basically comes down to holding down the right key) Character Profiles: don't feel like writing it, have some wonderful @mi3li art instead (I mean I did actually wrote some in my discord...) Random Q&A Time Q:How much of hours of fun can I expect from this game? A:i will update this answer when the game is finished and asking people to play test it. The planned length™ is around 2 hours. Q:How much will the game cost? A:1 usd per hour of average gameplay length. So if the final game lasts around 2 hours, it would be 2 USD after the discount. New A: I have decided to make the game free to play as of now. Q:Discount? A:The game will be discounted 20% off on the first day, then I will keep it on sale as much as possible.The discount will raise very slowly over a long time(Subject to change). New A:Money is important, but there are things even more important than it, so I am gonna make it free. 'What do you have that can be sacrificed?' 'What are you willing to sacrifice for your ideals?' Q:Release Date? A:2023 Q3~4.(Please be prepared for the game to be delayed.) Q:Planned long term support after game release? A:Depends on my mood and the game sales.Possible contents are: An extra stage. A new difficulty mode inspired by Len'en called ABSURD, where things really get ABSURD(or it would become the extra stage). Maybe more in the future. Q:What is the meaning of life? A:There is no meaning of life.The meaning of life is something you create and decide for yourself. Q:What is this game inspired by? A:Rabi-Rabi, Alternative Sphere, WPNfire, Shuan's tutorial, Len'en project,2hou, Run online,i forgot the rest Q:What is a meme? A:A miserable little pile of ideas. Q:How much time have you spend on this game so far? A:The project started from 26 March 2022 00:40 with 228 Days 11 Hours 29 Minutes 8 Seconds of dev time. Q:How much money have you spend on this project so far? A:2394 USD + 13165 yen, VN stuff takes up most of it Q:why A:Life is short and painful, so learn to enjoy fresh air and have fun correctly. Q:Is this a shmup or is this a runner? A:It's actually a visual novel... Q:Fanfiction? A:I will decide when someone asks. Most likely going to copy and paste Len'en copyright rules. Q:Experience as a game dev? A:This is my first public game. Q:Planned career length/Amount of games? A:Until I die.🌟 Q:Where did the goodest trailer go? A:'People die when they are killed.' Q:Who are you? A:Just an hobbyist/doujin gamedev who have zero experience related to game dev. The funny thing is, I never intended my first game to be a shmup(or at least half of it).Whenever a major turn-point happens in my life,it is always involved with a shoot-em-up game.If fate truly does exist,then this must be it. Life is truly miserable and wonderful,isn't it?

rows.name: Arena Breakout: Infinite
rows.short_description: Arena Breakout: Infinite is a high-stakes tactical extraction shooter where every decision matters. Fight, loot, and extract—or lose it all. With stunningly realistic visuals, lifelike sound, and unforgiving PvPvE combat, every raid is a gamble between glory and ruin.
rows.description_html: TACTICAL EXTRACTION Arena Breakout: Infinite (ABI) has meticulously crafted 5 distinctive maps - the Farm, the Valley, the Northridge, the Armory, and the TV Station - with each demanding a radical shift in raid strategy. Sprint through the tight Valley corridors for hit-and-run strikes or plan a tactical siege in the Armory’s block-by-block warzone. But pay attention, nature doesn’t play by your rules - everchanging weather in the Dark Zone can alter every extraction into a new desperate gamble. Outthink, outgun, and extract - before the zone swallows you whole. HYPER-REALISTIC, EFFORTLESS MASTERY Arena Breakout: Infinite respects the depth military fans crave while welcoming newcomers with the red carpet treatment. For the die-hard military enthusiasts, this is a love letter to authenticity. Our Ultimate Gunsmith System features over 900 weapon mods on over 20 attachment slots to allow you to create your ultimate custom weapon. For newcomers, we’ve built in quality-of-life features like one-tap loadouts that let you gear up in seconds. Arena Breakout: Infinite strips away frustration so you can focus on the loot ‘n shoot fun. RUN SOLO OR WITH YOUR SQUAD Arena Breakout: Infinite offers a variety of game modes for all operators - Tactical Ops, Solo Ops, Covert Ops and fast-paced 4v4 Deathmatch modes. Whether you prefer tactical teamwork or going in alone, you decide how you take on the fight. TROPHY ROOM & PROGRESSION The Trophy Room is your off-field stronghold, where every upgrade and decoration tells your story. That rare sniper rifle, a stack of high-tier armor, or a collection of enemy dog tags - showcase all your hard-earned loot with pride! Here, progression never stops and each season brings fresh challenges - complete weekly and seasonal tasks to unlock rewards that grow with your lethal reputation. The crown jewel? A free, top-tier 3X3 Titanium Case ensuring your most valuable loot stays safe no matter how tough the raid gets. FAIR PLAY AND ANTI-CHEAT In Arena Breakout: Infinite, fair combat isn’t just a promise - it’s a guarantee with our ever-improving, anti-cheat system. This includes Killcam Replays that allow you to submit a one-tap report whenever you flag suspicious activity. Moreover, we don’t just punish cheaters - we make it right for you. If you’re confirmed to have lost loot, gear, or a match due to cheating, automatic in-game compensation will hit your inventory. Last year alone, our anti-cheat system placed 10-year bans to punish over 123,000 players, and reimbursed over 630,000 players with over 400 Billion Koens.

rows.name: Deceptus
rows.short_description: Arena PVP Multiplayer with up to 8 Players, pure mayhem, kill and collect famous death coins to unlock and equip up your characters with famous accessories and power-ups on 9 levels and counting.
rows.description_html: Expect mayhem and chaos! An original Arena shooter with up to 8 players, featuring true cross play against console, mobile or PC devices! Kill everyone, collect the death coins and earn bonuses or collect and unlock special cosmetic powers, new levels and new characters! At random times that nobody can predict, a red light will go on. No players are allowed to move or jump during this time or they will perish fast and loose one kill score. Players will however be able to aim and shoot at each other while the red light is on. Ow and of course players can through grenades as well.

rows.name: THE FINALS
rows.short_description: THE FINALS is the world’s first Dynamism Shooter, a free-to-play, fast-paced, physics-driven, first-person shooter set on the stage of the biggest Gameshow of the future! Fight for Fans and fortune in fully-destructible, virtual Arenas that guarantee no two rounds will ever play the same!
rows.description_html: GOT WHAT IT TAKES? Viewers at home, here's the news you've been waiting to hear: THE FINALS is accepting new contestants, and that means YOU! That's right, soon the world could be watching YOU tear apart our newest dynamic arenas and seize everlasting fame! As you know, THE FINALS is the world's greatest free-to-play combat game show! Our contestants plug in to our virtual world and join teams in escalating tournaments. They fight it out in our beautifully-rendered arenas based on real-world locations that they can alter, exploit, and even destroy. Sure, you can aim and shoot, but contestants that add our carefully curated virtual environments to their arsenal are more likely to advance, so do anything you can imagine in the name of victory! Burn arenas to the ground! Send wrecking balls crashing into your opponents! Don't just pull triggers - pull down buildings! THE WORLD IS WATCHING THE FINALS thrives on spectacle, so drive your fans wild with thrilling combat and your own personal flair as you compete for worldwide fame and the support of our discerning and stylish sponsors. Play Your Way - Whether it’s sneaking up on enemy squads with a katana in hand or ripping an entire building out from under their feet with explosives, THE FINALS lets YOU make the call! With different skills across body builds and a wide array of weapons and gadgets, you'll have all the tools to make your playstyle your own! The World Is Your Weapon (And Enemy) - A skilled contender might go in guns blazing, but with environmental destruction in your arsenal, that’s just the start of what you can wield against your foes! All of our arenas can be altered, used, or reduced to rubble - and not just by you. Your Rising Star - Ready for your close-up? Standing out in THE FINALS means the eyes of the world will be upon you, so you’d better look your best! Gather fans and fame as you craft a unique avatar with the help of our generous sponsors and dazzling customization options! GET FAMOUS This is the opportunity of a lifetime. Arenas based on iconic places, unparalleled destruction, and endless tactical possibilities await - make them your own, and the floodgates of fame will open. Your competition will have the same opportunities, so it’ll be up to you to be more clever and attention-grabbing. Are you up to the challenge? Are you the world’s next all-star? Can you reach THE FINALS?

rows.name: Blocks of Nature
rows.short_description: Combine cubes of the same color in a lapland-inspired scene with bright visuals and relaxing music for casual gameplay
rows.description_html: Blocks of Nature is a casual puzzle game. The objective is to combine three or more cubes of the same color and to keep scoring until cubes build up too high. Beware of the cold Winter has come. Cubes that fall on the ice block on the ground or touch other frozen cubes will freeze over time. Once frozen, they cannot be broken unless they are melted with lava cubes. However, lava cubes are rare, so use them wisely... Lava cubes cool over time and turn into rocks. These rocks can be removed by combining atleast three of them together, like normal cubes. Temperature falls as you gain levels, so cubes will freeze faster and lava cubes cool down faster too. For unknown reasons, as the temperature drops, it conveniently also makes cubes to drop faster. Maybe it´s the magic of Lapland? Rainbows to the rescue Rainbow cube is a special, but unfortunately a very rare cube. It will destroy every unfrozen cube of the same color that it lands on. It works for lavacubes too! Extra 100 points are granted if you are brave enough to land it on frozen cube or on the ice on the ground (It won´t do you any good, but hey, 100 points!). Casual or competitive? Seemingly so casual game can find itself being quite competitive if you challenge your friends in this game! There is an ingame online leaderboard too!

rows.name: One Night at Barneys 3
rows.short_description: A survival horror game based off of Five Nights at Freddy's featuring many iconic characters from Barney & Friends. Defend, upgrade, and discover secrets throughout the one night you will spend trapped in a prison.
rows.description_html: One Night at Barneys 3 is a continuation as well as a reimagining of the series started on Scratch four years ago. Based off of the wildly popular horror game, Five Nights at Freddy's, you will spend one night trapped in a prison, forced to defend yourself against Barney and many of his colleagues. Spend your night checking the hallways, vents, and cameras, collecting materials to craft and upgrade the tools at your disposal, and discovering secrets to alter the endgame. However there are no doors. Instead you are equipped with a EERG-15 Shotgun. Works like a charm...until you run out of bullets.

rows.name: OrbiTank
rows.short_description: Local multiplayer tanks in space!
rows.description_html: Tanks! Space! Tanks in space! Does much more even need to be said? OrbiTank is a local-multiplayer tank game with a fresh spin on projectile combat. Use gravity to your advantage to shoot your shells in and out of orbit, hop from planet to planet, and dive bomb your enemies. Explore a vast variety of arenas which feature several gravitational mechanics such as planets, orbiting moons, spinning space stations, and even treacherous black holes. Classic The classic game mode is good old reliable. You can't go wrong! It's just you, a friend, and the most balanced version of the game that has been experimented with. Players have three lives per round, and in order to win it all, you must rack up five points. Points are collected by winning levels, and levels will continue to be generated until either player wins the game. Usually a game in the classic game mode will last about 10 minutes, or until your friend starts to call your mother names. Tournament With the tournament game mode, you can challenge a whole group of friends to your mega epic gamer skills. Winner gets to not be made fun of for playing MOBAs. No, but seriously. Although no more than two players will ever be hashing it out on the screen at once, tournaments can be generated with up to eight contestants. This is a great game mode for parties and does not disappoint as a fun time sink. Expect hoots and hollers. Custom Trying to shake things up? Then this is just the game mode for you! You can modify several balancing settings using the custom game mode. This means if you want a really long game but it switches levels after every time a player is killed, you can do that. If you want to speed or slow down the fire rate to make the game more arcade-like or more tactical, you have the options. And, finally, my favorite, you have the ability to turn the planet movement up to like, a lot a lot. Prepare yourself for ludicrous speed.

rows.name: SHAFTED
rows.short_description: SHAFTED is a QUICK resource management game. Build your mini mining colony. Optimize your mineral outputs. Strategically position your buildings with turn based tactics. Pay off your contracts or else you'll get SHAFTED.
rows.description_html: SHAFTED is a micro-mining simulator with an emphasis on letting you quickly build out your colony. Single rounds are fast and short. The alien clients swoop in to extract contract payments. Clear out those clients and call it a day. Mining Colony Management Expand your colony with mining equipment. Build a variety of harvesters, each providing a unique production bonus. Manage 4 primary minerals: Stone, Copper, Iron, Gold. Each resource has a special purpose in your colony. Optimize Each mineshaft has a new optimization challenge. CONFIGURE optimal paths to maximize profits. SPEND from your bank to upgrade equipment. PRIORITIZE or else you'll get SHAFTED! Turn Based Tactics PLAN the placement of your units every day. No time limit. REACT to the alien client's attacks. (RUDE Clients!) Manage grid expansions on future stages!

rows.name: Silent Seeker
rows.short_description: Silent Seeker is a Hide & Seek multiplayer game. Play in the clutches of the hunter to find the props hidden in the map! Or Play as a prop and hide from the hunter!
rows.description_html: SOCIAL NETWORKS DISCORD SERVER About the Game Welcome to Silent Seeke r, the exciting multiplayer prop hunt game where you'll experience the thrill of hiding and seeking with friends! Become either a crafty Prop or a relentless Hunter and test your skills in an intense battle of stealth and strategy. BEING A PROP As BRUMBLE , your task is to blend in seamlessly with the environment by disguising yourself as everyday objects. Transform into furniture or household items scattered across carefully designed maps. But beware! One wrong move could give away your position and alert the Hunters. As a Prop, finding a smart hiding spot and staying perfectly still is essential. Utilize your surroundings to outsmart the Hunters and survive. Will you manage to stay hidden until the time runs out, or will you succumb to the Hunter's keen eye? BEING AN HUNTER On the other hand, embrace the role of a determined Hunter with FURY ! Use your sharp senses to track down and eliminate the elusive Props. You have three different attacks at your disposal, each with unique damage and cooldown times. Coordinate with other Hunters, communicate effectively, and devise clever strategies to corner and eliminate the Props. Props can use the environment to their advantage, making every match a thrilling test of skill, teamwork, and deception. Silent Seeker also features a chat system, allowing you to communicate with your teammates and opponents. Additionally, immerse yourself in the action with a proximity voice chat, where you can strategize with teammates or taunt your opponents in real-time. Are you ready for an exhilarating multiplayer prop hunt adventure like no other? Gather your friends, sharpen your senses, and dive into the heart-pounding world of Silent Seeker . The clock is ticking, the Props are hiding, and the Hunters are closing in. Will you be the master of deception or the ultimate seeker?

rows.name: Bloom: Roots of Renewal
rows.short_description: Bloom: Roots of Renewal is a first person shooter inspired by Hexen and Quake. Use your skills of magic and maneuverability to quell the overgrowth and free the forest and lost village of these creatures.
rows.description_html: The mystic forest is blooming and ancient evils have returned. Only the Tome of Power hidden in the ancient Archives contain the answers to how to defeat these forces. Use your skills of magic and maneuverability to quell the overgrowth and free the forest and lost village of these creatures. Game Details Thrilling Old School Combat Fight foes big and small as you navigate the forest in search of the Tome of Power. Evade tiny spiders, out-maneuver teleporting magicians, and find the perfect vantage point to take out your air-based foes. Unique Magical Environments From an overgrown forest to a forgotten library, from the depths of the caves to the heights of the mountains, navigate through the magic-infested world. Enjoy exploring a rich and varied landscaped filled with secrets and treasures to collect. Wide Arsenal of Weapons Battle your enemies with a wide selection of eight unique weapons, including shotguns, snipers, and heavy machine guns. Switch between them as you manage your ammo and find the right weapon for the job. About This Game Bloom: Roots of Renewal is created by the WolverineSoft Studio at the University of Michigan, a voluntary student games studio. It is an educational case study on Bethesda's Quake, and takes inspiration from its game mechanics as well as other games in the genre. Bloom: Roots of Renewal was developed by a team of 20 students. The development took place over a period of 8 months.

rows.name: The First Descendant
rows.short_description: The First Descendant is a third-person looter shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Become a Descendant. Fight for the survival of humanity. Descendants have unique abilities to tackle both solo and co-op missions. Up to 4 players use varied mechanics to defeat giant bosses. BE THE FIRST DESCENDANT!
rows.description_html: PLAY FREE NOW About the Game The First Descendant is a free third-person cooperative action RPG shooter featuring high-quality graphics. Experience the fun of strategic boss fights through 4-player co-op and various unique characters, exciting gunplay, and looting. A variety of equipment is necessary for growth, and you can obtain them through clearing scenario missions within the game or in the World Missions where cooperation is crucial and battles with huge bosses. The player becomes a Descendant in the game and is given a mission to fight against the invaders for the survival of humans and to protect the ‘Ingris continent’. The player can experience a spectacular story by growing stronger through various missions and stories to finally discover the Descendants' secret. You can also feel the First Descendant’s unique atmosphere through high-quality fields developed with Unreal Engine 5 and gain a new experience of reality and SF fantasy coexisting in one place. Charming and Unique Characters You can play various characters with distinctive concepts and battle styles. We plan to add various customizable elements such as skins for each character to support character decoration. Exciting Battles and Dynamic Action Using Various Skills and Firearms Experience the First Descendant’s exciting battles composed of various characters with unique skill sets, free movements, and chain actions through Grappling Hooks, colorful firearms, and additional effects. With these, the player can create any battle style they desire. Battles With Huge Boss Monsters Through Cooperative Play You can target huge boss monsters with different appearances and abilities through 4 player co-op play. The various difficulties will stimulate your competitive spirit, and you can destroy or extract various parts of the huge bosses through 4-player cooperative play. By targeting the huge boss’s gimmicks, you will be able to experience a more compact team play. Motivating Play and Growth You can equip a character with 3 guns, 4 secondary accessories, and various sub-weapons. Of course, there will also be items to enhance a character or their firearm stats or add a new ability all together. A variety of equipment is a necessary element for growth, and you can obtain them through clearing scenario missions within the game, or in the World Missions where cooperation is crucial and battles with huge bosses. We provide equipment so you can develop the characters to play continuously through character growth and acquiring and combining the various equipment. Use it to challenge yourself with more difficult tasks and enjoy the thrill of clearing them.

rows.name: PewPew Live
rows.short_description: A fast twin-stick shooter where you compete for the top spot in the leaderboards.
rows.description_html: PewPew Live is a twin-stick shooter with retro vector graphics where you compete for the best scores . Emphasis is put on the speed and diversity of the gameplay. Comes with 5 different built-in levels and dozens of levels created by other players! Online leaderboards, with replays of every score. Retro-futurist vector graphics. Unlockable ships, bullets and trails. 2 player co-op: online or over LAN.

rows.name: Catch Royale
rows.short_description: Remember playing tag? We spiced it up a little bit: Immerse yourself in Catch Royale: A stylized free-to-play Battle-Royale game with up to 250 players.
rows.description_html: Conquer the Catch Royale's everchanging seasonal maps as a hunter and catch them foxes or flip the coin, show your inner escape artist, and choose to be part of the foxes team. The concept is plain and simple: The hunters' task is to tag them foxes, aka catch them, as the name indicates. However, the longer you survive as a fox, the higher your reward is. Various settings, various parameters: Try out Party mode, in which, instead of the standard 100-player mode, you can battle amongst 250 other fighters. For the full experience, we added an optional Smart AI mode, in which you can set the other AI-handled foxes and hunters to find the optimal route to simulate the best experience. What can I do with my XP? The game offers 20 skins you can earn as you go up the staircase of experience points, each with a 5000 XP gap. Future features that are yet to come: Plain multiplayer mode Replay mode Create and publish your levels

rows.name: Flowa
rows.short_description: A relaxing 2D puzzle game about watering and collecting flowers. Plan an efficient route to the goal, complete bonus challenges, and collect as many flowers as you can!
rows.description_html: Gather flowers in 100 meticulously crafted levels Unlock and complete challenging hidden bonus levels Achieve tricky bonus goals on every level, with many unique varieties (think 'crack all the ice in the level' or 'jump at least five times') Experiment with tons of different objects, including teleporters, freeze bombs, blocks of slime, and dark matter that 'voids' anything it touches Access an additional 100 challenges in a difficult optional postgame

rows.name: Protocol Xeno
rows.short_description: This hectic twin-stick shooter will force you to balance blowing up massive alien warships and growing your monumental arsenal. How long can you survive in this galactic brawl?
rows.description_html: Earth has suddenly been thrust into the center of a galactic warzone, and now you must take charge and prepare mighty defenses. The aliens never let up for long, so you must carefully divide your attention between combating them and spending your resources. You may crush aliens with the moon or overwhelm them with your extreme partying, but they will only grow stronger. How long can you hold them off? Key Features Extreme Combat - Build weapons that dwarf even the largest mountains and fight aliens the size of planets. Resource Management - Spend your resources wisely for what upgrades you pick could mean the difference between a quick death and glorious survival. Ever Growing Challenge - The longer you survive, the stronger your enemies will become. Permadeath - Once the Earth has shattered, it's over, and you must once more build up your defenses using your new knowledge and skills. High Scores - Skilled players can aim for high scores, which challenge them to act fast and never give the aliens a break.

rows.name: Han'yo
rows.short_description: After witnessing her village being destroyed and slaughtered by the Oni demon, Hiroko has only one goal: revenge. Join this young samurai in this 2D side-scrolling platformer.
rows.description_html: Han’yo is a 2d side scrolling combat game that tells the story of Hiroko, a young samurai girl from ancient Japan. After witnessing her village being destroyed and slaughtered by the Oni, Hiroko has only one goal: revenge. Join her on a journey to find the Oni and avenge her people. Ancient Japanese themed fantasy inspired graphical style with ink Traditional samurai duels, where quick reactions will decide your fate Enjoy the visually calm feeling and the tension provided by the fast combats, providing lethal combat choreographies Languages: English, Spanish, Italian, German, Catalan, Basque Han'yo is a project developed by Hangover Studios, a team of 2nd Year students at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao in a 9-month development cycle from the ground up using C++ to develop their engine and game.

rows.name: VANQUISH
rows.short_description: This is Vanquish! A top-down pixel art shooter where you play as either an Orc Warrior or a Gnome Magician which have both crashed onto a cursed island.
rows.description_html: VANQUISH your enemies in this deeply challenging isometric arcade shooter. Awaken ashore and enter the fray with reckless abandon as Gruegus, the furious close-quarters fighter—or take a more tactical approach with Zarus, the shamanic magician. Find new weapons and abilities to augment or overhaul each character's distinct playstyle, and fight to your last breath while unravelling the mystery of this uncanny, mist-mired island.

rows.name: Utomah
rows.short_description: Utomah is a 2D platformer in which the player navigates through a nightmarish world. Grapple, latch, and dash through incredible environments, discovering the darkness of one's inner mind, encountering true horrors along the way. Prepare to push your skills to the limit!
rows.description_html: Utomah is a 2D platformer in which the player, a boy with a parasitic creature stuck to his head, navigates through a nightmarish world. Grapple, latch, and dash through incredible environments, discovering the darkness of one's inner mind, encountering true horrors along the way. With memorable bosses, challenging fast-paced encounters, and unique level structures, prepare to push your skills to the limit! Surreal environments to traverse! Can you make it through this unforgiving world? Three bosses that will push your platforming and combat skills to the limits! A world like you've never seen before! Everything you see was hand-drawn with charcoal. Immersive audio! Surely those creepy noises are coming from the game...right? This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: The Last Metal Shooter
rows.short_description: the Last Metal Shooter is a 2d Game art style run and gun action game focused on wave battles with the enemies and fighting using different weapons that can be selected and changed during the fights.
rows.description_html: the Last Metal Shooter is a 2d Game art style run and gun action game focused on wave battles with the enemies and fighting using different weapons that can be selected and changed during the fights. 'Game Missions' the Main Game Mode is the 'Game Missions' as the game has 5 main challenging missions with different kind of environment that it get harder by going forward in the game progress, the more you proceed further the more you meet different type of enemies and different challenges. each level has an ending fight as a boss fight or a hard enemy waves to stand and defeat. rows.name: Energy Tail
rows.short_description: Energy Tail is an oldschool arcade game where you fight enemies in relentless arena battles. It's free, so go and give it a try!
rows.description_html: Energy Tail is an oldschool arcade game where you fight enemies in relentless arena battles. You take control over a blue vectoid, which tries to stop the invasion of enemy vectoids into its realm. To defeat its enemies, the blue vectoid is able to create a deadly tail while moving, allowing it to let the enemies crash into its tail. However, the same is true for the enemy vectoids. The tron-inspired mechanic is simple to learn and hard to master, allowing for fast-paced arcade action that demands precision as well as quick reactions. Can you seal the breaches and stop the invasion? Fast-paced arcade action that requires quick reactions and high precision Simple game mechanics that are easy to learn and hard to master An abstract realm with elegant graphics 3 hand-crafted difficulty levels The hard difficulty poses a real challenge 20 levels offering a variety of enemy types Endless mode

rows.name: TrainFormation
rows.short_description: TrainFormation is a simple, fast-paced puzzle game created by one student as a university project. Place rails in front of an ever-accelerating train to cross procedurally generated levels, reach stations, collect power ups and make it as far as you can!
rows.description_html: TrainFormation is a simple, fast-paced puzzle game created by one student as a university project. Place rails in front of an ever-accelerating train to cross procedurally generated levels, reach stations, collect power ups and make it as far as you can! Build a path for the train Swap hexagonal tiles to create a path for the train. Make sure to find the matching rails and terrain, or the train will not make it through! ⠀ Reach stations and collect power ups Make it to a station and take a moment to breathe. Use specific rail tiles to collect power ups to help you in your toughest moments! ⠀ Make it as far as you can Reach new levels and face the difficult terrain. Hold on tight as the train continues to accelerate! ⠀

rows.name: Koa: The Forgotten Gods
rows.short_description: Become Kalena, a warrior who finds herself pursuing her revenge against the goddess of volcanoes, travel through the fantastic islands of the Pacific, seek the blessings of the Forgotten Gods and fight Tiki minions to dispel the curse that gnaws at you.
rows.description_html: Just Updated The game is designed to be played with a controller , if your are playing on keyboard you can add 'US English Layout' in windows . About the Game Koa the Forgotten Gods is a 2022 graduation game developed by a team of 7 students from ISART Digital Montreal. The goal of the experience is to provide a feeling of overpower to the player through a combat system based on the flow of movement. With abilities granted by the gods emphasizing the fluidity of movement, we invite the player to explore the world and history of a rich culture. Narration A story of passion inspired by the Hawaiian legend of Ohia Lehua. Play as Kalena, the cursed warrior, who lost her village and her lover to the explosive jealousy of Tūtū Pele, the forgotten goddess of volcanoes. Combat Possessed by the curse of Tutu Pele that Kalena manifests into wings, engage in fluid and fast-paced combat as you ravage the defenders of the Jungle. Prove yourself to the forgotten gods through their challenges and obtain their blessing to propel you forward with greater speed and power. Environment Explore the dense jungles, lush moutain peaks and rich caverns this Hawaiian tropical island has to offer with life and vibrant colors. Found on the island are multiple mythological areas describing the power of each gods you will encounter in a beautiful and serene display of divinity.

rows.name: GogMagog
rows.short_description: Play as the cyber-messiah as you bring judgment upon legions of heretics at the Armageddon. Build a deck of powerful abilities, scale up your gameplay with artifacts and create powerful synergies to smite the sinners!
rows.description_html: Play as the cyber Messiah as you bring judgment upon legions of heretics at the Armageddon. Build a deck of powerful abilities, scale up your gameplay with Artifacts and create powerful synergies to smite the sinners! Build your deck GogMagog brings a unique blend between the Twin stick shooter and Deckbuilding genres. While progressing in your run you will find additional cards that will create powerful combos with existing cards and overall snowballing your character to greatness, as well as card upgrades and artifacts that will synergize your deck. Plan your hand You only have 2 cards at your disposal in a given time, and each card brings a different type of action into the game whether it’s damage or utility you must plan accordingly. Using the wrong card at the wrong time might be the end of the run! Roguelike By combining cards with artifacts you’ll create a unique play-style, from melee to summoner builds or be a tank of holy retribution. When you die you’ll come back to a new set of challenges and a new build to smite the heretics with. Bring judgment In GogMagog there is no moment of rest for the savior, as the cyber Messiah you will be bombarded with massive waves of non-stopping heretics & demons that evolve with time and as the apocalypse becomes closer, so does the difficulty of saving the world.

rows.name: Vespa's Test
rows.short_description: Vespa's Test is a short, relaxing personality test based on real psychological research. Answer a multitude of thought-provoking questions, and receive a vision tailored to your answers; what, in life, is holding you back?
rows.description_html: To see the future is hard, but to see yourself is even harder. Vespa's test is a short, atmospheric personality test. During your time meeting with the titular and inquisitive Vespa, you'll answer a variety of questions about your life and the way you view the world, after which she'll attempt to read your present, and see what your greatest demons look like. There are numerous different outcomes, each of which is tailored from the answers you provide. What you choose to do with the insights provided, of course, is the greatest choice of all. Bagdul, city of Sapphires. A modern kingdom flanked for miles by sand and dust. Playground of the rich, resting place of the poor, and herald of the new millennium, with mysteries and secrets around every corner. One night, you follow a tip from a friend to a shady back-alley tucked between shadows. There, you find a out-of-place circus tent shrouded in the drippings of another world. What awaits within? Only one way to find out... Short and relaxing ~15 minutes playtime Answer over 100 introspective questions Various results depending on how you answer Completely free The results and questions are loosely based on psychologists Jeffrey E. Young, Ph.D. and Janet S. Klosko, Ph.D.'s concepts of 'lifetraps', which attempt to model patterns of behavior that hold us back in life, but you couldn't possibly know that, could you?

rows.name: Third Power
rows.short_description: Third Power is a unique puzzle adventure where players alternate between forms with distinct abilities in order to progress through a mysterious tomb. Avoid traps, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of an enigmatic curse as you advance toward discovering your third—and final—power.
rows.description_html: Third Power is a twist on the traditional puzzler, where players must balance alternating between two distinct forms and use the unique abilities of each in order to advance through a mysterious and dangerous cave system. You’ll have to dodge traps and monsters, deflect projectiles, and decipher clues as you puzzle your way through the numerous stone chambers, each of which boasts unique challenges to overcome in order to progress. Creative Puzzles Each area presents new and exciting elements to discover. You’ll have to rely on the powers associated with each of your forms to figure out how to get through to the next room. From hidden panels to mysterious switches to manipulating projectiles to traversing mazes, there is no shortage of exciting brain teasers and satisfying solutions laid out before you. Dangerous Foes Keep your eyes up - or you might get encased by jelly! You may have to dodge a wolf that can manipulate your very form, too. Keep your wits about you and make the best use of your powers to avoid the creatures that defend these enchanted halls. Mysterious Lore As you make your way through the perilous chambers ahead, you’ll uncover hints of a curse laid over the area, threatening anyone who dares move through the caves to satisfy their desire for fame or treasure. Will you be the first to achieve your goals without succumbing to the curse? Uncover the secrets of the tomb, before it’s too late...

rows.name: Mushroom Musical
rows.short_description: A colorful and difficult rhythm platformer game.
rows.description_html: Bounce to the beat of different music genres, and save your missing mushroom friends! Mushroom Musical is a colorful platformer game, with two game modes: adventure and challenge. In adventure mode, you are searching for your mushroom friends through forests, fields, oceans and factories. The better you are in adventure mode, the more skins and adventure/challenge levels you unlock. Each adventure level has its own music genre. Examples of level names: Jellyfish Jazz, Bumblebee Blues. The challenge levels is where you can test yourself to see for how long you can avoid enemies. If you get good at it, it´s also a way to unlock skins. There are 3 worlds, 9 adventure levels, 1 boss level, and 3 challenge levels. This game is also available on android. Wishlist the next game in the same genre: Balls & Beats!

rows.name: Eremidia - Archivist's Curse
rows.short_description: Archivist's Curse brings you into an otherworldly harbor of knowledge: The Great Library, although unfortunately, you ended up in the dangerous section of the complex called Hall of Pawnsmoor.
rows.description_html: Wishlist Insurgence - Bloodmoon! Click the images for more information, and don't forget Add to your Steam Wishlist now! Join or Discord Server! About the Game Archivist's Curse brings you into an otherworldly harbor of knowledge: The Great Library, although unfortunately, you ended up in the dangerous section of the complex called Hall of Pawnsmoor. To escape from the Hall, you have to take the test from The Chessmaster, Hall's current proprietor. Before you face The Chessmaster, you need to find companions who, fortunately, may come from Hall's own collection. Enter the Library's murky Dark Alleys to find companions, items, and clues on Hall's history as well as its owner. Fight against numerous intruders from within the Library as well as from the outside realm, and ultimately, defeat The Chessmaster to obtain your freedom and escape from Hall of Pawnsmoor. Synopsis: The 'Chessmaster of Pars Mythos' has invited you to play his game of chess--or that's what he wants you to believe. His game is not mere chess, however; you're required to find your own chess pieces, as he will also bring his own pieces. In order to find your own pieces, you need to delve into the murky, once-forbidden Hall of Pawnsmoor. Luckily, you will be assisted by another unexpected guest--one of the Scribes who happens to have knowledge about what the Hall has to offer. Know your pieces, learn about his game's rules, and best the Chessmaster in his own game, for it's the only way to release yourself from the Hall's succumbing imprisonment. Features: Two game modes: Chessmaster Match, where your mettle is tested; and Dark Alley, where you explore the Great Library for resources and unlockable companion pieces. It has its own tutorial segments, separated from the main game modes, too. Grid Battle System; fight various enemies on a chess-like battlefield. A slow tactic-like battle mechanics that emphasize position and proper abilities usage, since the battlefield can be affected by any present pieces. Dozens of unique, playable companions; each can be promoted to unlock their potentials to the fullest. Each comes with its share of lore that explains their backgrounds, abilities, and characteristics. Dozens of enemies to take on, including hidden bosses and a series of enemy compilations present in the Chessmaster Match. Crafting equipment, with unlockable recipes either from Dark Alley and every match you win against the Chessmaster.

rows.name: BloodPit: Skelton II
rows.short_description: Find travelers and fight mutants through the violent waves and endless levels of the blood pits.
rows.description_html: The Skelton zones on the surface are not the only places trapping travelers. Enter the Blood Pits as a new rescuer. The mission: Save as many as you can as you descend down the elevator and rescue travelers on each level. Fight through endless waves of mutants and followers as they keep the final remnants of true human DNA locked away. In FPS style action where you navigate through the dark caves and structures. Dig through rocks and shoot the opponents. Locate the 'travelers' and make it back to the elevator alive to descend just one floor deeper. There is no end. You do not escape to a better life, this is all there is. The only question to ask of the rescuer: how many final human travelers can you save?

rows.name: Queen Beast
rows.short_description: Join Otto on his quest to rescue his sister in this fantasy visual novel.
rows.description_html: INTRODUCTION The uneventful days of the humble miller Otto are thrown into chaos one morning when he rolls out of bed to discover his beloved sister Bronwyn has been kidnapped! The culprit is a mysterious knight in black armour; the only clue left in his wake is a bag of gold coins minted with the profile of an unknown woman. Joining forces with the beautiful and enigmatic adventurer Switch, and the mischievous fairy Echo, our hero sets forth on a journey through the forgotten corners of his homeland in pursuit of the black knight and the sinister forces behind him. But on the way Otto will discover much more than he anticipated in this tale of romance, swashbuckling action, and adventure! FEATURES A concise, fully-realised visual novel inspired by genre classics 60,000 words clocking in at around 5-7 hours of reading De luxe hand-drawn character and background artwork Dozens of bespoke illustrations depicting key moments in the story A memorable original soundtrack that brings the adventure to life All for absolutely free! CHARACTERS After losing his parents to a plague, the disappearance of his older brother, and suffering an injury that left him hobbled, Otto feels as though the wheel of fortune has tossed him aside and left him to rot. When his sister, his sole remaining family, is inexplicably kidnapped, this retiring and passive youth decides he's lost quite enough and resolves to take his destiny into his own hands. From the scorching deserts of Casper comes this wily and free-spirited adventurer, hot on the trail of a series of kidnappings she's been tasked with investigating. When her path crosses with that of Otto's, the two team up in the spirit of mutual interest. But the appearance of such a stalwart ally seems almost too good to be true; just what other motivations does she harbour behind her lovely face and disarming smile? A certain incident in a magical forest thrusts the presence of this adorable, disagreeable creature into Otto and Switch's reluctant company. Living for thousands of years has granted Echo a wealth of knowledge and wisdom, but extracting anything of the sort past her dismissive and haughty personality may well prove to be an exercise in futility. Probably born to be a teacher, Otto's sister Bronwyn decided from an early age that her goal in life was to give every child in the isolated valley where the two siblings reside a proper education. Being kidnapped has thrown a considerable wrench into these plans, and being separated from her younger brother, the apple of her eye, has left the usually altruistic and patient young woman in a foul mood that she won't hesitate to visit upon her captors. A cruel and capable warlord from the harsh northern steppes. A successful military campaign has placed the land of Byron and its long-suffering people in the palm of her hand, but also left her unsatisfied, existentially bereft, and quickly sliding into indolence and hedonism. The stage is set for this slumbering beast to be roused from her stupor, but who can say whether good or ill will come of it?

The stage is set for this slumbering beast to be roused from her stupor, but who can say whether good or ill will come of it?

rows.name: Super Nova Party
rows.short_description: Prove to your friends that you're the true hero of the galaxy in an out-of-this-world party game! Win minigames and reach distant planets to save the most escape pods before Nova implodes.
rows.description_html: Nova's going super! Compete online against 3 of your friends in this party game among the stars! To win you'll need to collect the most escape pods before Nova implodes the galaxy! But how do you collect these pods? Soar your ship through multiple spirals of the galaxy to reach the planet at the end and rescue their pods Play chaotic free-for-all battles and intense 1v1 duels to make a comeback or further your lead Use movement cards to try and land on the perfect board space Super Nova Party is currently in an alpha version and will continue to receive updates.[/b] In it's current version, Super Nova Party requires a full party of 4 to play and does not support split-screen. There is currently only one minigame for the duels and battles, but more are planned!

rows.name: My Hotel: Echoes of the Past
rows.short_description: Try it now for free and Add to Wishlist! Step into a 1950s adventure with My Hotel: Echoes of the Past! As the new owner of a hotel shrouded in mystery, renovate with style, unravel secrets, and juggle faction intrigues. A captivating blend of history and adventure.
rows.description_html: Add to wishlist About the Game My Hotel: Echoes of the Past! Welcome to the intrigue of the 1950s, where mystery cloaks every corner of My Hotel. Remember - this is a free trial. Ensure you're in the loop by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist for the full, thrilling story. You've just landed the role of a lifetime: owner of a hotel that's seen better days. It's like stepping into a 1950s adventure movie – the previous owner's mysterious end, a hotel riddled with secrets, and now, it's all yours. Your quest: to transform this relic into a beacon of style and history. Choose from a range of furnishings that span decades, each with its own story to tell. But it's not just about the décor. The guests are as varied as they are mysterious, some with quests that will draw you into a tangle of alliances and covert affairs. Balance these factions carefully to keep your hotel thriving and avoid a fate like your predecessor's. It's a game where adventure meets history, and every decision you make is a part of the legend.
