rows.name: SquadBlast
rows.short_description: Master the most intense platformer shooter ever created. Play in teams of up to 5v5 players across 8 game modes or make your own custom lobby. Collect & craft an arsenal of weapons to master your loadout. Play cross-platform for free on PC, Console, Mobile, and Web with full controller support.
rows.description_html: The year is 2042 and the state of the planet has been in decline: bankrupt governments and ruthless dictators are plentiful, while selfish corporations rule the world. Injustice against the powerless population is rampant. But there is hope. Armed gangs organized by a shadowy organization are intent on battling the oppressive evil. SquadBlast is a free-to-play multiplayer run and gun shooter. Its team-based battles are an innovative take on a shooter that you have to experience — meticulously balanced for fairness and incredibly easy to pick up and play. In SquadBlast, every bullet matters. You'll need to adapt diverse lines of attack to claim victory in a variety of modes. Play cross-platform with your friends for free on Xbox Series S|X, Xbox One, PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android, web, cloud and PC with full controller support. DEEP CLASS-BASED COMBAT Choose from a roster of heroes, each with their own abilities, to turn the tide of battle in your team’s favor. You’re sure to find a favorite, but you’ll have to master them all – and even swap heroes mid-battle – to shut down your opponents’ dreams of victory! AN FPS IN DISGUISE Bring all your skills from your favorite FPS. Swap to your secondary after unloading with your main. Equip your melee weapon to run unburdened. Rocketjump for a greater vertical leap. Slide down ramps, bunny hop, vault over projectiles and more. MEATY MULTIPLAYER Jump into battle to master each essential multiplayer mode, from TDM to Capture the Point to Payload. Better yet, pick a custom match to choose the map, mode, and rules that suit you best. Always expect a smooth experience since all the action is synced with perfect rollback netcode. Lead your squad to striking locations across the troubled world of 2042. GUNS GALORE One thing's for sure – there are tons of guns in SquadBlast, from assault rifles to rocket launchers to experimental supa weapons. Get your hands on each one and get a feel for the play style that maximizes its effectiveness. SUPER COMFY CONTROLS Pick up and play! All the controls are right where you'd expect them to be whether you're playing with a controller or mouse and keyboard.

rows.name: Rawbots
rows.short_description: A universe where you can play with amazing robots that are designed, built and even programmed by you.
rows.description_html: A universe where you can play with amazing robots that are designed, built and even programmed by you. Everything is a robot, doors, roads, walls, bridges, safes, traps, turrets, surveillance systems, etc. Build forts, towers and architect impressive structures to protect your planets and resources. You may play solo or with friends to infiltrate, conquer planets and gather resources. The Rawbots universe has a unique set of matter, energy and physics laws. These laws are engineered to serve up fun emergent gameplay that is different every time you play. Everything you would expect from a sandbox game and more. We are taking this to the next level with gameplay that truly emerges beyond imagination and defined contextually by the type of robots you build. On one planet you might experience a first person shooting experience, go into a space battle in 3rd person, and down into an RTS offensive on another planet. An intuitive and streamlined graph system will bestow the power of visual programming into the hands of creative minds. Under the hood, the latest in signal processing, inverse kinematics and PID controllers, will breathe life into your creations. From geeks, to tinkers, to grinders, there is a creation path for everyone. And while you are building and tinkering around, we will also be busy developing story campaigns, random missions, battle tournaments and creating new and impressive bot parts.

rows.name: CALAMITY CREATURES
rows.short_description: CALAMITY CREATURES is a 2D action game in boss rush format. Mechanical creatures of overwhelming stature stand before you. Gadgets in the prosthetic hands, the terrain, and the enemies' habits...use all the elements to dismantle the living calamity.
rows.description_html: Abstract CALAMITY CREATURES is a 2D action game in boss rush format, in which players dismantle giant mechanical creatures. In this game, mechanical creatures of overwhelming stature stand before you. In order to overcome the desperate gap in strength, you will need to use gadgets in the prosthetic hands, the surrounding terrain, and sometimes even the habits of your enemies.... You will need to make effective use of everything. Find their weaknesses points and dismantle the living calamity. Mechanical Creatures Hostile creatures have a wide variety of characteristics. They range in size from large animals to skyscrapers, and their habits vary. To defeat them, you must sometimes perform difficult actions and sometimes use your head. Various Actions The character can perform various actions with the gadgets in her prosthetic hand. A variety of actions are possible, such as clinging to enemies, turning bolts, shooting bows, and ejecting wires. Others This game is compatible with game controllers.

rows.name: Kathana
rows.short_description: Adventure awaits in Kathana Select your character, quest with friends, face challenging bosses, explore dungeons, and engage in guild wars and PvP battles!
rows.description_html: Embark on an epic journey in Kathana and immerse yourself in a world brimming with adventure! Join forces with friends and connect with adventurers from around the globe in this captivating classic MMO. Set out on shared quests, overcome formidable challenges, and experience everything Kathana has to offer. Key Features: Rich, Immersive Storyline: Uncover the mysteries of Kathana through a deep and engaging narrative. Solo and Party Quests: Tackle quests alone or team up with others for greater rewards. Epic Boss Hunts: Face off against powerful bosses in thrilling encounters. Dangerous Dungeons: Explore perilous dungeons filled with secrets and treasures. Guild Wars: Battle for dominance and glory in large-scale guild conflicts. Ranked PvP Arenas: Test your skills and climb the leaderboards in competitive PvP. Duels and Open PK: Challenge others in one-on-one duels or engage in open player combat. Forge Your Own Path: Choose from 8 highly customizable character classes, each offering unique playstyles and abilities. Tailor your stats and skill progression to suit your strategy and preferences. Full Character Customization: Personalize your character’s appearance with a wide variety of weapons and armor. Dynamic Visuals: Your look evolves with every piece of equipment you wear. Flexible Stat Allocation: Assign spirit points freely to shape your strengths. Unique Specializations: Select from 8 distinct character specializations. Versatile Skill Trees: Mix and match skills to create your perfect build. Are you ready to write your legend in Kathana? The adventure awaits!

rows.name: Jasper and the City of Lights
rows.short_description: A cozy adventure about love, kindness and slowing down. Two siblings are separated, a mystical forest is where they were last seen. In the darkest shadows, an old spirit is hiding, but the lights of an ancient city is shining between the branches. Fully narrated, easy to play.
rows.description_html: Roadmap Join the journey into the world of cozy adventure gaming! The Weasel Club is the perfect place for those who love games about exploring mystical worlds, cultures and heartwarming stories. We are building the Weasel Club as a hub for players to get involved with the direction of projects like Jasper, and for developers to be part of a friendly and supportive group that values creativity and thoughtfulness. Some key features of the Weasel Club include: Beta-access to games Giveaways Events like game-jams or screenshot contests We can't wait to see you there! <3 About the Game On summer vacation Jasper and Nora were separated, when one of them carelessly decided to enter the forbidden forest in front of their grandparents farm all alone. Jasper, Nora's young brother, gathers courage when he sees a star falling out of the night sky and takes on the quest to find and bring back his beloved sister and reunite the family. Features Survive the Cold! Something is going on in the depth of the old forest in front of grandma Sophies farm: Snow and ice, in the middle of summer? Don't venture too deep into the icy cold of the whispering forest or you will join the freezing souls of Myr! Bring the World to Life! A shooting star crashes inside the very forest where Jasper's big sister is thought to be missing. Where will it guide Jasper? Light up candles and lanterns and experience the forest coming back to life! Complete your Collection! Document the mystical nature of the forest and its inhabitants and present your findings at the Library of Myr. Find Nora’s treasures and other collectables and showcase them back at the Narrator’s home. Collect Soul Dust to strengthen Jasper's fallen star and increase your power! Make Friends! At first glance only the whispering masks live within the shadows of the woods. But wait, is that light in the distance? The deeper you go, the more you will learn about a civilization that only a few people ever got to tell stories about. Reveal the Mystery! Ice and snow in the middle of the summer. The stars are falling out of the sky. Whispering masks lurk in the shadows. The lights of a city on the horizon. And a name that makes the people of Myr shudder: Svangur Stay Warm <3 Many cozy features are coming to Jasper. This is a game that can be explored in your own pace. We do try to invite you to stay for a while and enjoy the atmosphere. Wholesome features that are planned for the future include: Jasper’s analog camera A library that you can upgrade and fill with knowledge Fishing (Soul flower gardening?) (Just sitting down near a warm candle and taking a break from the long journey?) ??? About We started working on Jasper with a vision of what we would love to play, today we are proud and happy about what we created. After we worked so long on Jasper, it's sometimes hard for us to keep focus on what matters. For us this is not just a game we love to play anymore but a passion project that we poured our heart into and at this point we constantly get lost in little details. So for the next step we are moving to a community-driven approach. We need to continue work on this openly and with your  opinions, wishes and criticism! If you are into games that are fully about immersing yourself into mystical worlds, cultures and heartwarming stories, please join us on this journey. Jasper is our framework to build a world about love, kindness and slowing down. Join us on the Weasel Club Discord to discuss with us about the City of Myr that is hidden within the Whispering Forest.

rows.description_html: You start the game with one penny, you have to find the person who is interested in trading your penny for anything more valuable then the penny for example a Pen, then sell the pen for a Coin, then buy a water bottle with that and sell it double the price, continue the cycle until you have enough money to afford the plane ticket to the next city, You also have side quests like walking the Dog, collecting plastic trash and selling it, finding golf balls and starting a bid and food deliveries, Once you buy or rent any of the vehicle, You start getting food delivery orders. Use all the money to buy the plan tickets and reach to the mrBest and deliver him the penny but don't waste your time since you only have 30 days, and remember to feed Trayan every day. Good Luck :)

rows.name: RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure! ~SHOBOMI AND THE PHANTOM RUINS~
rows.short_description: Action game suitable for live game play and streaming, which looks cute but full of unreasonable traps! 'RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!' series is a 2D side-scrolling action game in which you control Shobomi, a cute cat character, and aim for the goal!
rows.description_html: New DLC Available About the Game Action game suitable for live game play and streaming, which looks cute but full of unreasonable traps! 「RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!」 'RUKIMIN's Disappointing Adventure!' series is a 2D side-scrolling action game in which you control Shobomi, a cute cat character, and aim for the goal! The second in the series! Join the 'Shobomi Expedition' and explore the phantom ruins full of traps! Unpredictable traps everywhere! A lot of unpredictable traps that will make you shout, 'How is this possible!!?' were prepared. For example, when you try to pick up a coin, you are trapped in iron bars, and when you are stuck, spikes fall on you, or when you pick up a key, you are crushed because you cannot bear the weight of the key. The game is full of traps that you cannot even imagine. We assume that the main target players are live game players and streamers. As a secondary target, we are targeting players who like to play 2D platformers with high difficulty level. We want the game to be delivered and played live, and for the audience to get excited by enjoying the reactions of the distributors. In addition, we hope that the distributors and the audience will cooperate with each other to find solutions by communicating and thinking of ways to avoid the traps together.

rows.name: Heartbite: Dating in Daylight
rows.short_description: Get to know a unique cast of characters in Heartbite: Dating in Daylight! Escape from a dire situation, collect candy and witness a decisive battle as you get closer to them. Behold stunning locations, uncover secrets and get a taste of different genre minigames in this dating sim!
rows.description_html: You wake up early, and the sun is already beginning to shed its rays over the skies. But this time you won’t hide away from sunlight. Food’s out after all, and who knows what (or who) you’ll encounter out there? Maybe there is hope for a nocturnal creature such as yourself to find what you’ve been looking for? Get to know a unique cast of characters as you go through your day in Heartbite: Dating in Daylight! Escape from a dire situation, collect candy and witness a decisive battle as you get closer to them. Behold stunning locations, uncover secrets and get a taste of different genre minigames in this dating sim! These mini games are a platformer, a physics playground and an old school RPG battle!

rows.name: Capitals
rows.short_description: A mash-up of the common idle clicker genre and a city builder, Capitals is a fast-paced and competitive strategy game. Each match is set on a resizable game board made up of hexagonal tiles, randomly generated each time you play.
rows.description_html: A mash-up of the common idle clicker genre and a city builder, Capitals is a fast-paced and competitive strategy game. Each match is set on a resizable game board made up of hexagonal tiles, randomly generated each time you play. Games will have you try to build and grow your city as fast as possible, forcing you to keep up with the ai or players you're up against. There are two ways to win: spread your territory as far across the map as possible, building over enough 'winning tiles' to collect the majority out of all other players; or play the offense/defense game and wipe out your competition. But if you aren't playing a balance of both you're bound to lose. This game is a year-long labor of love accompanied by a thorough soundtrack from a project partner, so I hope this delivers! If you'd like to learn more about the both of us the developer credits include links and are on the first page upon opening the game...

rows.name: Trimurti Online
rows.short_description: Relive the classic gameplay of an old-school MMORPG. Select a class that suits your style and join your friends to explore the vast world of Trimurti Online. Upgrade your equipment and maximize your skills, face monsters and bosses, conquer dungeons.
rows.description_html: Discover and explore the world of Trimurti Online! Enjoy a classic MMO experience with your friends, meet people from all over the world, share objectives and face countless challenges in the world of Trimurti Online. Long argument. Solo and group missions. Boss hunt. Raids. Dungeons. Guild wars. Free and ranked PvP arenas. Duels/PK Mode. Crafting, collecting, life skills. Choose one of 8 fully customizable characters and select the play style that best suits you. Manipulate the stats and skill tree as you wish! Fully customizable appearance. Weapons and armor that change the appearance of your character. Wide collection of accessories and cosmetic items. Statistics freely manipulated by assigning spirit points. 8 different specializations to choose from. Flexible skill tree that allows for mixed specializations. FREE TO PLAY Trimurti Online offers a true Free to Play experience , a game without Item Mall or Cash Shop. Experience a classic, fair MMORPG where your character's growth is rewarded for your efforts!

rows.name: Unsolved Case
rows.short_description: A new lead turns up old doubts about an 'Unsolved Case'. A trap, or a copycat killer? In this co-op puzzle game prequel to the award-winning Cryptic Killer series, put on your detective badges as you collaborate and communicate to crack the codes, solve the riddles, and catch the Cryptic Killer.
rows.description_html: IMPORTANT : 'Unsolved Case' is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game that requires each player to have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac . Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our Discord community - find the link in the game details on the right! CRACK THE UNSOLVED CASE Unsolved Case is the free, standalone prequel to the cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series 'Cryptic Killer'. Dip your toes in and go back to where it all began as you team up as detective duo Old Dog and Ally against the Cryptic Killer. For the first time in the series, you'll encounter a labyrinth of puzzles and challenges laid by one of the most devious minds in the world. Solve puzzles, crack codes, and find a way out. Do you have what it takes to crack the Unsolved Case of the Cryptic Killer? Crack the case during a focused playthrough of 30-60 minutes—perfect for a night of puzzle solving. THE STORY SO FAR Years ago, the twisted Cryptic Killer was put away behind bars at the infamous Anagram Asylum. But today, he's back, and he's taunting the detectives. Did they catch the wrong guy, or are they looking at a copycat killer? A new lead arrives in the form of a mysterious locked box, delivered directly to their addresses. Detectives Ally and Old Dog are once again sent on a chase that'll challenge them unlike any case before. Explore new locations, crack codes, and unravel the mystery. In this prequel, you're invited to step into the detectives' shoes and return to where it all began. THE ONLY WAY TO ESCAPE IS TO WORK TOGETHER Two minds are better than one, and the only way you'll be able to crack the Cryptic Killer's codes is by working together. Through separate screens, you and your friend will each be given half of a puzzle at each location. Communicate, collaborate, and work together to push your puzzle-solving skills to the limit. FEATURES LIST Full Game for Free Get started as detectives Ally and Old Dog with this complete prequel game at no cost, providing a glimpse into the larger puzzle series. 30-60 Minutes of Puzzle Solving Immerse yourself in an adventure filled with engaging puzzles, designed to be resolved within half an hour to an hour. Two Player Co-Op In Unsolved Case, the detectives are separated. You’ll see different items and clues than your partner and will be tested on your communication! Challenging Collaborative Puzzles Two brains are better than one when it comes to cracking the Cryptic Killer's codes. Explore Illustrated World Unsolved Case's hand-illustrated environments are inspired by noir novels. Draw on… Everything! You cannot solve a case without taking notes. At any time in the game, you can whip out a notebook and pen to make notes and scribble on your environment. Hurry up, or risk losing more than just the case!

rows.name: Layer Hunt
rows.short_description: Layer Hunt is a singleplayer, survival sandbox game where the goal is to survive and hunt down all the bosses. To reach your goal you will have to mine, craft, build, farm, fight and explore for new abilities and resources.
rows.description_html: Layer Hunt is a survival sandbox and dungeon game where the goal is to survive and hunt down all the bosses. To reach your goal you will have to mine, craft, build, farm, fight and explore for new abilities and resources. The world is broken up through many different layers that each offer new enemies, minerals and dungeons to explore. To progress, the player must explore all these layers and eliminate each layer's boss to finally beat the game. Layer based dungeon system - Explore underground layers to hunt down bosses and enemies in their fortified dungeons. Defeat the boss to unlock the next layer where you will find new resources and more difficult challenges. Combat - Craft your own weapons and spells with the resources you found. Learn new abilities called Knowledges which you may find scattered across the world in enemy camps. Survival sandbox - Search the underground layers to gather ores, abilities and magic orbs for spellcrafting for better survival. Or travel the different biomes to gather wood, food or other resources to build yourself a base for protection. Procedural generation - Explore a procedural generated world for a new experience every time you play Building and farming - Build your own house to secure a safe space for your resources and farms. Craft new furniture or use your obtained treasures to decorate your house, and of course build a railway system to connect to your friends' houses to show it off! Multiplayer - Play with your friends in a maximum group of 8 More layers - More underground layers with unique monsters and bosses Overworld - Additional content on the different biomes Items - New items and abilities Building - More variation in building And more...

rows.name: VChat
rows.short_description: I wanted to have a secondary voice social space that could be used for motion capture with just a normal webcam and only a low configuration computer. So VChat was born, and it supports both single-user virtual host mode and virtual image voice chatting and dating using network matching mode.
rows.description_html: Basic Introduction Gmail email registration is not supported for the time being. Gmail email registration is not supported for the time being. P.S. There are quite a number of problems, sometimes it's a bit wacky, and there are also bugs. It's a free product, mainly for fun, so please don't be too critical. Before 0:00 on January 1st, 2025, the first 3, middle 3, and last 3 comments of each person will be eligible to receive 150 yuan of game shopping funds! It's a voice social software for two-dimensional virtual avatars based on the capture of a single camera. After entering the application, users can set up their own two-dimensional virtual avatars. Subsequently, they can conduct voice chats by matching with other users. During the video chat process, they will use their own two-dimensional virtual avatars. The application will project users' expressions and movements onto the two-dimensional virtual characters through facial recognition technology, thus enabling voice chat socialization. Users can manipulate the expressions of virtual characters through their own expressions. Briefly speaking, it's similar to the Avatar system. In the movie 'Avatar', real bodies are manipulated, while players can manipulate two-dimensional virtual avatars through this application. It will continue to be developed in the future, and functions such as users' custom uploading of network models will be added. It also supports the individual anchor mode, the online social mode, and the desktop companion mode. It supports full-body and half-body motion capture. Desktop Companion Mode You can chat with your friends while playing games, studying. Normal Matching Mode VRM It supports uploading custom VRM models. (Only pre-made model matching is supported.) Live2D

rows.name: All Hallows Evie
rows.short_description: All Hallows Evie is a Halloween themed single screen style platform game moulded on the 8 bit classics of the ZX Spectrum. This is a difficult game! Please keep that in mind going in..
rows.description_html: It's the day before Halloween, and Spooktoids have only gone and stolen all the candy buckets from around town. They have made off with them into their underground, sometimes over-ground (never wombling free) caverns and intend to hoard them for themselves, ruining Halloween in the process! Not on Evie's watch! Evie chased the Spooktoids down and located the entrance to their lair! Now she must navigate the caverns and collect all the candy buckets so the good folks of the town have candy to dish out on Halloween! This is very much an 80's inspired retro game! You must collect all the items on each screen to open the exit and progress to the next. You must jump gaps, climb ladders, avoid nasties and not touch anything pointy! Should you fall into a trap or hit a Spooktoid, you will lose a life and restart the screen! This is a very difficult little game but not unfair! Learn the baddie paths and practice any level you get stuck on with the handy practice mode, once you have reached that level of course!

rows.name: Mysterious School
rows.short_description: 'Mysterious School' is a horror game that supports multi player online and single player. Why do girls often cry on campus at midnight? What happened to the once famous No.1 middle school? Take your partner, find out the truth that the young girl has become a zombie, and help the girl reincarnate.
rows.description_html: [Background Story] In this town lies an abandoned school that has been deserted for years, after a tragic incident that occurred there. A beautiful young girl committed suicide inside the school, leaving many people deeply saddened by the news. However, strange occurrences started to happen in the school after that. Every night at midnight, an identical girl to the one who had committed suicide would appear in the school cafeteria. She would sit there for an hour before disappearing, leaving the same message every time: 'I want to go home.' Even more mysterious, people would sometimes catch a glimpse of her in various corners of the school, only to have her disappear in the blink of an eye. Many students and teachers were afraid of these occurrences and didn't dare venture out at night. Some believe that this is the girl's soul searching for the way home, seeking help rather than threatening anyone. Regardless, everyone in the school hopes that her soul can find its way home and rest in peace. [Gameplay] In this horror game, you need to work together with your team to find and destroy the evil items that manipulate the girl, in order to rescue her soul. Of course, if you are brave enough, you can also complete this task alone. The girl won't always be chasing you; her appearance is governed by different rules. There are five different talismans in the game, each with its own power. You need to observe the situation at all times because the rules change in different stages. Once you break the rules, you will be in big trouble. The game not only includes the task of breaking the curse, but you can also find other interesting things around the campus. You can go to the basketball court to shoot some hoops, or use the basketball to scare the chickens. There's also a storage room that seems to contain some fireworks. See if you can find it and have a fireworks party with your friends in the schoolyard. [Game Features] Fun hide-and-seek gameplay Players need to be aware of the changing rules and avoid traps set by their teammates, using different strategies and plans to evade the pursuit of evil ghosts. Besides hiding, players can also use the environment to cover themselves, increasing their chances of survival. Random paranormal events Random and creepy paranormal events can occur in the game, such as encountering a funeral procession in a dark hallway, experiencing eerie illusions in the infirmary, or being trapped in a locked room, increasing the excitement of the game. rows.about_html: [Background Story] In this town lies an abandoned school that has been deserted for years, after a tragic incident that occurred there. A beautiful young girl committed suicide inside the school, leaving many people deeply saddened by the news. However, strange occurrences started to happen in the school after that. Every night at midnight, an identical girl to the one who had committed suicide would appear in the school cafeteria. She would sit there for an hour before disappearing, leaving the same message every time: 'I want to go home.' Even more mysterious, people would sometimes catch a glimpse of her in various corners of the school, only to have her disappear in the blink of an eye. Many students and teachers were afraid of these occurrences and didn't dare venture out at night. Some believe that this is the girl's soul searching for the way home, seeking help rather than threatening anyone. Regardless, everyone in the school hopes that her soul can find its way home and rest in peace. [Gameplay] In this horror game, you need to work together with your team to find and destroy the evil items that manipulate the girl, in order to rescue her soul. Of course, if you are brave enough, you can also complete this task alone. The girl won't always be chasing you; her appearance is governed by different rules. There are five different talismans in the game, each with its own power. You need to observe the situation at all times because the rules change in different stages. Once you break the rules, you will be in big trouble. The game not only includes the task of breaking the curse, but you can also find other interesting things around the campus. You can go to the basketball court to shoot some hoops, or use the basketball to scare the chickens. There's also a storage room that seems to contain some fireworks. See if you can find it and have a fireworks party with your friends in the schoolyard. rows.name: Etheria: Restart
rows.short_description: Etheria is an Ethereal Hero RPG. To preserve the flame of civilization, humanity transfers their consciousness into the virtual world 'Etheria'. And you, as a Hyperlinker, will enter the virtual world to uncover the hidden truths of Etheria.
rows.description_html: Etheria is an Ethereal Hero RPG When a devastating global freeze threatens to extinguish human civilization, humanity transfers their consciousness into 'Etheria,' a virtual world, to preserve their legacy. Within Etheria, humans coexist with beings known as the Animus, who wield mysterious Anima Powers. Their peaceful coexistence shatters when the 'Genesis Virus' emerges, corrupting the Animus and driving them berserk, endangering humanity's survival. In response, the Hyperlinker Union forms to combat this threat. Take on the role of a Hyperlinker and begin your adventure in Etheria. [Breathtaking 3D Visuals & Cinematic Spectacle] Built in Unreal Engine, Etheria delivers cinematic immersion through lifelike lighting, detailed shadows, and fully rendered real-time scenes. Each character features unique combat animations enhanced by dynamic camera work and dazzling effects, creating spectacular battles without visual clutter or overwhelming effects. [Strategic Combat & Limitless Team Compositions] Etheria evolves classic turn-based combat by incorporating diverse strategic mechanics and sandbox exploration, delivering a next-generation Team RPG experience! Create countless team combinations by synergizing Animus abilities, issue real-time combat commands, and freely control each Animus in battle. Master skill combinations and tactical setups to experience the thrill of overcoming powerful foes through superior strategy. [Strategic PvP Arena Battles] Step into the Arena, where non-stop duels rage day and night! Engage in exhilarating PvP battles amid roaring crowds, showcase your unique strategies to fellow Hyperlinkers, and experience the pure thrill of tactical competition as you pursue your combat dreams! [Venture into the Threshold] Explore Etheria's rich PvE content, where formidable foes from the Main Quest return in the Threshold, GP Outposts, and Investigations. Team up with your Animus squad to tackle powerful bosses! For those seeking greater challenges, venture into the Ember ruins, where even deadlier and more mysterious adversaries await... [Forge Your Combat Style] Each Animus features a unique Prowess system with diverse progression paths. Customize their abilities through Shell equipment and nearly a hundred different Ether Module combinations to develop distinct fighting styles and combat approaches. Create specialized builds for your favorite Animus to tackle any battle scenario! [Discover Extraordinary Allies] Your journey through this virtual metropolis of danger and opportunity won't be lonely! Meet hundreds of unique Animus characters: a dual-wielding Reaper carrying a mighty coffin, a punk genius Hacker, a metropolitan Empress who manipulates Soul Flames... Join forces to confront unknown threats and unveil the mysteries of this futuristic city.

rows.name: Buy Hyacinths
rows.short_description: A colourful narrative adventure game. You're one of the first sheep to attend university. Roam the campus, attend lectures by day and enjoy friend-time at night. Discover campus truths, and sniff out secrets. Live the life of a campus sheep, but beware: not everybody wants to see a sheep graduate!
rows.description_html: Sheepy goes to university! Congratulations Sheepy! But it's hard to be a sheep in a human world. Not everybody wants to see you graduate! Lollop around the campus! Nuzzle whatever you find, and sniff out secrets. Head to lectures and try out assignments, adventures and crimes! Make lifelong friendships, and stand up against discrimination! By day you can study law, dance, writing, science and drama. By night, enjoy Friend Time - a range of activities with your new neighbours. Experience the real highs and lows of dorm life. Solve the goose mystery, and weep for those long lost. Live and learn, but beware the tanglewood snare! Shine bright on pancake day, and hold tight in the darkness. A colourful narrative adventure game about being a real-live sheep at university. Over fifteen days and fifteen nights, Sheepy experiences the three years of study, of friendship and heartbreak.

rows.name: No Time For Caution
rows.short_description: New Parkour Role Playing Game. No Time For Caution is a parkour-role-playing game with a tertiary perspective. Manage your character, try various game modes and face monsters to complete the parkours. Parkour and be an unstoppable warrior with your strong character.
rows.description_html: New Parkour Role Playing Game. No Time For Caution is a parkour-role-playing game with a tertiary perspective. Manage your character, try out various game modes, try out various levels and face monsters to complete the parkours. Parkour and be an unstoppable warrior with your strong character. Destroy every monster that comes your way and those who control that monster. Find the key and open the door. And then switch to another game mode and play a new chapter. Ravens have gathered and monsters have invaded this realm. As the last protector and noble warrior of the realm, send these unknown monsters back to where they came from. Destroy each one one by one and be prepared to embark on a new adventure as the greatest warrior alive. Manage your character and face monsters. Gain new experience with different weapons, different fighting techniques and different damage system. Kill monsters and complete challenging tracks. Select the mode you want to play. Get a new experience by playing the maps of that mode. Different maps in different modes contain various difficulties. At the beginning of each section, information about the features of that section is given. Read this information carefully and defend your character in line with this information. Experience two different camera perspectives. Have a better camera experience according to the section you have chosen and strengthen your warrior in line with this camera experience. Make sure a tough battle awaits you with different camera perspectives. And complete all the parkours with these challenges.

rows.name: Cracking the Cryptic
rows.short_description: Curated Sudoku puzzles from YouTube's most popular Sudoku channel, Cracking the Cryptic!
rows.description_html: Line Sudoku Line Sudoku is a pack devoted to sudokus involving… LINES! Each puzzle features one or more of the popular “lines constraints” that often feature in variant puzzles on Cracking The Cryptic, including Renban, German Whispers, Palindromes, Region Sum and Ten Lines! We’re thrilled that Line Sudoku includes puzzles by Phistomefel, Qodec, Clover, zetamath, Jay Dyer, Tallcat, Mr Menace, Peter Veenis, Joseph Nehme, Richard Stolk, Prasanna Seshadri, Tyrgannus and Full Deck & Missing A Few Cards! In addition, Mark and Simon have written hints for the challenging puzzles themselves so these hints are meaningful and, above all, educational. -------------------- Welcome to the brand new Sudoku app from YouTube’s most popular Sudoku channel, Cracking The Cryptic. Unlike other Sudoku apps, we feature handcrafted and curated puzzles from the world’s best Sudoku constructors. Each collection features puzzles made by various authors that are now familiar names to those who follow the channel. Authors like Phistomefel, Clover, Sam Cappleman-Lynes, Christoph Seeliger, Richard Stolk, jovi_al, Qodec, Prasanna Seshadri and of course, Simon and Mark! Downloading Cracking the Cryptic will give you access to our two launch packs. Our first free collection is a variety pack by Prasanna Seshadri featuring 7 puzzles inspired from our previous Sudoku apps; Sandwich, Classic, Chess, Thermo, Miracle, Killer and Arrow Sudoku. Our first paid collection is Domino Sudoku, a new variant not featured in our previous apps with puzzles from our amazing constructors. We’ll be releasing more free and paid packs in the future so keep an eye on the app for more Sudoku content from Cracking The Cryptic! -------------------- Domino Sudoku Domino Sudoku is named after its domino-like appearance with X's, V's, white dots and black dots placed between cells on the grid. Each puzzle features one or more of these domino types with them all having a different effect: an X means digits in the two cells in the domino must sum to 10; a V means they sum to 5; a white dot means the digits are consecutive; and, finally, a black dot means the digits must be in a 1:2 ratio (ie one of the digits must be double the other). As you can imagine, when you allow the world’s best Sudoku makers to use these rules they are in their element and they’ve made another set of masterpieces for this collection with a huge amount of variety! We’re thrilled that Domino Sudoku includes puzzles by Christoph Seeliger, Sam Cappleman-Lynes, Richard Stolk, Prasanna Seshadri, Phistomefel, Qodec, Clover and jovi_al. In addition, Mark and Simon have written hints for the challenging puzzles themselves so these hints are meaningful and, above all, educational. As a bonus, Studio Goya has curated 10 generated beginner puzzles so that players of all skill levels can enjoy Domino Sudoku! In Cracking The Cryptic’s games, players start with zero stars and earn stars by solving puzzles. The more puzzles you solve, the more stars you earn and the more puzzles you get to play. Only the most dedicated (and cleverest) sudoku players will finish all the puzzles. Of course the difficulty is carefully calibrated to ensure lots of puzzles at every level (from easy through to extreme). So do join us as we continue to try to revolutionize Sudoku app genre.

rows.name: Royal Idiots
rows.short_description: Royal Idiots is a medieval style third person battle arena. Fight others using weapons you have in your arsenal, or your bare fists. The game has 6 weapons to choose from all with unique abilities which can give you the edge in a fight, or are just fun to mess around with.
rows.description_html: Royal Idiots is a medieval style third person battle arena. Fight others using weapons you have in your arsenal, or your bare fists. The game has 6 weapons to choose from all with unique abilities which can give you the edge in a fight, or are just fun to mess around with. The characters colors can be changed in game to add personality to each player. Strike eachother down, or get struck down. Current Weapons Implemented : Fists - Special : Punching Barrage Sword - Special : Upwards Strike Spear - Special : Spear Toss Axe - Special : Spinning Blade Crossbow - Special : Shoot Bolt Steel Ball - Special : Golden Rotation Bo Staff - Special : Vault Hammer - Special : Crush Character Colors : Yellow Purple Orange Green Red Pink Current Gamemodes : Multiplayer Battle Arena Singleplayer Zombies Mode More weapons, maps and gamemode are planned in the future, this is just an early access release. Weapon Ideas : Flail - Physics based weapon that can knock around your opponents Grappling Spike - A rope with a spike attached that can be used to bring enemies closer to you Shield - Not really a weapon, but an item that can be used to block incoming attacks Different maps will be implemented for different game modes, a few of those game mode ideas we have are : Capture the Flag Destroy enemy castles a Siege and Capture game mode

rows.name: Hiddens Awakening
rows.short_description: The Howler Hidden regains consciousness in the forest and discovers that his world has changed. Can you save the Hiddens from extinction, organize the resistance and get the situation under control ? Become the ruthless shadow of the forests in this turn-based stealth strategy game
rows.description_html: The legend tells that behind every tree, every rock, there are Hiddens, mythical creatures, guardians of nature. That day, the Howler Hidden regains consciousness in the forest, and discovers that his world has changed… Can you save the Hiddens from extinction, organize the resistance, and get the situation under control ? Discover this new single player turn-based strategy game with a focus on stealth and reflexion. Build and expand your colony to gain a tactical advantage in the levels, and become the ruthless shadow of the forests. There is no chance, no dice roll in Hiddens, every action will always have the same result. Your success depends solely on your strategy.

rows.name: The In Between
rows.short_description: A competitive party game that pits demons against spell-casting hunters! A demon must possess a hunter to attack other hunters, and a hunter must successfully attack a possessed hunter to defeat the demon. But both sides must be careful to not attack members of their own team.
rows.description_html: Overview The In Between is an online multiplayer game where you play as a hunter or a demon. The goal is simple: eliminate the other team! Hunter Gameplay Hunters can cast two spells: attack and protect. To power these spells, hunters must gather charges that are scattered throughout the map. The attack spell requires full charge, while the protect spell only requires some charge and lasts longer the more charge that you have. When protected, attack spells do not affect the hunter. Attack spells can result in four different outcomes: If another hunter is nearby and protected, nothing happens. If another hunter is nearby and possessed, the demon dies. Otherwise, if another hunter is nearby, they die. If no other hunter is nearby, the caster dies. As a hunter, you must be careful with your attack spell. Luckily, candles indicate when a hunter has been possessed and when a demon is nearby. Use them to your advantage! Demon Gameplay Demons can possess hunters. When possessing a hunter, a demon can use the hunter's spells. When used by a demon, the attack spell results in similar outcomes. The only difference is that if no other hunter is nearby and the demon casts the attack spell, the demon dies, not the host hunter. To gain more possession time, demons must gather charges, just like hunters do. The only way a demon can kill a hunter is to possess another hunter and use the attack spell.

rows.name: Idle Baker Boss
rows.short_description: Grow your bakery franchise and manage bakeries in this cute idle tycoon game with over 150 desserts, 100+ in game awards, daily challenges, skill tree system, events each month with unique desserts and much more...
rows.description_html: Grow your franchise and manage a bakery in Idle Baker Boss , a new idle game. Unlock over 150 recipes from cookies, muffins and donuts to extravagant cakes and pies. Gain coins and sell your store to grow your tycoon empire. Gifts allow you to unlock special rare recipes which you can sell for higher profits. You can bake common, Tasty (uncommon), Yummy (rare), Decadent (epic) and Exquisite (legendary) desserts. Display your baked goods for sale in special display cases to increase your profits. Hire bakers, cashiers and managers to run your bakery and let it run idle while you are offline making you coins and gems while are you away and become a true tycoon of the baking world. Features: Over 150 cute desserts to collect Periodic Events year round Daily Challenges Over 100 Awards to collect Prestige / Ascension System. Managers that earn you in game cash while you are away (Offline). Inventory System with Display Cases No Internet connection requirement Different Franchise with unique recipes to unlock Skill Tree system Portrait / TATE Support Idle Baker Boss is great for casual gamers and fans of idle clicker games and appeals to those who like to maximize efficiency and profits. Bake your way to the top of the industry. If you love to see numbers go up (NGU), are a fan of idle games or incremental games and cute desserts, this game is for you!

rows.short_description: Street brawler with a vintage style.
rows.description_html: Your glory days as a boxer are long gone. Once champ, now bum. All you care about is beer and your faithful dog - Rottweiler Max. You play as a retired boxer who is looking for his stolen dog. The game follows a classic arcade brawler so prepare to face lots of enemies. Characters and backgrounds are based on old pictures from 1910s, 20s and 30s so this is a true retro game. Play to find: 22 enemies & 3 bosses 16 levels 37 unlockable achievements and backstories 1 car, 1 dog and 1 boxer with 2 fists

rows.name: Neon Fighter
rows.short_description: Neon Fighter is a tiny arcade game packed with lasers and explosions, in which every few seconds you are forced to switch weapons automatically, making you have to adapt quickly to the new situation and re-evaluate your perspective.
rows.description_html: Neon Fighter is a tiny arcade game packed with lasers and explosions, in which every few seconds you are forced to switch weapons automatically, making you have to adapt quickly to the new situation and re-evaluate your perspective. rows.description_html: Embark on this new adventure, uncovering a brave hero's quest as he encounters a variety of daunting locations in an attempt to return to the real world after entering the afterlife. On your Adventure you will find allies that will lend you their strength. Fight powerful Bosses and Enemies Powerful base skills create an almost infinite Skill ceiling. This game will show you how good you actually are at Games. Your reaction speed and adaptability will be key to your success. Dash and bash through enemies to reset your jump and bash on. rows.name: QuantumVR
rows.short_description: QuantumVR is a virtual reality game that teaches you to solve small quantum algorithms by placing simple quantum gates. In addition, a 2D version is available.
rows.description_html: Learn to solve quantum algorithms in a playful way with QuantumVR. The game is based on escape elements in virtual reality (VR). By placing simple quantum gates you solve small quantum algorithms to free animals. Immerse yourself in the virtual game world and advance from level to level. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced player, there is a suitable mode for everyone. The QuantumVR-App was developed at the Technische Universität Braunschweig in the project QuantumVR (FKZ 13N15399) in the frame of the funding initiative “Quantum aktiv” by the Bundesministeriums für Bildung und Forschung.

rows.name: Odium
rows.short_description: Odium is a fast paced Action Roguelike where you follow Chris's life as a bullied child, in a subtle and parodic interpretation of his subconscious release of anger and frustration from his life inside his dreams.
rows.description_html: Odium is A fast paced Action Roguelike, following Chris's life as a bullied child, in a subtle and parodic interpretation of his subconscious release of anger and frustration from his life inside his dreams. Gameplay Battle your way through each room by defeating powerful enemies! Collect coins and abilities to create the best build to fit your playstyle! Face and defeat Chad - the big boss! Story Odium follows the life of Chris, a young student who is being bullied for as long as he can remember. Chris's Dad left long ago and even though his mom is there, present in the moment, she is distant emotionally and not supportive, actually making things worse. In his dreams, Chris is back at school and his life hardships manifest as monsters. But in his dreams, Chris has the power to fight back! and defeat the monsters! Battle your way to Chad, the big boss! defeat him, and break free from all the bullying and suffering! Features * Fast paced combat * Use powerful abilities combination to destroy your enemies * 4 unique starting points to increase playability * Over 10 unique abilities, and over 60 ability combinations * Each failure is a chance to try a different ability and progress the story Side Note Odium is our Graduation Project from Tiltan School of Design & Visual Communication. We made the game in our free time, with love! All assets, models, textures, and sounds were created by our small team. We hope you enjoy playing Odium, we encourage you to question your actions and we challenge you to see the unspoken message in Odium.

rows.name: Abigor
rows.short_description: Abigor is a third-person action RPG where you play as Alric, a demon hunter at Alastor Academy who must overcome incredible odds to protect his school from demonkind. Combat features traditional melee combat with dodging, but also a magic stance system which changes the players attacks.
rows.description_html: In the world of Abigor, humans must constantly live with the threat of demon invasions from another realm. Their vicious and unpredictable attacks have claimed entire cities. To combat this, humans have specialized themselves into powerful demon hunters. Our story follows Alric, a young demon hunter who attends Alastor Academy. There are only three more days until graduation, yet strange events and numerous demon sightings have began to worry Alastor's principle, Headmaster Neithardt. Follow the story of Alric as he goes through the Forest, the Crypt, and Hell itself on a mission to slay demonkind and protect Alastor Academy! Will you, be able to fend off the demon hordes, figure out their weaknesses, and protect your school all in time to graduate? Abigor features traditional third-person action combat with a focus on dodging to survive. Additionally, Alric has the ability to use powerful enhancement magic that lets him switch his fighting style! Use the strong Dark Stance, the nimble Serpent Stance, or the ranged Light Stance. Choosing the right stance depending on the foe is key to victory. These stances can be freely swapped between, but keep in mind to manage your mana, or else you won't be able to use any magic. Slay demon after demon within the Forest, the Crypt, and even Hell itself on your journey to protect humanity! Abigor was made by a passionate student team. Thank you for playing!

rows.name: Project Possession
rows.short_description: This project is the result of a 2 week internal Game Jam done by a small, passionate and dedicated team of devs from Colombia. We used this as an opportunity to challenge ourselves into creating something fun, simple and polished.
rows.description_html: A two weeks Jam Game This project is the result of a 2 week internal Game Jam done by a small, passionate and dedicated team of devs from Colombia . We used this as an opportunity to challenge ourselves into creating something fun, simple and polished. We hope you have as much fun with it as we did crafting it. The Game ' Project Possession ' is a 3D top down competitive 'Enter the Gungeon' type of game where the objective is to eliminate more monsters than your rivals in PvE arenas filled with enemies and traps. Up to 4 players can join a match. Each player starts out as a 'Ghost' who must possess monsters in order to use their abilities to rack up more monster kills. Each monster has different types of movement, attacks and HPs. Ranged attacks are strong but will consume mana. Melee attacks are weak and will refill mana. The player that has the most points when time runs out is the winner. Support We will make improvements to the game and it will continue to be developed. UI/UX improvements New mechanics and improvements in Gameplay

rows.name: Songs from the Iron Sea
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in a contrasted emotional journey with delicate visuals! Songs from the Iron Sea is a poetic platformer set in a whimsical aquatic universe. Guided by a kind entity, embody a creature lost in a metal nightmare and escape the foreman's gaze to regain your freedom.
rows.description_html: Developed by a team of 6 students from ISART Digital Montreal, Songs from the Iron Sea is a 2022 graduation game. Songs from the Iron Sea was made for 1080p resolution. Songs from the Iron Sea is a poetic platformer scattered with environmental puzzles, taking place in a whimsical aquatic universe. Through a short one-sititng experience , the game portrays a creature lost in a metallic nightmare. Will you be able to get out? Your adventure start in a dark old factory, where everything has changed. Guided by a friendly entity, you must escape to regain your freedom. But stay on your guard, the foreman's gaze is on you.. Experience an original controller in our aquatic universe. Feel the freedom and smoothness of underwater movement and enjoy the transition between air and water highlighted by our platforming challenges. Immerse yourself in an emotional journey with delicate visuals. Highlighted by thoughtful environments, discover the story of this place through poems scattered throughout your adventure. Dive into a contrasted journey with strong atmospheres. From worries to relief, progress in a communicative universe and enjoy beautiful scenery.

rows.name: TRAFFIC
rows.short_description: TRAFFIC is an Atmospheric First-Person Psychological Horror game about a troubled child in a home where he must deal with both internal and external stresses. You will communicate with your parents, do your chores, and stay out of the way.
rows.description_html: TRAFFIC is a fictional story inspired by my own personal experiences, various news articles, statistics, and national incidents that remain unexplained. TRAFFIC is a First-Person Psychological Horror game about a troubled child in a home where he must deal with both internal and external stresses. You will communicate with your parents, do your chores, and stay out of the way. Secure the front gate and lock your doors. You never know who might be out there. TRAFFIC is about a family living in Wyoming as they traverse through the economic recession of 2008. You play as the single child in a family of three, along with your Mother and Father. Experience the gut-wrenching tension and horrifying story of TRAFFIC as you make your way through the days, doing whatever you can to take your mind off of the traumatic events occurring. Piece the story together as you notice tiny details within the dialogue and environments. Huge thanks to Unrested / Inksmith for creating the Art of 'Mother' used in this game. You can check him out on YouTube @Unrested or at @Inksmith Huge thanks to Bazookya for creating an entire TV show segment. You can check him out on Twitch @ Bazookya Huge thanks to Monk for taking my terrible MIDI music and producing it into something useful and awesome. Unreal Retro Shaders / DaveFace Rest of credits in game This game contains subject matter not suitable for those susceptible to the following themes: Implications of Domestic Abuse Implications of Suicide Gore Sleep Paralysis Home Invasions

It's best to be played while streaming any sort of music you want. :)

rows.name: No More Future
rows.short_description: In the last days of their life, a dying person takes one final gamble... No More Future is a linear Sci-Fi Visual Novel, where you explore a futuristic world as an android trying to rebuild their old life. In this strange journey, they'll question the very foundations of their life and their world.
rows.description_html: Anything can begin, and end, at a moment's notice... You're a young adult yuuman, living in a futuristic America in the late 22nd century. Though you had a life, dreams, and aspirations once, it all got swept away once you were diagnosed with incurable late-stage brain cancer; now you're stuck in a hospital, living the last few weeks of your life in existential agony, incapable of processing what you did wrong to deserve this fate. Everything changes when, one day, you're approached by a scientist from the world's largest mega-corporation, who offers you a chance to escape your dying body and have your mind transplanted onto an android synth vessel; the only catch being, nobody knows whether the process works or not, whether you'll survive the transition or ultimately perish. With little holding you back, you eventually accept... ...You awaken in your new body, feeling quite different from how you were before. Nobody can tell whether it's truly you inside the machine, or an AI pretending, believing that it's you. Not even you. In a world where technology's constantly evolving, advanced AIs are viewed with fear and suspicion and few things are certain, you have to rebuild your old life from scratch, convince those who abandoned you on your deathbed that you're still here, and ultimately figure out whether you truly are who you claim to be. About the game: NMF is a linear Sci-Fi Visual Novel: explore a high-tech futuristic world as an android, meet all sorts of new people and reconnect with some old faces, find the truth behind your existence and your purpose in this new world. The game addresses heavy topics such as death, suicide, depression, anxiety, and existential dread. If you are suffering from depression or are easily overwhelmed by these topics, I advise you to exercise caution when reading the contents of this VN or refrain from playing altogether. The game is entirely SFW, though there are some adult non-explicit jokes thrown in for comedic effect. There aren't, nor will there ever be, any explicit scenes or suggestive content in this VN. There are fight scenes in the novel that feature non-graphic depictions of violence.

rows.name: Pest Control
rows.short_description: A fast paced garden defense game. Collect what you can before the pests take over!
rows.description_html: Days move fast in your little solar system, and so do the pests! Can you collect enough crops before the invading pests take over your garden? This fast paced garden defense game features: 24 levels across 4 planets custom levels to set your own challenge control rebinding my blood sweat and tears cute Kenney assets a little guy that goes around a day-night cycle like you wouldn't believe absolutely no plot It's a little game you go around hitting little guys. You get it. Have fun.

rows.name: Klaystar
rows.short_description: Klaystar is a 2D precision platformer, where the player controls Klay, a talented boy with the ability to turn into a bouncy ball, along with his friend Malo. Experience the mysteriously wonderful world of the Pillar, as you follow two boys seeking to join the honorable Vanguard.
rows.description_html: Klaystar is a 2D precision platformer, where the player controls Klay, a talented boy with the ability to turn into a bouncy ball, along with his friend Malo. Set on a massive pillar connecting the earth and the sky, the ever-shifting world of Klaystar is filled with a myriad of unique and strange phenomena. Klaystar features eight chapters, each with their own story, unique mechanics, and collectibles. So experience the mysteriously wonderful world of the Pillar, as you follow two boys seeking to join the honorable Vanguard, an organization hellbent on exploring the eccentric world they find themselves in.

rows.short_description: Run to score, jump to survive! That's all there is to it. Go as far as you can go!

rows.name: Notes From Province
rows.short_description: Dive into a deep Open World that rewards exploration. Solve clever puzzles with lateral thinking, and engage in unique, story-driven boss battles. Then take a break. Furnish your home, fish a little, and chill with your eccentric neighbors.
rows.description_html: Need help? Stuck on a puzzle? Stumped by a boss? No worries! We have a welcoming, helpful Discord community available to answer questions, or just chat about the game. About the Game Dive into a deep Open World that rewards exploration, solve clever puzzles with lateral thinking, and engage in unique, story-driven boss battles. Then take a break. Furnish your home, fish a little, and chill with your eccentric neighbors. Kyme's searching for a fresh start in the city of Province. Will he find it among the eccentric residents and their whimsical adventures? Or will he get lost chasing his personal villain, a grand thief capable of stealing the blue from the sky, the voice of a singer, and even the very memory of what he stole, leaving you with nothing but an empty feeling? Features Open world No dead ends, only new things to see and treasure to find Character driven story Even the battles have a story to tell 7 characters Each with distinct styles and roles, swap-able mid combat Equipment based customization Abilities and passives come from equipment that can be freely swapped to redefine characters Enemies worth reacting to Each encounter has a plan to crush you unless you spot the weakness and counter Decorate and expand your house Earn bonus awards based on your furniture arrangement NPCs with lives Each villager has their own daily agenda, situational dialog, and a story to tell the more you get to know them So much to do Crafting, cooking, fishing, dancing, finding a strange rat-loving man living in a hole under your neighbor's house

rows.name: Nomori: Prologue
rows.short_description: Nomori is a mind-bending adventure game where you control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.
rows.description_html: Add to Wishlist About the Game This is the Pre-Alpha page for Nomori. We recently transitioned from Tech Demo to Pre-Alpha and want to give players a first-hand experience with our mind-bending game. Play now and enjoy 18 puzzles with 60-100 minutes of gameplay. Nomori is a gorgeous and heartfelt adventure puzzle game that puts the power of time and space in your hands. As Kiko, players will venture into a vividly rendered fantasy world full of colorful and eccentric spirits, where she will learn to see the world from exciting new perspectives. As Kiko comes into her own and bonds with the Spirits, she will see beyond the limits of reality and save Nomori. Change Your Reality Place, shift, and rotate portals to change the gravity direction of objects and even yourself. Make clever use of portals to reach new places! Try to challenge your understanding of the world’s physical limits. Use your spirit powers to influence the world around you. Control the flow of time and rotate the forces of gravity to solve mind-bending environmental puzzles! Think Outside the Box Combine your Spirit Powers to create new outcomes; play with gravity and timing to make time and space collide! There are lots of ways to solve puzzles, and to look at the world around you. Don’t be afraid to get creative—perspective is everything.

rows.name: Hero Hours Contract 2: A Factory for Magical Girls
rows.short_description: Join the Union of Magical Girls, as they navigate the free market of Magical Girl heroics, in tactical, grid-based combat!
rows.description_html: Once upon a time, a girl made a contract with a magical familiar, in exchange for amazing powers. Unfortunately, their familiar was a massive jerk, forcing them to fight evil at all hours without pay. So the girl and her friends decided to unionise against their familiars, seizing the magical means of production! Magical Girls VS The Gig Economy! Join the Magical Science Angel , Genius Beauty Knight and Magical Girl (Provisional) 917B (Just call her 'Bea') as they navigate the free market of Magical Girl heroics. Magical Girls are mysteriously disappearing, a suspicious new App has monopolised the magical job market, and something seems to be draining all the electricity in the city... Magical Girls VS Late Stage Capitalism! Take on the brainwashed zombie hordes in tactical, grid-based combat . Build the Cooperative Union of Magical Girls (and friends) by recruiting and training new magical recruits. Explore 'The Factory' , a mysterious multi-floored dungeon into which many of your friends have disappeared. Flexible (and delicious!) difficulty modifiers to customise your experience on the fly. Magical Girls VS Scheming Familiars! Commit copyright felonies to regain your image rights! Find out why your house is overrun with hideous, identical monkeys! Run their stupid magical cryptocurrency into the ground! Try to avoid the inevitable burnout of self-employment!

rows.name: The Dark Egg Demo
rows.short_description: A surrealist text-based RPG. You will explore an island, solve puzzles, and fight enemies, all in your attempt to get the Dark Egg.
rows.description_html: Old tales tell of an island across the Silver Lake... A bustling island, once filled with people and treasures innumerable. Now, the island is dead and empty, and the only tale that anyone still tells is that of the Egg. It is a dark thing. A thing that will grant any wish you desire. And it is a thing... you must get. In this text adventure RPG, you travel by boat to an old island, intent on finding the Dark Egg. You will meet many strange people, and encounter things that should not exist, yet stare you in the face regardless. Every choice you make matters and shapes the story. You will solve puzzles, face enemies, and must explore every corner of the island to make it to your Egg. Of course, not everyone can make it. Perhaps you might find your ending somewhere else, or, like the others, decide your goals have changed along the way. The Egg will wait. It always has, and always will. You just have to take it.

rows.name: Tina & Rook! Cookie Quest!
rows.short_description: Two idiots are hungry for cookies after playing some games! and for some screw-up reason, you have to go through a whole puzzle to get that. Will these 2 idiots get to eat their cookies and enjoy their afternoon?
rows.description_html: A couple of idiots are hungry for cookies after playing some games! and for some screw-up reason, you have to go through a whole point-and-click puzzle to get that. Will these 2 idiots get to eat their cookies and enjoy their afternoon? follow this girl and boy, Tina and Rook on their cute and short adventure. Features: a 30 minutes point and click puzzle game to get the cookies. Play as the two idiots trying to get the cookies. Enjoy the wackiness of their interaction along the way. Drag and drop items to solve problems along the way. Create new items by combining 2 items. Accompanied by 2 pieces of music that I had to make despite not having any musical background. There's also a dog.

rows.name: Soulbound
rows.short_description: Soulbound is a 2D PvP platformer where one player races as a ninja while the other possesses enemies to try and steal their body. Dash, slash, and slide to maintain control of the ninja and leave your opponent in the dust in this fast-paced showdown!
rows.description_html: In Soulbound, experience a thrilling 2D multiplayer platformer where precision meets unpredictability. Engage in fast-paced, asymmetrical PvP battles that keep you on your toes in an ever-changing game of cat and mouse. Whether you're a fan of competitive platformers or looking for a unique multiplayer experience, Soulbound offers intense matches filled with unexpected twists. Its blend of speed, strategy, and ever-changing levels ensures no two games are the same. As the ghost, you tactically possess various enemies, each with unique abilities, to set traps and ambushes. Upon the ninja's demise, roles switch, ensuring both players experience the thrill of the chase and the hunt. Each run offers a new challenge with randomly generated stages, enhancing replayability. Master wall-jumps, dashes, and evasive manoeuvres to outpace your opponent. One player controls the agile ninja, navigating treacherous terrain, while the other becomes a ghost, possessing enemies to thwart the ninja's progress.

rows.name: Party Bunch
rows.short_description: Psychological and fun game with lots of game modes for a big group of friends!
rows.description_html: Imagine you are sitting with friends (or alone :c) and absolutely do not know what you will be doing. Why not sue your friend for a fictitious article, or interrogate him with psychological questions? Party Bunch gives you such an opportunity! The range of anguish you can deliver ranges from simple questions to lie detection, fake lawsuits, and delivering pain through laughter! Agony Of Questions (1 - 8 Players) - 15 psychological questions that increase in difficulty! If you don't want to answer, give up. Double Agony (2 - 8 Players) - Same Agony Of Questions, but now the questions are put in front of each other! The answers are shown at one moment, so you can't change it. Pool Of Questions (1 - 8 Players) - Don't like developer questions? No problem, write your own, and mix them between each other. Nonsense (1 - 8 Players) - Answer a couple of questions and make your own shuffled story out of them! Truth Or Lie (2 - 8 Players) - Do your friends lie a lot? Check it out, spot the lie and get points for it! Court (4 - 8 Players) - Imitation of the trial, where you will take on all the key roles! Judge your friends, give words to witnesses, build a situation on the fly. Bingo (1 - 8 Players) - A grid of 25 situations that you must complete depending on whether it happened in your life or not. Make Me Laugh (2 - 8 Players) - Make your opponent laugh in 2 minutes and don't laugh yourself! Developers are very boring creatures who rarely release updates, and playing the same thing over and over is not so fun. So this person created a very simple mod support! With the help of the documentation, you can easily create your own content for the game. And also, you can download other people's mods through the workshop.

rows.name: Nekomancy
rows.short_description: Nekomancy is a Magic roguelite looter shooter! Craft spells and vanquish evil creatures! Grab their loot and craft better spells! Make progress in the skill tree! Only the best synergies pass the test!
rows.description_html: Delve into the ancient catacombs and slay Eldritch beings as a cat crafting and wielding spells! Crafting! Craft spells with 85 different components! Spells are made with 4 component types: Patterns, Shapes, Effects, and Mods. Patterns determine how many effects or mods the spell can have and its firing mode. Shapes change how the spell is delivered! Effects effect what the spell does when it hits the target, freeze them, heal them, or even duplicate them! Mods change various things about the spell. Make it bouncy, make it explode, make it pierce, etc! Levels! As of right now there are 4 dungeon types that you will slay your way through. The Hills, The Catacombs, the Caves, and the Sanguine Depths! Each level is procedurally generated! Charms! Charms let you passively fire spells when a condition is met! for example: When HP goes below 50% > cast Self heal, or On Jump > Cast Fire Area! You can equip up to 5 charms! Altars! Altars can be found throughout the dungeons and usually offer a benefit at a cost The altar of corruption has a 75% chance to destroy your spell but a 25% chance to Greatly buff it! The altar of binding lets you cast a spell on the impact of another spell! The altar of sacrifice decreases one stat but greatly increases another The altar of dismemberment can remove arms for stronger spells! Movement! Wall jump, slam, and slide your way through dungeons with immense slickness! Nekonomicon ! The Nekonomicon is a skill tree with some insane synergies! Bosses will drop knowledge that can be spent in the Nekonomicon when you die. Be careful though, as you progress so will your madness! Cats! Unlock new cats with unique passives and different stats!

rows.name: vivid/stasis
rows.short_description: Rhythm-mystery hybrid game about uncovering the history of a mysterious system. The stage is set. Will you step up and play your role?
rows.description_html: EVERYTHING IS ABOUT TO CHANGE vivid/stasis is a rhythm-mystery hybrid game that follows the fates of four girls as they get wrapped up in a mind-bending adventure involving organizations, mysterious disappearances, and the fourth dimension. The game ties together an emotionally intense interweaving storyline with varying levels of music-based gameplay... and more...? In the rhythm game section of vivid/stasis, you'll find yourself facing various levels of difficulty, with many options for customizability to play the game your way. Whether you're a casual rhythm gamer just here to enjoy the story, or a hardcore rhythm game legend looking to find a new kind of challenge, there's a good chance you'll find it here. Between 'Opening', 'Middle', 'Finale', and the extra-spicy 'Encore' difficulty, players will be sure to find something fun for their skill level no matter their prior experience with rhythm games. Unlike other traditional vertical-scrolling rhythm games, vivid/stasis introduces the concept of 'Bumper Notes'; notes that take up two lanes. These notes can be hit with either of the keys assigned to the lanes it falls under, giving the game a unique playability with strictly four keys, despite the six types of possible notes. The song list of vivid/stasis features well-known and prominent artists in the music game scene (Tanchiky, Camellia, Silentroom), but also shines light on a fair amount of lesser known producers (A-Saph, Lundy, Spehs, and many many more). On July 21st, 2022, Tsuki Tasogare went missing after not coming home before her agreed-upon curfew. An investigation was picked up, but after less than a day of little to no progress, her sister, Saturday, finds the lack of enthusiasm for finding her sister confusing, and gets impatient. And so, she decides to look into it herself. Alongside her friends, Allison and Kotomi, Saturday hopes to uncover the secret behind her sister's strange disappearance... and isn't quite ready for what she discovers. vivid/stasis' story spans multiple chapters and multiple game genres to tell a coming-of-age story about living with trauma from a young age, and what makes our feelings 'real'.

rows.name: Table Ball
rows.short_description: Table Ball by Lockyz Media is the ultimate virtual arcade game! Compete against friends or the computer in exciting matches of top-down Ping Pong. This game is perfect for players of all skill levels. Start playing today and see if you have what it takes to come out on top!
rows.description_html: Introducing Table Ball, the ultimate virtual arcade game created by Lockyz Media! In this game, you'll compete against your friends or the computer in exciting matches that will keep you on the edge of your seat. But, we've added a twist, power-ups! These powerups include super speed, to increase your speed and give you the win. You'll use your paddle to bounce the ball back and forth across the screen, trying to outmanoeuvre your opponent and score the most points. With intuitive controls, Table Ball is the perfect game for players of all ages and skill levels. So why wait? Start playing today and see if you have what it takes to come out on top! Customization System Customize your balls and bumpers to your liking. We include a theme system as well to change the various menus and default game scene. Multiple Game Modes You wouldn't think such a simple game would have game modes did you? Table Ball ​The Table Ball Game mode resembles the classic game with one big difference, powerups. You can use for example the Speed boost powerup to give yourself that extra speed. Endless Do you want to continuously increase your score and eventually get the highest score in the world, while being able to take breaks between sessions? The Endless Game Mode allows that due to it's very revolutionary and definitely not something that's been in games for decades, saving system. Space Game The Space Game, game mode was created as a Beta test of sorts for another game we're working on. Battle against multiple different ships with different abilities to get the highest score possible. Now go, lord Klooloo demands it!
