rows.name: Soulforged
rows.short_description: Join our community on a fantastic journey across a vast, unique world. Discover new technologies, build infrastructure and brave new frontiers. All that with no fees or in-game purchases. Please note: This is a slow-paced game limited by Action Points that regenerate very slowly in real time!
rows.description_html: Soulforged is a passion project of one developer aiming to create a game where players become a part of a living and breathing fantasy world. What makes Soulforged different is how your character is part of its persistent world at all times. As you go about your day, your character earns action points that you can then spend when it's convenient for you on a variety of tasks like travelling, gathering, crafting or fighting. The game focuses on the important moments and does away with needing the players to spend hours upon hours every day to progress your character, like almost all other MMORPG games do. Game pacing This is a slow-paced game and playtime is limited by Action Points that regenerate very slowly in real time. Travelling, crafting, gathering and recovering from wounds all require Action Points. There is also no way, in-game or outside the game to get yourself more Action Points or have them regenerate faster. There are however in-game means to help yourself by making actions faster, meaning they take fewer Action Points to complete, enabling you to achieve more with the same amount of Action Points. Pricing The entire game is completely free to play. On top of that I am committed to having no other monetization tied to the game. There will be no upfront cost, no micro-transactions, no macro-transactions, no in-game purchases, no purchasable cosmetic items, no loot boxes, no expansions nor 'DLC'. You simply get access to the entire game for free and whatever you attain in the game - that'll be all through in-game means. Feature list While the game is currently under development there's already a large number of features included in the game. The list below is not meant to be exhaustive, but more to outline the current state of the game. A starting location which includes some guidance Multiple large and distinct areas Resources, items and monster names all dynamically named by the players Hunting, fishing, mining and other gathering professions Robust research & discovery system Crafting & equipment management Building construction, including player housing and housing decorations Player-made towns, roads, bridges and other infrastructure Meaningful character skills and statistics Complex and involved wound and healing system Farming - grow and harvest plants on your own farm Hostile creatures and combat system F.A.Q Q. How do I get more Action Points? A. You need to wait. You don't need to keep the game running - you can close it and just check later to use the Action Points you get. Q. So there's only so much I can do in the game every day? A. Yes, there's a limit, but you have a lot of control over how much you can achieve in a day. Most important is your character's mood - the better the mood the fewer Action Points each action will take. Avoiding injuries and pain, making sure you are well fed, hydrated and clean - all this will help your character keep your mood up and do more with their Action Points. Q. I am joining late and everyone has better gear and tools than I do. How can I get those? A. The game is designed so that all content, crafts and monster remain relevant throughout the game. Even starting resources are worth collecting and many players will be interested in exchanging them for some more advanced equipment and support. Q. My character is weak compared to other players. How can I level my skills to compete with older players? A. Characters in Soulforged age and die. Dying means all the skills and attributes are lost and that player will then need to create a new character. No single character can provide a high quality crafts forever. Q. So if my character dies I have to start all over again? A. When your character dies the skills and attributes they had are all lost. But there are things that carry over! Your Essence (in-game currency), discovered recipes and powers carry over. You also retain ownership of your buildings and will have access to all items that are stored there. Q. What is Essence and how do I get it? A. Essence is an in-game currency used primarily to empower and develop your character. There are two main ways to gaining essence. You can trade with other characters and get essence from them. But the main way to gain essence is by creating items and infrastructure that are used by you and other players and you will generate essence on a daily basis. The amount depends on how many items, how valuable and how many players were benefiting from what you contributed. Q. Can other players attack me? Can they rob me or my house? A. No. There is no interactions in the game that enables other players to harm your character or to claim any items in your possession without your explicit consent. Q. How do I know what to use for crafting? Is there a wiki I can use? A. The discovery process in the game is costly and that's very purposeful. There is no official wiki, the intent is to use the in-game research system. However, the community did discover multitude of recipes and they often share many of their findings. Check out our Discord server for a link to the document that players put together. Q. Action Points limit me too much. Can I just play using multiple accounts? A. Each player is only permitted to use a single account to play the game. Playing using multiple accounts is a violation of Terms of Service and risks getting your account banned.

rows.name: Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts
rows.short_description: Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts is a Multiplayer Survival Horror game for up to 4 players. Set in the Middle of the Unknown, you can craft, build, explore and discover secrets in the exciting first chapter from EFNSOFT.
rows.description_html: Chapter One: The Enigma of the Root Mountains Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts Set in September 1993, the first episode begins with four friends heading into uncharted territory, searching for a mysterious artifact. It doesn’t take long to realize something is wrong, as this is the site of the Root Experiment, famed for its stories of those who enter and never return. There is no other option but to survive, and not be afraid of the impossible… Survival is all that matters Explore a hostile environment, build a shelter, and survive in a place unknown to man. Make your life here easier by improving your living conditions, upgrading your shelters, and protecting yourself and your friends against the dangers that lie ahead. Don’t forget your sanity and your health, however, as it is all that keeps you alive... Discover-Loot-Craft You are in a world full of secrets. Everything around you contains traces of the past. You can wander through these areas and learn recipes that will allow you to craft new items. Discover unique places in Root Mountains which is all of these places has so many unique Items! Seamless Weather Conditions that alter the way you play Our game’s unique weather variations give players the chance to create their own dynamic stories of survival. Gain an advantage in challenging conditions, choose when to head out and how the weather might affect your journey. The Day and Night cycle plays an integral part in the game too, with the environments, enemies, and strange anomalies all affected by this system. Solo and Coop In Nowhere , you can explore and survive as a lone wolf, or team up and experience the whole adventure in co-op, with up to 3 of your friends!

rows.name: Farm Wars
rows.short_description: Farm Wars is a real-time PVP strategy game where you compete to outwit your rivals. Plant crops during the day, defend your fields, and transform into animals at night to sabotage your rivals' fields. Outsmart your rivals, sabotage their plans, and dominate the battlefield with clever tactics!
rows.description_html: HOW TO PLAY Farm Wars is a real-time PVP strategy game where farming meets fierce competition. During the day, you purchase seeds, plant crops, and prepare your defenses. At night, you transform into animals to sabotage your rivals' fields, while they attempt to disrupt yours. EARLY GAME At the start of the game, each player sets a price for their fields. These prices are compared, and half of the difference between the highest and lowest prices is added to the starting gold of the player with the lower-priced field. This ensures a strategic balance from the very beginning. DURING THE GAME During the day, players can purchase seeds and defensive items from the shop, plant their crops, and prepare for the night ahead. Strategic planning during the day is crucial for withstanding attacks and executing undermine missions at night. ANIMAL SELECTION At the beginning of each night, players choose an animal to attack their rival's fields. If a player fails to make a selection within the allotted time, an animal will be randomly assigned. Selecting the same animal for two consecutive nights locks it for the next night, encouraging diverse strategies and adaptability. NIGHT During the night phase, players raid their rivals’ fields as their chosen animals. They can attack unprotected areas to destroy crops, but stepping on a hidden mine will kill their animal, preventing further attacks that night. END GAME The game ends when a player’s gold reaches the field price set by their rival at the start. If neither player reaches the target by the 10th day, victory goes to the player whose gold is closest to their rival’s field price.

rows.name: LASER LAB
rows.short_description: LASER LAB is a 3D puzzle game with the theme of exploration and interaction. The player is trapped in a locked laboratory surrounded by laser beams, and those who reroute the beams' path can escape from the chamber. It contains multiple puzzle levels, casual and challenging. Never miss it!
rows.description_html: LASER LAB is a 3D puzzle game with the theme of exploration and interaction. The core gameplay is to interact with laser devices in order to reroute laser paths and escape. In this game, players only need to push and rotate, which is very easy to start with. It contains a total of 9 levels, and the overall gameplay time is about 40-80 minutes. Wanna have some fun with 3D puzzles? Hope you enjoy it!

rows.description_html: Out of Early Access! [h1]ChatFight is out of Early Access![/h1] After far too long, ChatFight Is finally out of Early Access! Thank you so much to everyone who has played this game and kept it alive for all this time. The game has been out for 3 years now and I decided it's about time I finally get around to adding some more content and some long-requested quality of life features for all the loyal community members. [h4]Tournament Mode is here![/h4] Fighters are no longer confined to the chaotic battlefield where they all fight at once, now they can duke it out on the main-stage for everyone to see, one fight at a time. View the bracket and watch each match one-at-a-time to highlight each and every viewer! 1.2.0 Patch Notes Added the ability to switch game modes, allowing for potential additional gamemodes in the future! Currently the choices are Battle Royale and 1v1 Tournament New Gamemode: 1v1 Tournament New map: Colosseum When the tournament starts, a bracket is created. Matchups can be shuffled around, and then matches can either be played one by one or you can toggle 'Auto-Advance' to continue the fights. Press V for auto-camera, which simply rotates around the platform Or control the camera manually like BattleRoyale mode. Press Tab to view the bracket at any time. Battle Royale Auto camera is here! No more having to manually follow the action, now you can sit back and interact with your stream while the camera automatically finds the action for you! Press V to switch camera modes Press Left or Right arrow keys to change the auto-follow target Quality of Life Updates Advanced options are available now! Edit the the following aspects of fighters: Fighter Health Max Damage Movement Speed Attack Interval (Attack speed) Heal On Kill (toggle) Heal Amount Allow Overhealing And also customizable bot settings, in case you want the bots to be easier or harder than real players  Different Stats for Bots (toggle) Bot Health Bot Max Damage [h1]Thank You![/h1] Seriously, thank you all so much for continuing to play ChatFight! It means so much to me that even after the updates have significantly slowed down, there is still a community of players that continue to play this game every day. Thank you. About the Game ChatFight! is a battle royale for stream VIEWERS . Play the game on stream and let your viewers customize their characters, equip ridiculous outfits, and fight to the death! Perfect for small groups of friends all the way up to hundreds of people beating each other up in hopes of being the absolute best at a game of PURE RNG . There is zero input from the viewers once their characters are in game, simply sit back and pray to the gods of RNG that your character will be victorious. Practical Uses For This Game Stream Giveaways tournament Bracket Seeding Entertaining Viewer Interaction Mindless Fun This game runs along with its website, where you can customize your character, view leaderboards, and keep up with any announcements for the game. Twitch connectivity requires a Twitch account.

rows.name: Expense
rows.short_description: Balance chance and strategy to escape a procedurally generated maze of unique AI opponents in this first-person adventure/escape room blend. Follow your pendulum and try not to lose money; you're going to need it.
rows.description_html: Expense is a first-person adventure/escape room game about intuition, strategy and exploration, with simple controls and hand-made animations that surround and immerse the player. Puzzle your way through carefully or try your luck with random chance, but always remember to follow your pendulum. Controls: Tab to think / leave console WASD to move / navigate within console Space to jump / press console button Ctrl+0 to reset all progress In Expense you can expect to: Traverse a procedurally generated maze with new challenges behind every door Use movement controls to bet on and compete against AI opponents in games of prediction and luck Play minigames at in-game consoles to progress towards your final destination, unlocking clues and lore along the way Take risks and learn through trial and error, guided only by the voice in your head when you close your eyes and think ...

rows.name: Black Gunner Wukong: Prologue
rows.short_description: Black Gunner Wukong: Prologue is a TPS+ROGUE game where players will take on the role of Sun Wukong, using three heads, six arms, and six big guns to rampage through the US military base and rescue their master.
rows.description_html: Black Gunner Wukong is a Rougelike type shooting game. In the game, the player takes on the role of Goku, who enters a U.S. military base to rescue his master who has been captured by Biden. A very rare TPS+Vampire survivor! Can use 6 big guns to crush your enemies! Can fly using the Nimbus Cloud! Rich build options, gun bonds combinations. Play as different forms of Wukong, with various active and passive skills. Bullet storms, a true bullet hell! Collect peaches from each round of battle, purchase enhancements, and ultimately engage in a showdown with the boss. A comically themed background storyline.

rows.name: Adventure's Calling
rows.short_description: Adventure's Calling is a relaxing educational game that tests your geography skills by flying around the world in a house held up by balloons!
rows.description_html: Travel the world, study, and test your geography skills by flying around in your house held afloat by balloons! Test your skills by exploring the world with two different modes: normal and aviation . In normal mode, you fly with a top down view, and can see almost half the earth at any given time. In aviation mode, you can test your skills as if your were a pilot, seeing only a narrow view of the earth and seeing countries from far more obscure angles. Study by flying around the world with country labels, and even find the shortest path to the country. Check your progress by monitoring the Atlas to see which country locations you are particularly strong strong at, and which need some work. Play with your friends and compete to get the highest score on the leaderboard! I hope you enjoy my passion project, which involved figuring out the best ways to 3D model the planet to make a beautiful experience! I know some of the datasets containing country data might be slightly outdated, so please leave feedback and I will do my best to adjust the numbers. Thank you! Credits: Major credit to Lee (@kirbeedia) for the box art and Victoria Tan for the store asset art! You all are amazing, thank you for helping me out! :)

rows.name: Last Chance in Xollywood
rows.short_description: In this sci-fi RPG/visual novel, you are an extraterrestrial movie director at a low-budget movie studio. Struggle against capitalism, corruption, and your eccentric coworkers to get the movie done on time and under budget.
rows.description_html: Live the life of an extraterrestrial movie director in the intergalactic future. You work for Last Chance Productions, a low-budget movie studio full of sleazy, desperate, and eccentric aliens. Will you risk your health, sanity, and ideals to get the movie done on time and under budget? It's a living! Sort of. Last Chance in Xollywood takes place in Ingress, an alien metropolis orbiting Earth and populated by people from across the galaxy. Beneath its shiny, cosmopolitan surface lurks inequality and corruption on a galactic level. At least the rent is cheap! (It's not.) Make movies, make money, make friends, or fail spectacularly in this highly interactive RPG/visual novel. Last Chance in Xollywood is completely free. Although the Special Edition DLC adds another playable character and some additional scenes, the base game can be fully experienced for free without the DLC. Feature s 3 playable characters, each with their own story: Be a grizzled movie-making veteran, an idealistic kid fresh from art school, or a family man trying to support his twenty-three kids. RPG skill system with 9 stats: Use your persuasion, creativity, technical knowledge, connections, or financial know-how to overcome challenges. Relationship system with 8 characters to befriend or antagonize: You can't make everyone love you, and you probably won't even want to. 6-8 hours and 100,000+ words Countless choices and endings! (Seriously, there are a lot.)

rows.name: SANGOKU XIANGQI
rows.short_description: A strategy board game set in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Combine various soldiers with generals and command your troops to aim for victory!
rows.description_html: Authentic Sangokushi strategy board game This game is a strategy board game set in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Victory is achieved by taking the headquarters or defeating a unit (piece) with a military commander. Command a variety of units with different abilities and aim for victory! Fight strong opponents in online battles! This game supports online battles. Enjoy playing against players from all over the world! Form a formation considering offense and defense! Before the battle, you can freely arrange various pieces and form a formation. The key to victory is to think about the balance between offense and defense and form a formation. A big damage attack from behind the piece! Pieces are vulnerable to attacks from behind. It is also an important strategy to take advantage of mobility and attack from the side or from behind. Summon a warlord using the Warlord Souls! Collect beautiful warlord cards! You can get Warlord Souls by winning battles or by making purchases. You can summon new warlords by using warlord souls. Collect unique military commander cards and use them properly in battle. Purchase weapons and schemes with rewards! If you win the battle, you will get 'Wu Zhu Coin'. If you go to the store, you can buy weapons and schemes for Wu Zhu Coin. Make full use of weapons and strategies to advance the battlefield more favorably.

rows.name: Lightspeed Dating
rows.short_description: A cyberpunk social deduction game for 4 - 8 players in which players voices are made unidentifiable. Perfectly copy your friends speech patterns, mannerisms and opinions to win in this intense experimental party game. Find out how well you really know your friends!
rows.description_html: How well do you know your friends really? How well do you know their mannerisms, their speech patterns, their secrets? If they were replaced by a shapeshifting monster, becoming indistinguishable by sound and appearance alone, would you still be able to tell them apart? And, if you were to be that shapeshifting monster, do you know them well enough... to become them? Features Endless, chaotic fun, best enjoyed with 4 - 8 of your friends An AI-powered voice scrambler, that makes voices almost entirely unrecognizable Take on your friends identity as a shapeshifter set loose in a dating show Pay attention to word choices, opinions and speech patterns to figure out your opponents identity in tense one-on-one conversations Lightspeed Dating is primarily intended to be played with friends or acquaintances and requires at least 4 people to be played properly. At this point there is no public matchmaking. If your friends are sick of playing weird indie games with you, you can join our super cool Discord server and find some new, better friends to play with! The invite link can be found in the box to the right. Social Deduction - Reimagined It's the year 20XX. In a future devoid of societal empathy the only path left to true human connection is through violence. Five of the universes hottest bachelors have been acquired from around the galaxy and as a shapeshifting alien is set loose upon them they have been given only two options: truly understand one another or die. In this revolutionary new kind of social deduction game players voices become indistinguishable from one another thanks to a new machine learning powered voice filter. Each round players get paired up in rooms together where they have to closely inspect one anothers 'realness', as one of them has taken on the role of a shapeshifting monster and disguised themselves in the skin of their friends, trying their best to emulate their speech patterns and opinions. Easy to Learn - Hard to Master As your voice chat partner judges you by your every word choice, claimed opinion and speech patterns, you have to both convince your opponent that you're the person you're disguised as, as well as that you're earnestly examining them on their own realness. Many strategies can lead to victory, but all require acting skills, smarts and, most of all: confidence. Hours of replayable fun. No round is the same! Intense, hillarious gameplay. Several question packs available in Deluxe version for different kinds of friend groups

rows.name: Monster Mystery
rows.short_description: A game of survival and Mystery. 3 - 10 Explorers find themselves deep in the mountains of Transylvania. They must stay in the light or die in the dark for within one of them lies a monster. This was a student project which we plan to slowly complete over the next year.
rows.description_html: “It’s so much darker when a light goes out than it would have been if it had never shone.” - John Steinbeck (MONSTER MYSTERY) It is a 3 - 10 player Third Person Survival Multiplayer game where the players take the role of an Explorer or the Hidden. As the Explorer, the player tries to find out the identity of the Hidden. You do this by fixing Generators around the map that then turn on the Big Generator that reveals the identity of the Hidden. As the Hidden, the player turns in and out of the Monster forum to try and kill the Explorers without the Explorers finding out who they are. Vision: The night is dark and your lanterns are dim. You must refuel your lanterns at fireplaces scattered around the map, but make sure to fill them with boards because when they all go out all hope is lost. ITEMS: There are many items scattered throughout the map that the explorers will need to fix the Generators. These items are the Axe, Toolbox, Batteries, Boards and the Blunderbuss . The Explorers win by killing the Hidden and the Hidden wins if they kill all Explorers.

rows.name: Jam Scrapz Collection
rows.short_description: A collection of old Game Jam projects revamped, remastered, and rebooted for commercial and more playable value! More than a handful of games to play!
rows.description_html: NOTE: Some of these games feature DXR (DirectX Raytracing). They will be marked with '{DXR}' next to their name. Be sure to acquire the latest video card that supports integrated raytracing to access it. A collection of old Game Jam projects revamped, remastered, and rebooted for commercial and more playable value! More than a handful of games to play! Abyss Rush How far can your rocket reach the center of the earth without crashing? Steel Rain {DXR} Survive as long as you can until you reach the surface! 99 Cracks {DXR} A treasure chest holding a relic called the Cerulean Shard. Located deep in a cave at the highest peak of an arduous mountain. Frozen ice patches, unstable bridges, hot geysers, shaky mountain tops. 4 hours of pure exploration and survival. No guides. You are on your own. Valentide! You are Cordante Saint Valentine; an intergalactic agent of the Corde, a race of xenophobic bounty hunters and assassins sent to collect skulls to use in their 'Great Journey' expedition. You have been sent from your home planet, Amourium, to planet Tera (aka Earth) - the only planet not yet registered in the Amourian index, yet the Great Prophecy demands skulls of 'homosapien origin' and the so-called 'humans' are the key. You have been deployed by the council to collect as many of these skulls as possible and bring them back to your home planet. Gene-Soldier {DXR} The Gene-Virus War has just begun and the Cyan Genes are losing, being cut-down by the Crimson Viruses to the brink of extinction. You may be the last of your kind; the Last Gene-Soldier. It is time to carry out your mission and vendetta: Fight your way through hordes of Viruses in search for survivors, and hunt down whoever is responsible for this horrific genocide. And more (check the DLC list)!

rows.name: Jewel Run
rows.short_description: Introducing Jewel Run, the ultimate multiplayer action game that puts a hilarious spin on burglary! Join the heist as two teams with distinct gameplay styles go head-to-head: Will the cunning thieves outsmart the magical orchard's vigilant guards, or will the guardians protect their treasures?
rows.description_html: Get ready for team strategies and all-out action! Jewel Run modernizes the asymmetrical multiplayer genre and brings it online, on PC and mobile. Play as a team to defeat a formidable opponent or feel the thrill of defeating a whole team by yourself. Choose Your Team As a thief looking for adventure, team up with up to 7 like-minded youngsters to seek fortune. As Mr or Mrs Crosby, you will be alone to defend your quiet way of life. Don’t be afraid to use your strength and all the tools at your disposal to protect your goods. To Steal Or To Defend? The thieve's goal is to get through the garden's maze, shake the trees to get their jewels, and carry this loot safely to their base. Carrying a lot will slow you down! The Crosbys may be outnumbered and slow, but they can tactically deploy their clumsy dogs to corner the thieves, before taking them out with a precise tackle! Tackle a few thieves, and you win! Unleash Your Creativity Express your own playstyle with or against your friends: dash to become intouchable, lure the dogs away from your team, or take as many jewels at once as you can! Unlock outfits elements to customize your character, as well as map features that change the gameplay: alarms that will reveal your location to the other team, trick walls that will block your pursuers, bushes to hide into, teleporters… Each session guarantees fresh challenges and intense action. Warning: Jewel is free to play, but to unlock most character customization options as well as map gameplay features, you will need to buy the Premium DLC. If you play online with someone who has the Premium DLC, you will be able to play with them on the premium maps for free! A Unique Visual Appeal Inspired by the renowned filmmaker Tim Burton, the visuals of Jewel Run combine a dark and twisted atmosphere with vibrant and colorful visuals, creating a truly one-of-a-kind gaming experience. Players will experience a world unlike any other, filled with strange and intriguing characters and locations that are sure to leave a lasting impression.

rows.name: Orpheus
rows.short_description: Revive Orpheus story to save Eurydice
rows.description_html: My first solo indie game i started to work during my studying Two Soulmates separated by death. In this game, you play as Orpheus from the greek myth. Orpheus is a first solo project i published on STEAM, started in 2022 for art license, i continue to develop it. rows.name: Project R4T
rows.short_description: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device capable of shrinking and enlarging the user. Take on a few tests by changing your size and weight in this short single-player experience.
rows.description_html: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device capable of shrinking and enlarging the user. You will be tasked with completing tests, all designed around the tester's height and weight. Platform, collect keycards, and fit through small gaps in this short single-player experience. Features: You can make yourself larger and smaller with a simple press of a button. With this, you will be able to fit through small openings. However, your size affects your weight, so you must keep that in mind as you might encounter a pressure plate that will take your weight into account. Additionally, your weight determines your speed, letting you jump over large gaps or run through doors before they close. As you solve puzzles, the Overseer will observe your performance and talk to you as you play. You will get to know him, and the difficulties he faces at the facility.

rows.short_description: 'Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories' is a series of co-operative escape-room style puzzle scenarios. Each one is sure to test your wits as you try to overcome the challenges that stand in the way of your escape.
rows.description_html: 'Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories' is a series of co-operative escape-room style puzzle scenarios for 1-5 players. In each story, you will face various puzzles that you need to overcome to escape. You must use your wits to their fullest potential to succeed. In the 'Jail Breakout' scenario, you are a burglar who, after an unfortunate turn of events, finds themselves in a jail. Can you conquer the many obstacles that stand in the way of your escape? Solve Puzzles From security devices to deductive reasoning, wide variety of puzzles await you in each scenario. They are sure to test your wits and intellect. Explore and Discover There are plenty of hidden collectibles for you to find as you make your way through each scenario. Work Together Play solo, or work together your friends, in up to 5-player multiplayer.

rows.name: Apollo's Adventure
rows.short_description: Step into the shoes of Apollo and try to find the Sage of Wisdom as you explore many levels and face multiple puzzles.
rows.description_html: Apollo's Adventure is a top down educational game, where you take on the role of a wanderer who seeks the Sage of Wisdom. Along the journey you come across many characters and face math, science, geography, history and spelling questions! The game features 20+ unique levels created by the crew at nonPareil. nonPareil Institute's mission is to help adults on the autism spectrum grow towards their potential by providing work readiness training integrated with hands-on technical instruction and social engagement opportunities.

rows.name: What if George Washington was a Girl?
rows.short_description: An historical epic following Georgia Washington in her attempt to stop the dark musician Mozart from destroying Antarctica.
rows.description_html: A historical visual novel about history's greatest heroes and villains and their trials and tribulations. It is important to note that a lot of time and research was put into the writing of this game's story and themes, all historical people and events were heavily studied to make sure everything is accurate. This was taken extremely seriously and any naysay will not be tolerated. So anyways, the story starts with the Dark Musician (Mozart) plotting to destroy Antarctica. Georgia Washington (George Washington) and Teddy Rosebelt (Theodore Roosevelt), knights of the United Nations were sent to stop the mad musical genius before the icy continent is lost forever. BUT THEN, more stuff happens and there's intrigue and suspense and penguins? Find out more and meet other historical figures in this first chapter of an exciting new saga, Alter Historia. Yeah that's right it's only the first chapter, hopefully this doesn't get popular because there will be more if it does. Game Features Meet several historic figures like Georgia Washington, Bonny (Napoleon Bonaparte), The Night Gale (Florence Nightingale) and more. Has an in-game wiki that unlocks exciting info about the actual historic figures as you progress through the game. Features a custom made visual novel engine. It currently has camera effects, map scenes, particle effects and more, with lots of other features being planned. Has an actual plotline. (It's sort of similar to Shonen stuff like One Piece.) Bonny is the best character. Parental Guidance Suggested, this uses some brief strong language like ' Heck '.

rows.name: Hex And Tricks
rows.short_description: An adventure card game on witchcraft and magic recipes ! Explore the oppressive real world and the fantastic dream world. Fight colorful characters with your own deck of magic ingredients and monstrous assistants. Solve diverse puzzles to win cards and expand your collection !
rows.description_html: CHECK OUT THE IMPROVED GAME : Hex & Tricks is a story-driven card game with lots of puzzles ! Explore a strange witch world and summon little monsters while cooking weird ingredients to trigger special effects with the magic cauldron. The game is not yet complete but will be updated and stay free. As the old witch card game 'Cursed Cauldron' gets back popularity, a young boy by the name of Ethan finds a new passion for it. Completly obsessed with his new passion he gets overwhelmed by his own thoughts in his dreams and gets transported in the mysthic universe of the game. Explore this fantasy world along his side to help a lost creature find his owner back.

rows.name: Gods of Savvarah | Part I
rows.short_description: Gods of Savvarah is a visual novel with the philosophy of a classic fantasy RPG. Defeat enemies, explore countries, make friends, and find your place in Savvarah.
rows.description_html: 'Gods of Savvarah' is an interactive story (visual novel) in the fantasy genre, inspired by classic RPGs. Savvarah is an evergreen paradise hidden from the eyes of strangers. The godlike and all-powerful tyrant Ackotal has sealed himself off from the world and created his own state in the middle of the forest with a rigid hierarchy, at the very bottom of which are lizard-slaves. Hasvah was one of them. One day, however, the slave receives the chance not only to break out of his imprisonment, but also to change the destinies of other characters and entire nations. 'Gods of Savvarah | Part I' is the first part of the great adventure. The protagonist visits different countries, encountering their inhabitants, both ordinary people and gods. The world of Savvarah is ruthless, so the protagonist has to either fight for his life or die along the way. Our main features are: - An original fantasy worlds; - Dozens of characters, each with their own story and appearance; - Intense battles in every chapter; - An elaborate visual style and an original and diverse soundtrack.

rows.name: Torch
rows.short_description: Jump, transform and triumph over your opponents in an insane climb in Torch the elements platform game !
rows.description_html: GET READY FOR A WILD RIDE! Be brave young Player ! Push the door of the elemental dungeon and defeat your friends to survive! A crazy race with your friends Torch is a platform game where you have to jump and change elements to fit the dungeon platforms! This game allows you to play up to 4 players locally. Win the game by being faster and smarter than your opponents! A unique ascension Each new game, you will face a new tower to climb! Whether it be the type of platforms or their positions, nothing will ever be the same again... From heaven to hell The higher you climb in the dungeon, the more difficult it will become: the platforms will become less numerous, less large but also less immobile.... Only the most daring will triumph over hell... Controllers You can play in : solo mode with a controller or keyboard : get as high as you can local multiplayer mode with at least one controller + other controllers or keyboard : distance your opponent(s) to win the race !

rows.name: No men in this house
rows.short_description: 'No men in this house' is a visual novel set in Thailand. This edge-of-your-seat detective story about mysterious deaths on a touristy island will make you suspect everyone, including yourself!
rows.description_html: When a widow dies a painful death, she becomes an evil spirit. The ghost wanders around the village, breaks into locked houses, and kills the men who live inside. Does that sound like a creepy fairy tale? It's a folk belief that runs throughout Southeast Asia. Every year in Thailand, dozens of men die in their beds at night under unusual circumstances: they fall asleep, never to wake up again. Many Thai people think these strange deaths are caused by Phi Maemai, the 'widow ghost,' who can ravage entire villages. The 'No men in this house' visual novel is based on the Phi Maemai legend. It tells the story of several eccentric tourists trapped on an island in Thailand because of a pandemic. When one of the villagers mysteriously dies, the characters begin an investigation and conclude that the death may have been caused by... a ghost? Has the legend come to life, or are the creatures of flesh and blood at fault? Could it have been a tragic accident? 'No men in this house' is an absurdist detective thriller full of bizarre situations, erratic characters, biting humor, and twists you won't see coming! 55,000 words Non-generic, awesome OST (seriously!) 8 characters and a grumpy cat named Cilantro Story based on real events 30 Full HD backgrounds based on actual locations

rows.name: Dark Maidens
rows.short_description: Dark Maidens is a side scrolling action game where you fight through hordes of enemies to test your metal against the strongest of foes. It has an advanced combat system in which you can light attack, heavy attack, block, fake out, and dodge. Don't expect an easy win as the enemies fight back!
rows.description_html: Story As a knight of the Church, Sir Galahad receives a mission to exterminate a group of demons. Through this perilous journey, Galahad will question himself and his faith. Will he obey the orders given to him, or will he fight for the affection of the Dark Maidens?! Gameplay Dark Maidens is a side scrolling action game where you fight through hordes of enemies to test your metal against the strongest of foes. The game offers an advanced combat system in which you can light attack, heavy attack, block, fake out, and dodge. The same goes for your enemies however. Do not expect an easy win as the in-game enemies fight back hard. 4 Fierce Fully Voiced Bosses 3 Maps 3 Types of Minions Fully Voiced Story 2.5D Animations Adaptable Difficulty Wavemode Also contains a wave mode where you can fight enemies nonstop. Prove you are the strongest and make it to the top of the leaderboard! Adaptable Gameplay Adjust the game difficulty to your liking with 5 difficulty settings ranging from ‘Very Easy’ to ‘Very Hard’. Whether you're a hardcore brawler or casual gamer, you can have loads of fun! Meet the Cast Abigale Abigale is a devout follower of the Church who was given orders to keep watch over Galahad and keep his sword loyal to their cause. Though she and Galahad have fought together side by side in the past, she has a cold disdain towards Galahad for having so little faith in the Church. Trina Once she was a part of the Church, but ever since she was turned into a vampire, she’s been reviled and hunted by crusaders and witch hunters. She still has kept a playful personality despite her past. That is mainly because she has never found the crusaders to be much of a problem because of her skill with a scythe as well as having vampire strength. She is very confident in her fighting skills and is very enthusiastic about finding Galahad, her new play thing. Slan Of the three sisters in arms, she is the eldest of them. She was born into the world a demon and ever since has been reviled as one. She’s not fond of outsiders, especially those related to the Church. So it’s no wonder that Galahad and Slan really don’t get along when they first meet. Gila Gila used to be an inquisitor for the Church. She made many a wretched soul pour their hearts out and repent for their actions against the Church. Gila is incredibly sadistic and very much enjoyed her duties, however because of her maniacal and chaotic tendencies to go...lets say...a little crazy, she herself fell under inquisition, accused of being possessed by the devil. She underwent the tortures she herself had inflicted on others and because of that became blind in one eye. She however managed to escape from the Church’s clutches and now turns her blade against her former comrades who did her wrong. She definitely has a hard time trusting anybody, including her newfound sisters in arms and fights with them...a lot. Galahad Despite not having any faith, Galahad like many had little choice but to be conscripted by the Church to fight in the Holy Wars. Though he achieved great feats in battle, he never was able to raise his rank because of his lack of faith. So he spent his days serving under his commander, Lady Abigale. Now having traveled far out of the Church's domain, will Galahad continue down the burning path of righteous blood and honor laid out for him by the Church, or will he take up the sword and fight for himself and forge his own path?

rows.name: Edge Of The End
rows.short_description: A young kid returns to his boyhood home in search of closure amid strong family ties and regrets while uncovering bittersweet memories.
rows.description_html: Edge Of The End is a Short Walking Simulator, Emotional 3D FPS Exploration Game, Where You Play as a young boy who is going back to his beloved boyhood refuge as you go on an emotional trip. Uncover a treasury of love-filled and heartbreaking experiences that are intertwined. Get lost in the complex web of regrets and desire that makes up familial ties. Explore a moving tale as the son navigates the echoes of the past in his quest for closure. Are you prepared to engage in this sincere adventure and see the power of emotions? Unravel the tale to leave you with lasting memories when the voyage is over. KEY FEATURES Emotional and Heart warming story Explore the beautiful nature Search For Family Memories Short walking simulator experience Explore Houses

rows.name: Digital Pierrot Museum
rows.short_description: Digital Pierrot Museum is a free virtual museum presenting the experience of navigating through a museum of digital and multimedia art through VR and Windows platforms.
rows.description_html: Digital Pierrot Museum is a free digital museum presenting the experience of navigating through a museum of digital and multimedia art through a virtual setting. This project is designed to give the audience a live adventure of the whole museum experience. This museum will promote digital art, contemporary art and virtual experiences. The floor plan and the architecture of the museum is devised so the audience can fully immerse in the experience, get lost, and interact. It’s an open virtual space in which multimedia artists can join our vision of making art accessible to everyone. Our goal is to promote art, technology and multimedia and to provide an open space to integrate and incorporate these mediums into the virtual experience of the museum. Using Unity Game engine and VR Virtual Reality Headsets technology to power up the museum experience, we are trying to further enhance the interactivity and the adventure of the museum for purely educational purposes.

rows.name: Metro Manager LA
rows.short_description: Metro Manager LA is a strategy simulation game about connecting communities throughout Los Angeles. Manage maintenance, security, wait time, and train capacity as you attempt to keep the riders of Los Angeles happy.
rows.description_html: **This game is no longer being supported by updates, but it's now free to play! ** Metro Manager LA is a strategy simulation game about connecting communities throughout Los Angeles. Manage maintenance, security, wait time, and train capacity as you attempt to keep the riders of Los Angeles happy. Key Features: - Connect over 50 real communities around the Los Angeles area. - Shuffle workers around your stations and trains to respond to maintenance and crime as it arises. - Add new cars to an existing train to increase capacity on popular lines. - Unlock new trains to ensure low wait times for your riders - Complete in-demand routes to claim rewards and keep your riders happy.

rows.name: Bananner Nababber
rows.short_description: It's a nice sunny day in Neo-Tartaria and ruthless killer Harry Pippels and his pretend friend Humpty-Ho are guzzling down some sprutzels and racking up a debt at the bar. Their life of luxury is soon interrupted however when the Elder Demon's diabolical crypto schemes threaten the lands.
rows.description_html: It's a nice sunny day in Neo-Tartaria and ruthless killer Harry Pippels and his pretend friend Humpty-Ho are guzzling down some sprutzels and racking up a debt at the bar. Their life of luxury is soon interrupted however when news about the Elder Demon's crypto schemes becomes public knowledge. Energy generation is diverted from the population into crypto mining, and if no one intervenes then the precious lives of all Neo-Tartarians are upended as the chilling Neo-Tartarian winter draws near. Only one question remains... What is a Banana Nababa? GENRE Bossrush Platformer GAME INFO Pick one of six fighters and enter the lands of Neo-Tartaria to do battle against the mystical Elder Demons and their evil schemes. Destroy them all one at a time in an epic 1v1 duel to the death, each one more difficult than the last. Sniff out mysterious hidden secrets to help you on your journey, and hold on to your hat as you witness the heartwrenching lore that will have you reeling for days. PROS  6 mildly unique characters  10 disgusting boss creatures  Strong anti-crypto sentiment CONS  Based on a subpar indie game from aeons ago  Contains 'jokes'  Retro 8-bit nostalgia childhood graphics and sounds SOUNDTRACK You can check out the soundtrack by Kyle Riley & Jacob J Ritz on Bandcamp!

Only one question remains... What is a Banana Nababa? GENRE Bossrush Platformer GAME INFO Pick one of six fighters and enter the lands of Neo-Tartaria to do battle against the mystical Elder Demons and their evil schemes. Destroy them all one at a time in an epic 1v1 duel to the death, each one more difficult than the last. Sniff out mysterious hidden secrets to help you on your journey, and hold on to your hat as you witness the heartwrenching lore that will have you reeling for days. PROS  6 mildly unique characters  10 disgusting boss creatures  Strong anti-crypto sentiment CONS  Based on a subpar indie game from aeons ago  Contains 'jokes'  Retro 8-bit nostalgia childhood graphics and sounds SOUNDTRACK You can check out the soundtrack by Kyle Riley & Jacob J Ritz on Bandcamp!

rows.name: graveyard keeper
rows.short_description: An interesting synthetic casual game
rows.description_html: This is an ancient and interesting merge type game Players need to merge three tombstones (or zombies) with the same shape into a higher-level tombstone When all the squares on the chessboard are full, the game ends and you will get a gold coin reward according to the points If you encounter difficulties and cannot merge, you can try to use the round universal merge, or use a bomb. At present, the game is offered to fans as a free product. Therefore, the option to buy gold coins in the game is unlimited (cheating). If you are confused about the difficulty of the game, you can directly buy gold coins in the game for free, and then use gold coins to buy props for customs clearance. In addition, we have retained some 'back doors' of the game 1. Using the right mouse button in the chess board of the game can directly upgrade the object pointed by the mouse 2. Press keypad 1, and then press the left mouse button to automatically generate a zombie 3. Pressing keypad 2 and then the left mouse button will blow up the object pointed by the mouse 4. Pressing the L key on the keyboard will delete all the contents on the chessboard You can also try to use this series of commands to construct an 'interesting' level. Ten years ago, we were trying to make independent games. Unfortunately, the environment was poor at that time, and piracy was rampant. After the game came out, the prison break version was soon released, and the free version was overwhelming. So the game died. Ten years later, after a lot of things, the game has seen the light of the day again. In order to give back to our friends who insisted on supporting us in those years, and to leave footprints in the dusty past, this commemorative version of the game is specially launched for pure commemoration. The comments on this game will be taken into account in the subsequent reproduction products. This game is developed with unity3d 3.5.6, and written with ngui and uscript plug-in visual programming. Now the plug-in has disappeared, and this work is also the masterpiece of this plug-in.

rows.name: Rune Break
rows.short_description: Cut down Thousands of enemies, from the undead to the mysterious creatures of the night to save the world from the impending doom, Rune Break is a Fantasy Rogue-lite where you fight hordes of enemies with casual elements.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Rune Break, the completely free time survival game with minimalistic gameplay and rogue-lite elements. As a solo developer, my goal was to create a game that everyone could enjoy without any barriers. That's why Rune Break is completely free to download and play, and there is no monetization whatsoever. In Rune Break, your objective is simple - survive as long as possible and gather as many gems as you can to power up your next character. With over 20 skills and abilities, you must experiment with different builds to upgrade your abilities and go even further on your next run. Face off against challenging bosses, unlock achievements, and use various points of interest to your advantage. But beware, the game is not easy, and you cannot hide. You must survive, or you will lose everything. However, with every failure, comes new opportunities to learn and try again. Rune Break V1.0 is finally here, featuring new bosses, new maps, new enemies, and many more surprises in store for you. Plus, with controller support, you can play the game with your favorite controller for a more immersive experience. Whether you prefer fast-paced action or strategic gameplay, Rune Break has something for you. With its minimalistic design and rogue-lite elements, the game offers endless replayability, challenging gameplay, and satisfying progression. You can unlock new skills and abilities, upgrade your character, and even experiment with different builds to discover the perfect combination for you. While the game has been thoroughly tested, there may still be a few issues or bugs that need to be resolved. I am committed to resolving any problems that arise to ensure that the game is as polished and enjoyable as possible. Your feedback is always welcome, and I invite you to join our Discord group to connect with other players and share your experiences. Download Rune Break now for a completely free gaming experience that's all about survival, strategy, and skill.

rows.name: Summon Masters
rows.short_description: 'Summon Masters' is a fair online turn-based strategy card game, allowing players to formulate their own decks with various cards for free battles.
rows.description_html: customer service coolstar.cs1@gmail.com About the Game This is a card and board game with the following features: Deck Building: Players can build their own decks to battle with. Depending on different strategies and opponents, players can choose different cards to counter. Tactical Gameplay: The game uses a 3x10 chessboard, and players can freely place cards to fight. Players need to develop tactics and arrange card positions and usage order within limited space. Different Professions: Players can choose freely from four professions - swordsman, mage, monk, and archer. Each profession has different characteristics and skills, and players can choose according to their preferences and tactical needs. Competitive Battles: Players can battle with other players after building their decks, and it is fun to fight with other people. Through battles with other players, players can improve their strength and tactical skills. Team Dungeons: In addition to fighting against other players, players can also team up with others to challenge high-difficulty dungeons. Players need to defeat powerful bosses through cooperation and strategy to get more rewards and cards. Special Challenges: Players can participate in special rules challenges and use their intelligence to defeat other players. These special rules make the game more interesting and challenging, and players need to constantly think and try new strategies. Fast-paced: Each game is fast-paced (within 5 minutes), and can be played in short fragments of time. The fast pace of the game allows players to enjoy the game in a short time, while also being able to play at any time and anywhere.

rows.description_html: In Abstract Grind you have to face multiple waves of bloodthirsty enemies and defeat a boss at the end. You have only basic attack at first, but as you level up and clear waves you pick various skills and upgrades to aid you in battle. There are no active skills, all attacks and spells are being auto-casted, you just have to position your character by running and sliding.

rows.short_description: You've been given the chance to go to the country's most prestigious academy. Your future couldn't have looked brighter! But you'll soon find out nothing is ever as it seems...
rows.description_html: You are the newest member of the AGG book club. Members of this book club are known to read the latest and most riveting books that they can get their hands on They soon stumble across a strange book called 'The Fractured Oath' The book synopsis reads... 'When Tyler Lee decides to risk it all to get the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to attend the most prestigious school in the country, He soon realizes that he may have bitten off more than he could chew. Whether he rises to the challenge or accepts defeat, That'll be solely up to you!' Actions have consequences in this Choose-Your-Own-Adventure Visual Novel! rows.name: Tiles II - Multiplayer
rows.short_description: Tiles II is a battle royale in which you must conquer as much territory as possible. Challenge your friends through many game modes and a great customization of gameplay, as well as a map creator to make your own arenas !
rows.description_html: Tiles II is a minimalist battle royale where you play as a cube, alone against all or in team, where you must conquer as much territory as possible in a giant arena before your opponents! The game has several game modes: Normal mode Challenge your friends on the arena in a limited time, move freely in the arena and avoid other players from eating your territory. Elimination mode Compete in a battle royale where players are eliminated as they run out of territories. Will you be up to it of not being eliminated? Contamination mode Survivors, run away from infected players and tiles for as long as possible! Power mode Fight in a game where all the moves are allowed with the many power-ups! Arena offensive mode Challenge the opposing team by conquering as much territory as possible from each side and earn the most points to win! The game features a customization system, where you can choose mutators to create the game you like, as well as a simple map editor of 128 tiles by 128.

rows.description_html: Neutrino is a minimalist pong-like game with very simple mechanics . You rotate the aim, click to launch and if you are fast enough to change your mind, reset back try it again!                      13 levels , each with 10 different rooms - total to 130 puzzles ! Difficulty evolves and new types of challenges are introduced gradually as you evolve further in the game, and if you're good enough o win level 12, you get the final boss to face to and finally escape the black hole! Controls You can use Mouse, Keyboard in 2 ways and PS4 Dual Shock, as you wish. Thank you for playing Neutrino!

rows.description_html: ADD FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST About the Game This is the free prologue to Cult Of Babel - A roguelite Horde Survivors with dungeon crawling elements. Select your mighty steampunk witch or wizard, get the ancient cards of power and slaughter the horde of evil cultists guarding the tower of babel. Fast-paced horde survival gameplay Play as one of the legendary sorcerers Get magic cards to upgrade your steampunk wizard's arsenal Zany Synergies Quick, 15 min sessions for quick fun In this roguelite, arena survival game, the randomized cards you get change how you play the game completely. Become a thunder mage, control gravity and much more ! 60+ cards to collect and upgrade ! The more cards you have in your deck, the more their effects combine and enable you to unleash the fury of ancient magic. Play as one of the legendary sorcerers ! There are many characters to choose from each run. New characters to unlock, each with their own weapon and ability New areas to explore New map variations New booster packs and build diversity Dungeon-crawling ! You'll be able to climb through the levels and fight the boss of the cult at the top of the tower

rows.name: Super Ball Mania
rows.short_description: Super Ball Mania is an action-packed minigame-based party game. Compete against your friends to earn the most points by the end of the game, and become a Super Ball Maniac.
rows.description_html: Games are 10 rounds long with 4 players, by default. To add or remove players, visit the character customization screen. Features: 10 unique minigames Character customization Partially customizable bindings Up to 8-player local multiplayer (with the help of a third-party controller grouping program) Click 'Play Now' on the game select screen to automatically add all games to the game selection, and jump right into the action! Players will play ' Ballf With Your Friends , Color Clash , Cumulonimble , Flappy Balls , Hot Potato , Light On Your Feet , Most Wanted , Row Race , Simon Says , and Sumo .' Controllers are automatically assigned to the first x number of players in the game, depending on x number of controllers plugged in to the computer. If there are any players without controllers to be assigned to them, they will be automatically assigned keyboard controls. Keyboard controls can be found on the main menu. Controls can also be reassigned on the Character Customization screen. Have fun playing my game! If you have suggestions or run into a bug, send me a message at the email address in the support section.

rows.name: Different Strokes
rows.short_description: A collaborative online painting game where players can create, edit, and rate each other's art!
rows.description_html: Paint! Fix! Explore! A collaborative online painting game where players can create, edit, and rate each other's art! Check out the Deluxe Edition DLC to unlock 9 additional colors and numerous extra features: - smaller brush sizes - brush smoothing - straight line tool - canvas zoom - studio room for viewing your paintings/liked paintings - painting easel for saving draft paintings Your friend, a conceptual artist, has invited you to their latest exhibition. You enter expecting to see their art adorning the walls, but to your surprise, the VISITORS are the ones drawing the art — they’re even drawing over each other’s work! It’s up to you to protect the exhibition from being covered in artwork that is, intentionally or otherwise, truly awful. Gameplay consists of: - exploring the ever-expanding gallery - painting your own artwork on blank canvases - editing other player's artwork - rating completed artwork All of the art exhibited in the game is 100% created and remixed and rated LIVE by other players . Yes, we host all of this art and load it in dynamically. We hope that you will choose to fix the (inevitable) unacceptable art! In addition to the main gallery there is also a portal to the 'gallery of the week'. Every week there will be a new gallery with a particular theme. The main gallery is pretty crowded so your art may have a better chance of standing out in the gallery of the week! Paintings have a 'share link' button that takes you to a web page you can use to share your work with other people outside of the game. Player's can optionally create a user account. When logged in, any paintings you create/edit will be marked with your username. Other players will be able to click on your username to see all the paintings you have created. You can choose between setting up an account with a separate username/password that can be used cross-platform (Itch.io / browser version) or to login using your steam account in which case your account will always be tied to Steam. From the logged in screen you can see notifications when other players like your paintings and see how many total likes they've received. Join the Discord!

rows.name: Speed the Card Game
rows.short_description: Speed a card game also known as Spit or Slam, is very fast-paced game. Speed is a game for two players of the shedding family of card games.
rows.description_html: Speed a card game also known as Spit or Slam, is very fast-paced game and it could result in damage to the cards -- so play this and don't ruin your actual playing cards. Speed is a game for two players of the shedding family of card games, in which each player tries to get rid of all of his cards. Speed is a game associated with the game Nertz. Speed supports online multiplayer mode over the internet. Test your speed skills against other players. Speed is a game for two players of the matching and shedding family of card games, like Spit or Slam, in which each player tries to get rid of all of his cards. If you have ever played Spit,Slam, or Nerts before you will love Speed. Controls: Drag the cards Objective: To play all your cards first. How to Play: Each player is dealt five cards to form a hand, and each player is dealt 15 cards face down to form a draw pile. If you are playing with jokers, you use them as wild cards and give each draw pile 16 cards. A stack of five cards, placed face down on each side between the players, serves as a replacement pile. Finally, two cards are placed face down in the center between the replacement piles. Play cards from your 'Hand' to the 'Play Pile' if the card is higher or lower by 1 number or value. A 3 can be played on a 2 or 4 and a Jack can be played on a Queen or 10. The Ace's value is 1. You can block your opponent from playing if you place your card faster. You can have upto 5 card in your hand at all times. Refill your hand from your 'Draw Pile'. First player to play all of his/her cards wins!

rows.name: POP SURVIVOR
rows.short_description: Pop all balls in the level before you rush to the goal, in under 60 seconds. You need to jump, run, avoid obstacles to successfully clear each level. Make sure to efficiently pop balls or else, you won`t be able to clear levels in time!
rows.description_html: This game is perfect for speedrun, as you have 60 seconds to complete each level. Your goal is to reach the destination of the level as the goal will unveil itself when all balls in the level are popped using cones with matching color. This game requires timing, patience, and critical thinking as you have to figure out a way to reach the destination in under 60 seconds, by efficiently popping balls. Avoid being hit by the obstacles and falling from the stage as you need to move efficiently to continue to the next level. There are total of 100 levels and you may be expected to finish in 2-5 hours depending on how fast you adapt and if you can figure out the optimal way to move around the stage in order to clear in time. Sometimes, the goal won`t open up unless you drop the cone.

Your goal is to reach the destination of the level as the goal will unveil itself when all balls in the level are popped using cones with matching color. This game requires timing, patience, and critical thinking as you have to figure out a way to reach the destination in under 60 seconds, by efficiently popping balls. Avoid being hit by the obstacles and falling from the stage as you need to move efficiently to continue to the next level. There are total of 100 levels and you may be expected to finish in 2-5 hours depending on how fast you adapt and if you can figure out the optimal way to move around the stage in order to clear in time. Sometimes, the goal won`t open up unless you drop the cone.

rows.name: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant
rows.short_description: Welcome new warriors looking for their dream weapon, collect the needed resources, craft and sell them their desired weapon. Upgrade your garden so you can collect exotic resources and complete more lucrative recipes.
rows.description_html: Join the community! About the Game Collect Resources A small clicker game where you need to gather resources from trees, rocks, and divers minerals to craft different weapons for your clients. Clients and Recipes Each client will have its time limit and if exceeded will leave, if three clients leave you loose the game. Each recipe will add one point to your score, at the end of the game your score will be uploaded to a Steam leaderboard so you can compete worldwide.

rows.name: Lost Skies: Island Creator
rows.short_description: Sculpt your island, design places for other players to explore, and even set traps or create puzzles in the Lost Skies: Island Creator! Each island tells its own story; are you ready to craft yours?
rows.description_html: Lost Skies: Island Creator allows you to create your very own island for the upcoming co-op survival game Lost Skies. Create your own sky island full of stunning vistas and brutal enemies, then release it into the world via the Steam Workshop! Create Your Own Island The Lost Skies: Island Creator is a free standalone tool where you can create the island of your dreams or your friend’s nightmares. Form the basic look of your island using simple geometric shapes, then sculpt away until you get your island looking exactly how you imagined it. Want a giant cave system or mountain range going through the island? You can do it!  Decorate Your Island Create a beautiful island filled with lush forests and stunning vistas or an island full of mystery and danger littered with foreboding caves full of dense fog and dangerous ruins filled with enemies and traps. No matter what you choose, you will be able to bring your island to life! Create Puzzles and Add Threats Not every island is peaceful. Add dangerous threats such as enemy drones or create puzzles for players to solve to find treasure. How hostile (and rewarding) you make your island is up to you! Share Your Island with the World! After you’ve put the finishing touches on your island, upload it to the Steam Workshop for other players to explore! Change your mind? You can freely edit and re-upload your island as often as you’d like for everyone to enjoy! Join the Discord to join the active Lost Skies community filled with creative visionaries and eager explorers who are helping to shape the future of the game!

rows.name: Pep-Pel
rows.short_description: Run through each level as Pep-Pel! a goofy red goblin thing. In this beautifully hand drawn game. play through tons of fast-paced and difficult levels, each with there own challenge to master!
rows.description_html: Play as Pep-Pel, a magician cursed to be a small red goblin, in this fluid and fast paced platformer! Explore 8 unique worlds in the search of monstrous treasure chests that cursed her. Hundreds of hand drawn assets make up each world the player will travel to. Try not to be too greedy, with hundreds of collectables in each level, and medals you can win for beating levels quickly! Key Features -Momentum Based Platformer: Pep-Pel is a momentum based platformer, where the player runs through large scale levels. -High Replayability Value: The game is made to encourage the player to replay each level to improve how fast they can finish a level, along with having collectables in each level. -Unique Level Mechanics: Each of the games 8 main levels have there own unique mechanic, including; candy projectiles, rope, lazers, chase mechanics, wind, water, and poison -Robust Customization Options: Unlock many different costumes as you progress through the game. Costumes can be unlocked by beating levels or by collecting collectables. Momentum Based Platformer -Momentum System: run as fast as you can through each level to beat them as fast as possible. With a focus on building momentum as you play, skilled players will be rewarded by being able to move at extreme speeds through levels. -Curved Surfaces: Curved and natural surfaces are a main focus of level design. Using a system that allow the player to move across any style of surface geometry, level design is not restricted to blocky pixel surfaces -Movement Mechanics: Pep-Pel has a large variety of different movement mechanic. All of which can help the player move fluidly through levels. -Fast and challenging: Players will die often so player deaths are made to be quick and satisfying, allowing the player to retry quickly. Armour can be found hidden around levels, this allows the player to survive one extra hit of damage before they die. Level mechanics -Each level has its own unique mechanic: New Mechanics are introduced naturally at the start of a level and get more complex as the level progresses -Hard Mode: Hard mode levels incorporate mechanics from multiple different levels Visuals -Level Worlds: Every level exists in its own unique world, allowing level designs to be creative and involve anything that would be fun as a visual. -Color Palette: Each level is designed with a unique color palette and style to make them visually distinct. -Hundreds of unique animations: Pep-Pel is animated with over 150 unique animations. These are blended together in gameplay. -Animation blending: animations are combined as the character moves to make character animation more dynamic and natural. -Actually 3D!: Pep-Pel is animated as a unique 3D model using 2D stylization, this allows for more extreme and dynamic animations to be made.

rows.name: Avani
rows.short_description: Join Avani in this action-adventure game where you will explore this corrupted land, fight the evil that hides within and cleanse it from the spirit before it destroys the world.
rows.description_html: Avani, our furry protagonist, finds an ancient sword in the forest. By accident, they broke its seal, freeing the vile being that it was imprisoning. Join them in this action-adventure game where you will explore this corrupted land, fight the evil that hides within and cleanse it from the spirit before it destroys the world. Isometric-style art and enemy attacks. Three stages: Forest, Fire, Ice! Featured digital art cinematics in-game Enjoy the visually calm feeling of the forest, and then the contrast of the evil's power destruction. Languages: English, Spanish, Basque, Catalan, Galego, German, and Simplified Chinese Avani is a project developed by Kyuut Katz, a team of 2nd Year students at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao in a 9-month development cycle from the ground up using C++ to develop their engine and game.

rows.name: Idle Clans
rows.short_description: Idle Clans is a multiplayer idle game that combines the classic MMORPG experience with simplified gameplay and less time commitment. Features include a player-driven economy, PvE, trading, quests, crafting and opportunities to play, socialize and collaborate with other players.
rows.description_html: Idle Clans is a multiplayer idle game that aims to provide the classic MMORPG experience in a casual, easy to digest and far less time-consuming manner. If you've played RPG's before, Idle Clans will make you feel right at home. With almost 20 skills to train and a deep combat system to dive into, you'll discover a ton of fun and interesting ways to progress your account. Even if you're not a role-playing veteran though, we've put a lot of effort into making the game as easily accessible as we could! Skills are as easy to level up in as clicking the objective you want to complete and... that's it! Your character will take care of the rest - even when you go offline! Smith your armour, craft your weapons, enchant your jewellery to provide different boosts, brew a large variety of potions and prepare for combat! Enemies range all the way from measly turkeys to the bosses behind the locked doors of The Valley of Gods. Or if fighting things isn't your cup of tea, you could sell your hard-earned items to other players in your very own shop. Another large part of the game, as you might guess from the name, is clans! Create your own or join an established clan to enjoy a variety of benefits on top of the social experience. Clans have their own levels and a fraction of the experience every player gains is sent to the clan. With high enough levels and reputation, leaders of the clan can purchase upgrades that everyone in the clan benefit from. On top of that, there's shared housing and a shared vault that clan members can enjoy. In game you'll also find leaderboards where you can compete both individually and with your clan. That's just a fraction of the available content though - come give Idle Clans a closer look! It's free!

rows.name: Termalloc
rows.short_description: Connect terminals to the server. Guards are coming. Keep yourself safe.
rows.description_html: Termalloc is a top-down 3D shooting game. You can move forward/backward and left/right, but you can not jump. There are 22 pentagon-pillar-like terminals in the field, and your mission is connect all of them to the server. While connecting, terminals turn yellow, and green if connection is complete. Guards are coming to stop you. Shoot them to keep yourself safe. Guards get faster every time, and more and more are coming. Guards sometimes drop a coin which you can pick up and buy upgrades.

rows.name: Plane Accident: Prologue
rows.short_description: Dive into the heart of aviation mysteries in 'Plane Accident: Prologue.' Explore realistic crash sites, analyze evidence, and solve puzzles. Unveil the truth in this thrilling prelude to the full 'Plane Accident' experience.
rows.description_html: Wield advanced investigative tools and immerse yourself in the intricacies of aviation disasters in 'Plane Accident: Prologue,' as you decipher the enigma of a plane crash using cutting-edge techniques and expert analysis. Your task will be to get to the site of the plane crash . With the help of such tools as a drone find the likely location of the plane wreckage and Investigate the crash site , You will have to mark the area of the accident, find evidence and take photos so that the entire plane wreckage is finally transported to the hangar. Transporting the plane wreckage is only the beginning of your investigation. To get to the causes of the crash you will have to reconstruct the wreckage of the plane , send parts for analysis or examine the black box . An integral part of any investigation is questioning witnesses and gathering all the clues to work out the true scenario of the cause of the crash. Experience a tantalizing glimpse of the aviation mystery world in Plane Accident: Prologue. But remember, what you see here is just the tip of the iceberg. Dive deeper into the full game to uncover a universe of secrets waiting to be revealed.

rows.name: Project XLOWS - Keyboard Apocalypse TM
rows.short_description: think fast, type fast, create opportunity, and demolish your enemies
rows.description_html: Project XLOWS: Keyboard Apocalypse is a typing game in 3D world space sharing many features similar to rpg elements. Players can use skills, and a variety of selection of characters. This project is made by a single developer with the main focus of gameplay. As the project is currently in an early phase, more updates will be released based on players feedback. Players can expect to jump into the world and start playing as their favorite character. Backstory: Monsters have appeared from the underground, and have created a war zone. countless armies got together to seal the entrance, but none has been successful. If this continues, the whole planet will be engulfed in darkness. Game-play: Type your way to victory. Type various skill names ('jump left', 'teleport', 'launch fireball') and press enter to activate the skill. A list of skills can be found on top left screen under 'Commands' title. Enter a specific series of sentences to win. Each sentence will be more difficult than the previous. Watch-out for the endless monsters that appear and prevent you from accomplishing your mission. Use your skills to make enough time to type the main quest lines.

rows.short_description: A doll falls into a dark world inside an interactive full length film. You can JUMP from any scene in the film to an interactive 3d version of the scene and back! Experience a film in an entirely new way. Available in DVD++ and VHS++

Watch in DVD++ or VHS++ Almost 3 hours of director commentary inside interactive scenes Watch with friends using Steam Remote Play
