rows.name: In The Darkness
rows.short_description: Hello there traveller. Are you going into that maze? I must warn you, it's an awfully dreadful place there. Full of monsters and the like. You won't find many torches in there, you'll be in the darkness. But if you insist, go right on ahead. Farewell traveler.
rows.description_html: What Is In The Darkness? In The Darkness is a game where you are traveling through a dark maze filled to the brim with monsters that have only one purpose: To eat and kill. If you want to escape this dark land, then you must venture into the maze and explore every corner to discover its secrets. But be careful! The monsters are hiding in the darkness, waiting for the right time to strike! Originally made for the 2022 GeoJam, the Steam release of this game features an expanded map and story, with new secrets and paths to explore! Art And Aesthetic This game uses flat, geometric shapes for a minimalist art style. This game also utilises Light and Shadow to create the feeling of a dark and dreary maze that you are trapped in. UI I have a strong belief in minimalist design, and this game reflects that. There is no flashy buttons or gizmos to distract you from the game. All you have is your encyclopaedia, and your map to aid you in your journey, each of which is toggled via a hotkey. Gameplay In this game, you'll use the WASD keys (or joystick) to navigate around the maze. You will also be able to use the scrollwheel (or joystick) to aim your lantern at your surroundings. Use these tools to journey through the maze without getting eaten. You'll also have your Encyclopaedia of Monsters, as well as a map that fills in as you explore the maze! Be warned though, death in this game is not so kind in this game. There are very few checkpoints, so death will mean restarting entire sections (only your map stays the same). Be prepared for a very difficult experience! Language support In The Darkness is officially supported in 2 languages: -English -Spanish The use of controllers is reccomended, but not required. Controller support is tested on Xbox controllers.

All you have is your encyclopaedia, and your map to aid you in your journey, each of which is toggled via a hotkey. Gameplay In this game, you'll use the WASD keys (or joystick) to navigate around the maze. You will also be able to use the scrollwheel (or joystick) to aim your lantern at your surroundings. Use these tools to journey through the maze without getting eaten. You'll also have your Encyclopaedia of Monsters, as well as a map that fills in as you explore the maze! Be warned though, death in this game is not so kind in this game. There are very few checkpoints, so death will mean restarting entire sections (only your map stays the same). Be prepared for a very difficult experience! Language support In The Darkness is officially supported in 2 languages: -English -Spanish The use of controllers is reccomended, but not required. Controller support is tested on Xbox controllers.

rows.description_html: Explore the mysterious Beach Island with Beach Guy! Face the many challenges the island holds to collect the many stars needed to open the mysterious Gateway. Designed for both experienced players and those unfamiliar to games, feel free to take it at your own pace, take on the island’s toughest challenges or kick back and enjoy the beach! Retro Open World Adventure! A completely open and non-linear experience in a charming retro 90’s style for beginners and experienced players. Explore and gather all 15 stars in any way and any order you like! There's no wrong way to play! Three additional stars to find! There’s new things to discover! Speedrun Mode offers exactly the same experience but you’ll be timed! While this game might be short, you’ll spend hours perfecting your speedrun! Full gamepad support! With dynamic control support, you can change from gamepad to mouse and keyboard on the fly! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Mafia Pigs
rows.short_description: Let the Heist shenanigans begin! Slip on your shades, get your stealth on and get ready to sneak your way past your friends. Use the environment and cheeky dodges to complete daring heists and surprise other players in the online multiplayer competitive game.
rows.description_html: Park city has gotten too rich, and the treasures lying around are just too much to ignore. The mafia has other ideas: getting stealthy and stealling the world’s largest Golden acorn would be a real coup! But who are the best thieves in the city? So begin the Mafia Pigs challenges: test your wits against your friends and other players online to pull off the most daring heists! But be careful. The city guards REALLY don’t want you grabbing the golden acorn, and they’ll knock you out if they spot you! Stay hidden, avoid their vision cones and get to the prize! Tired of getting one-shotted in the latest extraction shooter? In Mafia Pigs, use your brains and skill to trick your opponents and grab the prize - no killing allowed. KO’s put you down for a while, but you can always come back and snatch glory at the end! Use the environment, stealth and tricks on others to gain an advantage. Each match is for up to 6 players and randomizes the goals on the map. Find all the keys and grab loot along the way to boost your score. Use ridiculous powerups to beat your friends. With so many thieves and grifters invading their territory, the city guards are on red alert (when not sleeping off a big lunch, that is). Try to sneak around unnoticed, but see where you can slow down your opponents by arousing suspicion, sounding alarms, and setting traps. No players or guards can be killed permanently … the mafia doesn’t want anyone to get seriously hurt. Just a little roughing up and a few knockouts here and there are fair game! Play with up to 6-players in cooperative online multiplayer for Mac and PC. Create your own lobbies with friends or play in public lobbies. Play single-player tutorial missions to learn the ropes and uncover some of the secrets of the Mafia Pigs world. Find us at the following locations on social media:

rows.name: BlockUrbs
rows.short_description: BlockUrbs is a small city builder game where you can place a variety of structures and roads on tiles to create tiny, detailed and beautiful city sections without worrying about any goals or scores.
rows.description_html: BlockUrbs is a small city builder sandbox toy where you can play freely without worrying about progression, resource management or scoring. You can place variety of structures like houses, residential buildings, commercial buildings, sport grounds, industries, restaurants, trees, hospitals and roads on tiles of various sizes to create detailed and beautiful city section. There are 3 types of tiles to choose in BlockUrbs - Green - Desert - Cold You can choose from following 5 tile sizes - XS (4x4) - S (6x6) - M (8x8) - L (10x10) - XL (12x12) Also, you can unlock additional structures by completing the optional objectives. Please feel free to reach out to me for any feedback or queries. Thanks!

rows.name: BirdsBorough : Town of Alchemy
rows.short_description: Build and run your own alchemy store, make your own unique custom potions and learn the stories of the residents, in the ominous town of BirdsBorough...
rows.description_html: *THIS GAME IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED, unfortunately this game did not receive the funding we needed to continue working on it and bring it to the quality we wanted. We appreciate everyone who supported this project and we're still proud of our first commercial release. BirdsBorough has been made free for anyone who enjoys the game or is curious to continue playing.* After mysterious events a run-down potion shop has found it's way into your possession! The people of BirdsBorough have many unique problems for you to solve but you can create just as many unique potions brewed with various properties and powers. As you grow close to the people of BirdsBorough you may learn more secrets of this mysterious town you find yourself.... Combine 27 unique potion effects using a colour mixing alchemy system. All effects have can be combined by matching their effect colours in the cauldron and mixing them all together! All potions drastically effect those who drink them! Solve NPCs unique problems , all NPCs have procedurally generated dialogue, so they'll always have something unique to say and unique problems to solve! It's up to you to figure out which potion would best help each NPC. Build your own potion store with various decorations and structures, in whatever way you want! As you collect funds from potion sales you'll be able to build you're own store in a large plot of land in the town, however you see fit, will you create an ominous monolith? A simple market stall? Or something else entirely! It's all up to you! Grow and harvest multiple unique plants , from elder trees to death blooms, all of which will affect your potions in different ways!

rows.name: Beyond the Mountains
rows.short_description: Uncover a vast land filled with secrets, monsters, and ancient myth in BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS, a top-down action RPG about a lost soul who uncovers a mysterious secret. Stranded in a foreign land and armed only with your wits and curiosity, you will collect items, unlock secrets, and fight monsters.
rows.description_html: Uncover a vast land filled with secrets, monsters, and ancient myth in BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS , a top-down action RPG about a lost soul who uncovers a mysterious secret. Stranded in a foreign land and armed only with your wits and curiosity, you will collect items, unlock secrets, and fight ferocious monsters. Fifteen years ago, King Leo braved Zanarik, Brother of Darkness, atop the Tower of the Gods. Where King Leo disappeared to is anyone's guess. Will you be able to solve the mystery? A STRANGE LAND As Peter, you will slowly uncover a vast mystery as you attempt to save the world of Evalon from unthinkable destruction. EVERY INCH UNCOVERED Use every item you can find in dungeons, caves, and the large handcrafted overworld to map an entire continent full of secrets. With dozens of enemy types and hundreds of puzzles, you will have to use every trick in your arsenal to stop evil forces and save the world of Evalon. A COLORFUL CAST The world of Evalon is stocked with colorful and crazy characters, each with their own unique desires and motivations. It never hurts to talk to each person you meet! WHAT LIES BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS? Explore a handcrafted overworld filled with intricate caves, tunnels, hidden paths, and overarching dungeons Fight multiple enemies and bosses using a variety of weapons and items you will collect on your journey Explore beaches, towns, deserts, mountains, swamps, and a city of the dead Battle your way through a volcano, flooded lighthouse, abandoned factory, and much, much more Take a break from the action with fishing and minigolf minigames Get into shenanigans with a goofy trading sequence Immerse yourself with an original soundtrack of over 50 songs and hundreds of unique sprites and tiles Choose from Super Easy, Hard, and Speedrun game modes BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS is a passion product of over a decade. I have lived with these characters and concepts for many years, and am excited to finally share the world of Evalon with you! -Eric

rows.short_description: The Ender Ocean principle? Locate and collect waste (plastic bags, bottles, lost nets...) thanks to underwater robots connected to a collection boat, in order to valorize them afterwards, all from home.
rows.description_html: ENDER OCEAN™ is an innovative environmental video game. Players control remote-controlled robots to perform underwater cleaning missions. The game includes software levels where players have to face virtual challenges to earn points (pick up plastic waste, remove fishing nets...). And material levels, where they can participate in real sessions in natural environment (lakes, rivers, sea...) and collect real waste by staying at home.

rows.name: Synchronicity
rows.short_description: 1v1 turn-based tactics, online or vs a practice-AI in a futuristic cyberpunk setting. Plan 3 steps in advance while your opponent does the same. Mind-game and outsmart your opponent with a variety of abilities, destructible and penetrable environments and a good strategy.
rows.description_html: As a small Indie multiplayer game, matchmaking with a small player-base is always a challenge. That is why Synchronicity implements ' Cloud Turns '. When playing matchmaking games, do not expect to play them in one go, but rather over the course of a couple of days . You will get notified whenever there is a new turn for you; as will be your opponent. That is not to say that there won't be the occasional match that is played live, but it probably will be the exception. For playing live games, I encourage you to invite your friends or join the discord and find people to play with that way. Synchronicity is a tactical turn based game. Maneuver your Units to outsmart your opponent and use their special abilities to the greatest effect. The game is split into two phases, planning and execution: Each round you can plan up to 3 actions for each of your 3 Units. Have them move across the map, Shoot along a certain path, overwatch a specific area or use one of their special abilities. Once both sides have submitted their plans for the round they get executed at the same time. Then you'll find out how well you anticipated your opponents moves of it its all falling apart. Any online game you start, both Matchmaking games or custom private matches , can be played synchronously as well as asynchronously: Synchronous gameplay is what you expect. Both players are online at the same time. Whenever both sides have submitted their turn you get to see the result can plan your next moves. Asynchronous gameplay means that your opponent does not need to be online for you to play. Any plans you submit are saved in the cloud. If your opponent has already submitted their turn you get to see the result and can submit your next turn to the cloud.     Notifications are send whenever it is your time to make the next move. You can register for either notifications through Steam or Discord. Synchronous turns: Plan 3 steps in advance while your opponent does the same. Asymmetrical multiplayer: Opportunistic hackers vs righteous megacorp? Idealist revolutionaries vs malevolent corporate overlord? Pick your side! Destructible and penetrable environments: Predict enemy positions and just shoot through the wall! Need a different angle? Breach some walls! Instant Replay: Missed something? Look at what happened in the last round again. Any detail can give you an edge! Practice Puzzles : Get to know the special abilities and mechanics with fun little Puzzle levels! Practice AI: Want to get used to the game without pressure? Try practicing against the AI! Cloud Games: Turn any game into an asynchronous cloud game. Don't have time to finish the game in one go? Come back later, the game will be waiting for you. The game was developed over the course of >5 years by me and myself: Simon Special Thanks to Jazz Mickle (queenjazz.gay) for allowing me to use her track 'super violence' in the Trailer and also a huge thanks to all my playtesters for the great feedback!

rows.name: Motherless - Season 1
rows.short_description: Motherless is a captivating story-driven visual novel for mature audiences. Follow the story of Sunny, a young man who was separated from his loved ones at birth. Join him on a journey of self-discovery, as he reconnects with people from his past and uncovers the secrets of his childhood.
rows.description_html: Motherless - Season 1 includes: 11 chapters Season 1 is composed of over 10,000 renders, animated scenes, 178 videos, sounds and mini-games that you can play. You can enjoy over 8 to 10 hours of gameplay totally free of charge! Get your harem of beautiful women! Motherless is a captivating, narrative-driven visual novel intended for mature audiences. It follows the story of Sunny, a young man who was separated from his loved ones at birth and raised with little knowledge of his origins. Join him on a journey of self-discovery, as he reconnects with people from his past and uncovers the secrets of his forgotten childhood. In this game, you will witness the journey of a young boy who runs away from his private boarding school in search of his childhood memories. During this quest, he will unwittingly find employment with someone from his past... You can play the intro or choose to ignore it... We recommend you play it!!!! You will be able to choose through the relationship manager if you want to follow the path of any character. The characters in the game have different ethnicities and personalities, so you will be attracted to some of them. Will you be able to ignore them? The further you advance in the game, the more you will get caught up in the story and each character with their different needs. The game is a visual novel that becomes more interactive through fun mini-games and hilariously awkward events.

rows.name: Cursed 3
rows.short_description: The epic conclusion of the CURSED trilogy.
rows.description_html: In 2009 a girl named Jennifer was lost in an abandoned mineshaft. She was rescued by a brave man who studied the mine's history, but she was changed. That man disappeared without a trace... In 2019 Jennifer's friend Randall came back to their hometown only to find it in shambles. He took down an evil cult and the demon they were attempting to resurrect. He and Jennifer fled to find a new life elsewhere. Now in 2022 , Jennifer is restless about her destiny. Why did this all befall her? How was her family related to the ancient past? Jen sets off alone to her great-grantparent's abandoned house. Her father grew up in that house, and it may hold the answers she seeks. She will discover far more than she bargained for... The final chapter of the CURSED trilogy! This game has a ton of new features! -Same distinctive art style, but now in Widescreen and up to 120hz supported -Investigate the house in any way you choose. Non-linear progression with tons to discover -Look around every room and fight hideous creatures in full 360 degrees of rotation -A fusion of combat and world. Everything is now real-time, so fight or flight, it's up to you -Equip up to 4 items to quick-swap at any time for maximum readiness -Many weapons to find and build gradual mastery of -Gain stat points to improve Jennifer in whatever way you see fit -Over 10 magic spells that can be used anytime with a new sigil-drawing mechanic -Over a dozen intense boss fights to test your wits, skill, and reflexes -A massive adventure with even more difficult puzzles, enemies, items, and ways to solve problems than ever -Around 30 minutes of cutscenes tell the full story like never before (skippable for you speedrunners :)) -Over 10 hours of gameplay. New completion and playtime counters track your progress. -The biggest baddest CURSED game I could possibly make by myself. I hope you enjoy it

rows.name: The Longest Walk
rows.short_description: The Longest Walk is a deeply personal biographical walking-simulator game about my father's experience of living with depression.
rows.description_html: The Longest Walk is a deeply personal biographical walking simulator game about my father's experience of living with depression and suicidal thoughts. The game was created using audio recorded from a 54-minute-long interview that I conducted with my dad, which was then edited into this approximately 9-and-a-half minute long playable experience. The aim for this game is to help reduce feelings of isolation and encourage those who are struggling with depression or experiencing suicidal thoughts to reach out for help. Through my father's sharing of his personal experience in an open and frank manner, this game seeks to raise awareness of and provide an insight into what it is like living with depression in order to provoke discussion and help tackle the stigma about opening-up about mental health issues. Whilst my father's experience and the locations depicted in the game are specific to him, the thoughts, feelings, and message conveyed through his recollection of lived experience are universal. The Longest Walk is now playable on Steam Deck! Please use the following settings for best performance and subtitle readability: - Subtitles: Standard - Graphics: Optimised Players using a gamepad or Steam Deck can invert the Y-Axis by holding LB (L1) and tapping RB (R1) on the gamepad. This free game is part of a series of documentary-inspired biographical game prototypes that I am developing for my PhD at Abertay University - Funded by The Northwood Charitable Trust - and was inspired by games such as Dear Esther (The Chinese Room), Actual Sunlight (WZOGI), and That Dragon, Cancer (Numinous Games). This game is published under the Abertay Game Lab practice-based research group by Somewhat Unsettling.

rows.name: Downbass Warriors: Heroes of Maydamn
rows.short_description: DownBass Warriors: Heroes of MayDamn (DWHOM) is a hardcore first-person shooter with nice physics, a trouble-free, enjoyable shooting and an advanced character injury systems. A unique, one of a kind character armor customization system was also introduced in the game . So what are you waiting for?
rows.description_html: Game is in early access state. In DWHOM, player gets into a modern war conflict cituation with several sides and factions of the military campaign. Every player will personally experience what could be happening at war, and its up to you what game content actualy means, is it pathetic parody or harsh truth? We left it for you to decide. We, as developers, doing everything we can, to make the players expirience unique and unrepeatable with our brand new advanced gameplay systems you wouldnt be able to enjoy in any other game. The game is at early state of its development, but already features 43 various character injury types which have their own negative aftereffect on the player. Dont expect your soldier to have his full functionality after taking a couple of hits. Character has very precise hitbox, what copies his body structure, and with combo of simple, but fast and multifunctional shooting system wich allows you to shoot throw walls or even to ricoche, you will have a unrepeatable expierence. The game features brand new armor system designed by us from scratch, which lets you to place armor pieces anywhere on character and subsequently calculates its position, to exclude any collision in wrong places. Any resemblance to real life is purely coincidental. Currently there are only 20 slots for players. Join our discord : For any questions or suggestion : nikoniko5120@gmail.com

rows.description_html: What is RUNGORE Have you ever dreamt about a world where you don't need to follow arbitrary rules of your favorite card game? Like, making turns, or use a finite amount of manaenergyAP or whatever. If you answered 'yes' then I have a treat for you :) RUNGORE: Beginner Experience is heavily inspired by Slay The Spire and Loop Hero. It takes all the good parts from those games and smashes them together until they stick. This version is a prologue for the full game, and its features are: - Idle battles (very exciting) - Non restricted card-play. Have you ever wanted to play 100 cards during one encounter? Well, now you can - 3 heroes with different strategies for each one to explore - 3 levels to assert dominance over random mobs - Psychopathic tutorial guide

rows.name: Blindsided Labs
rows.short_description: Recruit Swordsmen, Archers, and Templars, then watch your pixel squad auto-battle across the screen. Crush the enemy base before its ever-tougher waves crush you in an endlessly escalating tug-of-war!
rows.description_html: Key Information A tide of pixel-art combat rolls across the screen—your hand-picked squad on the left, relentless enemy waves on the right. Spend steadily-generated Energy to recruit one of three classic heroes: Swordsman – hardy frontline bruiser Archer – ranged sharpshooter who thins the horde Templar – Tankier, faster, and more damage! Once deployed, units march forward automatically, clashing wherever they meet. If a side’s warriors fall, survivors push on to batter the opposing base. Destroy the enemy stronghold before they topple yours and the round is yours. But victory comes at a price: each win beefs up the enemy army and bolsters their base with extra health, ratcheting up the pressure in an ever-escalating gauntlet. How long can your tactics keep pace with their growing fury? Key Features Pick-and-Play Strategy – Simple unit-buying at the start of every round; deep decisions in what you field. Three Distinct Classes – Mix frontline muscle, ranged support and tanky defense to craft the perfect battle line. Endless Escalation – Every victory toughens the next wave, turning early skirmishes into nail-biting sieges. One-Screen Pixel Action – Clean, colorful art keeps the focus on moment-to-moment tactics. Short Sessions, Long Mastery – Matches play fast, but optimal play and high-wave survival demand cunning. Rally your tiny army, sharpen your strategy, and see how far you can push before the ever-stronger foe pushes back!

rows.name: Ascend: Reborn
rows.short_description: Ascend Reborn is an old-school, 3rd person action RPG. Wage war as a brutal Caos warrior on your journey to Ascension. The reign of the Titans has come to an end. The New Gods have risen to claim ultimate power and need a champion. Will you rise to the challenge?
rows.description_html: The cult classic action RPG Ascend: Hand of Kul is reborn! Lore The ancient prophecies foretold that once the Titans' reign had ended, one of the Three Gods would claim dominion over their brethren and seize a position of ultimate power. That time has come, and now your God needs a Champion. Will you rise to the challenge? The Titans In the deadly world of Ascend: Reborn, blood is power. The Titans–colossal, bloodthirsty, immortal giants–lumber through the World satiating painful hunger with endless feasts of human souls. Humans pray in vain as their villages are engulfed in the violent onslaught of the Titans and their monsters. The new God rise to claim their legacy. Caos Declare your allegiance to the God of Darkness, Light, or Void. Personalize and level your Caos with hundreds of customization options including appearance, weapons, armor, gear, abilities, skills, and much more. As you journey through Ascend you’ll be rewarded with rare loot and valuable lore. Discover the secret of defeating the Titans and secure your god’s dominion to claim your place as Champion in the Crusade. Ascend The largest rewards require the ultimate sacrifice-your character! But all is not lost, as each life dedicated to your god brings new abilities that help shape you into the ultimate Caos warrior. Evolving world Behold the world as it changes dynamically beneath your feet, bowing to your growing power. As you discover the secret of defeating the Titans and securing your god’s dominion over the world, you’ll claim your place as a legend. Free-to-Play Ascend: Reborn is an old-school action RPG experience with a lot of unique twists and surprises. Ascend is free to play over Steam.

rows.name: Paradise Puzzle!
rows.short_description: Move the gems in the stage and line up three or more to make them disappear! If you line up 3 or more gems, you can reduce the HP of the enemy. You will win the battle when you reduce the enemy's HP to 0.
rows.description_html: Paradise Puzzle! is casual puzzle game. Call a girl you want to play with , and beat monsters. Beautiful, kawaii, a little erotic CG will be yours! Your goal is to line up three or more of the same type of gem horizontally or vertically. Feel free to move them to any square you'd like! When you clear a line of gems, the spots you cleared will be filled with prisms falling from above. Because of this, you can combo matches together. However, once you stop dragging it, or if the time limit reaches zero, your turn is over. In order to win, you have to fight until the enemy's HP goes down to zero. if your HP goes down to zero first, you lose. The hourglass shows the number of turns you have left. You'll also lose if that reaches zero. You can make use of any type of jem to damage the enemy, but there are also jems that have special effects. If you clear Skull jem, your turn counter will go down. If you clear Potion jem, your HP will be restored. I recommend you carefully look at the jems on screen and consider which ones will give you the highest combo when you clear them. rows.name: Dreamer's Road
rows.short_description: Help make the world a better place while carrying the weight of your studies and 3 jobs on your shoulders! Experience the reality of thousands of young immigrants in the United States, seeking to improve themselves and help the growth of this great nation.
rows.description_html: Pursue the American dream. The term 'Dreamers' refers to young immigrants who came to the United States as children and who feel American, but who live without access to full citizenship. Dreamer's Road presents us with an interactive adventure about the empowering experience of a young immigrant developed entirely by Latinos. Each of its five levels confronts us with tests of a varied nature, from the traumatic and cruel reality of crossing the border at a very young age to working as a delivery or waitress, to end up facing the very promoter of the pandemic, an evil scientist who seeks to dominate the world! All in a classic arcade aesthetic. Discover through this interactive experience the strength and determination of the young people who overcome obstacles to improve their lives and the lives of their communities by guaranteeing the next generation of leaders and essential workers who will make this planet a better place. It traces the life of a young immigrant who contributes to the growth of this great nation through her daily work, hoping to be able to train professionally and achieve the 'American dream'. Are you ready to live as an immigrant in the United States? - Install yourself and start training as a professional! He arrives at a new home and faces the challenges of starting a new life. - Master your work skill! Deliver orders at high speed, deliver food before your customers leave, repair houses before they are destroyed, and much more. - Save the world! Become a professional scientist and save the world from an evil scientist.

rows.name: Mr.Addon Game Maker
rows.short_description: Haven't had enough of Mr.Addon in Sulpicius Gallus M? Well now, in this fantastic second part, you will be able to create your own levels! Create your own adventure in Mr.Addon Game Maker!
rows.description_html: Haven't had enough of Mr.Addon in Sulpicius Gallus M? Well now, in this fantastic second part, you will be able to create your own levels! Create your own adventure in Mr.Addon Game Maker! You will see a lot of new things and it will be a lot of fun! Fight or create your own levels, worlds and more! Replace the world of Mr.Addon with your own, as if you had developed it yourself and effortlessly! Now with Mr.Addon Game Maker you can add everything you can imagine: spikes, fixed platforms, diamonds, coins, teleportation portals, rotating platforms, drawbridges, power-ups and a large number of enemies to choose from: flying 'brain' aliens , mechanical reptiles, replicating cyborgs and spiky worker octopuses. Regarding the gameplay, MrAddon is an incredible 2D platform game, whose mechanics consist of eliminating all the enemies in each level. Being able to play in an 'Arcade' mode or in the 'Creation of new levels' mode. The game cannot be saved and continues are limited. In Mr.Addon Game Maker the difficulty is decided by you when you create new levels. To eliminate all the enemies, it is achieved by throwing multi-frequency 'rainbow' rays at them, which is the special ability of the MrAddon character, thus turning them into 'Moons', 'Snow' or 'Fire' type balls and then rolling them to eliminate more enemies. An adventure created by fans of the legendary Snow Bros Arcade game and the fantastic Mario Maker.

rows.short_description: Race around the track across 9 unique locations to achieve the fastest time on the leaderboard.
rows.description_html: Pedal to the Metal is a single player, 3D racing game where the player drives around the track, trying to achieve the fastest time to add to the leaderboard. The game features 9 unique levels spread across various locations. All the levels were created by the crew members at nonPareil. nonPareil Institute's mission is to help adults on the autism spectrum grow towards their potential by providing work readiness training integrated with hands-on technical instruction and social engagement opportunities.

rows.name: Forgotten Lands: Online
rows.short_description: A free online multiplayer RPG that tells the tale of a realm whose history was lost to time! Battle through hoards of monsters, join up with other players you meet along the journey, and compete in enjoyable mini-games to rank in the leaderboards!
rows.description_html: Forgotten Lands: Online is a free online multiplayer RPG. Explore an open world without much limitation. ﻿Customize your character appearance through character skins and vanity items! Collect and compare hundreds of combat items to perfect your character build. Create a party, join a Guild, and befriend special players you encounter along your journey! Battle through hoards of combat NPCs, and encounter strong bosses for loot and prestige.   Battle other players in the PVP Zone for a chance to nab their equipment and prove your strength. Participate in mini-games that happen at certain times of the day! Strut your stuff by reaching the top of the rankings! (Displayed on the main website) The game was released in an alpha state, and is under active development. The game is updated approximately once per month. Max character level is 35, but is planned to be expanded to at least level 100. Server Reboot Schedule... The server will automatically restart itself every day. Resets everyday @11:59 (UTC) The server may be offline for up to 5 minutes while it reboots. *The server also checks if it is offline, so if the server were to ever crash, it will automatically reboot itself. Just please wait a few minutes if the server goes offline. Important Note About VPNs and UDP Connection... The game requires a UDP connection, which may cause issues if you are using VPN services. As a result, you likely will not be able to log into the game when connecting through a VPN connection. If you are able to launch the game but cannot log into the game, it is likely that you are using a VPN service or a TCP connection. Controller, Gamepads, and Steam Deck... You can play the game using a controller, gamepad, or the Steam Deck. However, you may need to map buttons. Button mapping can be done directly through the Steam Input controller configuration, or it can be edited in the game settings (options menu -> controls). Most controllers and gamepads have enough buttons to map all essential game controls. However, controllers and gamepads cannot be used to navigate game menus, and there is no built-in keyboard which would allow you to type text into the chat box or other input fields.

rows.name: Warlocks Quarry
rows.short_description: Use your skills in looting, fighting, exploring and base building to survive and progress in Warlocks world.
rows.description_html: Warlocks quarry, a prelude to Warlocks Entanglement.  Use your skills in looting, fighting, exploring and base building to survive and progress in Warlocks world. Destructible environment Destroy anything you see and build something new with the resources. Combat Fight a variety of different creatures with various weapons that you can either find from looting or craft yourself as you learn. Day and night cycles Craft torches to provide you light or enchant one of your weapons with radiance to help you see in the dark, You can carry torches in both hands giving much more visibility in dark places. Looting and exploring There are many locations to loot but as you exhaust areas you must start heading further afield to find what you're looking for. Base building You can occupy a house and convert it to your own requirements or build one from scratch, there are many different resources around that you can utilise to aid you in this. Levelling As you gain experience create more advanced high tier weapons / bows and armour. Gardening You can create or loot seeds and plant them to grow crops, Cross contaminating some crops can cause more exotic and useful plants to grow, You can learn the secret to this as you go. Brew potions As your cauldron grows stronger with the ingredients it needs you will be able to brew more powerful potions, Providing an array of additional skills to aid you. Delving deep underground There are many chasms that open up to underground tunnels and sometimes cities, There are many precious recourses to loot and mine underground

rows.name: Gordian Rooms 2: A curious island Prologue
rows.short_description: Locked and left to your own devices once again! Muster your wits and find a way out of a yet undiscovered part of your recently inherited mansion. The Prologue takes place between the events of Gordian Rooms 1 and 2.
rows.description_html: Welcome back to Gordian Rooms! On one sunny day you were strolling down your newfound mansion and successfully stumbled into a yet undiscovered part of it. Just as your luck would have it the door closed behind you before you could escape, like in the good old days... Once again you were left to your own devices to challenge your uncle's final surprise! The prologue version of Gordian Rooms 2: A curious island aims to bridge the events between the prequel and the sequel. You will be able to experience all the new features that we have worked on but in a different location than the Isle of Lye, namely a yet unseen part of your uncle's mansion. We improved nearly every aspect of the game since the first episode's release. Here are some features you can definitely expect: Free roaming movement Redesigned User Interface and User Experience Vastly improved visuals, powered by Unreal Engine 5 and Lumen Full controller support The rest you need to find out for yourself, well only if you can escape...

rows.name: Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era Prologue
rows.short_description: Create weapons of your dreams from gunpowder pistols to grenade launchers. Craft cartridges by mixing powder ingredients. Melt ore, blow glass, study chemistry, and make explosives. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more in the Dune deserts!
rows.description_html: This is the prologue to Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era . Which Include a 3-5 hours of gameplay. You can try some basic mechanics of the game like building factories, gathering resources, fighting robots, researching skills, traiding, managing. In full version of the game will be able much more content. Like this : You will have to survive in the harsh world of the steampunk era, with a constant shortage of resources. Explore new lands, look for caves with minerals, explore the ruins for food and water. Build factories by modules, creating and assembling each piece. Explore new technologies, and develop new engines. Exlore various fuel technologies. Protect your camp from the invasion of mechanical robots that are constantly eager to dismantle your factories for parts. Research and improve your technologies and factories. Create weapons of your dreams from gunpowder pistols to grenade launchers. Craft cartridges manually by mixing powder ingredients in different proportions. Melt ore, blow glass, study chemistry, and make explosives. Cut wood, mine ore, dig, shoot, build and repair, create drones to transport resources, build transport systems and more. Powder pistols, revolvers, Winchesters, shotguns, sniper rifles, machine guns, Gatling guns, grenade launchers, and more. Want a weapon with 2 barrels - please, 3…5 or even 10 barrels, it depends on your imagination. Make barrels of different diameters and cast bullets of different calibers. Collect various factories from hundreds of different spare parts. Fill your engines with the fuel and use the oil grease so that they don't rust or break down. Repair damaged engines and restore factories replacing broken parts. Improve your character by raising his skill level. Develop an exoskeleton and upgrade it to carry heavy parts in your inventory. Build and manage a complete chemical laboratory, mix, heat, cool reagents for different effects. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more! In this game, everything you will see, all the tools, factories, engines, every gear, all this will be created and assembled by your hands from scratch.

rows.name: Wander Vyrosa
rows.short_description: A tower-defense game with roguelite elements on fully explorable mini planets! Travel the galaxy of Vyrosa, land on planets, and defend your drilling equipment while mining fuel to continue your journey throughout the galaxy!
rows.description_html: Wander Vyrosa is a tower-defense game with roguelite elements set on fully explorable mini planets! As the next in a long lineage of elite spacefarers, you have been chosen to travel the cosmos in search of the Heart of Vyros. It is up to you to travel between star systems, land on planets, and defend your drill while mining fuel to continue your journey! The features below are currently available in the game Roguelite elements mixed with tower defense style fun Fully traversable spherical planets Dynamic tower building, with customizable tower loadouts and upgrades Procedurally generated star systems Multiple playable wanderers, each with their own specialties and abilities Vyrosa is a complex galaxy with much to explore. While these features aren't currently in for you to experience , they are coming soon during early access! Enemy Races - Vyrosa is full of many more races than just Lizards, with each giving a fresh take on a given archetype. Learn each races strengths and weaknesses and which towers work best against them Tower Variations - Evolved versions of existing towers that wildly change up how they can be used Lore - Learn more about the Heart of Vyros and why so many seek the power it contains Minigames - If you're feeling bored while traveling thousands of lightyears away during your search, relax and play some minigames in the arcade Coffee Bar - The staple drink of every Wanderer. Join the Trader in a cup of joe and enjoy a pep on your next planet

rows.name: Slurpies FREE
rows.short_description: Snake, slither, SLURRPP! Chill out with your friends in this free multiplayer arcade game. Relax as you grow your colorful space snake by eating lots of food and avoiding playful baddies and other players. How long can you grow your Space Slurpie?
rows.description_html: How long is your Slurpie worm? Relax in this FREE version of the multiplayer arcade game and control a colorful space snake with your hand. Chill out with your friends while collecting as much food as possible. The more you eat, the more the snake grows. Try not to run into other players or all kinds of playful baddies! With a calming Zen mode, multiplayer modifiers, and over 18 solo maps, there is a game mode for everyone to enjoy. Snake, slither, SLURRPP! Players control a snake that follows your hand It grows in length as you eat food Evolve and cover yourself in armor as it grows Survive the longest without colliding with yourself or other players Competitive players can sabotage each other to win the game Avoid the Jazzeroids and other enemy obstacles on your quest to be the longest slurp! Enjoy over 18 unique and vibrant maps Cross platform multiplayer, both matchmaking and games with friends Multiplayer compatible with the original paid game Space Slurpies Customize your snake and make uniquely yours SLUUUUUUUUUUURRP & Grow

rows.name: World Mahjong
rows.short_description: This board game is a mahjong game played by 4 people or computer.learn and play by this App about the [Traditional Chinese Mahjong] and [Japan Riich Mahjong] Game.
rows.description_html: ◆This board game is a mahjong game played by 4 people or computer. You can play with 3 ai users by yourself, Or you can play Mahjong with 3 other real users. ◆This game supports traditional [Chinese mahjong] and [Japanese riich mahjong]. Tutorials, practice( single play mode ), and online play ( 4 user play mode ) supported. We provide two styles of mahjong tiles for western players unfamiliar with mahjong games. ◆You can learn how to play Mahjong by investing only 10 minutes in the tutorial. This game requires a network connection for online play. If the network connection is not smooth, the game will not play normally. The game also supports single play game with AI players. ◆Mahjong is a game that requires skill. Our games are played by thousands of real users every day. More than 30% of users have played this game more than 10,000 times. You'll have to play that much and you'll be of average skill. If you are in doubt about the game opponent, please report it using the replay function. ◆This game has in-app purchase items. You can purchase 3, 5, 9, 30, or 50 gold items. Purchased gold can be used to exchange for game money, avatars, and other items. Many Mahjong players await your challenge.

rows.name: Cut Master Spades
rows.short_description: Quick, seamless, and HIGHLY engaging Spades matches between real people. Play with your friends, enjoy the classic game in immersive 3D with quirky characters. Match up online and climb the leaderboards or just have a chill session with your buddies. There's a table for everyone!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Cut Master Spades, the thrilling twist on the classic card game of that will push your strategic skills to new heights! Get ready for an immersive multiplayer experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Sharpen your skills in single-player showdowns against challenging AI opponents or dive into intense Spades battles against players from around the globe in real-time matches. Immerse yourself in the action with an exhilarating first-person perspective. Step into the shoes of your character and feel the adrenaline rush as you make strategic moves and outwit your opponents. Collaborate seamlessly with your partner, synchronize your tactics, and outmaneuver your opponents to win rounds and claim glorious victories. Prepare yourself for intense showdowns and take on the top players in Ranked mode! Get ready to master the art of Spades in Cut Master Spades and prove your skills in the ultimate card game battle! Key Features: 1. Strategic Gameplay: Think tactically and carefully play your cards to outsmart your opponents. Coordinate with your partner, predict the moves of other players, and bid wisely to gain the upper hand. 2. Thrilling Game Modes: Explore a variety of game modes, including Classic Spades, Mirror and more. Play each mode with a partner or go Cutthroat in solo. Each mode offers unique challenges and rule variations to keep you engaged. 3. Competitive Multiplayer: Challenge friends or team up with players worldwide in ranked multiplayer matches. Prove your Spades expertise and climb the global leaderboards. 4. Custom Lobbies: Create and customize your own private lobbies, where you can invite friends or set specific match parameters. Tailor the Spades experience to your liking and enjoy battles with your preferred rules and settings. 5. Diverse Character Roster: Show off your personality with a fun character that gives off your vibe. Collect all characters for bragging rights. 6. Beautiful Environments: Immerse yourself in stunning and vibrant environments that enhance your Spades experience. Play in unique locations, whether its a smoky basement or a family barbeque. 7. In-Game Rewards: Earn exciting rewards as you progress, including new card decks, avatars, and customization options. Unlock achievements and showcase your Spades mastery to the world. 8. Fun Player Interactions: Enjoy lively player interactions as you engage in real-time chat with opponents and teammates. Celebrate successful plays, strategize together, and experience the camaraderie of the Spades community. Whether you're a seasoned Spades player or a newcomer to the game, Cut Master Spades offers an immersive and competitive multiplayer experience like no other. Sharpen your skills, form alliances, and become the ultimate Spades champion! Note: Cut Master Spades works best with an internet connection.

rows.name: United heist
rows.short_description: Your crew consists of two elite thieves. A client hires you to steal a mysterious item. One handles intel; the other infiltrates. Choose your roles and master the heist in this asymmetric co-op puzzle game.
rows.description_html: INFO This game requires two players and a headset for seamless communication. About Your crew consists of the best two thieves money can buy—no questions asked. That’s how it’s always been, until a mysterious client hires you to steal an unknown item. The target? Classified. The pay? Too good to pass up. Decide who will handle intel and who will infiltrate the facility in this high-stakes asymmetric co-op puzzle game. Unique Features Asymmetric Co-op. Work in separate places, using tools and solving puzzles to help each other. Engaging Heist Story. Discover a story with twists, multiple endings, and choices that matter. Creative Puzzles. Solve puzzles with new ideas that make teamwork essential. In-Game Voice Chat. Use an old-school walkie-talkie to stay in touch with your partner. Striking Level Design. Explore bold environments built to inspire and challenge you. Enjoy the game. ~ No More Sleep

rows.name: Socrates Jones: Pro Philosopher
rows.short_description: Debate for your life against brilliant thinkers, poke holes in their arguments and cause them to freak out— or just tell them their faces are ugly. NONSENSE!
rows.description_html: Everyone Socrates Jones knows seems to love philosophy— everyone except Socrates himself. A simple accountant from New York, Socrates was never interested in philosophical questions or the art of arguing. But when he finds himself debating for his life against a queue of famous philosophers, Socrates Jones has no choice but to expand his horizons in a quest to find the nature of morality. The classic game, rebuilt for Steam! Face off in interactive debates against a host of famous philosophers— and a deer repellent salesman. Ask questions and present counterpoints to find problems in your opponent's ideas and cut through their NONSENSE! A loving homage to a certain lawyerly game series, Pro Philosopher introduces its own mechanical twists to cross-examination gameplay, all wrapped up in a charming story and healthy helping of humor. If you've never played Pro Philosopher before, now's a great time to discover why people enjoyed it the first time around— It's free! And fans of the original release can look forward to: Greatly polished presentation! Higher resolution assets across the board! New 16:9 layout! Improved UI during debates. Improved UI in general! New gameplay features! Controller Support! Achievements! Dynamic conversation logging! The groundbreaking ability to save whenever you want! Additional script polish! A few weirdly worded lines are a little less weird! Em dashes instead of double hyphens! Double hyphens are a categorical evil. Perhaps a little something extra somewhere...

rows.name: Bogey Brian
rows.short_description: Play as Brian, a slime who dreams of playing golf - with himself as the ball! Squish, jump, roll, and spin your way to glory by getting Brian to the flag on each hole. Improve your score through the use of strategic powerups and collect hats along the way that can totally change the game experience.
rows.description_html: Golfing for a slime isnt easy. Without arms or legs, a slime can do many things, but swinging a club is not one of them. Brian, an eternal optimist, did not let this dissuade him from achieving his dreams. He envisioned a golf game where he himself was the ball, yeeting himself to glory across boundless and whimsical landscapes. Believing no obstacle was too great, he kissed his mom goodbye and bounded off to be the inaugural member of his own golf league. Squish, jump, roll, and spin your way to golfing glory by getting Brian to the flag on each hole. Improve your score through the use of strategic powerups and collect hats along the way that can totally change the game experience and give Brian some flare. Remember: 'Don't SEE the ball. BE the ball.' Use powerups to shave strokes off your score! Choose from 9 different powerup types. Mulligan - Make a bad shot? Use a mulligan go right back to where you were and reset your score as well. Sticky Shot - Stick to whatever you touch first after shooting. Aim Assist - Get a visual representation of where Brian will fly as you line up your shot. Rocket - Use a limited amount of rocket power to push yourself upward. Ghost - Use the ghost powerup to go through walls! Be careful though, as with great power comes great danger. If you stop ghosting while inside a wall, you will gain a penalty stroke and be sent back to your last position. And more! 9 unique courses! Each course has a unique theme and three levels of difficulty - Normal, Hard and Impossible. Some courses include: Grassy Greens Crystal Caves Spooky Strokes Galleon Greens Candy Country And more! **Note that the Impossible difficulty can be quite brutal. These are not for the faint of heart! Earn hats and Boge Coin! Earn rewards by completing courses with good scores. Buy and sell hats in the hat shop with your Boge Coin. Equip a hat to gain it's effects - over 10 different base hat effects with varying intensity, and tons of powerup modifiers. Power, Spin, Roll, Bounciness, Gravity and many other things can be effected by hats. There are millions of possible combinations! Several ways to play! Normal mode - Use powerups and hat effects to get the lowest score you can. Basic Brian mode - No powerups or hat effects allowed - get the lowest score you can. Speedrun mode - Complete each hole as fast as you can - strokes don't matter, only speed. Practice mode - Pick any hole on any course to practice on. Hone your lines and try new strategies to shave strokes off your score! Challenge mode - Choose from over 30 challenge hats, most with unique and difficult modifiers. Customize your trail! Choose the color and type of trail Brian leaves behind as he flies through the air. Random Mode! Play on a set of 9 randomly selected holes, with a randomly generated hat OR a randomly chosen challenge hat. Enter your own seed or have one randomly generated for you. Discord Server! Join our Discord Server to chat about the game and provide feedback to help shape the future of the game.

rows.name: The First Step
rows.short_description: Explore 2 levels, and collect all the required items. The levels are timed, so you can try to beat the levels as fast as possible. Or you can casually take your time and explore around. This project is only meant as a learning project for me. So please do not expect a complete game.
rows.description_html: I want to start off by mentioning that this project is a learning project for me. I am trying to learn how to use Unreal Engine, and for this purpose I have created this game. It is a very simple item collection game. And only has 2 levels. The entire game can be completed in a few minutes. Still, I have tried to make the levels interesting enough to explore for a bit. As well as added a timer, so you can try to find the quickest ways to complete the levels.

rows.name: Chess for idiots
rows.short_description: The first intellectually non-discriminatory chess variant. Instead of thinking, just move your pieces in one of the many absurd ways!
rows.description_html: Disclaimer: I do not support Kor*in and other extremes. The game is a satire full of stupid jokes aimed at people with an absurd sense of humor. The game is not intended to promote any ideology. Chess for idiots - a discipline of intellectual sport, invented and initiated by Ozjasz Goldberg. Seemingly chess for idiots resembles regular chess. The game is played on the same board using the same pieces. However, this is where the similarities end, because everything that would discriminate intellectually against players was eliminated from the rules. Therefore, there are practically no rules, and players can make any move with any pieces and capture any number of opponent's pieces. The victory is determined by the IQ (the lower, the greater the chances of winning) and the decision of Ozjasz Goldberg. Weapons: Blowing Arrow Invisible hand of market Brushwood+ Wozdoopy Grenade Inflation Hot Sauce And more... True story: When I was going to primary school, there was this guy named Paweł, and during breaks I played a game with him which involved blowing own coin in turns to land on the opponent's coin. Years later, I met Paweł and we remembered about this game, that day I couldn't sleep and I decided to copy this game to the computer. In addition to the coin mode, I added a chess mode and posted a video from a very early version of the game on a certain Facebook group where someone commented that it looked like Chess for idiots - it is a Polish political meme referring to a certain statement of a controversial politician, then I decided that this game will be a political satire. The game is therefore simultaneously a recreation of a physical game from my childhood, a parody of chess and a Polish political satire.

rows.name: TimeLost
rows.short_description: TimeLost is a Team-Based PvP Arena Fighter. Master precision combat, customize your playstyle through dual-weapon builds, and climb the ranks in Arenas that transcend space and time.
rows.description_html: TimeLost is a Team-Based PvP Arena Fighter. Master precision combat, customize your playstyle through dual-weapon builds, and climb the ranks in Arenas that transcend space and time. Prepare for Battle Enter the arena equipped with two distinct weapons, each offering unique skills. Your selections not only define your combat style but also impact your health and dodge capabilities. Strategize and customize to dominate the battlefield. Master The Art of Defense Defend with precision by balancing blocks and dodges. Absorb damage with well-timed blocks, but depleting your stamina leaves you exposed. Evade strikes and debuffs with perfectly timed dodges, gaining brief invulnerability. Strategy and reflexes are the keys to dominating the arena. Intense Combat with Endless Strategy Engage in fast-paced battles where strategy and precision are key. Compete in ranked arenas, skirmishes, or control points—each match brings new challenges. Customize builds to heal allies, debilitate enemies with status effects, and turn the tide of battle. Visit the Black Market The Black Market is the in-game shop where you can purchase new Weapons, Stimulants, Upgrade Chips, and other visual aesthetics to customize your character and weapons. You can acquire currency from competing in matches. NO MICROTRANSACTIONS!

rows.name: rotatePDF: A Corporate Tale
rows.short_description: Explore the liminal corridors of a company that only... rotates documents? This short artistic Indie title combines 2D exploration with paper physics to create a truly unique experience.
rows.description_html: Taking the role of an employee, explore a strange company that has you... rotate documents? Surely this must be a joke, you think, and begin to investigate. Switch between 2D exploration, physics simulation and puzzles in this enigmatic art game. Features Paper Physics * Calm, Liminal Atmosphere * A short, linear Story And lastly, a word of warning: O player, who seeketh for polished and complex games - turneth thy heel and flee, for thine search is in vain! This game is a single-developer Indie title and tries to make up for this with heart and humor, but it way not always succeed.

rows.name: Fall Minamo
rows.short_description: Save the lovely Minamo from flooding!
rows.description_html: 2022/9/17 Update Announcement We are happy to announce that We would like to thank Lime Anda, the creator of Minamo-chan, for kindly providing the music for this update. The BGM during the game and the BGM at the ending have been changed to bring out the cuteness of Minamo-chan even more. We hope you enjoy it! Credits VOICEVOX_Zundamon : NEUTRINO : About the Game This game is about you, Minamo-chan, being swept away by a waterfall. Game Features .The object of the game is to survive as long as possible, avoiding the attacks of the ferocious creatures that live in the waterfall. The longer you survive, the better your score, and you can enjoy a cute multi-ending based on your score. There are only two basic controls. Even beginners can enjoy the game casually. 'Move'... Move left and right with the directional keys. 'Swim'... Swim as hard as you can to raise your stamina a little. If you run out of stamina, you can't swim! Leveling up is important to defend against progressively more intense attacks. Collect Japanese confectionary to gain experience and strengthen your skills strategically. What is Minamo-chan ? Minamo-chan is a normal, cute girl who yearns to be an adult. She is unsociable, but she loves her friends. By nature, she is loved by all the water in the world. Minamo-chan is prone to flooding because the water wants to be friends with Minamo-chan.

rows.name: Dimensional Gears
rows.short_description: Dimensional Gears is a 2.5D puzzle platformer that takes place in a dystopian steam-punk future where household appliances are the only sentient beings left. Shift dimensions in order explore a dangerous 2.5D environment, escape the factory, and save your friends!
rows.description_html: Dimensional Gears is a 2.5D puzzle platformer that takes place in a dystopian steam-punk future where household appliances are the only sentient beings left. You play as Mike O. Wave the lovable microwave. You and your friends are stuck in an abandoned factory and must use Mike's supernatural ability to shift dimensions in order to escape. Make the most of this strange power to explore a dangerous 2.5D environment within a shifting, orthographic plane to escape the factory and save your friends. Shift between four different dimensions! This game's a mindbender! Pick up and throw objects to aid with platforming and defeating enemies! Dynamic music! Be immersed with audio that will constantly adapt to the situation at hand! The cutest microwave ever! He has some pretty adorable friends too! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Streamer Future Wars
rows.short_description: Questionable Gacha game where you can collect completely unique streamer characters!
rows.description_html: Streamer Future Wars is a high-fantasy hero collection RPG gacha game. Embark on your journey in this most questionable mobile-port gacha game. Only you can save the future of streaming. Collect unique heroes from the streaming world Level them, awaken and power them up Gather items and equip them on your heroes Breeze through story with handwritten dialogues Climb in the arena to claim the number 1 spot Battle through 40+ story chapters with unique story completely new made just for this game. Each stage contains a turn-based battle between your party of up to 5 heroes battling versus up to 5 enemies. Deplete their health bars to finish the stage. Any casualties on your side will cost you a star our of 3 possible stars for each stage. Special currency used in gacha can be acquired by clearing stage stars for the first time and daily/weekly missions. Game contains specialized summons where you can acquire heroes. There is a hard pity of 30 summons for a classic legendary hero. There's also a special darklight summon that contains more powerful or unique heroes. This summon comes with a special currency and a hard pity of 50 summons. Every character in the game can be obtained by a f2p player after some saving up. Not revolutionary by any means, and barely hitting the minimum standarts of a gacha hero game, but made with love and care! Game contains possible events for seasonal times like winter holidays and halloween. Gather completely unique streamer heroes, train and awaken them and upgrade their weapons. Also possibly with battlepass and pay to feed devs darklight battlepass. However you can collect all the heroes and beat everything in the game for completely free! Free to play *In-game purchases are available *Please read the End-User License Agreement (EULA) from the in-game menu before playing * Saves from mobile version are not compatible with the steam release

rows.name: Cyber Attack VR board game
rows.short_description: VR Co-op board game when players will fight against ship AI on board and inside of it at the same time. Hack all robots, and be prepared to protect yourself inside of the ship, solve 3D puzzles and help your friends.
rows.description_html: Be prepared to hack the ship AI and return yourself and your team back to the ship. This is the game where players can be at the same time inside and outside of the board game and have different gameplay, but it still will affect the gameplay for the entire team. Hack robots on the board (space ship rooms) and collect enough data to perform the Cyber Attack, but be cautious because the main computer (M.A.Z.E.) can hack you back and you will need to grab the gun to protect yourself. Robots that can explode and 3D puzzles will create tight situations, so be ready for it.

rows.name: Save and Conquer : 8 Years
rows.short_description: This is a 2D defense game that depicts the near future that may arise from climate change. Unlike the defense game, which is automatically attacked by traditional turrets, it is an attractive game that requires you to defeat the enemy by operating the turret directly with limited power.
rows.description_html: 'Due to climate change, the Earth in 2027 has run out of energy resources. In Korea, batteries charged with a set amount of power are provided to all individuals, companies, and national organizations to guarantee the minimum right to live. War is taking place around the world to scramble for energy resources. We must protect the batteries in the military installations from intruders trying to take them away. You're the commander of a military unit being invaded. Use battery power properly to protect the battery by preventing enemies from attacking 10 times in total.' As you can see in the title, this game is a 2D defense game that was developed for 5 months inspired by Command and Conquer. In-game music, illustration, and scripting(Except for some sound effects) are all being developed by one person. The game that I used to make as a practice gradually developed and participated in the BIGS 2022(Korean indie game show), and as a result, it was released on Steam. The game depicts the future of climate change. The time remaining before the increase in carbon emissions affects humanity has been set as a subtitle of the game, and the game is intended to remind gamers of the dangers. There are still many bugs in the game and there are many shortcomings. We will continue to develop and update continuously even after the release. Please show a lot of interest. Thank you.

rows.name: SIC-1
rows.short_description: SIC-1 is a single-instruction programming game. Neglect your personal life in pursuit of promotions and vague assurances of job security! Optimize your programs to rise to the top of the leaderboards! SIC Systems thanks you for your hard work! Now please return to your desk.
rows.description_html: SIC-1 is a programming game where the computer only understands a single instruction. Learn an esoteric assembly language. Implement programs to unlock more impressive job titles. Optimize your programs to climb the leaderboards. Sacrifice your personal life for the good of the company! It's an assembly language zachlike for everyone! New programmers will appreciate how few unique instructions there are to learn (just one!), and experienced programmers will appreciate how poorly suited this one instruction is for writing straight-forward programs. If you're ready for a challenge, respond to this job posting from SIC Systems: SIC Systems is hiring engineers to produce highly efficient programs for our flagship product: the Single Instruction Computer Mark 1 (SIC-1). The SIC-1 represents a transformational change in computing, reducing complexity to the point that the processor only executes a single instruction: subtract and branch if less than or equal to zero ('subleq'). Enter the brave new world of single-instruction computing and invent new ways of implementing programs that would be trivial on a conventional computer. Don't adjust the technology to match how you think, adjust your thinking to match how the SIC-1 operates!

Features: - Tight platforming controls - Colorful, cute and vibrant aesthetics - Online PvP multiplayer with up to 15 players per race - Procedurally generated obstacle tracks across 8 different themes. - Character customization - Free to play! - Leaderboards to compare your skill! - Compete in ranked races or set up unranked custom races with friends - Single player obstacle tracks Each obstacle track is procedurally made. The head, eyes and legs all have their own color and you can change them however you want. While waiting for new players to join a lobby, you can play through a procedurally generated obstacle course to practice your skills. Choose any cosmetic you want!

rows.name: Space Runaway
rows.short_description: Space Runaway, a compelling intergalactic journey soaked in bullet hell. Enemy vessels, lasers and larger than life bosses coming at you full speed in a 16-bit authentic arcade experience like no other.
rows.description_html: Space Runaway, a compelling intergalactic journey soaked in bullet hell. Enemy vessels, lasers and larger than life bosses coming at you full speed in a 16-bit authentic arcade experience like no other. Not only an integral part of Wanted: Dead, Space Runaway is a standalone game that features 7 unique stages that will test your reflexes. Space Runaway will be available as an arcade mini-game within Wanted: Dead and is now available for free to give a taste of things to come on Valentine’s Day 2023. Key features: 7 challenging levels to test your arcade skills to the limit. 7 epic bosses that each require a unique approach 7 nostalgic chiptunes to create an unforgettable atmosphere. Voyager 1, a space probe launched by NASA on September 5, 1977, as part of the Voyager program to study the outer Solar System and interstellar space beyond the Sun's heliosphere and deliver a message to a possible extraterrestrial life. The Voyager message was carried by a phonograph record, a 12-inch gold-plated copper disk containing sounds and images selected to portray the diversity of life and culture on Earth. Message received. 200 years later. Planet Corot, one of the few habitable worlds discovered in the second age of space exploration, houses a military research facility where a super secret project known as XR-110 is being commissioned. A giant combat mech capable of interstellar travel is the brainchild of Dr. Lincoln Maverick, the last hope for humanity to resist the wrath of The Toliman Empire. A group of spies from Proxima Centauri swiftly discover that XR-110 is extraterrestrial in its design as well. The mech, that soon will set the galaxy on fire, is a long-lost relic from the Toliman’s past. The Empire launches a surprise attack on Planet Corot before Dr. Maverick manages to refurbish the mech. In order to secure the ancient weapon all forces are thrown into battle. Corot is scorched in mere seconds. General Scaph launches the assault and assumes control over the planet. Before the research facility is levelled to the ground and Dr. Maverick and his team fight off the aliens until the last breath, Lt. Brooklyn Landers of The Earth Confederation Defence Force mans the mech and escapes the facility unharmed. Lt. Landers, reckless and diffident, unwillingly shoulders the fate of humanity. General Scaph, now enraged, orders The Toliman Empire forces to pursue and annihilate the Space Runaway.

rows.name: Square Off
rows.short_description: Square Off is a mayhem filled local party arena brawler where you must roll to move, move to aim, and aim to win by battling it out with up to 3 of your friends in short-chaos filled matches.
rows.description_html: Roll to move. Move to aim. Aim to win. You're a square, and it's time to Square Off! Up to 4 friends get to battle it out in this 'edgy' arena party brawler with unique controls. A New Spin On 2D Platforming You move by rolling. You also aim by rolling. You can climb anything. Chaos reigns supreme with this control scheme. We Accept All Types Of Playstyles Want to play skillfully and maneuver like a master? That works. Want to button mash and create mayhem wherever you roll? Yeah, that works too. Orient Yourself To Your Abilities Obliterate your friends with an array of unique abilities that attach themselves to one of your sides. Use these to fight off your friends! If you survive long enough, you'll be able to pick up boosts that jetpack you across the map or shield you from harm. If you keep surviving, acquire an ultimate ability to unleash complete devastation on your friends. Location Location Location A multitude of stages with unique mechanics add to the chaos by providing new possibilities for play, whether you're bouncing sky-high, knocking another player into lava, or throwing yourself through a teleporter. Support For The Underdog Losing? Don't worry! With a variety of underdog powerups, no game will ever be truly lost as you unleash new powers that increase in power the further you are behind. Free Forever Play with your friends for free. This will never change regardless of how much new content goes into the game!

rows.name: Gaze Into Fate
rows.short_description: A meditative and story-driven puzzle game, where you must discover answers to decisions, we all have to make. Can you make a change in a world of endless wars?
rows.description_html: The wilds are scarred by the endless cycle of war. It’s time for a change. In a world that has always been the way it is, Tiiyao, a shaman and tribal leader, searches for knowledge and answers. Communicate with your ancestors and experience an intense story in this approximately 60 minute game experience that will also make you search for answers. Why does the cycle of war never ends? Which is the right path? What is your fate in this world? Do we even have a choice? Immerse yourself in a primeval, shattered world and find your so needed answers. ‚Gaze Into Fate‘ is a meditative and story-driven puzzle game, where you have to find your place in a world of endless wars. Can you make a change? 50+ challenging puzzels, a fully voiced story line and highly polished visuals and sounds are making this game to a special game experience. An exciting story with a serious background Set in a mystical & primal world 50+ challenging but never frustrating puzzles fully voiced characters highly polished, hand drawn visuals coherent soundtracks and sound effects 100% free to play About the developer For us, this is our very first game we ever created as a team. We are so proud of what we accomplished and it’s definitely just the beginning of our journey. Please follow us on social media if you want to be part of our community as a supporter.

rows.name: Soul Guardians
rows.short_description: Soul Guardians is a 2D cross-scroll action RPG game. Hired as a mercenary of the Empire, the protagonist goes on a journey to stop the conspiracy of the Dark Forces Undertaker. Raising unique characters, collecting and combining chain arts to enjoy your own hot action!
rows.description_html: DISCORD About the Game An exciting adventure in the medieval fantasy world Midgard is waiting for brave warriors. Feel the sensation from Action RPG Soul Guardians with your own hands! ■Medieval Style Vintage Sensibility See and feel like traveling back to the Middle Ages with luxurious colors, neat pixel 2D graphics and delicate background music. ■Exciting Gimmick Type Dungeon Break through the dungeon by using prepared traps, winds, buttons, and etc. in the dungeon! Here are various modes like story mode, Escape king, Flee king, and etc. ■Build Your Own Combo Chain Arts Before you get bored from repeated skills, build your own combo Chain Arts. Design your own combo skills based on your job choice. ■Grand Sports Day with Everyone Grand Sports Day comes back every time! There are various events to satisfy your taste, including jumping mode, crystal mode, and racing mode. Stop hunting for a while and enjoy the sports day together! ■Who's good with your hands in Various PVP? Competition among users in death matches, siege matches, and round matches as well as beach valley ball, cake matches, hide and seek. In addition, there are various battles such as dominion battle, regional battle, and guild battle. Enjoy it with your friends!

rows.name: Brichi Quest
rows.short_description: One day, Brichi finds a mysterious sword that suddenly transports him to an unknown land. He needs to search every island and dungeon in search of an opportunity to return home. Many dangers and obstacles await him along the way. Embark on this adventure and see it all for yourself!
rows.description_html: Brichi is our hero! One day he finds a mysterious sword that suddenly transports him to an unknown land. Seven unique islands that need to be connected by bridges. Brichi will have to explore this archipelago, full of mysteries and secrets. He needs to search every island and dungeon in search of an opportunity to return home. Many dangers and obstacles await him along the way. But behind every challenge, a treasure chest awaits him! What can be stored inside each such chest? A powerful artifact? New weapon? Apples? Or a cute girlfriend in a witch hat? Embark on this adventure and see it all for yourself! But be careful, Brichi can’t swim, avoid the water! Good luck!
