rows.name: Legend of Snake
rows.short_description: Another Fire Emblem Clone, this one has a unique spin, overall I consider this an improved version of the previous 2 Legend of games, the game has 3 modes including the classic permanent death mode, it's slightly harder than the previous 2 Legend games I made, hope you enjoy.
rows.description_html: The third game in the Legend series, this game is more complex than Legend of Zero, and a bit more strategic, it has 3 level difficulties and have 6 characters. There are 11 chapters in this game, same as the Legend of Zero. All in all I consider this game to be a improved version of Legend of Zero, and has way more replay value, also included the classic permanent death mode. The game itself it extremely similar to Fire Emblem, you move characters on a grid map and defeat each map to advance to the next map, you can level up the characters and gain new skill and classes. It's an RPG styled game without any story.

rows.name: Deltazone
rows.short_description: DELTAZONE drops players into an unprecedented global conflict that has been going on for a few years. Your mission is to wipe out the opposing team and take back the land that was once yours.
rows.description_html: War didn’t arrive with a speech. It crept in. In DELTAZONE, it’s the background noise of your life—sirens in the distance, power grids flickering, streets emptied in a hurry. The spark? Veilstone. Purple veins running under the earth, torn open by greed. Touch it and it burns the world differently: lights whole cities, or levels them. Everyone wants it. No one agrees on what it should be for. Lines you thought were permanent keep shifting. Allies today, enemies tomorrow. You learn faces first, flags second. You share rations with strangers at noon and trade fire with them by nightfall. Trust becomes a calculation, not a feeling. Your crew has a simple brief that never feels simple: take back home. The places you grew up are checkpointed now, renamed by people who don’t belong there. Every block costs something, ammo, sleep, a friend’s voice you won’t hear again. You keep moving because stopping hurts worse. Veilstone doesn’t just power machines. It leaks into soil and lungs. Gardens turned to glass. Rivers that glow at midnight. Stay too long and people change, skin toughens, eyes shine, tempers break. The map is honest about one thing: everything past the next corner wants you gone. Soldiers. Drones. Things that used to be human. So you plan. You adapt. You live with the plan failing and make another before the smoke clears. Sometimes Veilstone is the edge you need, a battery in a dead city, a shield that holds one second longer than it should. Sometimes it bites back. You decide how close to stand. Welcome to DELTAZONE. No speeches. No guarantees. Just you, your crew, and a war that won’t end by itself. What you take. What you save. What you become. That’s the mark you leave.

rows.name: Enclosure 3-D
rows.short_description: You are Mike Goodman, joining a mission to investigate mysterious activity at an arctic base. Text-parser mystery adventure game inspired by classics of the genre, using pixel art in 3D.
rows.description_html: Story You play as Mike Goodman, a small-time con man who, after yet another night of bad business, gets an offer he just can't refuse. The next day you find yourself joining a party of 10 professionals embarking on a mission to uncover the secrets of an abandoned arctic base. Gameplay Enclosure is a text-parser graphic adventure game inspired by classics of the genre and horror movies of the 80s. You control Mike by moving him around and issuing commands via keyboard. You explore and interact with the environment, talk to your fellow party members and solve adventure game-style puzzles on the way. Enclosure 3-D is a modern remaster of the game Enclosure originally released in 2004. The graphics have been remodeled in 3D while preserving the pixel art look of the game, and a completely new soundtrack has been composed. You can switch between original and remastered graphics by using F2 in the game. Controls move Mike using arrow keys or the numpad (tap to move/stop) type in text commands ('look', 'open door' etc.) Enter to progress dialog Escape to open menu F11 for fullscreen Tips Talk - talk to all characters until you've exhausted their conversations (F3) Observe - ask Mike to look at anything that stands out Explore - walk inside and outside the station to discover all the locations

rows.name: Signal & Echo: Iris is Missing (demo)
rows.short_description: A point-and-click adventure with innovative detective mechanics. Help Ollie, a fledgling reporter on his first day at the Signal & Echo newspaper, to solve the mystery behind a schoolgirl's disappearance. Developed by an ex-journalist.
rows.description_html: Just gimme the gist! Informed by the developer’s past career in journalism, you play as Ollie, a wannabe reporter on his first day of work experience at the Signal & Echo newspaper, in the fictional town of Runeton, England. Ollie thought he’d be chained to his desk all day, rewriting press releases. Instead, he’s been given a real assignment: find out what happened to missing schoolgirl Iris Wood. Using a unique text parser system, alongside traditional point-and-click mechanics, help Ollie impress his colleagues and break the story wide open! What’s this about a ‘unique’ text parser? Alongside the verb interactions and inventory puzzles found in many traditional adventure games, Signal and Echo: Iris is Missing uses an innovative text parser system—for conversations, searching the newspaper’s computer archive, and finding new locations on your map. The system recognises any proper noun (i.e. capitalised noun, like John Smith, London, or The Beatles), so long as you’ve found it in-game. It also accepts the name of any hotspot, from any location, including inventory items. This means you can ask anyone about any of these things. You'll need to take notes out in the real world and really think for yourself! (All the puzzles use real-world logic, as opposed to cartoon or moon logic.)

rows.name: Stagdraft
rows.short_description: STAGDRAFT is a Chaotic 2D multiplayer hack and slasher. Designed for intense PvP action and supports up to 24 players. Pick your role, strategize with your allies and dominate the battleground to capture all the zones and secure the final objectives in a domination warfare!
rows.description_html: DISCORD Jump into Discord with us and become directly involved in our community-focused game development! About the Game STAGDRAFT is a chaotic 2D top-down multiplayer wargame that brings medieval fantasy battles with Hack and Slash PvP action, STAGDRAFT supports up to 24 players and lets you roleplay as one of five ranges of classes: Swordsman, Spearman, Ranger, Magic Staff, and Berserker. The objective is simple yet challenging: capture all the zones along with your allies and secure the final objective to claim your victory in a brutal domination warfare! STAGDRAFT is also accessible for a cross-platform multiplayer, allowing you to combat through PC or mobile device. Get ready to experience the chaotic excitement of medieval combat! Strategize with your allies, and dominate the battleground in this epic fantasy wargame against the enemies. Features: Playable Up to 16 Players: Engage in intense 24-player battles with friends and rivals. Five Unique Classes: Swordsman, Spearman, Ranger, Magic Staff, or Berserker. Diverse Skills: Utilize Shields, Magic Projectiles, and Buffs to enhance your strategy. Frontline Gamemode: Capture and push the zones forward to achieve victory. Cross Platform Multiplayer: Available on PC and mobile devices. Immersive 2D Pixel-Art: Crafted with a nostalgic pixel-art graphics.

rows.description_html: You've been invited to a strange party at Lady Tealwoods' new mansion. The other members of the guestlist are strange and often quarrelsome, and you are all locked in until midnight. A sudden murder is revealed, and you must piece together who is lying, and who is the murderer as you uncover the secrets of the different strange guests of Tealwoods Manor. 13 playable characters with unique dialogue. A murderer randomly selected from the attendee's, unique every game. The murderer will cleverly lie to you, and frantic guests will claim they saw anything, up to you to figure out what the truth is. Up to 20 million unique combinations of dialogue and scenarios built into the game's randomization engine. wager on which guests will survive the night in an attempt to score the most points.

rows.name: Memory Lost: Chapter One
rows.short_description: First chapter of Memory Lost. It is a story-driven action shooter, the battles in which are built around the mechanics of mind capturing and moving into the enemy's body. First-aid kits were not delivered, there is only one magazine in the weapon - change the bodies to survive!
rows.description_html: About the Game Memory Lost is a story driven action shooter, the battles in which are built around the mechanics of mind capturing and moving into the enemy's body. First-aid kits were not delivered, there is only one magazine in the weapon - change the bodies to survive! New body - new gameplay. There are dozens of archetypes of opponents in the game, each with its own unique characteristics and skills that affect the outcome of the battle. Relocation is the basis of survival If you don't want to run around in a half - dead state, look for a healthy body! Are the weapons out of ammo? Move into the enemy with full ammunition! Copy enemies' memories! Capturing consciousness is impossible without capturing memories. With each new migration, the Neural Network, the main character of Memory Lost, will collect more and more material to develop its own independent personality, after which it will process the knowledge gained and reap the fruits of his actions at the Mind-Map hub location. Karma in a top-down shooter? The neural network is also shaped by your interaction with the surrounding world. Kill for the common good or for mercy, regardless of the consequences - and get one of three possible endings. Warning: A very small percentage of people may experience seizures while viewing certain images, such as flashing lights or patterns that may be present in video games.

rows.name: Chris Isn't Alone
rows.short_description: Can you convince a demon from another realm to spare your life? Chris Isn't Alone is a visual novel horror/comedy game that gives players freedom to choose their own path towards their fate. This is a student project!
rows.description_html: THE PREMISE Chris Isn't Alone is a horror/comedy game where your choices actually have an effect on the outcome of the story. You play as Chris, a 12 year old boy that has just come to the realization that the monster in his closet was real. The monster informs you that they are there to kill you. You must convince it otherwise. CHOOSE YOUR OWN PATH You will be presented with many different choices that WILL have an effect on the outcome of the story. A story path that you may have gone down previously could end up changing depending on what items Chris has... ENDINGS There are a total of 17 unique endings! Can you find the TRUE ending? There is a reward for unlocking all the endings... HOW TO PLAY When you see text on the screen, you can Left Click to advance through the dialogue. Players can use a mouse or trackpad. PLEASE ENJOY! Keep in mind that this is a student project! Feedback would be amazing!

rows.name: My Loving Wife
rows.short_description: Come home to see your wife who loves you a lot every day.
rows.description_html: This is the story of you and your wife. Since it's your story, you get to decide the protagonist's gender! Every day, you come home from work to spend time with your wife who loves you more than anything and you feel the same, hoping the time that you both spend together will last forever. Things aren't always perfect though. Both of you are going to make mistakes, but that's not gonna stop the two of you from loving each other, right? How you will spend time with your wife is up to you. Of course, you can always be a good spouse and treat her right, but if you make certain decisions, she definitely won't be happy. There are at least a few ways things can turn out depending on your actions, whether they're good or bad. Things are gonna get tough, but that's not gonna separate the two of you. Besides, it's not like either of you is hiding anything from the other... right? Spend time reading this story, make decisions and see how your wife ends up because of them. Features: - Nameable Protagonist - Nameable Wife - 3 Gender Choices - Multiple Endings

rows.name: Wobble Warriors
rows.short_description: Wobble Warriors is a 1-4 player ragdoll fighting couch co-op game. In this dungeon crawler, you and your friends play as some wobbly dragons on a mission to conquer the goblins who stole your gold. Jump, dash, ground pound, and bonk your way to victory by clearing each room.
rows.description_html: Wobble Warriors is a 1-4 player ragdoll fighting couch co-op game. In this dungeon crawler, you and your friends play as some wobbly dragons on a mission to conquer the goblins who stole your gold. Jump, dash, ground pound, and bonk your way to victory by clearing each room. The king of the goblins is not only hoarding away the dragon's gold, but has locked himself in the throne room. Find the golden key, defeat the king, and celebrate your victory! Traversing the slime-covered goblin's dungeon is scary by yourself, so bring some friends along and reap the benefits of having additional help. Allied dragons can ground pound near knocked out dragons to revive them back to full health while pushing away the goblins at the same time. Even if an allied dragon cannot come to revive their friend, health slowly replenishes as long as all dragons are not knocked out. When all dragons are knocked out, a life is lost and all players get teleported to the previous room. When all lives are gone, it's game over. Whether you want to play with others or play by yourself to strengthen your skills, Wobble Warriors was made in mind to be played by all skill levels. Will you rejoice in victory or will you get knocked down to try again?

rows.name: Post-Apo Builder: Prologue
rows.short_description: Discover a post-apocalyptic world Collect resources and manage people Build your colony on the remains of an oil tanker Prepare supplies and vehicles for a dangerous expedition. Complete challenging tasks from the council of elders
rows.description_html: It's time to learn about the dangers of the wasteland. You've trained all your life to be one of the captains. The council of elders has given you your first serious assignment. You must lead your people through the wastelands. For the first time, you get access to 3rd level of technology. Which gives you access to vehicles, allows you to explore further terrain. You need to prepare the necessary equipment and resoruces. The wasteland awaits. Restore civilization on the ashes of the fallen world! Scavenge and gather for resources, everything counts! Build and manage city of survivors after a apocalypse. Take care of every aspect of life. Gather, build, farm, upgrade, win ! Explore wastelands to gather resources, protect and take care of your people! Fight off raiders, wild tribesman and natural disasters.

rows.name: Under Observation
rows.short_description: You are a researcher working at a Bioweapons R&D company, focusing on national security. The weapons being developed here are usually horrifying beasts that possess many different perks. In your case, one of them has escaped and it's up to you to continue your research or escape the facility.
rows.description_html: Under Observation is a first-person, single-player horror game developed by a group of students from Kajaani University of Applied Sciences. In-game you are a researcher working at a Bioweapons R&D company, focusing on national security. You've been given a subject which you need to study and fill out a report on. Now the subject has escaped its containment and the facility is on lockdown. The only way out is to open the main blast door with a staff keycard but unluckily you lost yours and need to find it. The rogue subject is a dangerous entity so you need to dance a fine line between avoiding it and following its every action to gather intel. Research focuses on the behavioral patterns of the subject. The aim is to figure out the subject's perks and abilities such as sight, hearing, and diet. As you gather intel the subject's main type becomes more evident. There is a total of 20 different subject types. When you are confident about the subject's type, the research is completed. Some perks are more subtle such as genetype, which gives out no visual clues. Instead, you need to take a sample off the subject and run that through various experiments. Some terrifying variations of the subject are also able to turn completely invisible. You have many gadgets at your disposal that are used in the experiments. These include things such as flashlights, dart guns, tablets, and photo cameras. Guard post has a CCTV monitoring station which you can use to locate the subject. Between the main corridors of the facility runs ventilation ducts that are accessible and great for hiding. ______________________________________________________________________________ 'A week ago they brought yet another subject to be analyzed. I believe this one was grown at ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ . The report we got from them suggests that subject's 4th development stage had an evolution score of 4.6. This means that the behavioral patterns need to be mapped thoroughly before commercial deployment can even be considered. It may never fit that mold, but that big of an evolutionary jump must be investigated. The subject is now located at ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ , where it is to undergo ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ . All required documentation on the said operation can be obtained through intel management. As the facility's security system was newly upgraded, the procedures/experiments with an SR of 3 or lower can be conducted by just 1 person on-site Operational Management, ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ Soteria Security Solutions Great is the Enemy of Perfect'

rows.name: Wings of The Universe
rows.short_description: Wings of The Universe (WoTU) is a free-to-play 2D indie space action MMORPG top-down game developed by a single programmer. WoTU is designed to be co-op heavy, but even a lone wolf can survive with his skills and have fun.
rows.description_html: Wings of The Universe is an indie game inspired by game titles 'Space Rangers 2: Reboot' (PC game), 'Avorion' (PC game) and 'Interstellar Pilot' (mobile game). Wings of The Universe is a game full of battles, diplomacies and trades. You can be a miner, merchant, warrior, diplomat or a strategist. You can build an empire with your friends and fight your foes, or become a pirate to promote chaos within other empires. There is only one galaxy, so make sure your name goes down in its history! Important In order to play, you have to register via game client or the game website. The game server is located in Europe, Germany. Players outside of Europe might face high internet latency issues. Key Features: single global map (the whole galaxy divided to 25 sectors and each sector is divided to 25 systems) purely player based economy (there are no NPC shops, everything is made and sold by players) galaxy domination, fights for resources strategy and tactics - your type of equipment and chosen ship make the difference bonuses for playing with other players in a long-term faction and a short-term squadron chained missions and repeatable missions non-pvp zone on starting map Purely player-based economy The space is empty. It is up to the players to create factions and build the space stations they need. Each station have different items it can interact with. This makes each station type have their own list of shop items and their own factory lines, which can consume the input items (mostly commodities) to create the output items (other commodities, ships or pieces of equipment). Players then set-up the shop prices, which can exclude some items from being bought or sold by the station or the player. Strategy Your equipment and skills matter! There are limitations on the ship equipment, but there are many types of equipment to choose from. Should you use projectile or energy weapons? Should your protection be against projectile or energy weapons? Should you take smaller or a bigger ship? Every target is different and one equipment strategy might not work all the time. Knowledge and reconnaissance is a key to survive. It also makes a difference if your strategy involves other players who can help achieve your goals. Tactics 'I go first and you follow' can sometimes be followed by 'Are you sure about that?' and Wings of The Universe is no exception. Especially when it comes to wars between players. Be prepared to be ambushed at all times. The space is vast and an enemy can come from any direction! Take a friend with you who will cover you or act as a bait for your own forces to counter an ambush. Prepare a carrier ship full of players to be safely transported to the war zone and be ready to be launched straight into battle.

rows.name: Fishing Online
rows.short_description: Begin your new online fishing adventure! Fishing Online is a cooperative adventure game where you explore the world and enjoy fishing with friends. Catch over 300 types of fish, complete your collection, and dive into crafting and cooking activities!
rows.description_html: Fishing Online lets you explore the joy of fishing in beautiful natural settings—online. Join friends or global players and experience a relaxing fishing life together. ■ The Fun of Fishing Your fishing journey begins! When you hook a fish, the real challenge begins as you battle to reel it in. Simple controls meet unique fish behavior patterns that deliver that satisfying fishing thrill. ■ Stylized Cartoon Graphics Experience nature brought to life through warm, cartoon-style visuals. Rivers, lakes, and a wide range of unique fish await you. ■ Cooking & Gathering Raise your catches or turn them into tasty meals. Collect ingredients from the wild to cook dishes that provide helpful fishing buffs. You can also craft your own tools. ■ Online Play Connect with friends or players worldwide. Explore maps inspired by locations around the globe and enjoy the game together. ■ Frequent Updates We're a small indie development team, but we're committed to listening to player feedback and providing regular updates. Fish Encyclopedia: View your catches, records, and rankings. Personal Pond: Raise various fish and decorative species. Fishing Tournaments: Compete globally and earn rewards based on rank. Fishing Area Expansion: Plans to expand from freshwater to ocean fishing. Co-op Play: Raid content to catch special fish with friends is in development.

rows.name: Don't Hide
rows.short_description: Trapped in a maze with a beast, you must find five keys and their door to escape. The monster can only smell and hear you, but as long as it hasn't fully caught your scent, you can move freely.
rows.description_html: Trapped in a maze with a beast, you must find five keys and their door to escape. The monster can only smell and hear you, but as long as it hasn't fully caught your scent, you can move freely. Don't Hide offers a horror experience where you're forced to manage the monster and explore the surroundings. Nothing is easy to find, as you'll always be surrounded by dreadful darkness. You'll be left searching for five barely illuminated keys, all scattered around the maze. However, your time is limited, as the creature trapped in the maze with you will will eventually catch your scent. Be sure to run away when close, and if it hasn't fully caught your scent, hide to get it off your tracks. Don't Hide offers 6 different levels, all with varying difficulty and predetermined initial key, object, and exit door locations. A 3 star system will help rank your performance in each room. At least one star is required to progress to the next room. Developed in Godot, this game was a side project of mine that I learned along with Godot. Updates may proceed the release with more levels, objects, or features. Its more than likely that I will release balance changes as well as more and more people play the game and test out the ranking system as well as the minor and major time (scent) limits. Controls: WASD = movement Space = hide Escape = open/close menu (pauses game), or go back to previous menu Enter/Left Click = Select Objectives Find all five keys With 5 Keys, find the exit door Don't get caught by the creature Credits Sole developed: T0rt1z (Shawn F.)

Don't Hide offers a horror experience where you're forced to manage the monster and explore the surroundings. Nothing is easy to find, as you'll always be surrounded by dreadful darkness. You'll be left searching for five barely illuminated keys, all scattered around the maze. However, your time is limited, as the creature trapped in the maze with you will will eventually catch your scent. Be sure to run away when close, and if it hasn't fully caught your scent, hide to get it off your tracks. Don't Hide offers 6 different levels, all with varying difficulty and predetermined initial key, object, and exit door locations. A 3 star system will help rank your performance in each room. At least one star is required to progress to the next room. Developed in Godot, this game was a side project of mine that I learned along with Godot. Updates may proceed the release with more levels, objects, or features. Its more than likely that I will release balance changes as well as more and more people play the game and test out the ranking system as well as the minor and major time (scent) limits. Controls: WASD = movement Space = hide Escape = open/close menu (pauses game), or go back to previous menu Enter/Left Click = Select Objectives Find all five keys With 5 Keys, find the exit door Don't get caught by the creature Credits Sole developed: T0rt1z (Shawn F.)

rows.name: Touhou: Fading Illusion
rows.short_description: A visual novel based on Touhou Project, made by fans for fans and others! Embark on the investigation of the greatest incident in Gensokyo's history and discover the terrifying truth of the youkai world with Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi and other heroines!
rows.description_html: Touhou: Fading Illusion is a visual novel set in Touhou Project universe that comprehensively describes Gensokyo and its inhabitants. Get ready to meet many of the series' iconic characters and travel to various locations in the Underworld, Gensokyo, Heaven, and even Outside World! Synopsis: Throughout the ages, excessive curiosity has had a cruel cost. Once, the urge for the unknown made humans superior to animals, but the fear caused by this urge gave birth to the youkai, creatures that rose above mankind itself. Although both species have managed to find a way to coexist peacefully, even today modesty is still not in high favour. While technology is advancing at a rapid pace in the Outside World, the Gensokyo sages are falling deeper and deeper into the illusion of their own power, not realising that there may be something very different, deep, and extremely dense that even they should not touch. With each passing day, the prospect of its coming to light is gradually becoming a question of time. Reimu is enjoying a warm spring day at her shrine, but her rest is interrupted by Yukari, who, in her manner, shows up unexpectedly and gives the shrine maiden an urgent task: Yukari wants Reimu to follow Sumireko at the festival at the Myouren Temple. The matter concerns the Hakurei Barrier, so Reimu has no choice but to go to the base of her rivals and hope that in the evening, Yukari deigns to explain everything that is happening. Game Features: Suitable for people unfamiliar with Touhou Project! A brief introduction to the universe in the free Prologue and an extensive in-game dictionary will keep newcomers from getting lost. Non-linear plot! You have access to many choices that can dramatically change the plot. Currently, you can play Prologue, the first three days of the Destitute Chapter and the first day of the Underworld Chapter. That's about 10-15 hours of reading. Journey through the vast world of Touhou Project! Visit the Former Hell, Netherworld, various parts of Gensokyo and even beyond! Over 50 characters from Touhou Project series! You will definitely find someone you'll like.

rows.name: Angels of Amsterdam
rows.short_description: Angels of Amsterdam; a truthful recreation of a 17th century Amsterdam-café, where you share key episodes in the lives of Maritgen Jans, Juliana, Elsje Christiaens and Pussy Sweet: four fierce angels who were not getting their fair share of the Golden Age’s gold and took destiny in their own hands.
rows.description_html: “Angels of Amsterdam” is a VR-experience which brings you to a truthful recreation of a 17th century café in Amsterdam. Here, you share key episodes in the lives of Maritgen Jans, Juliana, Elsje Christiaens and Pussy Sweet: four fierce angels who were not getting their fair share of the Golden Age’s gold and took their destiny in their own hands. The characters respond to eye-contact, and share their tales in the form of song, dance or musical performance. These stories show the dark side of the wealth and liberty which is generally associated with the port- and trading city of Amsterdam. The power relations between rich and poor, as well as between men and women in that young capitalist society also concerns us. Details from these stories now may seem odd, but the essence effortlessly transcends time frames. These stories have brought us to where we are now. Angels of Amsterdam is a critically acclaimed Immersive experience (VR), which had its world premiere at the 78th Venice Biennale. It is the first Dutch VR-work ever to be selected for the official competition. The work has received praise for bringing together historical storytelling and groundbreaking VR-innovation in an unprecedented way. The work was created by Avinash Changa, VR maker and director of WeMakeVR, and Anna Abrahams, filmmaker and VR programmer for EYE Film Museum in Amsterdam.

rows.reviews_html: “one of the most stunningly realistic historical recreation stories in VR to date” Scatter “You can almost smell the ripe plums that are laid out on the 17th-century bar, almost feel the sea breeze brushing through your hair. The virtual reality experience Angels of Amsterdam is so lifelike, that all your senses are involved.” Dutch Culture

rows.name: 2tinycowboys
rows.short_description: 2tinycowboys is an action-packed western-themed arcade multi-scrolling platformer in 2D, with huge variety, in which you take the role of one of 9 different cowboys, each with his/her own play-style. It has up to 4 players split-screen multiplayer available and quirky game-play and characters.
rows.description_html: Jump, run, shoot and dodge your way through huge multi-directional levels, while avoiding a wide variety of enemies. Take advantage of the vultures and fly to the top, all the while searching for the gold-bars, required to win. Utilize power-ups and the strengths of your chosen character to search every nook and cranny Enter almost any building and make sure to visit the barbershop and try out any of the eight different hairstyles available for each character, in this retro-flavored platformer for 1-4 players. The Protagonists: Clint : Does not get bitten by snakes. Esmaralda : Does not get bitten by spiders. Felipe : Has a short-sword, rather than a knife (Longer stab-range). /not able to change appearance at Barbershop Ma’ Belle : Able to take two arrows, before dying. Mercedes : Gets 2 jump-boots, rather than one, on pickup. Rose : Jumps higher than everyone else. Santiago : Fires faster than the others. Zeke : Has penetrating bullets that will go straight through his foes. Zorra : Double jump and faster than the rest. /not able to change appearance at Barbershop Ndyan (playable character): More info coming soon. The Enemies: Ndyan – Bow : If quick enough, you can shoot his arrows. Ndyan – Spear : This guy takes 2 bullets before going down. Long reach in melee, but no ranged weapons. Ndyan – Tomahawk : Keep track of his bounce and beware, it will take you 4 bullets to kill him. Sherif & Sherif Twin : Fast draw, quick-shooter. Careful with shooting their bullets. The sherif and his Twin will take 3 shots each to kill. Killing one will resurrect the other. Robot : Made of indestructible material and fires lasers. Bullets will ricochet right off of these guys; Your best bet is to jump over him. Zombies : These undead cowboys can take 5 bullets before going down, becoming slower by each hit. Stabbing will instantly kill them, however. Snakes : Sometimes easy to spot, sometimes hidden in the undergrowth. Their venomous bite will poison the player, giving them one minute to find a anti-venom. Spiders & Bats : These will stun the player for a few seconds. If however the player has been bitten by a snake previous, then they will be instantly killed. Ooze : This will make you unable to stop jumping for 30 seconds. Tentacle : These will slow you down, while decreasing your jump for 30 seconds. Boulders : On certain levels there are boulders coming down from the mountains above. You shoot these to slow them down and eventually destroy them, or try to jump them, else instant death. Vultures : These will carry off with you, enemies as well as goldbars. The Cavalry: Ollie : A bit slow, but fires scattering bullets. Otis : Slow reload, but far reaching bullets. Curtis : Fires his pistol at a rapid rate. Sarge : Boosts morale of the others. (Hard) Pete the Trumpeter : As long as Pete is alive, whenever there are less than 50% of Cavalry remaining, they will respawn. (Hard) The Guns : Pistol : Medium range, medium speed, fist-sized bullets. Ammo capacity = 6 Shotgun : Short range, slow speed, fires in five different angles in front of the shooter, thus making it ideal for taking down enemies on ledges in front of you. Fires pellets, rather than bullets. Able to destroy rolling boulders. Ammo capacity = 5 Rifle : Long range, fast speed, fires a half fist-sized bullet, penetrating any and all enemies (except for Zombies, which are spongy by nature), killing them instantly. Also able to shoot destroy rolling boulders. Ammo capacity = 3 The Loot: Goldbars : These are what you want. Grab enough to win. Hats : Extra lives. Boots : Double-jump. Anti-venom : Negates snake-bite. Ammo : More ammunition for your gun. The different difficulty levels alter the game in the following ways: Easy : No boulders, robots, sherifs, tentacles or zombies. Vultures don’t pick up Tomahawk Ndyan, Goldbars or Snakes & Spiders. 7 Goldbars required to win. Medium : No robots, no tentacles or boulders. Vultures don’t pick up Tomahawk Ndyan or Snakes. 10 Goldbars required to win. Hard : Your default game-mode, 2tinycowboys as it was intended. Challenging, but fun; Especially in multiplayer. But do feel free to pick any level of challenge to get acquainted with the game, before advancing to this. 2tinycowboys is about having fun, for everyone. 12 Goldbars required to win. Gamepad Controls are : D-Pad Right = move right D-Pad Left = move left D-Pad Up = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave/Interact with NPCs D-Pad Down = climb down (ladders/vines) A = jump B = stab X = shoot Y = special Keyboard Controls are: Player 1: Left Arrowkey = move left Right Arrowkey = move right Up Arrowkey = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave Down Arrowkey = climb down (ladders/vines) SPACE = jump M = stab CTRL = shoot N = special Player 2: D = move right A = move left W = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave S = climb down (ladders/vines) V = jump Z = stab C = shoot X = special Player 3: L = move right J = move left I = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave K = climb down (ladders/vines) O = jump ENTER = stab P = shoot Backspace = special Player 4: Numpad 6 = move right Numpad 4 = move left Numpad 8 = climb up (ladders/vines) and enter cave Numpad 2 = climb down (ladders/vines) Numpad + = jump Numpad 5 = stab Numpad - = shoot Numpad * = special

rows.name: Stillwater
rows.short_description: A short visual novel where a private investigator gets reeled into a murky mystery, entangled in lies, secrets, and a family curse.
rows.description_html: '𝕊𝕖𝕖𝕚𝕟𝕘 𝕤𝕥𝕣𝕒𝕟𝕘𝕖 𝕥𝕙𝕚𝕟𝕘𝕤 𝕔𝕠𝕞𝕖 𝕒𝕥 𝕒 𝕡𝕣𝕚𝕔𝕖…' A woman arrives with a mysterious letter in hand addressed to her grandfather. Etched in crimson is a foreboding message, a warning—a promise made from a time forgotten. Private Investigator Hugo Laurent and his assistants must solve this bizarre case before an old family's curse befalls them all. Story, Original Concept | anri Sprite, CG, UI | ota BG, CG | sasa Code, BG | z04 13,004 words + ~1hr playtime 4 endings + 1 ending epilogue Point & click exploration Updated animations, story, gallery, and author notes! Pet Colby! Warnings: shaking screen, abrupt sounds, minor jump scares, mentions of suicide { 𝙰𝚍𝚍𝚒𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗𝚊𝚕 𝙰𝚜𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚜 } Music | Presence of Music , H/MIX GALLERY SFX | Zapsplat Original GameJam Beta Testers | Heiden, sky, Zach Reyes, KyewT_T, auin Stillwater Remastered Beta Testers | Wing, Medrelo7, HardBoiledEgg98, KyewT_T, Sky 1. Will This Be Released On Steam & Itchio? Yes. 2. Will this be released for Windows, Mac, Linux, and Android? Yes. 3. What will happen to the old game jam build? (steam specific question) The game jam build will be obselete. Steam and Itch.io will be updated to Stillwater Remastered. While we are honored you enjoyed the original game jam version, we believe Stillwater Remastered is the polished vision of the work we couldn’t finish during the game jam. We hope you enjoy it! 4. Can I load up old saves from the game jam version of Stillwater? No, Stillwater Remastered can not load up previous saves from the game jam version. 5. Will there be a Stillwater sequel? It is a future project we would like to make, but realistically, we would need time and funds to tackle this endeavor. Hopefully soon.

rows.name: Picma - Picture Enigmas
rows.short_description: Picma is a cozy collection of puzzle games where you use your logic skills to reveal hidden pictures. It features more than 100,000 puzzles, created and curated since 2009 by our lovely puzzler community.
rows.description_html: Use your logic skills to uncover hidden pictures. With a library of over 100,000 community-created puzzles , distributed across multiple puzzle types , you are unlikely to run out of challenges. So, have a seat at the Moonberry Café, let Charlotte bring you a cup of your favorite drink, and relax as you sip and solve through Picma - Picture Enigmas. Main Features Much more than Nonograms - Find your favorite picture logic game from our selection of three puzzle types (more coming soon). True logic puzzles - All of our puzzles are machine-verified to have a single logical solution. Massive puzzles - Our puzzles range from the tiny 5x5 all the way to the gigantic 50x50. True multi-color puzzles - What you solve is what you get, with up to 8 colors per puzzle. Play for free daily - Create and rate images to earn Coins and play at no cost. Picma Plus (1/3) Use the numbers around the grid to discover a hidden picture! Picma Squared (2/3) Paint around each number to form a picture! Picma Links (3/3) Create paths between matching numbers to reveal a picture!

rows.name: ParkTo
rows.short_description: ParkTo is a simple puzzle game that stops the car at its destination. You don't drive a car yourself. The car just moves forward. Use the given triggers to move the car to its destination.
rows.description_html: ParkTo is a simple puzzle game that stops the car at its destination. You don't drive a car yourself. The car just moves forward'. Use the given triggers to move the car to its destination: LEFT, RIGHT, STOP, BACKWARD, etc. Triggers can be placed on the path of the car or used on the car itself. FEATURES 48 handcrafted levels. Various trigger interactions reflecting car movements. Comfortable colors and minimal graphics. You can play without a driving license!

rows.name: ENA: Dream BBQ
rows.short_description: Experience surreal environments and inexplicable characters as ENA in a new wild world.
rows.description_html: Supporter Edition The Supporter Edition of ENA: Dream BBQ includes bonus behind-the-scenes content on how the game was made! As well as additional goodies such as: Hidden Hourglass Dog Collectables Animatics and Concept Art Pre-Production Animations In-Development Screenshots Developer Commentary Downloadable Gifs and Wallpapers About the Game 'ENA! We've got work to do, so quit daydreaming and pay attention! And don't you DARE get involved in any predicaments along the way... got it?!!' The first interactive adventure of the ENA series by Joel G. Play as ENA as she searches for the Boss that everyone wants to be. Explore strange worlds, take on side gigs, and meet both sweet and sour characters along the journey. There is a lot to encounter on your adventures: Explore new environments filled with hidden secrets and oddities. Meet different characters who only want you to do things for them. Use strange Tools to solve unusual problems. Live the experience of being the least popular person at any party. Experience Chapter 1 'Lonely Door' now! Subsequent chapters are in development and will be available as a paid release. Disclaimers: This game contains sections with flashing lights and images that may induce seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. This game contains visuals and language that some individuals may find disturbing. Viewer discretion is advised.

rows.name: Shape Of The Toilet Rim
rows.short_description: A single player arcade-like game where you crush Toilet Cars driven by small suns. See how high of a score you can get!
rows.description_html: In this game, using the WASD keys, you can control a cube and make it slide around in all directions. You can press the spacebar to jump. The gameplay in this game features the riveting experience of jumping on top of moving toilet car enemies over and over again until you inevitably get hit by one of the enemies and die. You can then retry and try to beat your high score. A single cube fights for his life. He is stuck in an endless looping purgatory, fighting every second of every day in vain to attempt to vanquish the Shape Of The Toilet Rim. How far can you get him before your will, too, gives out? This game features: - Decently Responsive Controls - Easy to learn mechanics such as jumping on toilet cars to make them explode. - Decent Graphics - Questionable Music and SFX - A relatively easy to understand menu and UI - The game is endless! You can keep retrying to raise your score! - A story (sort of) that is completely disregardable and is not directly mentioned in the game itself - Challenge yourself to get a score above 100! - Don't worry, if you die you can always press enter to block AleeXhey and try again! Not only is this game a work in progress, but it was also mostly made as a joke and isn't meant to be taken too seriously. Thanks for playing though!

rows.name: Operation Satoshi [Early Version Alpha]
rows.short_description: This is a game in development. It has been published just to get feedback from community. We are aware there will be defects and will do weekly updates. Feedback can be sent to contact@metaxseed.io. A shooting RPG game to rescue a kidnapped scientist, Nakamoto Satoshi.
rows.description_html: This is a game in development. It has been published just to get feedback from community. We are fully aware there will be defects. You can give feedback to: contact@metaxseed.io Featuring characters from Paragon (Epic Games), a single player free to play demo FPS in a sci-fi and set in an alternate universe. The objective is to rescue the famous Satoshi Nakamoto who had been mysteriously kidnapped many moons ago. You are part of a elite unit that is tasked with a search and rescue mission. Travel across multiple regions to find clues and collect rewards along the way. Use these rewards to update your weapons, ammunitions and characters skill set. Fun and addictive sure to keep you playing for hours. First version of this free game with start with a couple of levels and the developers will keep updating based on community feedback. There are two in game tokens called MXS and SAT that is used to accumulate points to purchase bullets and lives in the marketplace.

rows.name: Connected through fate
rows.short_description: Romatic and dramatic Otome Game
rows.description_html: This is a part-time hobby project, which is why the game is available for free. Patch 1.1.0 has been released! We have managed to publish our game in English via machine translation ! Bugs in Seiichi's route have also been fixed. Connected through fate tells the story of our heroine, who is about to move with her mother to a new city. At her new school, she gets acquainted with the three strange Ichigawa brothers. The three brothers could not be more different, and so their first day is already extremely turbulent. But it's not just these strange encounters that will soon turn her entire life upside down! Your decisions influence the course of the story. Who will be by your side until the end? Choose your destiny now! With Connected through Fate we want to tell a deep, exciting but dramatic story. Through the four main characters and a total of 8 different endings, the player will be able to explore the characters and take his fate into his own hands. A romantic and dramatic otome game or let's just say a dromatic game ;D

rows.name: 500 Second Challenge
rows.short_description: As the ladder gets faster and narrower, can you increase your living space through the upgrade system? Last for 500 seconds, and your gameplay will be different from everyone else's depending on how your skills level up.
rows.description_html: The five hundred second challenge: In this game you will control a character in order not to let him have zero health, or fall to his death. Jumping is possible at the beginning of the easy version, but not the normal version. During the game, you can increase the experience value by stepping on the ladder or eating stars. Leveling up with experience points will give you three random skills, but you can only choose one. Each skill contributes to the development of the game as the ladder gets faster and narrower. You can use the z.x.c keys on the keyboard to quickly select skills, The simple version increases the luck value, the number of consecutive jumps, the maximum life, the life-saving floor seconds, but the score is reduced. feature: - Faster and faster game speed - Fun and light music - Use of random skills - Get high scores for your skills

rows.name: Soul Searching
rows.short_description: In this puzzle stealth game, your soul has been captured by an evil necromancer determined to take over the lands! Can you escape his perilous dungeon home to warn the kingdom before the undead rise and take over the throne?
rows.description_html: Your soul has been captured by an evil necromancer determined to take over the lands! Can you escape his perilous dungeon home to warn the kingdom before the undead rise again? Solve various puzzles through each floor of the necromancer's dungeon to ascend through the necromancer's home back to the surface. But you are not alone in the dungeon's chambers, as his undead minions and fellow lost souls also occupy the many floors. Sneak past his servants and rescue your fellow spirit to save the kingdom before it's too late!

rows.name: Ami's Room
rows.short_description: An exploration game set in a surreal dreamscape full of projections. Piece together past recollections and elusive memories. Make a choice as the reality and dreamed world begins to blur...
rows.description_html: A boy named Pierre refuses to leave his room. He sleeps to access dreams where his sister, Ami, escaped to after a traumatic event. Pierre believes that if he locates Ami by a slim chance, he’ll be able to convince her to wake up with him. ♢♢♢♢♢ An exploration game set in a surreal dreamscape full of projections. Piece together past recollections and elusive memories to find the story. Make a choice as the line between the real and the dreamed world begins to blur. The key lies in your hands… but would you choose to wake up? Features Go to sleep to start the game. Transverse between different dreams. Solve puzzles to obtain answers. Talk to those inhabiting the dreamworld. Avoid monsters who try to keep you asleep. When the time comes, remember. ...or forget? Controls Arrow keys — Movement Enter or Space bar — Interact Save — Interact with Save points Shift or F5 — Return to Title screen F4 — Toggle Fullscreen/Window modes F3 — Change display size This game contains depictions and/or descriptions of depression and anxiety. It may not be suitable for all audiences and viewer discretion is advised.

rows.name: Cycle of The Moon
rows.short_description: Soule-Like, Roguelike where you fight your way through a map, collecting souls to beat the boss
rows.description_html: In Cycle of The Moon, you fight your way through a map, trying to get to the boss and defeat him. However, you have to be careful, for the thirst of a vampire is constant. Features : Thirst During the game your character has a constant Health Loss effect, refill your health by killing any Npc. Souls Any Npc that can die has a chance of dropping their Soul. These effects can range from Increasing your max HP, Stamina, Decreasing the amount of hp you lose over time from thirst, or even a new Attack! New attacks Unlock new attacks by either the enemy dropping a soul that unlocks a triple attack, which is a triple swing that needs to be timed. Or by finding the other one out in the world! Humans There's a village with humans, which heal you for more than normal enemies would, however killing them also has a chance of spawning soldiers that will hunt you down The boss The goal. Reach the boss at the end, gather enough souls to become powerful enough, and beat the Harbinger of the Moon! This Project was made by 3 students in about 45 days To use a controller you might have to enable the support for your controller in the steam setting under controller tab, and then go under the general controller setting and enable the support for your specific controller. If that doesn't work we recommend DS4Windows

rows.name: Super Ball Arena
rows.short_description: Multiplayer ‘couch game’ that can be played up to 4 players. The primary purpose is to defeat others by hitting a ball so that it collides with the target, inflicting damage in the process.
rows.description_html: Multiplayer ‘couch game’ that can be played up to 4 players, gamepads are required to play locally. The primary purpose is to defeat others by hitting a ball so that it collides with the target, inflicting damage in the process. Each player has the ability to attack, dash and block, some actions require energy to be used. The attack can be held to increase its power, but there is also the possibility of using energy tokens to reach the full charge instantly. When played with the joystick, the left stick is used for movement and the right stick is used for aiming. There are also several special interactions to spice things up. For example, blocking a ball only reduces the damage, but doing it with a perfect timing will catch the ball and restore the energy token to the receiver. This project is still early in development and I am currently working on: -Online multiplayer (Photon PUN) -Several power-ups that players can use. -New game modes

rows.name: Jam Above Jam Below
rows.short_description: Witz and Doobz on their adventure to make a video game through seven different mini-games and funny cartoon cutscenes!
rows.description_html: Join Witz and Doobz on their adventure to make a video game in just a week! With seven different mini-games, you'll have plenty of fun as you try to win the game jam and save the day! You'll jump, run, bike, puzzle, and even date your way to success, as fully-voiced cartoon cutscenes bring the fast-paced story to life. Primarily an action platformer with some puzzle, rhythm, and dating sim elements, the total expected playtime is about 20 to 30 minutes. This game is made for all ages! Truly a jam within a jam, this game was made in a week by me, Kimberly Blais of Mama Makes Games, for the 2022 Epic MegaJam using Unreal Engine 5. Following the theme of 'As Above, So Below,' this recursive game about making a game playfully explores the joys and challenges of doing a game jam.

rows.name: Touhou - Reimus Awesome Holiday
rows.short_description: Its Reimus Day off. But her day is ruined by an unknown force in Gensokyo! Play as Reimu to find out what this mysterious group is about and uncover their secret!
rows.description_html: Gameplay: Reimus Awesome Holiday is a turn based RPG Game that will provide the Player with numerous decisions, in which the fate of multiple individuals is at stake in one way or another... or those decisions could lead you to find something strange and otherworldly, who knows? In other words, your choices matter! Of course the standard RPG experience of finding Items in the Overworld, battling Enemies and numerous Sidequests is also included. Features: The Game has an ATB (Action Time Battle) mechanic, where in a meter fills up over time for each participant in a Battle and you are able to control the flow of that Battle with various actions inside the Game, such as increasing the speed in which the meter fills by pressing down the Shift key on your Keyboard. Another Key action is the Guard mechanic. The Guard mechanic allows for reduced damage whenever that Action is selected, even while someone else performs an Action in the meantime. This allows for reactionary damage control and better strategy. Other minor mechanics include: -Hotkeys for the 3 primary Actions in Game (Skills, Guard, Items) which are S (for Skills), D (for Guard) and W (for Items) respectively. -Holding down the A -Key before entering a Cutscene will skip it entirely. (!Does not work during the Cutscene! A -Key must be pressed down before entering!) -Fullscreen can be enabled by simply pressing F5 -Screenratio (1x, 2x, 4x) can be changed with F6. -A Gameshow where you win real (ingame) money! -An Auction where you can spend your real (ingame) money to buy rare Items! -Tired of grinding? With just 5k real (ingame) moneybux, you can just train with Yuugi and get your character to lv30! And more... Also this game has at least 25 endings. I hope you enjoy!

rows.name: Forbidden Escape
rows.short_description: Escape the Exodus, a ship attacked by an encroaching corruption, and embark on a supernatural adventure to explore the various levels of the vessel. Try to survive against dangers and find the solution to challenging puzzles.
rows.description_html: This game requires a controller. We are in the middle of the ocean. Forbidden Escape is a 3rd person puzzle-solving and combat game that mixes supernatural clashes and platforming, on a tanker kept secret from the rest of the world, where scientists experiment on child guinea pigs to harness the supernatural effects of an artifact found at the bottom of the sea.  After nearly a decade of research, something goes wrong and the artifact explodes, spreading an encroaching corruption throughout the entire ship and infecting all of its passengers. You play as Riley, a young guinea pig who seems to be the only one to have survived the infection. Escape the tanker and discover the new powers that lie dormant within you. Explore the various levels of Exodus in linear levels and follow Riley's interesting encounter with Inspeca, the Alien Artifact, as she attempts to escape the only home she has ever known. Characteristics Embark on this supernatural adventure - escape from a secret ship, sinking in the middle of the ocean, while fending off any danger that crosses your path. Platforming - test your agility through perilous paths that will put your skills to the test. Puzzle solving - exercise your brain with challenging and interesting puzzles that force you to use all the resources at your disposal. Brutal Combat - unlock new supernatural abilities to aid you in battles against humans now transformed by the corruption of the artifact. Atmosphere and touching narration - the loneliness seems heavy in this sinking ship as the artifact quietly takes possession of what was once your only home. Find your changed friends and try to free them from this unprecedented infection. This original product was entirely developed by nearly thirty students of the 2021-2022 cohort of the Campus ADN, a public videogame school in downtown Montreal, as part of a 15-week end-of-study production project under the supervision of around ten industry professionals.

rows.name: FRAIM - Survival Rhythm Aim Trainer
rows.short_description: Fraim is a fun survival rhythm aim trainer that makes you improve faster by challenging you to your fullest with difficulties and level overrides. Miss too many targets and it's game over! Focused mostly on fast small adjustment shots which are highly relevant to high-skilled FPS.
rows.description_html: What's FRAIM? FRAIM is a super fun and addicting survival rhythm aim trainer focused mostly on micro-adjustment shots, which are the most important type of shots in a highly competitive first person shooters. Why is it designed that way? The game is played in between two frames. Targets spawn in the back frame and disappear once they get inside the front frame, which creates a sense of hurry. This fact is very important for aim training, as although you try your best to aim as fast as possible in other trainers, you generally won't force yourself to take shots which you don't feel confident in and are crucial for your development. In FRAIM you are forced to challenge yourself for your survival by design . Challenge by design Each track comes in five different difficulties to make sure that you can properly challenge yourself. But what if I'm stuck in between difficulties? You can easily override levels in the game. For instance, if you find that it gets easier to pass 'Hard' levels, but too hard to pass 'Expert' levels, you can choose to play the game as hard but override the targets to be smaller, play it as expert and increase the target size, increase/decrease the frame's surface, and much more. Playing in override mode would not affect your scores, they are simply training wheels to help you get to the next difficulty. Make it feel like your preferred game In the settings menu you can change your game profile. By doing so, you make sure that the FOV and the sensitivity feels exactly like they do in the selected game. Make it yours You can easily design your crosshair through the settings menu

rows.short_description: Mutants: Genesis is an online card game that you can play solo or with up to 3 players in PvE and PvP modes! Join the next generation of Psycogs and climb the ranks to establish yourself as Champion! Collect hundreds of mutants, fashion your own deck, cooperate with or fight other players!
rows.description_html: Mutants: Genesis: Unleash your mutants in the arena. The GCC where maps come to life Immerse yourself in Mutants: Genesis , an explosive online card game where every card comes to life in a vibrant cyberpunk universe. Fast-paced combat, spectacular visuals and high-level strategy: Mutants: Genesis brings card games to life! 🎴 Animated cards for intense battles Each ardc is animated, offering an immersive visual experience inspired by 90s comic books. The battles are fast-paced and visually impressive, turning each duel into a real show. 🧬 Build your deck with unique Mutants Collect over 200 cards spread across 6 distinct genes. Create synergies between Mutants, Support Cards and Buildings to devise winning strategies. 🤝 Cooperate to defeat legendary Bosses Take part in cooperative battles for up to 3 players against powerful Bosses. Complete weekly Time Rifts challenges for exclusive rewards. 🏆  Compete against other players and climb the rankings Engage in competitive PvP duels and progress from Bronze to Champion in dynamic seasons! Adapt your decks with regular balancing updates to stay on top. 🎁 Progress and unlock new cards Earn cards and resources by playing PvP, PvE and completing daily, weekly and monthly challenges! Use these resources to craft new cards and improve your decks. 🌌 A rich and mysterious universe to explore Play as the latest prodigy at an orphanage training future Psycogs, tacticians capable of controlling Mutants. Discover the secrets that lurk in the shadows of this institution and forge your legend in tournaments around the world!Mutants: Genesis takes you through two story arcs that explore the game's universe!
